    "5. Proposer une direction utile sans imposer un formulaire.",
    "6. Expliciter les hypothèses ; ne pas les présenter comme des faits.",
    "7. Renseigner desiredOutcome / initialScope seulement s'ils sont justifiés ou corrigés ce tour.",
    "8. Respecter négations et corrections (nom via proposedProjectName ; réorientation via projectIntention).",
    "9. Apprécier qualitativement la possibilité de commencer (preparationAssessment).",
    "10. Expliquer l'appréciation (preparationAssessmentExplanation) — jamais un GO de création.",
  ].join("\n");

  const agent = new Agent({
    name: "Nora",
    instructions: QUALIFICATION_INSTRUCTIONS,
    model: NORA_STUDY_MODEL,
    modelSettings: {
      reasoning: { effort: policy.effortRequested },
    },
    // Heterogeneous D4 + history + git tool schemas; SDK Tool typing is per-schema.
    tools: tools as ConstructorParameters<typeof Agent>[0]["tools"],
    // Composition visuelle conversationnelle gelée par décision Morris — 19/11/2026.
    // LIVE outputType: soft bounds + strip unknown parameter keys (E05 code retained).
    outputType: E05_VISUAL_COMPOSITION_FROZEN
      ? NoraTurnQualificationLiveOutputSchema
      : NoraTurnQualificationAgentSchema,
  });

  const prompt = buildPrompt(input, policy);
  const maxTurns = maxTurnsForPolicy(policy);
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const wallTimer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), policy.budgets.wallClockMs);

  let streamingAttempted = false;
  let streamingDelivered = false;
  let streamingNotes = "";
  let content = "";
  let qualification: NoraTurnQualification = unavailableQualification("NOT_YET_QUALIFIED");
  let providerContacted: "YES" | "NO" | "UNCERTAIN" = "NO";

  try {
    const attemptId = newAttemptId();
    // Structured qualification never surfaces provisional JSON to the Pilote (A3).
    // Non-stream avoids Agents SDK stream_drain REDACTED schema failures (fp d57214)
    // observed on tool-heavy investigation turns (CampusNova 2026-11-19).
    streamingAttempted = true;
    emitObs({
      event_name: "d3.nora.provider_attempt",
      component: "d3.nora_adapter",
      operation_id: input.toolScope?.operationId,
      generation_id: generationId,
      attempt_id: attemptId,
      outcome: "PARTIAL",
      policy_version: policy.policyVersion,
      profile_type:
        policy.profileType === "TEST_BOUNDARY" ? "TEST_BOUNDARY" : "OPERATIONAL",
      meta: {
        kind: "non_stream",
        maxTurns,
        model_requested: NORA_STUDY_MODEL,
        max_turns_note: "maxTurns≠maxProviderCalls",
        live_output_schema: "plain_omit_visual",
      },
    });

    try {
      // Invoking run() → provider contact becomes at least UNCERTAIN.
      providerContacted = "UNCERTAIN";
      const result = await run(agent, prompt, {
        maxTurns,
        stream: false,
        signal: controller.signal,
      } as unknown as Parameters<typeof run>[2]);

      const maybeResult = result as {
        toTextStream?: (opts?: { compatibleWithNodeStreams?: boolean }) => AsyncIterable<string>;
        finalOutput?: unknown;
        completed?: Promise<unknown>;
      };

      if (maybeResult.finalOutput != null) {
        providerContacted = "YES";
        streamingDelivered = true;
        streamingNotes = "structured_non_stream_finalOutput";
      } else if (maybeResult.completed) {
        await maybeResult.completed;
        providerContacted = "YES";
        streamingDelivered = maybeResult.finalOutput != null;
        streamingNotes = streamingDelivered
          ? "structured_non_stream_after_completed"
          : "structured_non_stream_completed_empty";
      } else {
        streamingNotes = "structured_non_stream_result_shape_unrecognized";
      }

      // Composition visuelle conversationnelle gelée par décision Morris — 19/11/2026.
      const validated = validateNoraTurnQualification(
        stripVisualCompositionForFrozenReplies(maybeResult.finalOutput),
      );
      if (validated.ok) {
        qualification = validated.value;
        content = qualification.replyDraft.trim();
        providerContacted = "YES";
      } else {
        // TV-05: no lexical fallback on invalid structured output.
        qualification = unavailableQualification(validated.reason);
        content = qualification.replyDraft;
        streamingNotes = `${streamingNotes}|QUALIFICATION_${validated.reason}`;
      }

      attempts.push({
        attemptId,
        kind: "non_stream",
        outcome: validated.ok && content ? "SUCCESS" : "UNKNOWN",
        notes: streamingNotes,
        providerContacted,
      });
    } catch (streamErr) {
      const cat = categorizeProviderError(streamErr);
      streamingNotes = cat.category;
      // Once run() was invoked, contact is at best UNCERTAIN — message text is NOT proof of non-send.
      // No automatic second run() after any exception from the first invocation.
      const contact: "YES" | "NO" | "UNCERTAIN" = streamingDelivered
        ? "YES"
        : "UNCERTAIN";
      providerContacted = contact;
      attempts.push({
        attemptId,
        kind: "non_stream",
        outcome: cat.interrupted ? "INTERRUPTED" : "UNKNOWN",
        notes: cat.category,
        providerContacted: contact,
      });

      const toolsUsedOnError =
        policy.budgets.maxD4ToolCalls - initialBudget.remainingCalls;
      const diag = extractProviderErrorDiagnostics(streamErr, {
        phase: streamingDelivered ? "non_stream_after_output" : "non_stream_run",
        streamingDelivered,
        toolCallsObserved: toolsUsedOnError,
      });
      // DEV-only ephemeral forensic dump — never OBS / never RECETTE / never handoff.
      writeEphemeralNoraDiag({
        generationId,
        attemptId,
        phase: diag.error_phase,
        category: cat.category,
        diag,
        err: streamErr,
      });
      emitObs({
        event_name: "d3.nora.provider_attempt",
        component: "d3.nora_adapter",
        operation_id: input.toolScope?.operationId,
        generation_id: generationId,
        attempt_id: attemptId,
        outcome: cat.interrupted ? "INTERRUPTED" : "UNKNOWN",
        error_category: cat.category,
        policy_version: policy.policyVersion,
        profile_type:
          policy.profileType === "TEST_BOUNDARY" ? "TEST_BOUNDARY" : "OPERATIONAL",
        meta: {
          kind: "non_stream",
          model_requested: NORA_STUDY_MODEL,
          provider_contacted: contact,
          error_name: diag.error_name,
          error_name_stable: diag.error_name_stable,
          error_kind: diag.error_kind,
          error_code: diag.error_code,
          http_status: diag.http_status,
          transport_kind: diag.transport_kind,
          error_phase: diag.error_phase,
          streaming_delivered: diag.streaming_delivered,
          cause_depth: diag.cause_depth,
          tool_calls_observed: diag.tool_calls_observed,
          zod_issue_path: diag.zod_issue_path,
          validation_rule_hint: diag.validation_rule_hint,
          msg_fingerprint: diag.msg_fingerprint,
          live_output_schema: "plain_omit_visual",
        },
      });

      const status = cat.interrupted ? ("INTERRUPTED" as const) : ("UNKNOWN" as const);
      return {
        generationId,
        mode: "openai-agents-sdk-live",
        status,
        streamingProvisional: false,
        streamingAttempted,
        streamingDelivered,
        streamingNotes,
        content: `Nora LIVE ${status}: une seule tentative fournisseur — aucune relance automatique après exception. Message utilisateur déjà persisté. Détail technique non exposé.`,
        policy,
        modelRequested: policy.modelRequested,
        modelApplied: null,
        effortRequested: policy.effortRequested,
        effortApplied: null,
        attempts,
        toolCallsObserved: policy.budgets.maxD4ToolCalls - initialBudget.remainingCalls,
        d4CharsReturned: policy.budgets.maxD4CharsReturned - initialBudget.remainingChars,
        qualification: unavailableQualification(cat.category),
      };
    }
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(wallTimer);
  }

  await Promise.all(liveActivityFlushQueue);

  const toolCallsObserved = policy.budgets.maxD4ToolCalls - initialBudget.remainingCalls;
  const d4CharsReturned = policy.budgets.maxD4CharsReturned - initialBudget.remainingChars;

  if (!content || qualification.status === "UNAVAILABLE") {
    return {
      generationId,
      mode: "openai-agents-sdk-live",
      status: "UNKNOWN",
      streamingProvisional: false,
      streamingAttempted,
      streamingDelivered,
      streamingNotes,
      content:
        content ||
        "Réponse Agents SDK vide ou qualification indisponible — état UNKNOWN, aucun effet métier inventé.",
      policy,
      modelRequested: policy.modelRequested,
      modelApplied: null,
      effortRequested: policy.effortRequested,
      effortApplied: null,
      attempts,
      toolCallsObserved,
      d4CharsReturned,
      observedToolSources: sourceJournal.entries.slice(),
      qualification:
        qualification.status === "UNAVAILABLE"
          ? qualification
          : unavailableQualification("EMPTY_OR_INVALID_OUTPUT"),
    };
  }

  return {
    generationId,
    mode: "openai-agents-sdk-live",
    status: "COMPLETE",
    streamingProvisional: false,
    streamingAttempted,
    streamingDelivered,
    streamingNotes,
    content,
    policy,
    modelRequested: policy.modelRequested,
    // Content received ≠ verified model id from provider metadata.
    modelApplied: "UNVERIFIED",
    effortRequested: policy.effortRequested,
    effortApplied: "UNVERIFIED",
    attempts,
    toolCallsObserved,
    d4CharsReturned,
    observedToolSources: sourceJournal.entries.slice(),
    qualification,
  };
}

/**
 * D3 adapter — OpenAI Agents SDK behind this boundary when LIVE key present.
 * NEVER activates MemorySession / ConversationsSession as authority.
 * Critical corrective: no uncertain stream fallback; budgets fail-closed; notes redacted.
 */
function minimalBoundaryPolicy(reasonCode: string): CognitivePolicy {
  // Construct without env resolution — used only for boundary fail envelopes.
  return {
    policyVersion: "ml2-cog-policy-v2-corrective",
    profileType: "TEST_BOUNDARY",
    profile: "simple",
    modelRequested: NORA_STUDY_MODEL,
    effortRequested: "low",
    toolAllowlist: [],
    budgets: {
      maxProviderCalls: 0,
      maxD4ToolCalls: 0,
      maxGitToolCalls: 0,
      wallClockMs: 1_000,
      maxD4CharsReturned: 0,
    },
    reasonCodes: [reasonCode],
  };
}

/**
 * DELIVERED is an observation of this generation, not of the projection.
 * Content may be attached (requested DELIVERED) and still not delivered if
 * generate failed before a fixture or provider body.
 */
function stampCkiDelivery(
  result: NoraGenerateResult,
  requested: string | undefined,
  generateRan: boolean,
): NoraGenerateResult {
  const asked = requested ?? result.ckiDelivery ?? "NONE";
  const ckiDelivery = asked === "DELIVERED" && !generateRan ? "RESOLVED" : asked;
  return { ...result, ckiDelivery };
}

export async function generateNoraReply(input: NoraGenerateInput): Promise<NoraGenerateResult> {
  const generationId = newId("gen");

  // Lane fixture gate before policy — fail closed with a clear category.
  if (noraFixtureFlagsOutsideDev()) {
    return stampCkiDelivery(
      boundaryFail(
        generationId,
        "NORA_FIXTURE_LANE_FORBIDDEN (STUDIO_E2E/FORCE requires STUDIO_LANE=DEV)",
        minimalBoundaryPolicy("NORA_FIXTURE_LANE_FORBIDDEN"),
      ),
      input.ckiDelivery,
      false,
    );
  }

  let policy: CognitivePolicy;
  try {
    policy = input.policyOverride ?? buildCognitivePolicy(input.userText);
  } catch (e) {
    const reason = isStudioError(e) ? e.message : "COG_POLICY_REFUSED";
    return stampCkiDelivery(
      boundaryFail(generationId, reason, minimalBoundaryPolicy("POLICY_RESOLVE_FAILED")),
      input.ckiDelivery,
      false,
    );
  }

  emitObs({
    event_name: "d3.nora.policy_selected",
    component: "d3.nora_adapter",
    operation_id: input.toolScope?.operationId,
    generation_id: generationId,
    policy_version: policy.policyVersion,
    profile_type:
      policy.profileType === "TEST_BOUNDARY" ? "TEST_BOUNDARY" : "OPERATIONAL",
    meta: {
      profile: policy.profile,
      effort: policy.effortRequested,
      model: policy.modelRequested,
      tools: policy.toolAllowlist.join(","),
      profile_type_detail: policy.profileType,
    },
  });

  if (mustUseNoraFixture()) {
    return stampCkiDelivery(await fixtureReply(input, generationId, policy), input.ckiDelivery, true);
  }

  // Level-B: simulated provider finalOutput at the LIVE boundary — still validates via
  // validateNoraTurnQualification and travels the real D3 service path. Never uses
  // fixtureSemanticQualify / UI keys. DEV-only; does not contact the provider.
  // SIM takes precedence over LIVE even when STUDIO_E2E=1 (mustUseNoraFixture already false).
  if (isDevLane() && process.env.STUDIO_NORA_SIMULATED_PROVIDER === "1") {
    const sim = resolveProviderSimulatedQualification(input.userText);
    if (sim) {
      const validated = validateNoraTurnQualification(
        stripVisualCompositionForFrozenReplies(sim),
      );
      const attemptId = newAttemptId();
      if (!validated.ok) {
        const failed = unavailableQualification(validated.reason);
        emitObs({
          event_name: "d3.nora.provider_simulated",
          component: "d3.nora_adapter",
          operation_id: input.toolScope?.operationId,
          generation_id: generationId,
          attempt_id: attemptId,
          outcome: "UNKNOWN",
          policy_version: policy.policyVersion,
          profile_type:
            policy.profileType === "TEST_BOUNDARY" ? "TEST_BOUNDARY" : "OPERATIONAL",
          meta: {
            profile: policy.profile,
            qualification_status: failed.status,
            validation_reason: validated.reason,
            provider_contacted: "NO",
            proof_level: "ADAPTER_FAKE",
          },
        });
        return stampCkiDelivery(
          {
            generationId,
            mode: "provider-simulated",
            status: "UNKNOWN",
            streamingProvisional: false,
            streamingAttempted: false,
            streamingDelivered: false,
            streamingNotes: `SIM_QUALIFICATION_${validated.reason}`,
            content: failed.replyDraft,
            policy,
            modelRequested: policy.modelRequested,
            modelApplied: "provider-simulated",
            effortRequested: policy.effortRequested,
            effortApplied: policy.effortRequested,
            attempts: [
              {
                attemptId,
                kind: "non_stream",
                outcome: "UNKNOWN",
                notes: `SIM_QUALIFICATION_${validated.reason}`,
                providerContacted: "NO",
              },
            ],
            toolCallsObserved: 0,
            d4CharsReturned: 0,
            qualification: failed,
          },
          input.ckiDelivery,
          true,
        );
      }
      emitObs({
        event_name: "d3.nora.provider_simulated",
        component: "d3.nora_adapter",
        operation_id: input.toolScope?.operationId,
        generation_id: generationId,
        attempt_id: attemptId,
        outcome: "SUCCESS",
        policy_version: policy.policyVersion,
        profile_type:
          policy.profileType === "TEST_BOUNDARY" ? "TEST_BOUNDARY" : "OPERATIONAL",
        meta: {
          profile: policy.profile,
          qualification_status: validated.value.status,
          provider_contacted: "NO",
          proof_level: "ADAPTER_FAKE",
          has_visual: Boolean(validated.value.visualComposition),
        },
      });
      return stampCkiDelivery(
        {
          generationId,
          mode: "provider-simulated",
          status: "COMPLETE",
          streamingProvisional: false,
          streamingAttempted: false,
          streamingDelivered: false,
          streamingNotes: "provider_simulated_validated",
          content: validated.value.replyDraft.trim(),
          policy,
          modelRequested: policy.modelRequested,
          modelApplied: "provider-simulated",
          effortRequested: policy.effortRequested,
          effortApplied: policy.effortRequested,
          attempts: [
            {
              attemptId,
              kind: "non_stream",
              outcome: "SUCCESS",
              notes: "provider_simulated_validated",
              providerContacted: "NO",
            },
          ],
          toolCallsObserved: 0,
          d4CharsReturned: 0,
          qualification: validated.value,
        },
        input.ckiDelivery,
        true,
      );
    }
    // Anti-fuite §4.5 — unknown SIM prompt must NEVER fall through to LIVE silently.
    emitObs({
      event_name: "d3.nora.provider_simulated",
      component: "d3.nora_adapter",
      operation_id: input.toolScope?.operationId,
      generation_id: generationId,
      outcome: "FAILED",
      policy_version: policy.policyVersion,
      profile_type:
        policy.profileType === "TEST_BOUNDARY" ? "TEST_BOUNDARY" : "OPERATIONAL",
      meta: {
        profile: policy.profile,
        provider_contacted: "NO",
        proof_level: "ADAPTER_FAKE",
        sim_miss: "NORA_SIM_PROMPT_UNKNOWN",
      },
    });
    return stampCkiDelivery(
      boundaryFail(
        generationId,
        "NORA_SIM_PROMPT_UNKNOWN (STUDIO_NORA_SIMULATED_PROVIDER=1 — no silent LIVE fallback)",
        policy,
      ),
      input.ckiDelivery,
      false,
    );
  }

  const key = process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY?.trim();
  if (!key) {
    if (!isDevLane()) {
      return stampCkiDelivery(
        boundaryFail(
          generationId,
          "NORA_LIVE_KEY_REQUIRED outside DEV (no silent FAKE fallback)",
          policy,
        ),
        input.ckiDelivery,
        false,
      );
    }
    return stampCkiDelivery(await fixtureReply(input, generationId, policy), input.ckiDelivery, true);
  }

  try {
    return stampCkiDelivery(await runLiveWithTools(input, generationId, policy), input.ckiDelivery, true);
  } catch (e) {
    const cat = categorizeProviderError(e);
    return stampCkiDelivery({
      generationId,
      mode: "openai-agents-sdk-live",
      status: cat.interrupted ? "INTERRUPTED" : cat.preContactLikely ? "FAILED" : "UNKNOWN",
      streamingProvisional: false,
      streamingAttempted: true,
      streamingDelivered: false,
      streamingNotes: cat.category,
      content: `Nora LIVE ${cat.interrupted ? "INTERRUPTED" : "UNKNOWN"}: erreur fournisseur catégorisée (${cat.category}). Message utilisateur déjà persisté. Détail technique non exposé.`,
      policy,
      modelRequested: policy.modelRequested,
      modelApplied: null,
      effortRequested: policy.effortRequested,
      effortApplied: null,
      attempts: [
        {
          attemptId: newAttemptId(),
          kind: "non_stream",
          outcome: cat.interrupted ? "INTERRUPTED" : "UNKNOWN",
          notes: cat.category,
          providerContacted: cat.preContactLikely ? "NO" : "UNCERTAIN",
        },
      ],
      toolCallsObserved: 0,
      d4CharsReturned: 0,
      qualification: unavailableQualification(cat.category),
    }, input.ckiDelivery, !cat.preContactLikely);
  }
}

```typescript
/**
 * Deterministic métier restitution after a governed D5/D6 conversational effect.
 * Facts come from Studio (pilotageEffect); Nora prior prose may be adjusted, never invented as authority.
 */

export type PilotageEffectView = {
  attempted?: boolean;
  intentClarity?: string | null;
  operation?: string | null;
  status?: string | null;
  reasonCode?: string | null;
  reason?: string | null;
  clarification?: string | null;
  decisionId?: string | null;
  effects?: Array<{ effectKind?: string; targetRef?: string }> | null;
} | null;

const PRE_EFFECT_PENDING =
  /l['']ouverture effective reste à confirmer par Studio\.?/gi;

function operationLabel(op: string | null | undefined): string {
  switch (op) {
    case "OPEN_CYCLE":
      return "ouverture de cycle";
    case "CLOSE_CYCLE":
      return "clôture de cycle";
    case "TRANSITION_CYCLE":
      return "transition de cycle";
    case "RETAIN_TRAJECTORY":
      return "rétention de trajectoire";
    case "PROPOSE_TRAJECTORY":
      return "proposition de trajectoire";
    case "RECORD_DECISION":
      return "enregistrement de décision";
    case "REVISE_DECISION":
      return "révision de décision";
    default:
      return op ? `opération ${op}` : "opération gouvernée";
  }
}

function stripPreEffectHedges(text: string): string {
  return text
    .replace(PRE_EFFECT_PENDING, "")
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
    .trim();
}

function effectFactLines(effect: NonNullable<PilotageEffectView>): string[] {
  const op = operationLabel(effect.operation);
  const status = (effect.status ?? "").toUpperCase();
  const reason = (effect.reason ?? effect.clarification ?? "").trim();

  switch (status) {
    case "APPLIED":
      return [
        `**Résultat Studio :** la ${op} a été **appliquée**.`,
        effect.operation === "OPEN_CYCLE"
          ? "Le cycle demandé est désormais actif ; la guidance spécialisée associée sera disponible sur Trajectoire / CKI."
          : effect.operation === "RETAIN_TRAJECTORY"
            ? "L'orientation est retenue. L'ouverture d'un cycle reste une décision distincte."
            : "L'état du projet a été mis à jour en conséquence.",
      ];
    case "ALREADY_APPLIED":
      return [
        `**Résultat Studio :** cette ${op} était **déjà appliquée** — aucun nouvel effet n'a été créé.`,
      ];
    case "REJECTED":
      return [
        `**Résultat Studio :** la ${op} a été **refusée**.`,
        reason
          ? `Motif : ${reason}.`
          : "Le contrôle d'autorité ou d'état n'a pas autorisé l'effet.",
        "Aucun cycle ni décision n'a été créé par cette demande. Vous pouvez reformuler ou préciser le type de cycle reconnu.",
      ];
    case "CONFLICT":
      return [
        `**Résultat Studio :** **conflit d'état** sur la ${op}.`,
        reason ? `Détail : ${reason}.` : "Rechargez l'état du projet puis réessayez si pertinent.",
      ];
    case "UNKNOWN":
      return [
        `**Résultat Studio :** l'issue de la ${op} est **encore en vérification**.`,
        "Je ne confirme ni le succès ni le refus définitif tant que Studio n'a pas consolidé l'état.",
      ];
    default:
      if (effect.intentClarity === "AMBIGUOUS") {
        return [
          "**Résultat Studio :** aucune commande n'a été exécutée — intention ambiguë.",
          reason ? `Précision utile : ${reason}.` : "Pouvez-vous préciser le cycle et l'acte souhaités ?",
        ];
      }
      if (effect.attempted === false) {
        return [];
      }
      return [
        `**Résultat Studio :** statut « ${status || "indéterminé"} » pour la ${op}.`,
        reason ? `Information : ${reason}.` : "",
      ].filter(Boolean);
  }
}

/**
 * Compose final assistant text: keep useful prior narrative, remove contradictory
 * pre-effect hedges, append durable Studio outcome in métier language.
 */
export function composePilotageEffectRestitution(input: {
  priorContent: string;
  effect: PilotageEffectView;
}): string {
  const prior = stripPreEffectHedges(input.priorContent ?? "");
  const effect = input.effect;
  if (!effect?.attempted) {
    return prior;
  }
  const facts = effectFactLines(effect);
  if (facts.length === 0) return prior;
  const block = ["", "---", "", ...facts].join("\n");
  if (!prior.trim()) return facts.join("\n");
  return `${prior.trimEnd()}\n${block}`;
}

/** True when a persisted assistant message is a raw technical mission dump (not métier Nora). */
export function isTechnicalMissionAssistantContent(content: string, generationId?: string | null): boolean {
  // Provenance hint alone is insufficient — a mission-continue may already carry métier D4 ACK.
  // E08 — publication effect restitution is Nora métier voice; do not mask it as technical dump.
  if (
    /Résultat d'enregistrement|Nouvelle version disponible|encore incertain/i.test(content) ||
    /a été publié|n'a pas été effectuée|Aucune publication n'a (été|été)|écritures GitHub ne sont pas disponibles|encore en vérification/i.test(
      content,
    )
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  if (/^### Suite de mission/m.test(content) && /projectId=|clientIntentKey=|status=COMPLETED/.test(content)) {
    return true;
  }
  if (/^### Suite de mission \(projection D3/m.test(content)) return true;
  if (/^### Restitution de mission \(faits propriétaires\)/m.test(content)) return true;
  const gen = (generationId ?? "").trim();
  if (
    gen.startsWith("mission-continue") &&
    /projectId=proj_|clientIntentKey=|status=COMPLETED|status=AWAITING_/.test(content)
  ) {
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** Métier projection for historical technical mission messages (READ path — no DB rewrite). */
export function projectMetierMissionMessage(content: string): string {
  if (/Projet créé \(projectId=/.test(content) || /projectId=proj_/.test(content)) {
    return (
      "Le projet a bien été créé. Vous pouvez poursuivre dans Travail, consulter la Trajectoire " +
      "et décider avec Nora de l'ouverture du premier cycle lorsque vous serez prêt."
    );
  }
  if (/AWAITING_PILOT_ACT/.test(content)) {
    return "Une action explicite de votre part est encore requise pour poursuivre (par exemple créer le projet).";
  }
  if (/AWAITING_PILOT_AUTH/.test(content)) {
    return "Une autorisation de votre part est requise avant publication Git.";
  }
  if (/AWAITING_CLARIFICATION/.test(content)) {
    return "Une précision de votre part est requise avant de poursuivre la préparation.";
  }
  if (/RESTITUTION_PENDING/.test(content)) {
    return "Les effets déjà enregistrés sont conservés ; la restitution détaillée reste en attente.";
  }
  return "Suite de mission enregistrée par Studio — détails techniques masqués dans le fil métier.";
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Level-B provider-simulated qualifications — DEV only.
 *
 * These envelopes mimic a structured LIVE finalOutput. They MUST go through
 * `validateNoraTurnQualification` and the real D3 service path
 * (`postUserMessageAndNora` → stash → turnProjection → commit → reload).
 *
 * Distinct from UI-key fixtures (`fixtureSemanticQualify` / STUDIO_FORCE_NORA_FIXTURE).
 * Activated only via `STUDIO_NORA_SIMULATED_PROVIDER=1` + `STUDIO_LANE=DEV`.
 */

import type { NoraTurnQualification } from "./semantic-qualification";

export const NORA_SIM_PROVIDER_MODE = "provider-simulated" as const;

function base(partial: Partial<NoraTurnQualification> & Pick<NoraTurnQualification, "replyDraft">): NoraTurnQualification {
  const goal = partial.goal ?? "Demande Pilote (simulation fournisseur)";
  const defaultIntent = {
    id: "sim-i1",
    capabilityId: "d3.converse" as const,
    mode: "EXPLAIN" as const,
    summary: goal,
    parameters: {},
    constraints: ["NO_EFFECT", "PROVIDER_SIMULATED", "ADAPTER_FAKE"],
    dependsOn: [] as string[],
    sourceEvidence: [] as string[],
  };
  return {
    schemaVersion: "ml4c-sem-qual-v1",
    status: "QUALIFIED",
    projectIntention: "",
    desiredOutcome: "",
    initialScope: "",
    proposedProjectName: "",
    clarifications: [],
    ...partial,
    goal,
    replyDraft: partial.replyDraft,
    intents: partial.intents?.length ? partial.intents : [defaultIntent],
  };
}

/**
 * Resolve a provider-simulated qualification by exact natural prompt.
 * Returns null when the utterance is not part of the Level-B corpus.
 */
export function resolveProviderSimulatedQualification(
  userText: string,
): NoraTurnQualification | null {
  const key = userText.trim();
  return SCENARIOS[key] ?? null;
}

export function listProviderSimulatedPrompts(): string[] {
  return Object.keys(SCENARIOS);
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Resolve an existing Studio document/revision for a publication mission.
 *
 * Precedence (POST-UAT convergence):
 *   1. Explicit Pilote / durable qual reference (documentHint, objectRef, revision)
 *   2. Same-turn D4 AVAILABLE — only if compatible with explicit ref
 *   3. UI documentFocus — only if compatible with explicit ref
 *   4. Sole available document (no explicit ref)
 *
 * Never invents ids. Never silently keeps focus A when Pilote asked for B.
 */
import { resolveReviseTarget, type DocumentListItem } from "./document-act";
import { getDocumentRevision, listDocumentRevisions } from "@/domains/document/service";

export type PublicationDocumentTarget =
  | {
      ok: true;
      documentId: string;
      revisionId: string | null;
      revisionNumber: number | null;
      requestedRevisionNumber: number | null;
      title: string;
      source:
        | "explicit"
        | "same_turn_d4"
        | "document_focus"
        | "hint"
        | "sole_document";
      /** True when an explicit ref overrode focus or same-turn. */
      overriddenImplicit: boolean;
    }
  | {
      ok: false;
      reason:
        | "NO_DOCUMENT"
        | "AMBIGUOUS"
        | "NOT_FOUND"
        | "NO_AVAILABLE_REVISION"
        | "EXPLICIT_FOCUS_CONFLICT"
        | "REVISION_MISMATCH"
        | "REVISION_NOT_FOUND"
        | "FORBIDDEN";
      candidates?: string[];
      detail?: string;
    };

export type SameTurnDocumentEffect = {
  status: string;
  documentId?: string | null;
  revisionId?: string | null;
  revisionNumber?: number | null;
  title?: string | null;
} | null;

export type PublicationDocumentFocus = {
  documentId: string;
  sourceRevisionId: string;
  sourceRevisionNumber?: number;
  observedHeadRevisionId?: string;
} | null;

function parseDocumentId(raw: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  const m = raw.match(/\b(doc_[a-z0-9-]+)\b/i);
  return m?.[1] ?? null;
}

function parseRevisionId(raw: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  const m = raw.match(/\b(drev_[a-z0-9-]+)\b/i);
  return m?.[1] ?? null;
}

/** Parse « v2 », « révision 2 », « revision: 2 » from durable hint text. */
export function parseRevisionNumberHint(raw: string | null | undefined): number | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  const m =
    raw.match(/\b(?:révision|revision)\s*[:=]?\s*(\d+)\b/i) ||
    raw.match(/\bv(?:ersion)?\s*[:=]?\s*(\d+)\b/i) ||
    raw.match(/\bv(\d+)\b/i);
  if (!m?.[1]) return null;
  const n = Number(m[1]);
  return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? Math.trunc(n) : null;
}

function titleNeedle(hint: string): string {
  return hint
    .replace(/\b(?:révision|revision)\s*[:=]?\s*\d+\b/gi, " ")
    .replace(/\bv(?:ersion)?\s*[:=]?\s*\d+\b/gi, " ")
    .replace(/\bv\d+\b/gi, " ")
    .replace(/\b(doc|drev)_[a-z0-9-]+\b/gi, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

function findByTitle(
  docs: DocumentListItem[],
  hint: string,
): { ok: true; doc: DocumentListItem } | { ok: false; reason: "AMBIGUOUS" | "NOT_FOUND"; candidates?: string[] } {
  const available = docs.filter((d) => d.latestRevision?.status === "AVAILABLE");
  const needle = titleNeedle(hint).toLowerCase();
  if (!needle) return { ok: false, reason: "NOT_FOUND" };
  const matches = available.filter((d) => {
    const t = d.document.title.toLowerCase();
    return t === needle || t.includes(needle) || needle.includes(t);
  });
  if (matches.length === 1) return { ok: true, doc: matches[0]! };
  if (matches.length > 1) {
    return { ok: false, reason: "AMBIGUOUS", candidates: matches.map((d) => d.document.id) };
  }
  return { ok: false, reason: "NOT_FOUND" };
}

function hasExplicitDocumentSignal(input: {
  documentHint: string | null;
  objectRef: string | null;
}): boolean {
  if (parseDocumentId(input.objectRef) || parseDocumentId(input.documentHint)) return true;
  if (input.objectRef?.trim()) return true;
  const hint = input.documentHint?.trim();
  if (!hint) return false;
  // Pure revision token is not a document signal.
  if (/^(?:v|révision|revision)\s*[:=]?\s*\d+$/i.test(hint)) return false;
  return titleNeedle(hint).length > 0;
}

/**
 * Resolve one independent explicit field (objectRef or documentHint) to a document.
 * Does not fall back across fields — callers reconcile conflicts.
 */
function resolveOneExplicitField(
  field: string | null | undefined,
  docs: DocumentListItem[],
  available: DocumentListItem[],
  detailTag: string,
):
  | { kind: "none" }
  | { kind: "doc"; doc: DocumentListItem }
  | { kind: "fail"; target: PublicationDocumentTarget } {
  const raw = field?.trim() || "";
  if (!raw) return { kind: "none" };

  const docId = parseDocumentId(raw);
  if (docId) {
    const hit = available.find((d) => d.document.id === docId);
    if (!hit) {
      return {
        kind: "fail",
        target: { ok: false, reason: "NOT_FOUND", detail: `${detailTag}_DOCUMENT_ID` },
      };
    }
    return { kind: "doc", doc: hit };
  }

  // Revision-only field does not select a document by itself.
  if (parseRevisionId(raw) && !hasExplicitDocumentSignal({ documentHint: raw, objectRef: null })) {
    return { kind: "none" };
  }

  if (!hasExplicitDocumentSignal({ documentHint: raw, objectRef: null })) {
    return { kind: "none" };
  }

  const byTitle = findByTitle(docs, raw);
  if (!byTitle.ok) {
    return {
      kind: "fail",
      target: {
        ok: false,
        reason: byTitle.reason,
        candidates: "candidates" in byTitle ? byTitle.candidates : undefined,
        detail: `${detailTag}_TITLE`,
      },
    };
  }
  return { kind: "doc", doc: byTitle.doc };
}

/**
 * Synchronous identity resolution from list payload + hints.
 * Independent explicit refs (objectRef vs documentHint) are reconciled —
 * no arbitrary `||` between contradictory fields.
 * Revision by number may leave revisionId null until D4 confirm.
 */
export function resolvePublicationDocumentTarget(input: {
  sameTurnEffect: SameTurnDocumentEffect;
  docs: DocumentListItem[];
  documentHint: string | null;
  objectRef: string | null;
  focus: PublicationDocumentFocus;
  revisionNumberHint?: number | null;
}): PublicationDocumentTarget {
  const available = input.docs.filter((d) => d.latestRevision?.status === "AVAILABLE");

  const objectDocId = parseDocumentId(input.objectRef);
  const hintDocId = parseDocumentId(input.documentHint);
  if (objectDocId && hintDocId && objectDocId !== hintDocId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: "AMBIGUOUS",
      detail: "EXPLICIT_REF_CONFLICT_DOCUMENT_ID",
    };
  }

  const objectRevId = parseRevisionId(input.objectRef);
  const hintRevId = parseRevisionId(input.documentHint);
  if (objectRevId && hintRevId && objectRevId !== hintRevId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: "REVISION_MISMATCH",
      detail: "EXPLICIT_REF_CONFLICT_REVISION_ID",
    };
  }

  const objectRevNum = parseRevisionNumberHint(input.objectRef);
  const hintRevNum = parseRevisionNumberHint(input.documentHint);
  if (
    objectRevNum != null &&
    hintRevNum != null &&
    objectRevNum !== hintRevNum
  ) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: "REVISION_MISMATCH",
      detail: "EXPLICIT_REF_CONFLICT_REVISION_NUMBER",
    };
  }

  const requestedRevisionNumber =
    input.revisionNumberHint ?? hintRevNum ?? objectRevNum;
  const explicitRevId = objectRevId || hintRevId;

  const fromObject = resolveOneExplicitField(
    input.objectRef,
    input.docs,
    available,
    "OBJECT_REF",
  );
  if (fromObject.kind === "fail") return fromObject.target;

  const fromHint = resolveOneExplicitField(
    input.documentHint,
    input.docs,
    available,
    "DOCUMENT_HINT",
  );
  if (fromHint.kind === "fail") return fromHint.target;

  if (
    fromObject.kind === "doc" &&
    fromHint.kind === "doc" &&
    fromObject.doc.document.id !== fromHint.doc.document.id
  ) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: "AMBIGUOUS",
      detail: "EXPLICIT_REF_CONFLICT",
      candidates: [
        fromObject.doc.document.title,
        fromHint.doc.document.title,
      ],
    };
  }

  const explicitDoc =
    fromObject.kind === "doc"
      ? fromObject.doc
      : fromHint.kind === "doc"
        ? fromHint.doc
        : null;

  if (explicitDoc) {
    const focusConflict =
      input.focus?.documentId && input.focus.documentId !== explicitDoc.document.id;
    const sameTurnConflict =
      input.sameTurnEffect?.status === "AVAILABLE" &&
      input.sameTurnEffect.documentId &&
      input.sameTurnEffect.documentId !== explicitDoc.document.id;

    // Focus / same-turn never win against an explicit incompatible document.
    void focusConflict;
    void sameTurnConflict;

    let revisionId: string | null = explicitRevId;
    let revisionNumber: number | null = requestedRevisionNumber;

    if (
      !revisionId &&
      !requestedRevisionNumber &&
      input.focus?.documentId === explicitDoc.document.id &&
      input.focus.sourceRevisionId
    ) {
      revisionId = input.focus.sourceRevisionId;
      revisionNumber = input.focus.sourceRevisionNumber ?? null;
    }

    if (
      !revisionId &&
      !requestedRevisionNumber &&
      input.sameTurnEffect?.status === "AVAILABLE" &&
      input.sameTurnEffect.documentId === explicitDoc.document.id &&
      input.sameTurnEffect.revisionId
    ) {
      revisionId = input.sameTurnEffect.revisionId;
      revisionNumber = input.sameTurnEffect.revisionNumber ?? null;
    }

    if (!revisionId && !requestedRevisionNumber && explicitDoc.latestRevision) {
      revisionId = explicitDoc.latestRevision.id;
      revisionNumber = explicitDoc.latestRevision.revisionNumber;
    }

    return {
      ok: true,
      documentId: explicitDoc.document.id,
      revisionId,
      revisionNumber,
      requestedRevisionNumber,
      title: explicitDoc.document.title,
      source: "explicit",
      overriddenImplicit: Boolean(focusConflict || sameTurnConflict),
    };
  }

  // No explicit document — same-turn D4 CREATE/REVISE.
  const effect = input.sameTurnEffect;
  if (effect?.status === "AVAILABLE" && effect.documentId && effect.revisionId) {
    if (
      requestedRevisionNumber != null &&
      effect.revisionNumber != null &&
      effect.revisionNumber !== requestedRevisionNumber
    ) {
      // Same document identity unknown without list — try list match.
      const d = available.find((x) => x.document.id === effect.documentId);
      if (d) {
        return {
          ok: true,
          documentId: d.document.id,
          revisionId: null,
          revisionNumber: requestedRevisionNumber,
          requestedRevisionNumber,
          title: d.document.title,
          source: "explicit",
          overriddenImplicit: true,
        };
      }
      return {
        ok: false,
        reason: "REVISION_MISMATCH",
        detail: "SAME_TURN_VS_REQUESTED_REVISION",
      };
    }
    return {
      ok: true,
      documentId: effect.documentId,
      revisionId: effect.revisionId,
      revisionNumber: effect.revisionNumber ?? null,
      requestedRevisionNumber,
      title: effect.title?.trim() || effect.documentId,
      source: "same_turn_d4",
      overriddenImplicit: false,
    };
  }

  // Focus — only without conflicting explicit document (already handled).
  if (input.focus?.documentId && input.focus.sourceRevisionId) {
    const d = available.find((x) => x.document.id === input.focus!.documentId);
    if (!d) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "NOT_FOUND", detail: "FOCUS_DOCUMENT" };
    }
    if (requestedRevisionNumber != null) {
      const focusNum = input.focus.sourceRevisionNumber;
      if (focusNum != null && focusNum !== requestedRevisionNumber) {
        return {
          ok: true,
          documentId: d.document.id,
          revisionId: null,
          revisionNumber: requestedRevisionNumber,
          requestedRevisionNumber,
          title: d.document.title,
          source: "explicit",
          overriddenImplicit: true,
        };
      }
    }
    return {
      ok: true,
      documentId: d.document.id,
      revisionId: input.focus.sourceRevisionId,
      revisionNumber:
        input.focus.sourceRevisionNumber ?? d.latestRevision?.revisionNumber ?? null,
      requestedRevisionNumber,
      title: d.document.title,
      source: "document_focus",
      overriddenImplicit: false,
    };
  }

  // Soft hint without "explicit signal" already handled — use resolveReviseTarget for sole/hint.
  const hint = input.documentHint?.trim() || null;
  const resolved = resolveReviseTarget(input.docs, hint, null);
  if (!resolved.ok) {
    const reason =
      resolved.reason === "AMBIGUOUS" ||
      resolved.reason === "NO_AVAILABLE_REVISION" ||
      resolved.reason === "NOT_FOUND"
        ? resolved.reason
        : "NOT_FOUND";
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason,
      candidates: "candidates" in resolved ? resolved.candidates : undefined,
    };
  }

  if (requestedRevisionNumber != null && resolved.baseRevisionNumber !== requestedRevisionNumber) {
    return {
      ok: true,
      documentId: resolved.documentId,
      revisionId: null,
      revisionNumber: requestedRevisionNumber,
      requestedRevisionNumber,
      title: resolved.title,
      source: hint ? "hint" : "sole_document",
      overriddenImplicit: true,
    };
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    documentId: resolved.documentId,
    revisionId: resolved.baseRevisionId,
    revisionNumber: resolved.baseRevisionNumber,
    requestedRevisionNumber,
    title: resolved.title,
    source: hint ? "hint" : "sole_document",
    overriddenImplicit: false,
  };
}

/**
 * D4 owner confirmation before D7 prepare.
 * Verifies pilot/project ownership, revision membership, AVAILABLE status.
 */
export async function confirmPublicationDocumentWithD4(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  preparationId: string;
  target: Extract<PublicationDocumentTarget, { ok: true }>;
}): Promise<PublicationDocumentTarget> {
  const { pilotId, preparationId, target } = input;

  if (target.revisionId) {
    const loaded = await getDocumentRevision(
      pilotId,
      preparationId,
      target.documentId,
      target.revisionId,
    );
    if (loaded.status === "FORBIDDEN") {
      return { ok: false, reason: "FORBIDDEN", detail: "DOCUMENT_OR_REVISION" };
    }
    if (loaded.status === "NOT_FOUND") {
      return { ok: false, reason: "REVISION_NOT_FOUND", detail: "REVISION_ID" };
    }
    if (loaded.status !== "AVAILABLE" || !("revision" in loaded) || !loaded.revision) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        reason: "NO_AVAILABLE_REVISION",
        detail: String(loaded.status),
      };
    }
    if (loaded.revision.documentId && loaded.revision.documentId !== target.documentId) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "REVISION_MISMATCH", detail: "REVISION_BELONGS_OTHER_DOC" };
    }
    // getDocumentRevision already scopes revisionId+documentId.
    if (
      target.requestedRevisionNumber != null &&
      loaded.revision.revisionNumber !== target.requestedRevisionNumber
    ) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        reason: "REVISION_MISMATCH",
        detail: `REQUESTED_V${target.requestedRevisionNumber}_GOT_V${loaded.revision.revisionNumber}`,
      };
    }
    return {
      ...target,
      revisionId: loaded.revision.id,
      revisionNumber: loaded.revision.revisionNumber,
      title: loaded.document?.title ?? target.title,
    };
  }

  if (target.requestedRevisionNumber != null || target.revisionNumber != null) {
    const want = target.requestedRevisionNumber ?? target.revisionNumber!;
    const listed = await listDocumentRevisions(pilotId, preparationId, target.documentId);
    if (listed.status === "FORBIDDEN") {
      return { ok: false, reason: "FORBIDDEN", detail: "DOCUMENT" };
    }
    const match = listed.revisions.find(
      (r) => r.revisionNumber === want && r.status === "AVAILABLE",
    );
    if (!match) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        reason: "REVISION_NOT_FOUND",
        detail: `V${want}`,
      };
    }
    return {
      ...target,
      revisionId: match.id,
      revisionNumber: match.revisionNumber,
      title: listed.document?.title ?? target.title,
    };
  }

  return {
    ok: false,
    reason: "NO_AVAILABLE_REVISION",
    detail: "MISSING_REVISION_IDENTITY",
  };
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Terminal métier restitution after a governed publication attempt.
 *
 * Produces ONE coherent pilot-facing state — not a pre-effect narrative
 * contradicted by an appended Studio block.
 * Never invents COMPLETED without owner facts. UNKNOWN stays non-terminal.
 */

export type PublicationEffectOutcome =
  | "COMPLETED"
  | "REFUSED_WRITE_DISABLED"
  | "REFUSED_AUTHORITY"
  | "AWAITING_CLARIFICATION"
  | "PREPARED_AWAITING_AUTH"
  | "DISPATCH_FAILED"
  | "NOT_ATTEMPTED"
  | "UNKNOWN";

export type PublicationEffectView = {
  attempted: boolean;
  outcome: PublicationEffectOutcome;
  reason?: string | null;
  documentTitle?: string | null;
  revisionNumber?: number | null;
  repositoryFullName?: string | null;
  publicationBranch?: string | null;
  /** Documentary path on the remote (owner plan / D8). */
  targetPath?: string | null;
  /** Base branch of the publication plan (usually main) — not the publication branch. */
  baseBranch?: string | null;
  commitSha?: string | null;
  prNumber?: number | null;
  prUrl?: string | null;
  fileUrl?: string | null;
  /** True only when a MERGE D8 fact exists — never inferred from PR_OPEN. */
  mergeObserved?: boolean;
  attemptId?: string | null;
  decisionId?: string | null;
} | null;

const PRE_EFFECT_PUBLICATION_HEDGES = [
  /la publication reste à confirmer par Studio\.?/gi,
  /l['']effet Git reste à confirmer par Studio\.?/gi,
  /reste à confirmer par Studio\.?/gi,
];

/** Premature success / action claims that contradict a non-COMPLETED outcome. */
const PREMATURE_SUCCESS_CLAIMS = [
  /\bje (?:vais )?publie(?:r)?\b[^.!?\n]{0,120}/gi,
  /\bla publication (?:est|a été|sera) (?:effectuée|réalisée|faite|lancée)\b[^.!?\n]{0,80}/gi,
  /\b(?:document|révision)[^.!?\n]{0,80}\b(?:publié|publiée|publiés)\b[^.!?\n]{0,80}/gi,
  /\bj['']ai publié\b[^.!?\n]{0,120}/gi,
  /\bpublication (?:sur|dans) (?:GitHub|le dépôt)\b[^.!?\n]{0,80}/gi,
];

export function stripPublicationPreEffectHedges(text: string): string {
  let out = text ?? "";
  for (const re of PRE_EFFECT_PUBLICATION_HEDGES) {
    out = out.replace(re, "");
  }
  return out.replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n").trim();
}

function stripPrematureSuccessClaims(text: string): string {
  let out = text ?? "";
  for (const re of PREMATURE_SUCCESS_CLAIMS) {
    out = out.replace(re, "");
  }
  return out.replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n").trim();
}

function docLabel(effect: NonNullable<PublicationEffectView>): string {
  const title = effect.documentTitle?.trim();
  if (title && effect.revisionNumber != null) {
    return `« ${title} », révision ${effect.revisionNumber}`;
  }
  if (title) return `« ${title} »`;
  if (effect.revisionNumber != null) return `révision ${effect.revisionNumber}`;
  return "le document";
}

/**
 * Single coherent terminal message for the Pilote.
 * When a Studio outcome is known, prefer a fact-based body and only keep
 * prior prose that does not contradict it (clarifications, caveats).
 */
export function composePublicationEffectRestitution(input: {
  priorContent: string;
  effect: PublicationEffectView;
}): string {
  const effect = input.effect;
  let prior = stripPublicationPreEffectHedges(input.priorContent ?? "");

  if (!effect?.attempted) {
    // Recognized publish intent with no owner attempt: never leave success claims.
    return stripPrematureSuccessClaims(prior);
  }

  // Non-success outcomes must not retain premature success narration.
  if (effect.outcome !== "COMPLETED") {
    prior = stripPrematureSuccessClaims(prior);
  }

  const facts = terminalFacts(effect);
  if (facts.length === 0) return prior;

  // Prefer a single coherent answer: facts first, then optional non-contradicting prior.
  const factBlock = facts.join("\n");
  if (!prior.trim()) return factBlock;

  // Keep prior only when it still adds clarification context (short remainder).
  const priorTrim = prior.trim();
  if (priorTrim.length < 40) {
    return `${factBlock}\n\n${priorTrim}`;
  }
  // Avoid stacking a long contradicted draft: return facts as the terminal voice.
  return factBlock;
}

function terminalFacts(effect: NonNullable<PublicationEffectView>): string[] {
  const reason = (effect.reason ?? "").trim();
  const repo = effect.repositoryFullName?.trim();
  const branch = effect.publicationBranch?.trim();
  const doc = docLabel(effect);

  switch (effect.outcome) {
    case "COMPLETED": {
      const path = effect.targetPath?.trim();
      const sha = effect.commitSha?.trim();
      const prNumber = effect.prNumber;
      const prUrl = effect.prUrl?.trim();
      const fileUrl = effect.fileUrl?.trim();
      const base = effect.baseBranch?.trim();
      const lines = [
        `Le document ${doc} a été publié` +
          (repo ? ` dans le dépôt \`${repo}\`` : "") +
          (branch ? `, sur la branche \`${branch}\`` : "") +
          (path ? `, chemin \`${path}\`` : "") +
          ".",
      ];
      if (sha) {
        lines.push(`Commit : \`${sha}\`.`);
      }
      if (fileUrl) {
        lines.push(`Fichier : ${fileUrl}`);
      } else if (repo && branch && path) {
        lines.push(
          `Fichier (branche) : https://github.com/${repo}/blob/${branch}/${path}`,
        );
      }
      if (prNumber != null) {
        lines.push(
          prUrl
            ? `Demande de fusion : PR #${prNumber} — ${prUrl}`
            : `Demande de fusion : PR #${prNumber}.`,
        );
      }
      if (effect.mergeObserved === true) {
        lines.push(
          base
            ? `Une fusion vers \`${base}\` a été observée (fait Studio).`
            : "Une fusion a été observée (fait Studio).",
        );
      } else {
        lines.push(
          base
            ? `Aucune fusion vers \`${base}\` n'a été effectuée.`
            : "Aucune fusion n'a été effectuée.",
        );
      }
      return lines;
    }
    case "REFUSED_WRITE_DISABLED":
      return [
        "La publication n'a pas été effectuée.",
        "Les écritures GitHub ne sont pas disponibles dans cet environnement.",
        "Aucune branche, commit ni demande de fusion n'a été créé.",
      ];
    case "REFUSED_AUTHORITY":
      return [
        "La publication n'a pas été effectuée.",
        reason
          ? `Motif : ${reason}.`
          : "L'autorisation ou les permissions n'ont pas permis l'effet.",
        "Aucun dépôt distant n'a été modifié.",
      ];
    case "AWAITING_CLARIFICATION":
      return [
        "Aucune publication n'a été lancée.",
        reason
          ? `Précision nécessaire : ${reason}`
          : "Une précision est encore nécessaire avant de poursuivre.",
      ];
    case "PREPARED_AWAITING_AUTH":
      return [
        "Une préparation de publication est disponible.",
        "L'effet distant n'a pas encore été exécuté.",
        reason ? `Détail : ${reason}.` : "",
      ].filter(Boolean);
    case "DISPATCH_FAILED":
      return [
        "La publication n'a pas abouti.",
        reason ? `Motif : ${reason}.` : "Échec au moment de l'effet distant.",
        "Aucun succès n'est affirmé sans preuve Studio.",
      ];
    case "NOT_ATTEMPTED":
      return [
        "Aucune publication n'a été tentée pour cette demande.",
        reason ? `Motif : ${reason}.` : "",
      ].filter(Boolean);
    case "UNKNOWN":
    default:
      return [
        "L'issue de la publication est encore en vérification.",
        "Je ne confirme ni le succès ni le refus définitif tant que Studio n'a pas consolidé l'état.",
        "La mission reste ouverte pour reprise — aucun nouvel effet n'est relancé automatiquement.",
        reason ? `Information : ${reason}.` : "",
      ].filter(Boolean);
  }
}

export function publicationWriteGate():
  | { allowed: true }
  | { allowed: false; reason: string } {
  const mode = (process.env.STUDIO_GITHUB_PROVIDER ?? "scripted").toLowerCase();
  if (mode !== "real") return { allowed: true };
  const flag = (process.env.STUDIO_GITHUB_ALLOW_MUTATIONS ?? "").toLowerCase().trim();
  if (flag !== "documentary") {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      reason:
        "STUDIO_GITHUB_ALLOW_MUTATIONS≠documentary — écritures GitHub REAL désactivées",
    };
  }
  // READ allowlist never implies WRITE — empty WRITE list keeps mutations OFF.
  const writeList = (process.env.GITHUB_APP_WRITE_ALLOWED_REPOS ?? "")
    .split(",")
    .map((s) => s.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);
  if (writeList.length === 0) {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      reason:
        "GITHUB_APP_WRITE_ALLOWED_REPOS vide — aucune cible WRITE REAL éligible",
    };
  }
  return { allowed: true };
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Hydrate PublicationEffectView from D7/D8 owner payloads — never from LLM prose.
 * Used for same-turn restitution and follow-up verification context.
 */

import { and, desc, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import {
  authorizedRepositories,
  documentPublicationRefs,
  effectAttempts,
  observedGitFacts,

import { buildGitFilePermalink } from "@/domains/integrations/resource-service";
import type {
  PublicationEffectOutcome,
  PublicationEffectView,
} from "./publication-effect-restitution";

export type OwnerPublicationPlan = {
  documentTitle?: string | null;
  revisionNumber?: number | null;
  repositoryFullName?: string | null;

export type OwnerPublicationResult = {

    prOpened?: boolean;

};

export function parseOwnerJson<T>(raw: string | null | undefined): T {

}

/**
 * Pure merge of plan + result (+ optional PR htmlUrl) into a COMPLETED/UNKNOWN view.

export function buildPublicationEffectViewFromOwnerPayload(input: {
  outcome: PublicationEffectOutcome;
  attemptId: string;
  decisionId?: string | null;
  reason?: string | null;
  documentTitle?: string | null;
  revisionNumber?: number | null;
  plan: OwnerPublicationPlan;
  result: OwnerPublicationResult;
  prHtmlUrl?: string | null;
  mergeObserved?: boolean;
}): NonNullable<PublicationEffectView> {
  const repo =
    input.result.repositoryFullName?.trim() ||
    input.plan.repositoryFullName?.trim() ||
    null;
  const branch =
    input.result.publicationBranch?.trim() ||
    input.plan.publicationBranch?.trim() ||
    null;
  const path = input.plan.targetPath?.trim() || null;
  const commitSha =
    input.result.commitSha?.trim() ||
    input.result.sha?.trim() ||
    input.result.progress?.commitSha?.trim() ||
    null;
  const prNumber =
    input.result.prNumber ?? input.result.progress?.prNumber ?? null;

  let prUrl = input.prHtmlUrl?.trim() || null;
  if (!prUrl && repo && prNumber != null) {
    prUrl = `https://github.com/${repo}/pull/${prNumber}`;
  }

  let fileUrl: string | null = null;
  if (repo && commitSha && path) {
    fileUrl = buildGitFilePermalink(repo, commitSha, path);
  }

  return {
    attempted: true,
    outcome: input.outcome,
    reason: input.reason ?? null,
    documentTitle: input.documentTitle ?? input.plan.documentTitle ?? null,
    revisionNumber: input.revisionNumber ?? input.plan.revisionNumber ?? null,
    repositoryFullName: repo,
    publicationBranch: branch,
    targetPath: path,
    baseBranch: input.plan.targetBranch?.trim() || null,
    commitSha,
    prNumber,
    prUrl,
    fileUrl,
    mergeObserved: input.mergeObserved === true,
    attemptId: input.attemptId,
    decisionId: input.decisionId ?? null,
  };
}

/**
 * Load attempt + publication ref + PR_OPEN fact → PublicationEffectView.
 */
export async function buildPublicationEffectViewFromAttempt(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  attemptId: string;
  outcome: PublicationEffectOutcome;
  documentTitle?: string | null;
  revisionNumber?: number | null;
  decisionId?: string | null;
  reason?: string | null;
}): Promise<NonNullable<PublicationEffectView> | null> {
  const row = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(effectAttempts)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(effectAttempts.id, input.attemptId),
          eq(effectAttempts.projectId, input.projectId),
          eq(effectAttempts.pilotId, input.pilotId),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!row) return null;

  const plan = parseOwnerJson<OwnerPublicationPlan>(row.planJson);
  const result = parseOwnerJson<OwnerPublicationResult>(row.resultJson);

  const ref = (
    await db
      .select({
        ref: documentPublicationRefs,
        fullName: authorizedRepositories.fullName,
      })
      .from(documentPublicationRefs)
      .innerJoin(
        authorizedRepositories,
        eq(documentPublicationRefs.repositoryId, authorizedRepositories.id),
      )
      .where(eq(documentPublicationRefs.effectAttemptId, input.attemptId))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];

  if (ref?.ref.targetPath && !plan.targetPath) {
    plan.targetPath = ref.ref.targetPath;
  }
  if (ref?.fullName && !plan.repositoryFullName) {
    plan.repositoryFullName = ref.fullName;
  }
  if (ref?.ref.headSha && !result.commitSha) {
    result.commitSha = ref.ref.headSha;
  }
  if (ref?.ref.prNumber != null && result.prNumber == null) {
    result.prNumber = ref.ref.prNumber;
  }
  try {
    const detail = JSON.parse(ref?.ref.detailJson || "{}") as {
      publicationBranch?: string;
    };
    if (detail.publicationBranch && !plan.publicationBranch) {
      plan.publicationBranch = detail.publicationBranch;
    }
  } catch {
    /* keep */
  }

  const prFact = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(observedGitFacts)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(observedGitFacts.attemptId, input.attemptId),
          eq(observedGitFacts.factKind, "PR_OPEN"),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  let prHtmlUrl: string | null = null;
  if (prFact?.detailJson) {
    try {
      const d = JSON.parse(prFact.detailJson) as { htmlUrl?: string };
      prHtmlUrl = d.htmlUrl?.trim() || null;
    } catch {
      prHtmlUrl = null;
    }
  }

  // MERGE facts live on the GIT_MERGE attempt — correlate via publicationAttemptId.
  let mergeObserved = false;
  const directMergeFact = (
    await db
      .select({ id: observedGitFacts.id })
      .from(observedGitFacts)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(observedGitFacts.attemptId, input.attemptId),
          eq(observedGitFacts.factKind, "MERGE"),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (directMergeFact) {
    mergeObserved = true;
  } else {
    const mergeAttempts = await db
      .select({ id: effectAttempts.id, planJson: effectAttempts.planJson })
      .from(effectAttempts)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(effectAttempts.projectId, row.projectId),
          eq(effectAttempts.pilotId, row.pilotId),
          eq(effectAttempts.kind, "GIT_MERGE"),
        ),
      );
    const correlatedIds = mergeAttempts
      .filter((m) => {
        try {
          const p = JSON.parse(m.planJson || "{}") as { publicationAttemptId?: string };
          return p.publicationAttemptId === input.attemptId;
        } catch {
          return false;
        }
      })
      .map((m) => m.id);
    if (correlatedIds.length > 0) {
      for (const mid of correlatedIds) {
        const mf = (
          await db
            .select({ id: observedGitFacts.id })
            .from(observedGitFacts)
            .where(
              and(eq(observedGitFacts.attemptId, mid), eq(observedGitFacts.factKind, "MERGE")),
            )
            .limit(1)
        )[0];
        if (mf) {
          mergeObserved = true;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return buildPublicationEffectViewFromOwnerPayload({
    outcome: input.outcome,
    attemptId: input.attemptId,
    decisionId: input.decisionId ?? row.decisionId,
    reason: input.reason,
    documentTitle: input.documentTitle,
    revisionNumber: input.revisionNumber,
    plan,
    result,
    prHtmlUrl,
    mergeObserved,
  });
}

/** Bound owner snippets for Nora follow-up verification (no secrets). */
export function formatPublicationOwnerFactsSnippets(
  pubs: Array<{
    repositoryFullName: string;
    targetPath: string;
    publicationBranch: string | null;
    targetBranch: string;
    headSha: string | null;
    prNumber: number | null;
    publicationStatus: string;
    effectStatus: string | null;
    mergeObserved: boolean;
    prStatusLabel: string;
  }>,
  limit = 3,
): string[] {
  return pubs.slice(0, limit).map((p) => {
    const branch = p.publicationBranch?.trim() || "(branche publication inconnue)";
    const sha = p.headSha ? p.headSha.slice(0, 12) : "∅";
    const pr =
      p.prNumber != null
        ? `PR #${p.prNumber} (${p.prStatusLabel})`
        : "aucune PR enregistrée";
    const merge = p.mergeObserved
      ? "fusion D8 observée"
      : `non fusionné vers ${p.targetBranch} (Studio)`;
    return (
      `PUBLICATION_STUDIO repo=${p.repositoryFullName} path=${p.targetPath} ` +
      `branch=${branch} base=${p.targetBranch} commit=${sha} ${pr} ` +
      `effect=${p.effectStatus ?? "∅"} status=${p.publicationStatus} ${merge}`
    );
  });
}

/**
 * Latest COMPLETED publication attempt for a project — for follow-up questions
 * when the thread no longer holds full facts.
 */
export async function loadLatestCompletedPublicationSnippet(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
}): Promise<string | null> {
  const row = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(effectAttempts)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(effectAttempts.pilotId, input.pilotId),
          eq(effectAttempts.projectId, input.projectId),
          eq(effectAttempts.kind, "GIT_PUBLICATION"),
          eq(effectAttempts.status, "COMPLETED"),
        ),
      )
      .orderBy(desc(effectAttempts.updatedAt))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!row) return null;
  const view = await buildPublicationEffectViewFromAttempt({
    pilotId: input.pilotId,
    projectId: input.projectId,
    attemptId: row.id,
    outcome: "COMPLETED",
  });
  if (!view) return null;
  const parts = [
    `PUBLICATION_STUDIO_LATEST attemptId=${view.attemptId}`,
    view.repositoryFullName ? `repo=${view.repositoryFullName}` : null,
    view.publicationBranch ? `branch=${view.publicationBranch}` : null,
    view.targetPath ? `path=${view.targetPath}` : null,
    view.commitSha ? `commit=${view.commitSha}` : null,
    view.prNumber != null ? `pr=#${view.prNumber}` : null,
    view.prUrl ? `prUrl=${view.prUrl}` : null,
    view.fileUrl ? `fileUrl=${view.fileUrl}` : null,
    view.baseBranch
      ? `base=${view.baseBranch} mergeObserved=${view.mergeObserved === true}`
      : null,
  ].filter(Boolean);
  return parts.join(" ");
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * S05 — pure pending-risk policy (internal decision labels only; not DB statuses).
 * Fail closed when durable evidence is insufficient to prove safety.
 */
import {
  effectIntents,
  type NoraTurnQualification,
} from "@/domains/conversation/semantic-qualification";

export type S05RiskClass =
  | "ACTIVE_EFFECT_RISK"
  | "UNKNOWN_EFFECT_RISK"
  | "PROVEN_NO_EFFECT"
  | "PROVEN_INDEPENDENT"
  | "SAME_INTENT";

export type S05SiblingEvidence = {
  id: string;
  clientTurnKey: string;
  status: "RUNNING" | "ACCEPTED" | "UNKNOWN" | string;
  createdAtMs: number;
  /** Durable qualification status from resultJson, when parseable. */
  qualificationStatus: string | null;
  qualification: NoraTurnQualification | null;
  documentSaveStatus: string | null;
  pilotageEffectAttempted: boolean | null;
  humanDecisionCreated: boolean | null;
  /**
   * Owner-side probe result (never derived from resultJson alone):
   * - true  = correlated owner mutation row identified
   * - false = applicable owners probed to completion with zero hits
   * - null  = probe absent, incomplete, errored, or identity insufficient
   */
  ownerEffectsFound: boolean | null;
  /** Durable correlation / intent keys for SAME_INTENT (comparable identities). */
  correlationKeys?: string[];
};

export type S05CurrentIntentContext = {
  /** Correlation / intent keys of the current turn effect request. */
  correlationKeys: string[];
  /** When true, current turn requests an owner mutation (D2/D4/D5/D6/D7). */
  requestsOwnerEffect: boolean;
};

function hasActionableEffectIntents(q: NoraTurnQualification | null): boolean {
  if (!q) return false;
  return effectIntents(q).length > 0;
}

/**
 * Classify one unresolved sibling for S05.
 * Never uses age alone. Never treats documentSave=null alone as proof.
 */
export function classifySiblingEffectRisk(
  sibling: S05SiblingEvidence,
  current: S05CurrentIntentContext,
): S05RiskClass {
  const sameIntent =
    current.correlationKeys.length > 0 &&
    (sibling.correlationKeys ?? []).some((k) => current.correlationKeys.includes(k));
  if (sameIntent) return "SAME_INTENT";

  if (sibling.status === "RUNNING" || sibling.status === "ACCEPTED") {
    return "ACTIVE_EFFECT_RISK";
  }

  if (sibling.status !== "UNKNOWN") {
    return "UNKNOWN_EFFECT_RISK";
  }

  // Owner probe found a mutation → not safe to ignore.
  if (sibling.ownerEffectsFound === true) {
    return "UNKNOWN_EFFECT_RISK";
  }

  // Explicit attempted pilotage / HD without terminal certainty.
  if (sibling.pilotageEffectAttempted === true || sibling.humanDecisionCreated === true) {
    return "UNKNOWN_EFFECT_RISK";
  }

  // Document save reached a real owner outcome (including CONFLICT/AVAILABLE/UNKNOWN).
  if (
    sibling.documentSaveStatus != null &&
    sibling.documentSaveStatus !== "NOT_EXECUTED"
  ) {
    return "UNKNOWN_EFFECT_RISK";
  }

  // Insufficient durable qualification → fail closed.
  if (sibling.qualificationStatus == null || sibling.qualification == null) {
    return "UNKNOWN_EFFECT_RISK";
  }

  // Owner probe required for PROVEN_NO_EFFECT (null = not probed).
  if (sibling.ownerEffectsFound == null) {
    return "UNKNOWN_EFFECT_RISK";
  }

  // QUALIFIED with actionable REQUEST_EFFECT but no owner row yet → uncertain.
  if (
    sibling.qualificationStatus === "QUALIFIED" &&
    hasActionableEffectIntents(sibling.qualification)
  ) {
    return "UNKNOWN_EFFECT_RISK";
  }

  // UNAVAILABLE / NEEDS_CLARIFICATION / QUALIFIED-without-effect-intents:
  // effectIntents() is empty unless QUALIFIED+REQUEST_EFFECT; owner probe empty.
  if (
    sibling.qualificationStatus === "UNAVAILABLE" ||
    sibling.qualificationStatus === "NEEDS_CLARIFICATION" ||
    (sibling.qualificationStatus === "QUALIFIED" &&
      !hasActionableEffectIntents(sibling.qualification))
  ) {
    if (sibling.ownerEffectsFound === false) {
      // No actionable owner path and no owner rows → proven without effect.
      // Relative to a disjoint current intention, also independent.
      return current.requestsOwnerEffect ? "PROVEN_NO_EFFECT" : "PROVEN_INDEPENDENT";
    }
  }

  return "UNKNOWN_EFFECT_RISK";
}

export function isBlockingS05Risk(risk: S05RiskClass): boolean {
  return (
    risk === "ACTIVE_EFFECT_RISK" ||
    risk === "UNKNOWN_EFFECT_RISK" ||
    risk === "SAME_INTENT"
  );
}

/** Deterministic order: createdAt ascending, then id ascending. */
export function sortS05SiblingsDeterministic<T extends { createdAtMs: number; id: string }>(
  siblings: T[],
): T[] {
  return [...siblings].sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.createdAtMs !== b.createdAtMs) return a.createdAtMs - b.createdAtMs;
    return a.id < b.id ? -1 : a.id > b.id ? 1 : 0;
  });
}

export type S05PolicyDecision = {
  allowOwnerEffects: boolean;
  pendingEffectBlocked: boolean;
  pendingBlockReason: string | undefined;
  classifications: Array<{
    clientTurnKey: string;
    status: string;
    risk: S05RiskClass;
  }>;
  /** Prefer UX hint only for reason string when that sibling actually blocks. */
  primaryBlockingKey: string | null;
};

/**
 * Evaluate all siblings. Missions are handled by the caller (still fail-closed).
 */
export function evaluateS05SiblingPolicy(input: {
  siblings: S05SiblingEvidence[];
  current: S05CurrentIntentContext;
  clientPendingHint: string | null;
  /** When false (DIALOGUE_INDEPENDANT), never block owner effects via S05 siblings. */
  applyPendingGate: boolean;
}): S05PolicyDecision {
  const ordered = sortS05SiblingsDeterministic(input.siblings);
  const classifications = ordered.map((s) => ({
    clientTurnKey: s.clientTurnKey,
    status: s.status,
    risk: classifySiblingEffectRisk(s, input.current),
  }));

  if (!input.applyPendingGate) {
    return {
      allowOwnerEffects: true,
      pendingEffectBlocked: false,
      pendingBlockReason: undefined,
      classifications,
      primaryBlockingKey: null,
    };
  }

  const blockers = classifications.filter((c) => isBlockingS05Risk(c.risk));
  if (blockers.length === 0) {
    return {
      allowOwnerEffects: true,
      pendingEffectBlocked: false,
      pendingBlockReason: undefined,
      classifications,
      primaryBlockingKey: null,
    };
  }

  const hint = input.clientPendingHint?.trim() || null;
  const hinted = hint ? blockers.find((b) => b.clientTurnKey === hint) : null;
  const primary = hinted ?? blockers[0]!;
  const reasonPrefix =
    primary.risk === "SAME_INTENT"
      ? "S05_PENDING_BLOCKS_SAME_INTENT"
      : primary.risk === "ACTIVE_EFFECT_RISK"
        ? "S05_PENDING_BLOCKS_EFFECT"
        : "S05_PENDING_BLOCKS_AMBIGUOUS";

  return {
    allowOwnerEffects: false,
    pendingEffectBlocked: true,
    pendingBlockReason: `${reasonPrefix}:${primary.clientTurnKey}`,
    classifications,
    primaryBlockingKey: primary.clientTurnKey,
  };
}

/**
 * Build comparable durable correlation keys for SAME_INTENT.
 * Only stable identities — never USER text, title, or lexical similarity.
 */
export function buildTurnCorrelationKeys(input: {
  commandId?: string | null;
  operationId?: string | null;
  userMessageId?: string | null;
  clientTurnKey?: string | null;
  /** Client salt / mission doc key / explicit correlation before seal. */
  clientCorrelationSalt?: string | null;
  /** Sealed documentCommandBindings[].correlationKey values. */
  bindingCorrelationKeys?: string[] | null;
  /** D5 conversational client command key when known. */
  businessClientCommandKey?: string | null;
  /** Mission continuity keys (doc:mission:… / pub:mission:…). */
  missionKeys?: string[] | null;
}): string[] {
  const out = new Set<string>();
  const add = (raw: string | null | undefined, prefix?: string) => {
    const v = raw?.trim();
    if (!v) return;
    out.add(v);
    if (prefix) out.add(`${prefix}${v}`);
  };
  add(input.commandId, "tcmd:");
  add(input.operationId, "op:");
  add(input.userMessageId, "umsg:");
  add(input.clientTurnKey, "ctk:");
  add(input.clientCorrelationSalt, "salt:");
  add(input.businessClientCommandKey, "bck:");
  for (const k of input.bindingCorrelationKeys ?? []) add(k, "bind:");
  for (const k of input.missionKeys ?? []) add(k);
  return [...out];
}

/** Parse durable qualification fields from a turn resultJson string. */
export function parseSiblingResultEvidence(resultJson: string | null): {
  qualificationStatus: string | null;
  qualification: NoraTurnQualification | null;
  documentSaveStatus: string | null;
  pilotageEffectAttempted: boolean | null;
  humanDecisionCreated: boolean | null;
  /** Binding correlation keys only — not a substitute for owner probe. */
  bindingCorrelationKeys: string[];
  operationId: string | null;
} {
  if (!resultJson) {
    return {
      qualificationStatus: null,
      qualification: null,
      documentSaveStatus: null,
      pilotageEffectAttempted: null,
      humanDecisionCreated: null,
      bindingCorrelationKeys: [],
      operationId: null,
    };
  }
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(resultJson) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const sq = parsed.semanticQualification as NoraTurnQualification | undefined;
    const sqStatus =
      (typeof parsed.semanticQualificationStatus === "string"
        ? parsed.semanticQualificationStatus
        : null) ??
      (sq && typeof sq.status === "string" ? sq.status : null);
    const docSave = parsed.documentSave as { status?: string } | null | undefined;
    const pilotage = parsed.pilotageEffect as { attempted?: boolean } | null | undefined;
    const bindingCorrelationKeys: string[] = [];
    const bindings = parsed.documentCommandBindings;
    if (Array.isArray(bindings)) {
      for (const b of bindings) {
        if (
          b &&
          typeof b === "object" &&
          typeof (b as { correlationKey?: string }).correlationKey === "string"
        ) {
          bindingCorrelationKeys.push((b as { correlationKey: string }).correlationKey);
        }
      }
    }
    return {
      qualificationStatus: sqStatus,
      qualification: sq && typeof sq.status === "string" ? sq : null,
      documentSaveStatus:
        docSave && typeof docSave.status === "string" ? docSave.status : null,
      pilotageEffectAttempted:
        pilotage && typeof pilotage.attempted === "boolean" ? pilotage.attempted : null,
      humanDecisionCreated:
        typeof parsed.humanDecisionCreated === "boolean" ? parsed.humanDecisionCreated : null,
      bindingCorrelationKeys,
      operationId: typeof parsed.operationId === "string" ? parsed.operationId : null,
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      qualificationStatus: null,
      qualification: null,
      documentSaveStatus: null,
      pilotageEffectAttempted: null,
      humanDecisionCreated: null,
      bindingCorrelationKeys: [],
      operationId: null,
    };
  }
}
```
