```typescript
      proposedProjectName: proposed,
      ownerActBinding: buildD2OwnerActBinding(preparationId, clientIntentKey),
    };
    d2Mission = mergeMissionSteps(d2Mission, [buildD2AwaitingStep(proposed)], "AWAITING_PILOT_ACT");
    if (
      studioIntent.wantsFollowOnDocument ||
      studioIntent.documentAct.kind === "CREATE" ||
      studioIntent.publication.wantsPublish
    ) {
      d2Mission = mergeMissionSteps(d2Mission, [
        buildPendingDocumentStep("CREATE", studioIntent.pendingDocumentBrief),
      ]);
    }
    missionProjection = d2Mission;
  } else if (
    !missionProjection &&
    carriedMission &&
    (carriedMission.status === "ACTIVE" || carriedMission.status === "AWAITING_PILOT_ACT")
  ) {
    // Resume carried multi-domain mission after D2 confirmed (or still waiting).
    if (documentEffectForAck?.status === "AVAILABLE" && documentEffectForAck.documentId) {
      const steps = carriedMission.steps.map((s) =>
        s.id === "d4_create" || s.capabilityId === "d4.create_document"
          ? {
              ...s,
              status: "DONE" as const,
              documentId: documentEffectForAck.documentId,
              revisionId: documentEffectForAck.revisionId,
            }
          : s,
      );
      missionProjection = {
        ...carriedMission,
        steps,
        status: steps.some((s) => s.status === "WAITING" || s.status === "PENDING")
          ? "ACTIVE"
          : "COMPLETED",
        restitution: continueFailedAfterEffect ? "PENDING" : "DELIVERED",
      };
    } else {
      missionProjection = carriedMission;
    }
  }

  // P1: PREPARE-only conflict must be observable without D4 mutation or silent rewrite.
  if (
    proposalAuthorityConflict &&
    !documentSave &&
    !ownershipLostBeforeD4 &&
    documentAct.kind === "NONE"
  ) {
    documentSave = {
      status: "NOT_EXECUTED",
      reason: proposalAuthorityConflict,
    };
  }

  // P1: never strip+reinject when concurrent fence was invalid or divergent.
  if (durableProposal && !ownershipLostBeforeD4 && !proposalAuthorityConflict) {
    const narrative = stripContractualDocumentFences(assistantBody);
    const fenced = serializeProposalFence(durableProposal);
    assistantBody = [narrative.trimEnd(), fenced].filter((s) => s.length > 0).join("\n\n");
  }

  // E07 — post-effect métier restitution: final assistant text must match Studio outcome.
  if (!ownershipLostBeforeD4 && authority?.attempted) {
    assistantBody = composePilotageEffectRestitution({
      priorContent: assistantBody,
      effect: pilotageEffectFromAuthority(authority) ?? null,
    });
  }

  // E08 POST-UAT — publication outcome after Studio owners; strip pre-effect hedges.
  if (!ownershipLostBeforeD4 && publicationEffectView?.attempted) {
    assistantBody = composePublicationEffectRestitution({
      priorContent: assistantBody,
      effect: publicationEffectView,
    });
  } else if (!ownershipLostBeforeD4 && missionIntent.wantsPublish) {
    // Intention recognized, no Studio publication attempt — NOT_ATTEMPTED (never success).
    assistantBody = composePublicationEffectRestitution({
      priorContent: assistantBody,
      effect: {
        attempted: true,
        outcome: "NOT_ATTEMPTED",
        reason:
          "Intention de publication reconnue — aucun effet Studio n'a été lancé",
      },
    });
  }

  const assistantContentForCommit = ownershipLostBeforeD4
    ? reply.content
    : appendMissionAck(
        appendDocumentEffectAck(assistantBody, documentEffectForAck),
        missionProjection,
      );

  const confirmedCapitalisations = capitalisation.capitalisations.filter(
    (c) => c.status === "AVAILABLE",
  );

  let turnStatus: "COMPLETE" | "FAILED" | "UNKNOWN" =
    ownershipLostBeforeD4
      ? "UNKNOWN"
      : reply.status === "COMPLETE"
        ? "COMPLETE"
        : reply.status === "UNKNOWN"
          ? "UNKNOWN"
          : "FAILED";

  if (
    !ownershipLostBeforeD4 &&
    reply.status === "COMPLETE" &&
    (documentSaveUnknown || capitalisationError) &&
    documentAct.kind !== "NONE"
  ) {
    turnStatus = "UNKNOWN";
  } else if (
    !ownershipLostBeforeD4 &&
    reply.status === "COMPLETE" &&
    capitalisationError &&
    documentAct.kind === "NONE"
  ) {
    turnStatus = "UNKNOWN";
  }

  // Lost ownership ⇒ never claim COMPLETE even if reply looked complete.
  if (ownershipLostBeforeD4) {
    turnStatus = "UNKNOWN";
  }

  // When ownership already lost, prefer DB reconstitution over in-memory lists
  // (local vars may omit effects committed earlier in the turn).
  let unknownCapReconstituted: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof reconstituteConfirmedD4Effects>> | null =
    null;
  if (ownershipLostBeforeD4 || turnStatus === "UNKNOWN") {
    unknownCapReconstituted = await reconstituteConfirmedD4Effects(pilotId, preparationId, {
      generationId: reply.generationId,
      userMessageId: reserved.userMessageId,
    });
  }

  const resultPayload: TurnResult = {
    userMessageId: reserved.userMessageId,
    assistantMessageId: ownershipLostBeforeD4 ? null : assistantId,
    operationId: reserved.operationId,
    requestId,
    turnCommandId: reserved.commandId,
    preparedContract,
    noraMode: reply.mode,
    status: turnStatus === "COMPLETE" ? reply.status : turnStatus,
    generationId: reply.generationId,
    policy: {
      version: reply.policy.policyVersion,
      profileType: reply.policy.profileType,
      profile: reply.policy.profile,
      modelRequested: reply.modelRequested,
      modelApplied: reply.modelApplied,
      effortRequested: reply.effortRequested,
      effortApplied: reply.effortApplied,
      reasonCodes: reply.policy.reasonCodes,
    },
    attempts: reply.attempts,
    toolCallsObserved: reply.toolCallsObserved,
    d4CharsReturned: reply.d4CharsReturned,
    streaming: {
      attempted: reply.streamingAttempted ?? false,
      delivered: reply.streamingDelivered ?? false,
      notes: reply.streamingNotes ?? null,
    },
    knowledgeSelection: {
      ...knowledgeForNora.counts,
      selectionMethod: knowledgeForNora.selectionMethod,
      selectionLimit: knowledgeForNora.selectionLimit,
      role: "pre_generation_context" as const,
      selectedAcquisIds: knowledgeForNora.selectedAcquisIds,
      selectedOpenPointIds: knowledgeForNora.selectedOpenPointIds,
    },
    knowledgeResumeHints: knowledgeResumeHints
      ? {
          ...knowledgeResumeHints.counts,
          selectionMethod: knowledgeResumeHints.selectionMethod,
          selectionLimit: knowledgeResumeHints.selectionLimit,
          role: "post_qualification_resume_only" as const,
          selectedAcquisIds: knowledgeResumeHints.selectedAcquisIds,
          selectedOpenPointIds: knowledgeResumeHints.selectedOpenPointIds,
          note: "Indice de reprise — n'a pas nourri la réponse déjà générée",
        }
      : null,
    capitalisation: ownershipLostBeforeD4
      ? (unknownCapReconstituted?.capitalisation ?? [])
      : confirmedCapitalisations,
    capitalisationAttempted: ownershipLostBeforeD4 ? [] : capitalisation.capitalisations,
    capitalisationLimit: ownershipLostBeforeD4
      ? (unknownCapReconstituted?.capitalisationLimit ?? "OWNERSHIP_LOST")
      : capitalisationError ?? capitalisation.selectionLimit,
    documentSave: ownershipLostBeforeD4
      ? (unknownCapReconstituted?.documentSave ?? null)
      : documentSave,
    pendingDocumentCandidate: ownershipLostBeforeD4 ? null : pendingDocumentCandidateOut,
    historicalAuthorization: ownershipLostBeforeD4 ? null : historicalAuthorizationOut,
    idempotentReplay: false,
    humanDecisionCreated:
      Boolean(authority?.humanDecisionCreated) || Boolean(publicationMandateDecisionId),
    pilotageEffect: pilotageEffectFromAuthority(authority),
    missionProjection,
    nextTurnKind,
    pendingEffectBlocked,
    pendingBlockReason,
    unresolvedPendingClientTurnKey:
      blockingSibling?.clientTurnKey ??
      blockingMission?.clientIntentKey ??
      clientPendingHint,
    semanticQualificationStatus: qualification.status,
    preparationProjection: preparationProjectionAck,
    turnProjection: buildTurnProjection({
      messageId: ownershipLostBeforeD4 ? null : assistantId,
      turnCommandId: reserved.commandId,
      status: turnStatus === "COMPLETE" ? reply.status : turnStatus,
      finalized: turnStatus === "COMPLETE" && !ownershipLostBeforeD4,
      // P1-A: never map clarifications[] → continue buttons.
      continueChoices: continueChoicesOverride ?? qualification.continueChoices ?? null,
      references: (qualification.resourceReferences ?? []).map((r) => ({
        kind: r.kind,
        label: r.label,
        resourceId: r.resourceId,
        revisionId: r.revisionId,
        repositoryId: r.repositoryId,
        path: r.path,
        ref: r.ref,
        commit: r.commit,
        href: r.href,
        available: true,
      })),
      toolCallsObserved: reply.toolCallsObserved,
      d4CharsReturned: reply.d4CharsReturned,
      documentSave,
      visualComposition: qualification.visualComposition,
    }),
  };

  if (turnRaceHooks.beforeTerminalCommit) {
    await turnRaceHooks.beforeTerminalCommit();
  }

  let applied: { applied: boolean };
  try {
    applied = await commitTurnTerminal({
      commandId: reserved.commandId,
      ownerToken: reserved.ownerToken,
      status: turnStatus,
      conversationId: ctx.conversation.id,
      assistant: ownershipLostBeforeD4
        ? undefined
        : {
            id: assistantId,
            content: assistantContentForCommit,
            messageStatus: reply.status,
            generationId: reply.generationId,
            ordinal: reserved.ordinalAssistant,
          },
      generationId: reply.generationId,
      resultJson: JSON.stringify(resultPayload),
      errorCategory:
        turnStatus === "COMPLETE"
          ? undefined
          : ownershipLostBeforeD4
            ? "OWNERSHIP_LOST"
            : capitalisationError ?? reply.status,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    // Mid-TX DB failure after attempted assistant write — TX rolled back; never COMPLETE.
    if (e instanceof StudioError && e.code === "CONFLICT") {
      emitObs({
        event_name: "d3.turn.assistant_identity_conflict",
        component: "d3.conversation",
        request_id: requestId,
        operation_id: reserved.operationId,
        generation_id: reply.generationId,
        outcome: "UNKNOWN",
        error_category: "ASSISTANT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT",
      });
    } else {
      emitObs({
        event_name: "d3.turn.terminal_tx_failed",
        component: "d3.conversation",
        request_id: requestId,
        operation_id: reserved.operationId,
        generation_id: reply.generationId,
        outcome: "UNKNOWN",
        error_category: "TERMINAL_TX_EXCEPTION",
      });
    }
    try {
      await markTurnUnknown(reserved.commandId, "TERMINAL_TX_EXCEPTION", reserved.ownerToken);
    } catch {
      /* ownership may already be lost */
    }
    const reconstituted = await reconstituteConfirmedD4Effects(pilotId, preparationId, {
      generationId: reply.generationId,
      userMessageId: reserved.userMessageId,
    });
    return {
      ...resultPayload,
      status: "UNKNOWN",
      assistantMessageId: null,
      capitalisation: reconstituted.capitalisation,
      capitalisationLimit: reconstituted.capitalisationLimit,
      documentSave: reconstituted.documentSave,
    };
  }

  if (!applied.applied) {
    emitObs({
      event_name: "d3.turn.complete_cas_miss",
      component: "d3.conversation",
      request_id: requestId,
      operation_id: reserved.operationId,
      generation_id: reply.generationId,
      outcome: "UNKNOWN",
      error_category: "COMPLETE_CAS_MISSED",
    });
    // Never return COMPLETE when ownership CAS failed — but surface DB-confirmed D4 refs.
    const reconstituted = await reconstituteConfirmedD4Effects(pilotId, preparationId, {
      generationId: reply.generationId,
      userMessageId: reserved.userMessageId,
    });
    return {
      ...resultPayload,
      status: "UNKNOWN",
      assistantMessageId: null,
      capitalisation: reconstituted.capitalisation,
      capitalisationLimit: reconstituted.capitalisationLimit,
      documentSave: reconstituted.documentSave,
      preparationProjection: { status: "SKIPPED_OWNERSHIP" },
    };
  }

  // Persist living projection only after durable COMPLETE terminal commit (Gap C).
  if (
    turnStatus === "COMPLETE" &&
    preparationProjectionDraft &&
    !ctx.project?.id &&
    !ownershipLostBeforeD4
  ) {
    try {
      const freshPrep = await openOrCreatePreparation(pilotId, preparationId);
      const appliedProj = await applyPreparationProjection({
        pilotId,
        preparationId,
        expectedCreationRevision: freshPrep.creationRevision,
        draft: preparationProjectionDraft,
      });
      preparationProjectionAck = {
        status: appliedProj.status,
        revision: "revision" in appliedProj ? appliedProj.revision : undefined,
        assessment: preparationProjectionDraft.suggestion?.assessment,
      };
    } catch {
      preparationProjectionAck = { status: "UNAVAILABLE" };
    }
    resultPayload.preparationProjection = preparationProjectionAck;
  }

  emitObs({
    event_name: "d3.turn.completed",
    component: "d3.conversation",
    request_id: requestId,
    operation_id: reserved.operationId,
    generation_id: reply.generationId,
    outcome:
      turnStatus === "COMPLETE" ? "SUCCESS" : turnStatus === "UNKNOWN" ? "UNKNOWN" : "FAILED",
    policy_version: reply.policy.policyVersion,
    profile_type:
      reply.policy.profileType === "TEST_BOUNDARY" ? "TEST_BOUNDARY" : "OPERATIONAL",
    meta: {
      attempts: reply.attempts.length,
      tool_calls: reply.toolCallsObserved,
      turn_status: turnStatus,
      cas_applied: applied.applied,
    },
  });

  return resultPayload;
}

export async function getConversationId(pilotId: string, preparationId: string) {
  const row = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(conversations)
      .where(
        and(eq(conversations.preparationId, preparationId), eq(conversations.ownerPilotId, pilotId)),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  return row?.id ?? null;
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Journal of sources actually returned by D3 tools this turn.
 * A tool-call count alone never proves CONSULTED — only concrete refs + coverage.
 */

import type { InvestigationSourceRef, SourceCoverage } from "./investigation-state";
import type { ToolCoverage } from "./d4-read-tools";

export type ToolSourceJournal = {
  entries: InvestigationSourceRef[];
  /** Fired when a concrete source is recorded — use for mid-turn OBSERVED activity. */
  onRecord?: (entry: InvestigationSourceRef) => void;
};

export function createToolSourceJournal(
  opts?: { onRecord?: (entry: InvestigationSourceRef) => void },
): ToolSourceJournal {
  return { entries: [], onRecord: opts?.onRecord };
}

export function mapToolCoverageToSource(coverage: ToolCoverage | string): SourceCoverage {
  switch (coverage) {
    case "COMPLETE":
      return "CONSULTED";
    case "PARTIAL":
      return "PARTIAL";
    case "STALE":
      return "STALE";
    case "DENIED":
      return "DENIED";
    case "NOT_FOUND":
    case "EMPTY":
      return "DISCOVERED";
    default:
      return "UNKNOWN";
  }
}

export function recordToolSource(
  journal: ToolSourceJournal | null | undefined,
  entry: {
    kind: InvestigationSourceRef["kind"];
    ref: string;
    coverage: ToolCoverage | SourceCoverage | string;
    title?: string;
    versionOrSha?: string | null;
    notes?: string;
  },
): void {
  if (!journal || !entry.ref) return;
  const coverage =
    entry.coverage === "CONSULTED" ||
    entry.coverage === "VERIFIED" ||
    entry.coverage === "DISCOVERED" ||
    entry.coverage === "PARTIAL" ||
    entry.coverage === "STALE" ||
    entry.coverage === "DENIED" ||
    entry.coverage === "CONTRADICTORY" ||
    entry.coverage === "UNKNOWN"
      ? (entry.coverage as SourceCoverage)
      : mapToolCoverageToSource(entry.coverage);
  // Never upgrade UNKNOWN from empty counters.
  if (!entry.ref.trim()) return;
  const existing = journal.entries.find((e) => e.kind === entry.kind && e.ref === entry.ref);
  if (existing) {
    // Keep stronger coverage if already present.
    const rank: Record<SourceCoverage, number> = {
      VERIFIED: 5,
      CONSULTED: 4,
      PARTIAL: 3,
      STALE: 2,
      CONTRADICTORY: 2,
      DISCOVERED: 1,
      DENIED: 1,
      UNKNOWN: 0,
    };
    if (rank[coverage] > rank[existing.coverage]) existing.coverage = coverage;
    return;
  }
  const recorded: InvestigationSourceRef = {
    kind: entry.kind,
    ref: entry.ref,
    title: entry.title,
    versionOrSha: entry.versionOrSha ?? null,
    coverage,
    notes: entry.notes,
  };
  journal.entries.push(recorded);
  try {
    journal.onRecord?.(recorded);
  } catch {
    /* observational sink must never break tool execution */
  }
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Durable D3 turn command — short transactional reservation only.
 * Never hold a DB transaction open across the provider call.
 * Ownership fencing via owner_token: lost ownership ⇒ no COMPLETE, no further D4 commits.
 */
import { and, asc, eq, ne, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import { conversationTurnCommands, messages } from "@/db/schema";
import { newId } from "@/lib/ids";
import { StudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";
import { fingerprintRequest, newOperationId } from "@/lib/observability";
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

export type TurnCommandStatus =
  | "ACCEPTED"
  | "RUNNING"
  | "COMPLETE"
  | "FAILED"
  | "CONFLICT"
  | "UNKNOWN";

export type ReservedTurn = {
  kind: "fresh";
  commandId: string;
  operationId: string;
  conversationId: string;
  clientTurnKey: string;
  requestFingerprint: string;
  ownerToken: string;
  ordinalUser: number;
  ordinalAssistant: number;
  userMessageId: string;
};

export type ReplayedTurn = {
  kind: "replay";
  commandId: string;
  operationId: string;
  status: TurnCommandStatus;
  resultJson: string | null;
  generationId: string | null;
  userMessageId: string | null;
  assistantMessageId: string | null;
  /** Stable turn key — enables C02 reconstitution of conv-auth:{key}. */
  clientTurnKey?: string | null;
  reconciled?: boolean;
};

/** Stale RUNNING lease — only when heartbeat (updated_at) is older than this. */
export const TURN_RUNNING_STALE_MS = 20 * 60 * 1000;

/** Injectable clock for deterministic lease tests. */
export const turnClock = {
  nowMs: (): number => Date.now(),
};

/** Ownership fence passed into D4 write TXs (documents + knowledge). */
export type TurnOwnershipFence = {
  commandId: string;
  ownerToken: string;
  /** Optional test injection before the ownership lock inside the write TX. */
  beforeFenceCheck?: () => Promise<void>;
};

/** Forces terminal TX rollback when CAS cannot apply after a side-effect attempt. */
export class TurnTerminalCasMissError extends Error {
  readonly code = "TURN_TERMINAL_CAS_MISS";
  constructor() {
    super("TURN_TERMINAL_CAS_MISS");
    this.name = "TurnTerminalCasMissError";
  }
}

type FenceTx = {
  execute: typeof db.execute;
  select: typeof db.select;
};

/**
 * Lock + verify turn ownership inside an open D4 write TX.
 * Uses FOR SHARE so reconcile/UPDATE waits until the write commits or rolls back.
 * Returns false when ownership is already lost (caller must abort write without commit).
 */
export async function assertTurnFenceInTx(
  tx: FenceTx,
  fence: TurnOwnershipFence,
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (fence.beforeFenceCheck) {
    await fence.beforeFenceCheck();
  }
  await tx.execute(
    sql`select id from conversation_turn_commands
        where id = ${fence.commandId}
          and owner_token = ${fence.ownerToken}
          and status in ('RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED')
        for share`,
  );
  const fenceRow = (
    await tx
      .select({ id: conversationTurnCommands.id })
      .from(conversationTurnCommands)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(conversationTurnCommands.id, fence.commandId),
          eq(conversationTurnCommands.ownerToken, fence.ownerToken),
          sql`${conversationTurnCommands.status} IN ('RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED')`,
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  return Boolean(fenceRow);
}

/** Test hooks — must stay no-op in production paths. */
export const turnRaceHooks: {
  /**
   * C02 — after same-turn D5/D6 authority (SEM/TV: Nora qualifies first).
   * Historical name retained; must not run before Nora.
   */
  afterAuthorityBeforeNora?: () => Promise<void>;
  afterGenerateBeforeEffects?: () => Promise<void>;
  beforeD4Effect?: () => Promise<void>;
  beforeTerminalCommit?: () => Promise<void>;
  /**
   * Test-only: replace Nora assistant text after generate, before D4 extraction.
   * Used to inject nested illustrative fences without LIVE Nora or production bypass.
   */
  replaceNoraAssistantText?: (text: string) => string;
  /**
   * Runs inside the terminal TX after optional assistant INSERT, before CAS UPDATE.
   * May mutate the same TX (e.g. revoke token) to force CAS miss + rollback.
   */
  insideTerminalTxAfterInsert?: (tx: FenceTx) => Promise<void>;
} = {};

export function turnFingerprint(content: string): string {
  return fingerprintRequest(["v1", content.trim()]);
}

function newOwnerToken(): string {
  return `own_${randomUUID()}`;
}

function isStaleRunning(updatedAt: Date | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!updatedAt) return true;
  return turnClock.nowMs() - updatedAt.getTime() > TURN_RUNNING_STALE_MS;
}

/**
 * Heartbeat + ownership proof. Refreshes updated_at so long active runs are not
 * falsely reconciled as orphans. Returns false if ownership lost.
 */
/** Persist generation identity on a still-owned RUNNING/ACCEPTED command (pre-terminal). */
export async function bindTurnGenerationId(
  commandId: string,
  ownerToken: string,
  generationId: string,
): Promise<{ bound: boolean }> {
  const gen = generationId.trim();
  if (!gen) return { bound: false };
  const updated = await db
    .update(conversationTurnCommands)
    .set({
      generationId: gen,
      updatedAt: new Date(turnClock.nowMs()),
    })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(conversationTurnCommands.id, commandId),
        eq(conversationTurnCommands.ownerToken, ownerToken),
        sql`${conversationTurnCommands.status} IN ('RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED')`,
      ),
    )
    .returning({ id: conversationTurnCommands.id });
  return { bound: updated.length > 0 };
}

export async function touchTurnLease(
  commandId: string,
  ownerToken: string,
): Promise<{ owned: boolean }> {
  const updated = await db
    .update(conversationTurnCommands)
    .set({ updatedAt: new Date(turnClock.nowMs()) })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(conversationTurnCommands.id, commandId),
        eq(conversationTurnCommands.ownerToken, ownerToken),
        sql`${conversationTurnCommands.status} IN ('RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED')`,
      ),
    )
    .returning({ id: conversationTurnCommands.id });
  return { owned: updated.length > 0 };
}

/**
 * Assert ownership still holds (short TX). Use before every D4 write boundary.
 */
export async function requireTurnOwnership(
  commandId: string,
  ownerToken: string,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const { owned } = await touchTurnLease(commandId, ownerToken);
  return owned;
}

/**
 * Conservative reconciliation of an orphan RUNNING command.
 * Invalidates owner_token so a late execution cannot CAS-complete or fence D4.
 */
export async function reconcileRunningCommand(commandId: string): Promise<{
  status: TurnCommandStatus;
  reconciled: boolean;
  assistantMessageId: string | null;
  generationId: string | null;
  resultJson: string | null;
}> {
  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.execute(sql`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(${"turn-reconcile:" + commandId}))`);

    // FOR UPDATE waits for any in-flight terminal/D4 fence locks — never revoke mid-write.
    await tx.execute(
      sql`select id from conversation_turn_commands where id = ${commandId} for update`,
    );

    const row = (
      await tx
        .select()
        .from(conversationTurnCommands)
        .where(eq(conversationTurnCommands.id, commandId))
        .limit(1)
    )[0];

    if (!row) {
      return {
        status: "UNKNOWN" as const,
        reconciled: false,
        assistantMessageId: null,
        generationId: null,
        resultJson: null,
      };
    }

    if (row.status !== "RUNNING" && row.status !== "ACCEPTED") {
      return {
        status: row.status as TurnCommandStatus,
        reconciled: false,
        assistantMessageId: row.assistantMessageId,
        generationId: row.generationId,
        resultJson: row.resultJson,
      };
    }

    let assistantId = row.assistantMessageId;
    let generationId = row.generationId;

    if (!assistantId && row.ordinalAssistant != null) {
      const existingAssistant = (
        await tx
          .select()
          .from(messages)
          .where(
            and(
              eq(messages.conversationId, row.conversationId),
              eq(messages.ordinal, row.ordinalAssistant),
              eq(messages.role, "assistant"),
            ),
          )
          .limit(1)
      )[0];
      // Bind only when both sides have a matching generationId (no silent appropriation).
      if (
        existingAssistant &&
        Boolean(row.generationId) &&
        Boolean(existingAssistant.generationId) &&
        row.generationId === existingAssistant.generationId
      ) {
        assistantId = existingAssistant.id;
        generationId = existingAssistant.generationId ?? generationId;
      }
    }

    const stale = isStaleRunning(row.updatedAt);
    if (!stale && !assistantId) {
      return {
        status: "RUNNING" as const,
        reconciled: false,
        assistantMessageId: null,
        generationId,
        resultJson: null,
      };
    }

    const errorCategory = assistantId
      ? "RECONCILED_ASSISTANT_PRESENT_TURN_UNKNOWN"
      : "RECONCILED_STALE_RUNNING_NO_ASSISTANT";

    // Invalidate owner_token — late owner can no longer commit.
    const updated = await tx
      .update(conversationTurnCommands)
      .set({
        status: "UNKNOWN",
        assistantMessageId: assistantId,
        generationId,
        errorCategory,
        ownerToken: `revoked_${randomUUID()}`,
        updatedAt: new Date(turnClock.nowMs()),
      })
      .where(
        and(
          eq(conversationTurnCommands.id, commandId),
          eq(conversationTurnCommands.status, row.status),
        ),
      )
      .returning();

    if (!updated.length) {
      const again = (
        await tx
          .select()
          .from(conversationTurnCommands)
          .where(eq(conversationTurnCommands.id, commandId))
          .limit(1)
      )[0];
      return {
        status: (again?.status as TurnCommandStatus) ?? "UNKNOWN",
        reconciled: false,
        assistantMessageId: again?.assistantMessageId ?? null,
        generationId: again?.generationId ?? null,
        resultJson: again?.resultJson ?? null,
      };
    }

    // Preserve prior resultJson (incl. stashed qualification) — update did not clear it.
    return {
      status: "UNKNOWN" as const,
      reconciled: true,
      assistantMessageId: assistantId,
      generationId,
      resultJson: updated[0]?.resultJson ?? row.resultJson,
    };
  });
}

export async function reserveTurnCommand(args: {
  conversationId: string;
  ownerPilotId: string;
  clientTurnKey: string;
  content: string;
}): Promise<ReservedTurn | ReplayedTurn> {
  const fp = turnFingerprint(args.content);
  const clientTurnKey = args.clientTurnKey.trim();
  if (!clientTurnKey) {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "clientTurnKey requis");
  }

  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.execute(sql`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(${args.conversationId}))`);

    const existing = (
      await tx
        .select()
        .from(conversationTurnCommands)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(conversationTurnCommands.conversationId, args.conversationId),
            eq(conversationTurnCommands.clientTurnKey, clientTurnKey),
          ),
        )
        .limit(1)
    )[0];

    if (existing) {
      if (existing.requestFingerprint !== fp) {
        throw new StudioError(
          "PAYLOAD_MISMATCH",
          "Même clientTurnKey avec payload divergent",
          { httpStatus: 409 },
        );
      }

      if (existing.status === "RUNNING" || existing.status === "ACCEPTED") {
        let assistantId = existing.assistantMessageId;
        let generationId = existing.generationId;
        if (!assistantId && existing.ordinalAssistant != null) {
          const existingAssistant = (
            await tx
              .select()
              .from(messages)
              .where(
                and(
                  eq(messages.conversationId, existing.conversationId),
                  eq(messages.ordinal, existing.ordinalAssistant),
                  eq(messages.role, "assistant"),
                ),
              )
              .limit(1)
          )[0];
          if (
            existingAssistant &&
            Boolean(existing.generationId) &&
            Boolean(existingAssistant.generationId) &&
            existing.generationId === existingAssistant.generationId
          ) {
            assistantId = existingAssistant.id;
            generationId = existingAssistant.generationId ?? generationId;
          }
        }

        const stale = isStaleRunning(existing.updatedAt);
        if (assistantId || stale) {
          await tx
            .update(conversationTurnCommands)
            .set({
              status: "UNKNOWN",
              assistantMessageId: assistantId,
              generationId,
              errorCategory: assistantId
                ? "RECONCILED_ASSISTANT_PRESENT_TURN_UNKNOWN"
                : "RECONCILED_STALE_RUNNING_NO_ASSISTANT",
              ownerToken: `revoked_${randomUUID()}`,
              updatedAt: new Date(turnClock.nowMs()),
            })
            .where(
              and(
                eq(conversationTurnCommands.id, existing.id),
                eq(conversationTurnCommands.status, existing.status),
              ),
            );
          return {
            kind: "replay" as const,
            commandId: existing.id,
            operationId: existing.operationId,
            status: "UNKNOWN",
            resultJson: existing.resultJson,
            generationId,
            userMessageId: existing.userMessageId,
            assistantMessageId: assistantId,
            clientTurnKey: existing.clientTurnKey,
            reconciled: true,
          };
        }

        throw new StudioError("TURN_IN_PROGRESS", "Tour déjà en cours pour cette conversation", {
          httpStatus: 409,
        });
      }

      return {
        kind: "replay" as const,
        commandId: existing.id,
        operationId: existing.operationId,
        status: existing.status as TurnCommandStatus,
        resultJson: existing.resultJson,
        generationId: existing.generationId,
        userMessageId: existing.userMessageId,
        assistantMessageId: existing.assistantMessageId,
        clientTurnKey: existing.clientTurnKey,
      };
    }

    const running = (
      await tx
        .select()
        .from(conversationTurnCommands)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(conversationTurnCommands.conversationId, args.conversationId),
            eq(conversationTurnCommands.status, "RUNNING"),
          ),
        )
        .limit(1)
    )[0];

    if (running) {
      const stale = isStaleRunning(running.updatedAt);
      if (stale) {
        await tx
          .update(conversationTurnCommands)
          .set({
            status: "UNKNOWN",
            errorCategory: "RECONCILED_STALE_RUNNING_OTHER_KEY",
            ownerToken: `revoked_${randomUUID()}`,
            updatedAt: new Date(turnClock.nowMs()),
          })
          .where(
            and(
              eq(conversationTurnCommands.id, running.id),
              eq(conversationTurnCommands.status, "RUNNING"),
            ),
          );
      } else {
        throw new StudioError("TURN_IN_PROGRESS", "Autre tour RUNNING sur cette conversation", {
          httpStatus: 409,
        });
      }
    }

    const last = (
      await tx
        .select({ ordinal: messages.ordinal })
        .from(messages)
        .where(eq(messages.conversationId, args.conversationId))
        .orderBy(sql`${messages.ordinal} desc`)
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    const ordinalUser = (last?.ordinal ?? 0) + 1;
    const ordinalAssistant = ordinalUser + 1;
    const userMessageId = newId("msg");
    const commandId = newId("tcmd");
    const operationId = newOperationId();
    const ownerToken = newOwnerToken();

    await tx.insert(messages).values({
      id: userMessageId,
      conversationId: args.conversationId,
      role: "user",
      content: args.content,
      status: "COMPLETE",
      ordinal: ordinalUser,
    });

    await tx.insert(conversationTurnCommands).values({
      id: commandId,
      conversationId: args.conversationId,
      ownerPilotId: args.ownerPilotId,
      clientTurnKey,
      requestFingerprint: fp,
      operationId,
      status: "RUNNING",
      ownerToken,
      ordinalUser,
      ordinalAssistant,
      userMessageId,
      updatedAt: new Date(turnClock.nowMs()),
    });

    return {
      kind: "fresh" as const,
      commandId,
      operationId,
      conversationId: args.conversationId,
      clientTurnKey,
      requestFingerprint: fp,
      ownerToken,
      ordinalUser,
      ordinalAssistant,
      userMessageId,
    };
  });
}

/**
 * S05 — sibling turns still unresolved for the same conversation (excluding current key).
 * Server authority for pending coexistence; client sessionStorage is UX aid only.
 * Ordered deterministically by createdAt then id (QA-19).
 */
export async function findUnresolvedSiblingTurns(args: {
  conversationId: string;
  ownerPilotId: string;
  excludeClientTurnKey: string;
}): Promise<
  Array<{
    id: string;
    clientTurnKey: string;
    status: TurnCommandStatus;
    operationId: string;
    userMessageId: string | null;
    createdAt: Date;
    resultJson: string | null;
  }>
> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: conversationTurnCommands.id,
      clientTurnKey: conversationTurnCommands.clientTurnKey,
      status: conversationTurnCommands.status,
      operationId: conversationTurnCommands.operationId,
      userMessageId: conversationTurnCommands.userMessageId,
      createdAt: conversationTurnCommands.createdAt,
      resultJson: conversationTurnCommands.resultJson,
    })
    .from(conversationTurnCommands)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(conversationTurnCommands.conversationId, args.conversationId),
        eq(conversationTurnCommands.ownerPilotId, args.ownerPilotId),
        ne(conversationTurnCommands.clientTurnKey, args.excludeClientTurnKey),
        sql`${conversationTurnCommands.status} IN ('RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED', 'UNKNOWN')`,
      ),
    )
    .orderBy(asc(conversationTurnCommands.createdAt), asc(conversationTurnCommands.id));
  return rows.map((r) => ({
    id: r.id,
    clientTurnKey: r.clientTurnKey,
    status: r.status as TurnCommandStatus,
    operationId: r.operationId,
    userMessageId: r.userMessageId,
    createdAt: r.createdAt,
    resultJson: r.resultJson,
  }));
}

/**
 * Persist validated semantic qualification on a RUNNING turn before any owner mutation (TV-04).
 * Merges into resultJson without changing status. CAS under ownerToken.
 * Does not requalify: callers must pass the already-validated envelope.
 */
export async function stashTurnQualification(args: {
  commandId: string;
  ownerToken: string;
  qualificationJson: string;
}): Promise<{ applied: boolean }> {
  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.execute(
      sql`select id from conversation_turn_commands
          where id = ${args.commandId}
            and owner_token = ${args.ownerToken}
            and status in ('RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED')
          for update`,
    );
    const owned = (
      await tx
        .select({
          id: conversationTurnCommands.id,
          resultJson: conversationTurnCommands.resultJson,
        })
        .from(conversationTurnCommands)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(conversationTurnCommands.id, args.commandId),
            eq(conversationTurnCommands.ownerToken, args.ownerToken),
            sql`${conversationTurnCommands.status} IN ('RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED')`,
          ),
        )
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    if (!owned) return { applied: false };

    let qualification: unknown;
    try {
      qualification = JSON.parse(args.qualificationJson) as unknown;
    } catch {
      // Invalid qualification JSON — refuse stash (no mutation of resultJson).
      return { applied: false };
    }
    let merged: Record<string, unknown> = {
      semanticQualification: qualification,
      semanticQualificationStashedAt: new Date(turnClock.nowMs()).toISOString(),
    };
    if (owned.resultJson) {
      try {
        const prev = JSON.parse(owned.resultJson) as Record<string, unknown>;
        // Never overwrite a terminal payload shape; only enrich while RUNNING.
        merged = { ...prev, ...merged };
      } catch {
        // Prior JSON unreadable — refuse rather than risk losing prior durable state.
        return { applied: false };
      }
    }

    const updated = await tx
      .update(conversationTurnCommands)
      .set({
        resultJson: JSON.stringify(merged),
        updatedAt: new Date(turnClock.nowMs()),
      })
      .where(
        and(
          eq(conversationTurnCommands.id, args.commandId),
          eq(conversationTurnCommands.ownerToken, args.ownerToken),
          sql`${conversationTurnCommands.status} IN ('RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED')`,
        ),
      )
      .returning({ id: conversationTurnCommands.id });
    return { applied: Boolean(updated[0]) };
  });
}

/**
 * Seal a document command binding into resultJson before any D4 mutation (O-04/O-05).
 * Appends under documentCommandBindings[]; refuses overwrite of an existing same correlationKey.
 */
export async function stashDocumentCommandBinding(args: {
  commandId: string;
  ownerToken: string;
  binding: Record<string, unknown>;
}): Promise<{ applied: boolean }> {
  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.execute(
      sql`select id from conversation_turn_commands
          where id = ${args.commandId}
            and owner_token = ${args.ownerToken}
            and status in ('RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED')
          for update`,
    );
    const owned = (
      await tx
        .select({
          id: conversationTurnCommands.id,
          resultJson: conversationTurnCommands.resultJson,
        })
        .from(conversationTurnCommands)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(conversationTurnCommands.id, args.commandId),
            eq(conversationTurnCommands.ownerToken, args.ownerToken),
            sql`${conversationTurnCommands.status} IN ('RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED')`,
          ),
        )
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    if (!owned) return { applied: false };

    let prev: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    if (owned.resultJson) {
      try {
        prev = JSON.parse(owned.resultJson) as Record<string, unknown>;
      } catch {
        return { applied: false };
      }
    }
    const existing = Array.isArray(prev.documentCommandBindings)
      ? (prev.documentCommandBindings as Array<Record<string, unknown>>)
      : [];
    const corr = typeof args.binding.correlationKey === "string" ? args.binding.correlationKey : "";
    if (corr && existing.some((b) => b.correlationKey === corr)) {
      const prior = existing.find((b) => b.correlationKey === corr)!;
      const priorPayload = prior.payloadSha256;
      if (priorPayload !== args.binding.payloadSha256) {
        return { applied: false };
      }
      // Identical binding already sealed — treat as applied without rewrite.
      return { applied: true };
    }
    const merged = {
      ...prev,
      documentCommandBindings: [...existing, args.binding],
      documentCommandBindingStashedAt: new Date(turnClock.nowMs()).toISOString(),
    };
    const updated = await tx
      .update(conversationTurnCommands)
      .set({
        resultJson: JSON.stringify(merged),
        updatedAt: new Date(turnClock.nowMs()),
      })
      .where(
        and(
          eq(conversationTurnCommands.id, args.commandId),
          eq(conversationTurnCommands.ownerToken, args.ownerToken),
          sql`${conversationTurnCommands.status} IN ('RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED')`,
        ),
      )
      .returning({ id: conversationTurnCommands.id });
    return { applied: Boolean(updated[0]) };
  });
}

/**
 * Atomic terminal commit under ownership fence:
 * FOR UPDATE lock → optional assistant INSERT → CAS UPDATE in the same short TX.
 * CAS miss after INSERT throws → full TX rollback (no orphan assistant).
 * Lost ownership ⇒ applied:false — caller must not return COMPLETE.
 */
export async function commitTurnTerminal(args: {
  commandId: string;
  ownerToken: string;
  status: TurnCommandStatus;
  conversationId: string;
  assistant?: {
    id: string;
    content: string;
    messageStatus: string;
    generationId: string;
    ordinal: number;
  };
  generationId?: string;
  resultJson?: string;
  errorCategory?: string;
}): Promise<{ applied: boolean }> {
  if (args.status === "RUNNING" || args.status === "ACCEPTED") {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "commitTurnTerminal exige un statut terminal");
  }

  try {
    return await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      // Exclusive lock: blocks reconcile revoke and concurrent terminal writers.
      await tx.execute(
        sql`select id from conversation_turn_commands
            where id = ${args.commandId}
              and owner_token = ${args.ownerToken}
              and status in ('RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED')
            for update`,
      );

      const owned = (
        await tx
          .select({
            id: conversationTurnCommands.id,
            assistantMessageId: conversationTurnCommands.assistantMessageId,
            generationId: conversationTurnCommands.generationId,
            resultJson: conversationTurnCommands.resultJson,
          })
          .from(conversationTurnCommands)
          .where(
            and(
              eq(conversationTurnCommands.id, args.commandId),
              eq(conversationTurnCommands.ownerToken, args.ownerToken),
              sql`${conversationTurnCommands.status} IN ('RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED')`,
            ),
          )
          .limit(1)
      )[0];
      if (!owned) {
        return { applied: false };
      }

      // T-03 / Lot B + O-04 + E05/M1: preserve stashed semanticQualification,
      // documentCommandBindings, and turnProjection when terminal omits them.
      let terminalJson = args.resultJson ?? null;
      if (owned.resultJson) {
        try {
          const prev = JSON.parse(owned.resultJson) as Record<string, unknown>;
          if (terminalJson) {
            const next = JSON.parse(terminalJson) as Record<string, unknown>;
            if (prev.semanticQualification !== undefined && next.semanticQualification === undefined) {
              next.semanticQualification = prev.semanticQualification;
              next.semanticQualificationStashedAt = prev.semanticQualificationStashedAt;
            }
            if (
              prev.documentCommandBindings !== undefined &&
              next.documentCommandBindings === undefined
            ) {
              next.documentCommandBindings = prev.documentCommandBindings;
              next.documentCommandBindingStashedAt = prev.documentCommandBindingStashedAt;
            }
            if (prev.turnProjection !== undefined && next.turnProjection === undefined) {
              next.turnProjection = prev.turnProjection;
            }
            // F1/F2 — sealed proposal candidates + historical authorizations must survive terminal.
            if (
              prev.pendingDocumentCandidates !== undefined &&
              next.pendingDocumentCandidates === undefined
            ) {
              next.pendingDocumentCandidates = prev.pendingDocumentCandidates;
            }
            if (
              prev.historicalSourceAuthorizations !== undefined &&
              next.historicalSourceAuthorizations === undefined
            ) {
              next.historicalSourceAuthorizations = prev.historicalSourceAuthorizations;
            }
            terminalJson = JSON.stringify(next);
          } else {
            terminalJson = owned.resultJson;
          }
        } catch {
          // Fail closed: keep prior durable JSON rather than wipe qualification.
          terminalJson = owned.resultJson;
        }
      }

      let assistantMessageId = args.assistant?.id ?? owned.assistantMessageId ?? null;

      if (args.assistant) {
        const existingAssistant = (
          await tx
            .select()
            .from(messages)
            .where(
              and(
                eq(messages.conversationId, args.conversationId),
                eq(messages.ordinal, args.assistant.ordinal),
                eq(messages.role, "assistant"),
              ),
            )
            .limit(1)
        )[0];

        if (!existingAssistant) {
          await tx.insert(messages).values({
            id: args.assistant.id,
            conversationId: args.conversationId,
            role: "assistant",
            content: args.assistant.content,
            status: args.assistant.messageStatus,
            generationId: args.assistant.generationId,
            ordinal: args.assistant.ordinal,
          });
          assistantMessageId = args.assistant.id;
        } else {
          // Reuse only with demonstrable identity: both generationIds non-empty and equal,
          // plus same message id or already-bound assistantMessageId. sameId/alreadyBound alone
          // are never sufficient when generation proof is missing or mismatched.
          const expectedGen = args.assistant.generationId?.trim() || null;
          const messageGen = existingAssistant.generationId?.trim() || null;
          const commandGen =
            (args.generationId ?? owned.generationId)?.trim() || expectedGen;
          const gensMatch =
            Boolean(expectedGen) &&
            Boolean(messageGen) &&
            Boolean(commandGen) &&
            expectedGen === messageGen &&
            commandGen === messageGen;
          const sameId = existingAssistant.id === args.assistant.id;
          const alreadyBound = owned.assistantMessageId === existingAssistant.id;
          const idConflict =
            Boolean(owned.assistantMessageId) &&
            owned.assistantMessageId !== existingAssistant.id &&
            !sameId;

          if (!gensMatch || idConflict || (!sameId && !alreadyBound)) {
            throw new StudioError(
              "CONFLICT",
              "Ordinal assistant incompatible avec la génération/commande courante",
              { httpStatus: 409 },
            );
          }
          assistantMessageId = existingAssistant.id;
        }
      }

      if (turnRaceHooks.insideTerminalTxAfterInsert) {
        await turnRaceHooks.insideTerminalTxAfterInsert(tx as FenceTx);
      }

      const updated = await tx
        .update(conversationTurnCommands)
        .set({
          status: args.status,
          assistantMessageId,
          generationId: args.generationId ?? args.assistant?.generationId ?? null,
          resultJson: terminalJson,
          errorCategory: args.errorCategory ?? null,
          updatedAt: new Date(turnClock.nowMs()),
        })
        .where(
          and(
            eq(conversationTurnCommands.id, args.commandId),
            eq(conversationTurnCommands.ownerToken, args.ownerToken),
            sql`${conversationTurnCommands.status} IN ('RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED')`,
          ),
        )
        .returning({ id: conversationTurnCommands.id });

      if (updated.length === 0) {
        // Must not commit a prior INSERT in this TX.
        throw new TurnTerminalCasMissError();
      }
      return { applied: true };
    });
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof TurnTerminalCasMissError) {
      return { applied: false };
    }
    throw e;
  }
}
/**
 * Terminal write for legacy UNKNOWN paths. ALWAYS preserves stashed
 * semanticQualification (T-03 / Lot B) — never wipe resultJson to null when
 * a prior stash exists.
 */
export async function completeTurnCommand(args: {
  commandId: string;
  status: TurnCommandStatus;
  assistantMessageId?: string;
  generationId?: string;
  resultJson?: string;
  errorCategory?: string;
  ownerToken?: string;
}): Promise<{ applied: boolean }> {
  if (args.status === "RUNNING" || args.status === "ACCEPTED") {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "completeTurnCommand exige un statut terminal");
  }

  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const conditions = [
      eq(conversationTurnCommands.id, args.commandId),
      sql`${conversationTurnCommands.status} IN ('RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED')`,
    ];
    if (args.ownerToken) {
      conditions.push(eq(conversationTurnCommands.ownerToken, args.ownerToken));
    }

    await tx.execute(
      sql`select id from conversation_turn_commands
          where id = ${args.commandId}
            and status in ('RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED')
          for update`,
    );

    const owned = (
      await tx
        .select({
          id: conversationTurnCommands.id,
          resultJson: conversationTurnCommands.resultJson,
          assistantMessageId: conversationTurnCommands.assistantMessageId,
          generationId: conversationTurnCommands.generationId,
        })
        .from(conversationTurnCommands)
        .where(and(...conditions))
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    if (!owned) return { applied: false };

    let terminalJson = args.resultJson ?? null;
    if (owned.resultJson) {
      try {
        const prev = JSON.parse(owned.resultJson) as Record<string, unknown>;
        if (terminalJson) {
          const next = JSON.parse(terminalJson) as Record<string, unknown>;
          if (prev.semanticQualification !== undefined && next.semanticQualification === undefined) {
            next.semanticQualification = prev.semanticQualification;
            next.semanticQualificationStashedAt = prev.semanticQualificationStashedAt;
          }
          if (
            prev.pendingDocumentCandidates !== undefined &&
            next.pendingDocumentCandidates === undefined
          ) {
            next.pendingDocumentCandidates = prev.pendingDocumentCandidates;
          }
          if (
            prev.historicalSourceAuthorizations !== undefined &&
            next.historicalSourceAuthorizations === undefined
          ) {
            next.historicalSourceAuthorizations = prev.historicalSourceAuthorizations;
          }
          terminalJson = JSON.stringify(next);
        } else {
          // No new payload — keep prior resultJson (qualification must survive UNKNOWN).
          terminalJson = owned.resultJson;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Fail closed on merge/parse: keep prior durable JSON rather than wipe.
        terminalJson = owned.resultJson;
        void e;
      }
    }

    const updated = await tx
      .update(conversationTurnCommands)
      .set({
        status: args.status,
        assistantMessageId: args.assistantMessageId ?? owned.assistantMessageId ?? null,
        generationId: args.generationId ?? owned.generationId ?? null,
        resultJson: terminalJson,
        errorCategory: args.errorCategory ?? null,
        updatedAt: new Date(turnClock.nowMs()),
      })
      .where(and(...conditions))
      .returning({ id: conversationTurnCommands.id });

    return { applied: updated.length > 0 };
  });
}

export async function markTurnUnknown(
  commandId: string,
  errorCategory: string,
  ownerToken?: string,
  resultJson?: string,
) {
  await completeTurnCommand({
    commandId,
    status: "UNKNOWN",
    errorCategory,
    ownerToken,
    resultJson,
  });
}

/** Force-stale helper for tests — advances updated_at into the past (uses turnClock). */
export async function injectStaleRunningForTests(commandId: string, ageMs = TURN_RUNNING_STALE_MS + 1000) {
  const past = new Date(turnClock.nowMs() - ageMs);
  await db
    .update(conversationTurnCommands)
    .set({ updatedAt: past })
    .where(eq(conversationTurnCommands.id, commandId));
}

/** Test helper: revoke ownership while leaving status RUNNING (simulates lost fence mid-flight). */
export async function revokeOwnerTokenForTests(commandId: string) {
  await db
    .update(conversationTurnCommands)
    .set({
      ownerToken: `revoked_${randomUUID()}`,
      updatedAt: new Date(turnClock.nowMs()),
    })
    .where(eq(conversationTurnCommands.id, commandId));
}
```

```typescript
  messageId: string | null;
  turnCommandId?: string | null;
  finalized: boolean;
  status: string;
  choices: TurnChoice[];
  references: TurnReference[];
  activity?: TurnActivitySummary | null;
  /**
   * Optional validated visual composition (T02).
   * Absent on historical turns — SafeMarkdown-only remains valid.
   */
  visualComposition?: VisualComposition | null;
};

export type MessageProjectionView = TurnProjection & {
  /** Actionable only for the latest finalized Nora turn with no later pilot turn. */
  actionable: boolean;
};

export type ContinueChoiceInput = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  transmitText: string;
};

/**
 * Build projection from durable turn facts.
 * Continue choices come ONLY from typed continueChoices — never from clarifications[].
 */
export function buildTurnProjection(input: {
  messageId: string | null;
  turnCommandId?: string | null;
  status: string;
  finalized: boolean;
  /** Typed continuation offers — distinct from open questions (clarifications). */
  continueChoices?: ContinueChoiceInput[] | null;
  references?: TurnReference[] | null;
  toolCallsObserved?: number | null;
  d4CharsReturned?: number | null;
  documentSave?: { documentId?: string; revisionId?: string; status?: string } | null;
  /** Optional T02 visual composition — sanitized; invalid → omitted. */
  visualComposition?: unknown;
}): TurnProjection {
  const choices: TurnChoice[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const raw of input.continueChoices ?? []) {
    const id = String(raw?.id ?? "").trim();
    const label = String(raw?.label ?? "").trim();
    const transmitText = String(raw?.transmitText ?? "").trim();
    if (!id || !label || !transmitText) continue;
    if (seen.has(id) || seen.has(transmitText)) continue;
    seen.add(id);
    seen.add(transmitText);
    choices.push({
      id,
      label: label.length > 120 ? `${label.slice(0, 117)}…` : label,
      kind: "continue",
      transmitText,
    });
    if (choices.length >= 6) break;
  }

  const references: TurnReference[] = [...(input.references ?? [])];
  if (input.documentSave?.documentId) {
    const already = references.some(
      (r) => r.kind === "document" && r.resourceId === input.documentSave!.documentId,
    );
    if (!already) {
      references.push({
        kind: "document",
        label: "Document du projet",
        resourceId: input.documentSave.documentId,
        revisionId: input.documentSave.revisionId,
        available: input.documentSave.status !== "FAILED",
      });
    }
  }

  let activity: TurnActivitySummary | null = null;
  const status = (input.status ?? "").toUpperCase();
  if (status === "FAILED") {
    activity = { kind: "failed", label: "Réponse interrompue ou en échec" };
  } else if (status === "UNKNOWN") {
    activity = { kind: "uncertain", label: "État de la réponse encore incertain" };
  } else if ((input.toolCallsObserved ?? 0) > 0 || (input.d4CharsReturned ?? 0) > 0) {
    activity = {
      kind: "sources_consulted",
      label: "Sources consultées pour cette réponse",
      detail:
        (input.toolCallsObserved ?? 0) > 0
          ? `${input.toolCallsObserved} consultation(s) observée(s)`
          : undefined,
    };
  }

  const visualComposition = parseVisualComposition(input.visualComposition);

  return {
    schemaVersion: TURN_PROJECTION_SCHEMA,
    messageId: input.messageId,
    turnCommandId: input.turnCommandId ?? null,
    finalized: input.finalized,
    status: input.status,
    choices,
    references,
    activity,
    ...(visualComposition ? { visualComposition } : {}),
  };
}

function isContinueChoice(c: unknown): c is TurnChoice {
  if (!c || typeof c !== "object") return false;
  const o = c as Record<string, unknown>;
  return (
    typeof o.id === "string" &&
    typeof o.label === "string" &&
    o.kind === "continue" &&
    typeof o.transmitText === "string" &&
    o.transmitText.trim().length > 0
  );
}

export function parseTurnProjection(raw: unknown): TurnProjection | null {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") return null;
  const o = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (o.schemaVersion !== TURN_PROJECTION_SCHEMA) return null;
  if (!Array.isArray(o.choices)) return null;
  const visualComposition = parseVisualComposition(o.visualComposition);
  return {
    schemaVersion: TURN_PROJECTION_SCHEMA,
    messageId: typeof o.messageId === "string" ? o.messageId : null,
    turnCommandId: typeof o.turnCommandId === "string" ? o.turnCommandId : null,
    finalized: Boolean(o.finalized),
    status: typeof o.status === "string" ? o.status : "UNKNOWN",
    choices: (o.choices as unknown[]).filter(isContinueChoice),
    references: Array.isArray(o.references) ? (o.references as TurnReference[]) : [],
    activity: (o.activity as TurnActivitySummary | null | undefined) ?? null,
    ...(visualComposition ? { visualComposition } : {}),
  };
}

export function extractTurnProjectionFromResultJson(
  resultJson: string | null | undefined,
): TurnProjection | null {
  if (!resultJson) return null;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(resultJson) as Record<string, unknown>;
    return parseTurnProjection(parsed.turnProjection);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Mark which projection groups remain actionable after reload / new pilot turn.
 * Historical choices stay visible but non-actionable.
 * UNKNOWN / frozen attempt → suspendActions keeps groups non-actionable.
 */
export function resolveActionableProjections(input: {
  messages: Array<{ id: string; role: string }>;
  projections: TurnProjection[];
  /** When true (UNKNOWN send / reconcile / in-flight), suspend actionable choices. */
  suspendActions?: boolean;
}): MessageProjectionView[] {
  const lastAssistantId = [...input.messages]
    .reverse()
    .find((m) => m.role === "assistant")?.id;
  const lastAssistantIdx = lastAssistantId
    ? input.messages.findIndex((m) => m.id === lastAssistantId)
    : -1;
  const hasLaterPilot =
    lastAssistantIdx >= 0 &&
    input.messages.slice(lastAssistantIdx + 1).some((m) => m.role === "user");

  return input.projections.map((p) => {
    const isLatest =
      Boolean(p.messageId) && p.messageId === lastAssistantId && !hasLaterPilot;
    const actionable =
      !input.suspendActions &&
      p.finalized &&
      isLatest &&
      (p.status ?? "").toUpperCase() !== "UNKNOWN" &&
      (p.status ?? "").toUpperCase() !== "FAILED" &&
      p.choices.length > 0;
    return { ...p, actionable };
  });
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Ensemble 05 / T02+consolidation+corrective — additive visual composition contract.
 * Validated structured blocks only — never executable HTML/JS from the model.
 * Stored inside turnProjection (result_json) — no migration.
 *
 * Fidelity rule (P1-A): a composition owns the on-screen body only when every
 * declared block and field is conserved without silent truncation/drop.
 * Otherwise parse fails closed → replyDraft Markdown fallback.
 *
 * Provenance rule (P1-B): declarative fields never authorize consultation;
 * Studio resolves against canonical turn references.
 */

import { z } from "zod";

/** Historical E05 wire — read/compat only. */
export const VISUAL_COMPOSITION_SCHEMA_LEGACY = "e05-visual-composition-v1" as const;
/**
 * Strategy B historical wire (replyDraft authority + optional projection).
 * READ only for stored turns — never re-interpreted as canonical_sections (A3).
 */
export const VISUAL_COMPOSITION_SCHEMA_PROJECTION =
  "conversational-composition-projection-v1" as const;
/** Strategy A active WRITE — canonical semantic sections (single authority). */
export const VISUAL_COMPOSITION_SCHEMA = "conversational-composition-canonical-v1" as const;
export type VisualCompositionSchemaVersion =
  | typeof VISUAL_COMPOSITION_SCHEMA
  | typeof VISUAL_COMPOSITION_SCHEMA_PROJECTION
  | typeof VISUAL_COMPOSITION_SCHEMA_LEGACY;

export function isKnownVisualCompositionSchema(
  v: unknown,
): v is VisualCompositionSchemaVersion {
  return (
    v === VISUAL_COMPOSITION_SCHEMA ||
    v === VISUAL_COMPOSITION_SCHEMA_PROJECTION ||
    v === VISUAL_COMPOSITION_SCHEMA_LEGACY
  );
}

export type VisualBlockKind =
  | "comparison"
  | "sequence"
  | "relations"
  | "synthesis"
  | "text"
  | "choices"
  | "references";

/** Semantic role — Studio maps to icon/colour; never invents authority. */
export type VisualSemanticRole =
  | "information"
  | "observation"
  | "fact"
  | "hypothesis"
  | "risk"
  | "recommendation"
  | "decision"
  | "dependency"
  | "step"
  | "source";

/** Allowlisted icon ids only — no arbitrary SVG/URL from the model. */
export type VisualIconId =
  | "info"
  | "observe"
  | "fact"
  | "hypothesis"
  | "risk"
  | "recommend"
  | "decision"
  | "link"
  | "step"
  | "source";

export const VISUAL_ICON_IDS: readonly VisualIconId[] = [
  "info",

  "fact",
  "hypothesis",
  "risk",
  "recommend",
  "decision",
  "link",
  "step",

] as const;

export type ParseVisualCompositionResult =
  | { ok: true; value: VisualComposition }
  | { ok: false; reason: string };

const MAX_BLOCKS = 10;

const MAX_STEPS = 8;
```
