```typescript
/**
 * B04 — citation / provenance contract for public web sources.
 * Distinguishes discovery vs open, records URL actually established, freshness.
 * Does not invent CONSULTED content. WEB LIVE remains gated.
 */

export type WebSourceCitation = {
  url: string;
  /** Final URL after validation — never a private destination. */
  establishedUrl: string;
  title: string | null;
  publishedAt: string | null;
  retrievedAt: string;
  freshness: "UNKNOWN" | "FRESH" | "STALE" | "UNAVAILABLE";
  coverage: "DISCOVERED" | "OPENED" | "CONSULTED" | "DENIED" | "PARTIAL";
  excerpt: string | null;
  limits: string[];
};

export function buildWebSourceCitation(input: {
  url: string;
  establishedUrl?: string | null;
  title?: string | null;
  publishedAt?: string | null;
  retrievedAt?: string;
  coverage: WebSourceCitation["coverage"];
  excerpt?: string | null;
  contentUnavailable?: boolean;
  limits?: string[];
}): WebSourceCitation {
  const retrievedAt = input.retrievedAt ?? new Date().toISOString();
  let freshness: WebSourceCitation["freshness"] = "UNKNOWN";
  if (input.contentUnavailable || input.coverage === "DENIED") {
    freshness = "UNAVAILABLE";
  } else if (input.publishedAt) {
    const ageMs = Date.now() - Date.parse(input.publishedAt);
    if (Number.isFinite(ageMs)) {
      freshness = ageMs > 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 365 ? "STALE" : "FRESH";
    }
  }
  const limits = [...(input.limits ?? [])];
  if (input.coverage === "DISCOVERED") {
    limits.push("DISCOVERED_NOT_OPENED — citation incomplete until OPENED/CONSULTED");
  }
  if (!input.excerpt && (input.coverage === "OPENED" || input.coverage === "CONSULTED")) {
    limits.push("NO_EXCERPT_CAPTURED");
  }
  return {
    url: input.url,
    establishedUrl: (input.establishedUrl ?? input.url).trim(),
    title: input.title?.trim() || null,
    publishedAt: input.publishedAt ?? null,
    retrievedAt,
    freshness,
    coverage: input.coverage,
    excerpt: input.excerpt?.slice(0, 500) ?? null,
    limits,
  };
}

export function formatCitationForDisplay(c: WebSourceCitation): string {
  const title = c.title || c.establishedUrl;
  const when = c.publishedAt ? ` (${c.publishedAt.slice(0, 10)})` : "";
  const note =
    c.coverage === "DISCOVERED"
      ? " [découvert, non ouvert]"
      : c.coverage === "DENIED"
        ? " [refusé]"
        : "";
  return `${title}${when} — ${c.establishedUrl}${note}`;
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * CA-01 / C14 bridge — after a Nora turn, persist investigation facts and optionally
 * prepare a DRAFT technical contract. Reuses nora-contract-prepare + investigation
 * persistence — no second preparation engine.
 *
 * C14: contract-prepare intent is semantic (qualification intents), never lexical.
 */

import { prepareTechnicalContractFromNora } from "@/domains/execution/nora-contract-prepare";
import type { TechnicalContractBody } from "@/domains/execution/types";
import {
  createEmptyInvestigation,
  evaluateContractReadiness,
  type InvestigationSourceRef,
  type InvestigationState,
} from "./investigation-state";
import {
  loadInvestigationSnapshot,
  saveInvestigationSnapshot,
} from "./investigation-persistence";
import { appendActivityEvent } from "./activity-projection";
import type { NoraTurnQualification } from "./semantic-qualification";

/** C14 — semantic prepare signal from structured qualification (not user-text regex). */
export function semanticWantsCursorContractPrepare(
  qualification: NoraTurnQualification | null | undefined,
): boolean {
  if (!qualification || qualification.status === "UNAVAILABLE") return false;
  return qualification.intents.some(
    (i) =>
      i.capabilityId === "d7.prepare_cursor_contract" &&
      (i.mode === "PREPARE" || i.mode === "REQUEST_EFFECT"),
  );
}

/** C14 — corrective draft within existing mandate (A04); never implies dispatch. */
export function semanticWantsCorrectiveDraft(
  qualification: NoraTurnQualification | null | undefined,
): boolean {
  if (!qualification || qualification.status === "UNAVAILABLE") return false;
  return qualification.intents.some(
    (i) =>
      i.capabilityId === "d7.prepare_cursor_contract" &&
      (i.parameters?.correctiveDraft === "true" ||
        // legacy boolean if ever present in persisted JSON
        (i.parameters as { correctiveDraft?: unknown })?.correctiveDraft === true),
  );
}

/**
 * @deprecated C14 — lexical detectors removed. Kept as always-false stubs so any
 * residual import fails closed (no contract from keywords). Prefer semanticWants*.
 */
export function detectsTechnicalContractIntent(_text: string): boolean {
  return false;
}

/** @deprecated C14 — see detectsTechnicalContractIntent. */
export function detectsCorrectiveDraftIntent(_text: string): boolean {
  return false;
}

export function draftBodyFromInvestigation(
  inv: InvestigationState,
  opts?: {
    title?: string;
    instructionExtra?: string;
    /** Full assistant prose when available — not silently truncated to a toy budget. */
    instructionFromNora?: string;
    businessCriteria?: string[];
  },
): TechnicalContractBody {
  const title =
    opts?.title?.trim() ||
    inv.desiredOutcome.trim() ||
    inv.intentSummary.trim().slice(0, 120) ||
    "Contrat technique préparé par Nora";
  const consulted = inv.sources.filter(
    (s) => s.coverage === "CONSULTED" || s.coverage === "VERIFIED",
  );
  const sources = consulted.map((s) => `${s.kind}:${s.ref}`).join(", ");
  const openQs = inv.questions
    .filter((q) => q.status === "OPEN" || q.status === "BLOCKED")
    .map((q) => `[${q.importance}] ${q.text}`)
    .join("\n- ");
  const contradictions = inv.contradictions
    .map((c) => `${c.a} ↔ ${c.b}: ${c.detail}`)
    .join("\n- ");
  const noraInstruction = (
    opts?.instructionFromNora?.trim() ||
    opts?.instructionExtra?.trim() ||
    ""
  ).slice(0, 24_000);

  const instruction = [
    `# Instruction technique (issue de l'investigation Nora)`,
    ``,
    `## Mission`,
    inv.intentSummary || "(intention non résumée)",
    inv.desiredOutcome ? `\n## Résultat attendu\n${inv.desiredOutcome}` : null,
    inv.constraints.length
      ? `\n## Contraintes / restrictions\n- ${inv.constraints.join("\n- ")}`
      : null,
    inv.exclusions.length
      ? `\n## Exclusions (OUT)\n- ${inv.exclusions.join("\n- ")}`
      : null,
    inv.risks.length ? `\n## Risques\n- ${inv.risks.join("\n- ")}` : null,
    sources
      ? `\n## Sources consultées (CONSULTED/VERIFIED)\n${sources}`
      : `\n## Sources\nAucune source CONSULTED/VERIFIED au moment de la préparation.`,
    openQs ? `\n## Questions encore ouvertes\n- ${openQs}` : null,
    contradictions ? `\n## Contradictions non résolues\n- ${contradictions}` : null,
    noraInstruction
      ? `\n## Élaboration Nora (contexte technique)\n${noraInstruction}`
      : null,
    `\n## Exécuteur`,
    `Cursor SDK local — aucune publication Git sans mandat D6/D9 distinct.`,
    `Préparer ≠ autoriser. Aucun dispatch sans HumanDecision D6.`,
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join("\n");

  const businessCriteria =
    opts?.businessCriteria?.filter((c) => c.trim()) ??
    inv.remainingWork.filter((w) => w.trim()).slice(0, 8);

  return {
    title,
    engagements: {
      willDo: inv.desiredOutcome || inv.intentSummary.slice(0, 400),
      willNotDo: inv.exclusions.join("; ") || "Hors périmètre non listé",
      expectedResult: inv.desiredOutcome || "Livrables conformes au contrat",
      pilotControl: "HumanDecision D6 avant dispatch ; STOP observé ≠ rollback",
    },
    volets: {
      mission: inv.intentSummary.slice(0, 800),
      perimeter: inv.constraints.join("; ") || "Périmètre à confirmer",
      capabilitiesAuthority: "CURSOR_SDK_LOCAL — permissions effectives uniquement",
      stopConditions:
        "STOP demandé / observé ; interruption → AMBIGUOUS si effet possible",
      proofsSources: sources || "Preuves à établir dans le handoff",
      integrity: "Fingerprint contrat + instruction exacte ; pas de troncature",
    },
    instructionText: instruction,
    risks: inv.risks.length ? inv.risks : ["Effets externes possibles via Cursor"],
    exclusions: inv.exclusions,
    acceptance: {
      criteria: businessCriteria.length
        ? businessCriteria
        : [
            "Comportements métier du résultat attendu vérifiés",
            "Handoff RECEIVED avec inventaire observé (complément, pas substitut métier)",
          ],
      expectedProofs: [
        "rapport markdown",
        "manifeste inventaire (fichiers observés)",
        "sorties de tests capturées lorsque des tests sont annoncés",
      ],
    },
    executor: {
      kind: "CURSOR_SDK_LOCAL",
      capabilities: ["file_edit", "shell_test"],
      permissionsNeeded: [],
    },
    stopConditions: ["STOP", "claim fence invalid"],
    reversibilityLimits: ["Pas de rollback automatique des effets Cursor"],
    gitScope: null,
  };
}

export type NoraContractBridgeInput = {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  preparationId: string;
  conversationId: string;
  turnCommandId: string;
  ownerToken?: string | null;
  userText: string;
  assistantText?: string;
  /** C14 — structured qualification drives prepare/corrective (required for intent). */
  qualification?: NoraTurnQualification | null;
  observedSources?: InvestigationSourceRef[];
  attemptPrepare?: boolean;
  contractKey?: string;
  sourceTurnCommandId?: string | null;
};

export type NoraContractBridgeResult = {
  intentDetected: boolean;
  correctiveIntent: boolean;
  investigation: InvestigationState | null;
  prepared: {
    contractId: string;
    contractKey: string;
    version: number;
    fingerprint: string;
    status: string;
  } | null;
  blockedReason: string | null;
  cursorRedispatch: false;
};

/**
 * Persist investigation progress and optionally prepare a DRAFT contract.
 * READY is never granted here. A04 corrective drafts never dispatch Cursor.
 */
export async function bridgeNoraTurnToContractPreparation(
  input: NoraContractBridgeInput,
): Promise<NoraContractBridgeResult> {
  const intentDetected = semanticWantsCursorContractPrepare(input.qualification);
  const correctiveIntent = semanticWantsCorrectiveDraft(input.qualification);
  if (!intentDetected && !correctiveIntent && !(input.observedSources?.length)) {
    return {
      intentDetected: false,
      correctiveIntent: false,
      investigation: null,
      prepared: null,
      blockedReason: null,
      cursorRedispatch: false,
    };
  }

  const prior =
    (await loadInvestigationSnapshot({
      pilotId: input.pilotId,
      preparationId: input.preparationId,
      intentFallback: input.userText,
    })) ?? createEmptyInvestigation(input.userText);

  const q = input.qualification;
  const merged: InvestigationState = {
    ...prior,
    intentSummary:
      (q?.goal?.trim() || prior.intentSummary || input.userText).slice(0, 800),
    desiredOutcome:
      (q?.desiredOutcome?.trim() || prior.desiredOutcome || "").slice(0, 800),
    sources: [
      ...prior.sources,
      ...(input.observedSources ?? []).filter(
        (s) => !prior.sources.some((p) => p.ref === s.ref && p.kind === s.kind),
      ),
    ],
    constraints: correctiveIntent
      ? [
          ...prior.constraints.filter((c) => !c.startsWith("A04:")),
          "A04: brouillon correctif dans mandat existant — aucun nouveau dispatch Cursor",
        ]
      : prior.constraints,
    exclusions: prior.exclusions,
    profileHint:
      prior.profileHint === "simple" && (intentDetected || correctiveIntent)
        ? "investigation"
        : prior.profileHint === "simple"
          ? "analyse"
          : prior.profileHint,
  };
  const evaluated = evaluateContractReadiness(merged);
  await saveInvestigationSnapshot({
    pilotId: input.pilotId,
    preparationId: input.preparationId,
    state: evaluated,
  });

  try {
    await appendActivityEvent({
      conversationId: input.conversationId,
      turnCommandId: input.turnCommandId,
      ownerPilotId: input.pilotId,
      phase: "nora.investigation",
      nature: "OBSERVED",
      status: evaluated.contractReady ? "COMPLETED" : "LIMITED",
      summary: evaluated.contractReady
        ? "Investigation suffisante pour préparer un contrat DRAFT"
        : evaluated.contractReadyBlockedReason ?? "Investigation en cours",
      detail: {
        sufficiency: evaluated.sufficiency,
        sourceCount: evaluated.sources.length,
        contractReady: evaluated.contractReady,
        semanticPrepare: intentDetected,
        semanticCorrective: correctiveIntent,
      },
      ownerToken: input.ownerToken,
    });
  } catch {
    /* observational */
  }

  const hasConsultedSource = evaluated.sources.some(
    (s) => s.coverage === "CONSULTED" || s.coverage === "VERIFIED",
  );
  if (
    !input.attemptPrepare ||
    !intentDetected ||
    !evaluated.contractReady ||
    !hasConsultedSource
  ) {
    return {
      intentDetected,
      correctiveIntent,
      investigation: evaluated,
      prepared: null,
      blockedReason: !intentDetected
        ? null
        : !hasConsultedSource
          ? "Aucune source CONSULTED/VERIFIED — contrat non préparé"
          : evaluated.contractReady
            ? null
            : evaluated.contractReadyBlockedReason ?? "Investigation insuffisante",
      cursorRedispatch: false,
    };
  }

  const body = draftBodyFromInvestigation(evaluated, {
    instructionFromNora: input.assistantText,
    businessCriteria: evaluated.remainingWork.slice(0, 8),
  });
  const key =
    input.contractKey ??
    `nora-${input.preparationId.slice(-8)}-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;

  try {
    await appendActivityEvent({
      conversationId: input.conversationId,
      turnCommandId: input.turnCommandId,
      ownerPilotId: input.pilotId,
      phase: "nora.contract.prepare",
      nature: "ANNOUNCED",
      status: "RUNNING",
      summary: "Nora prépare un contrat technique DRAFT",
      ownerToken: input.ownerToken,
    });
  } catch {
    /* observational */
  }

  try {
    const created = await prepareTechnicalContractFromNora({
      pilotId: input.pilotId,
      projectId: input.projectId,
      preparationId: input.preparationId,
      contractKey: key,
      body,
      sourceTurnCommandId: input.sourceTurnCommandId ?? input.turnCommandId,
      investigationOverride: evaluated,
    });
    try {
      await appendActivityEvent({
        conversationId: input.conversationId,
        turnCommandId: input.turnCommandId,
        ownerPilotId: input.pilotId,
        phase: "nora.contract.prepare",
        nature: "COMPLETED",
        status: "COMPLETED",
        summary: `Contrat DRAFT ${created.contractKey} v${created.version} préparé`,
        sourceRef: created.contractId,
        ownerToken: input.ownerToken,
      });
    } catch {
      /* observational */
    }
    return {
      intentDetected,
      correctiveIntent,
      investigation: evaluated,
      prepared: {
        contractId: created.contractId,
        contractKey: created.contractKey,
        version: created.version,
        fingerprint: created.fingerprint,
        status: created.status,
      },
      blockedReason: null,
      cursorRedispatch: false,
    };
  } catch (e) {
    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Préparation contrat refusée";
    try {
      await appendActivityEvent({
        conversationId: input.conversationId,
        turnCommandId: input.turnCommandId,
        ownerPilotId: input.pilotId,
        phase: "nora.contract.prepare",
        nature: "UNCERTAIN",
        status: "FAILED",
        summary: msg.slice(0, 200),
        ownerToken: input.ownerToken,
      });
    } catch {
      /* observational */
    }
    return {
      intentDetected,
      correctiveIntent,
      investigation: evaluated,
      prepared: null,
      blockedReason: msg,
      cursorRedispatch: false,
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { createHash } from "crypto";
import type { MergePlan, PublicationPlan } from "./types";

function canonical(payload: unknown): string {
  return JSON.stringify(payload);
}

export function revisionContentFingerprint(contentMarkdown: string): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(contentMarkdown).digest("hex");
}

/**
 * Stable, collision-resistant publication branch from full correlationKey.
 * Replaces prefix truncation (`slice(0,12)`) which mapped distinct keys to one ref.
 */
export function publicationBranchFromCorrelationKey(correlationKey: string): string {
  const slug = createHash("sha256").update(correlationKey, "utf8").digest("hex").slice(0, 16);
  return `sfia/pub-${slug}`;
}

/**
 * Resolve publication head for preparePublication.
 * Explicit Pilote name wins; otherwise deterministic correlation derivation.
 * Never silently replaces an explicit name with a hash-derived branch.
 */
export function resolvePublicationBranchName(input: {
  correlationKey: string;
  targetBranch: string;
  publicationBranch?: string | null;
}): { ok: true; publicationBranch: string } | { ok: false; reason: "INVALID_BRANCH" | "SAME_AS_BASE" } {
  const explicit = input.publicationBranch?.trim() || null;
  if (explicit) {
    if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/\-]{0,199}$/.test(explicit)) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "INVALID_BRANCH" };
    }
    if (explicit === input.targetBranch.trim()) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "SAME_AS_BASE" };
    }
    return { ok: true, publicationBranch: explicit };
  }
  return {
    ok: true,
    publicationBranch: publicationBranchFromCorrelationKey(input.correlationKey),
  };
}

export function inspectionFingerprint(input: {
  revisionId: string;
  revisionFingerprint: string;
  targetPath: string;
  baseSha: string | null;
  baseContent: string | null;
  proposedContent: string;
  unifiedDiff: string;
}): string {
  return createHash("sha256")
    .update(
      canonical({
        revisionId: input.revisionId,
        revisionFingerprint: input.revisionFingerprint,
        targetPath: input.targetPath,
        baseSha: input.baseSha,
        baseContentFp: input.baseContent == null ? null : revisionContentFingerprint(input.baseContent),
        proposedFp: revisionContentFingerprint(input.proposedContent),
        unifiedDiffFp: revisionContentFingerprint(input.unifiedDiff),
      }),
    )
    .digest("hex");
}

/** Canonical effect conditions — pilot/project bound outside the hash via attempt row. */
export function publicationEffectFingerprint(plan: PublicationPlan): string {
  // Historical plans omit effectProviderMode — keep payload shape identical so D6
  // fingerprints remain stable. New prepares always set REAL|SCRIPTED and bind it.
  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
    kind: "GIT_PUBLICATION",
    documentId: plan.documentId,
    revisionId: plan.revisionId,
    preparationId: plan.preparationId,
    repositoryId: plan.repositoryId,
    repositoryFullName: plan.repositoryFullName,
    authorizationId: plan.authorizationId,
    installationId: plan.installationId,
    actorLogin: plan.actorLogin,
    permissions: plan.permissions,
    targetPath: plan.targetPath,
    targetBranch: plan.targetBranch,
    publicationBranch: plan.publicationBranch,
    baseSha: plan.baseSha,
    revisionFingerprint: plan.revisionFingerprint,
    inspectionFingerprint: plan.inspection.inspectionFingerprint,
    steps: plan.steps,
  };
  if (plan.effectProviderMode === "REAL" || plan.effectProviderMode === "SCRIPTED") {
    payload.effectProviderMode = plan.effectProviderMode;
  }
  return createHash("sha256").update(canonical(payload)).digest("hex");
}

export function mergeEffectFingerprint(plan: MergePlan): string {
  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
    kind: "GIT_MERGE",
    repositoryId: plan.repositoryId,
    repositoryFullName: plan.repositoryFullName,
    authorizationId: plan.authorizationId,
    installationId: plan.installationId,
    actorLogin: plan.actorLogin,
    publicationAttemptId: plan.publicationAttemptId,
    publicationRefId: plan.publicationRefId,
    documentId: plan.documentId,
    revisionId: plan.revisionId,
    targetPath: plan.targetPath,
    prNumber: plan.prNumber,
    expectedHeadSha: plan.expectedHeadSha,
    expectedBaseSha: plan.expectedBaseSha,
    expectedHeadRef: plan.expectedHeadRef,
    expectedBaseRef: plan.expectedBaseRef,
    publicationBranch: plan.publicationBranch,
  };
  // Historical merge plans omit effectProviderMode — keep payload identical so D6
  // fingerprints remain stable until a new prepare freezes the mode.
  if (plan.effectProviderMode === "REAL" || plan.effectProviderMode === "SCRIPTED") {
    payload.effectProviderMode = plan.effectProviderMode;
  }
  return createHash("sha256").update(canonical(payload)).digest("hex");
}

/** Simple unified diff for documentary inspection (not a Git patch applicator). */
export function buildUnifiedDiff(path: string, before: string | null, after: string): string {
  const a = (before ?? "").split("\n");
  const b = after.split("\n");
  const lines: string[] = [
    `--- a/${path}`,
    `+++ b/${path}`,
    `@@ -1,${a.length || 1} +1,${b.length || 1} @@`,
  ];
  if (before == null) {
    for (const line of b) lines.push(`+${line}`);
  } else if (before === after) {
    for (const line of b) lines.push(` ${line}`);
  } else {
    for (const line of a) lines.push(`-${line}`);
    for (const line of b) lines.push(`+${line}`);
  }
  return lines.join("\n");
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * CA-01 — Nora prepares a technical contract from a durable investigation.
 * Reuses D3 investigation + D7 technical_contracts — no second preparation engine.
 */

import { StudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";
import {
  loadInvestigationSnapshot,
  saveInvestigationSnapshot,
} from "@/domains/conversation/investigation-persistence";
import {
  evaluateContractReadiness as evaluateInvestigationReadiness,
  type InvestigationState,
} from "@/domains/conversation/investigation-state";
import {
  createTechnicalContract,
  evaluateContractReadiness,
} from "./technical-contract";
import type { TechnicalContractBody } from "./types";

export type NoraContractPrepareInput = {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  preparationId: string;
  contractKey: string;
  body: TechnicalContractBody;
  sourceTurnCommandId?: string | null;
  /** Server-owned: never trust client "sourcesSufficient". */
  investigationOverride?: InvestigationState | null;
};

/**
 * Persist a DRAFT technical contract when investigation is sufficient.
 * READY is never granted here — markReady requires separate server qualification.
 */
export async function prepareTechnicalContractFromNora(
  input: NoraContractPrepareInput,
) {
  const investigation =
    input.investigationOverride ??
    (await loadInvestigationSnapshot({
      pilotId: input.pilotId,
      preparationId: input.preparationId,
      intentFallback: input.body.title || input.body.volets.mission,
    }));

  if (!investigation) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION",
      "Aucune investigation durable — Nora doit qualifier les sources avant contrat",
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }

  const evaluated = evaluateInvestigationReadiness(investigation);
  await saveInvestigationSnapshot({
    pilotId: input.pilotId,
    preparationId: input.preparationId,
    state: evaluated,
  });

  if (!evaluated.contractReady) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION",
      evaluated.contractReadyBlockedReason ??
        "Investigation insuffisante — contrat non préparé",
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }

  // Server readiness: unknown restrictions from investigation, not client flags.
  const unknownFromInvestigation = [
    ...evaluated.questions
      .filter((q) => q.importance === "DETERMINANT" && q.status === "BLOCKED")
      .map((q) => q.id),
    ...(evaluated.sufficiency === "BLOCKED_BY_UNKNOWN_RESTRICTION"
      ? ["UNKNOWN_RESTRICTION"]
      : []),
  ];

  const docReadiness = evaluateContractReadiness({
    body: input.body,
    unknownRestrictions: unknownFromInvestigation,
    // Sources judged from investigation, never from client boolean.
    sourcesSufficient: evaluated.sufficiency === "SUFFICIENT",
  });

  const created = await createTechnicalContract({
    pilotId: input.pilotId,
    projectId: input.projectId,
    preparationId: input.preparationId,
    contractKey: input.contractKey,
    body: input.body,
    sourceTurnCommandId: input.sourceTurnCommandId,
    markReady: false, // always DRAFT from Nora prepare — READY is a separate server act
    unknownRestrictions: unknownFromInvestigation,
    sourcesSufficient: docReadiness.sourcesSufficient,
  });

  return {
    ...created,
    investigationSufficiency: evaluated.sufficiency,
    contractReady: evaluated.contractReady,
    readiness: docReadiness,
  };
}
```

```typescript
import { createHash } from "crypto";
import type { TechnicalContractBody } from "./types";

function canonical(payload: unknown): string {
  return JSON.stringify(payload);
}

export function instructionFingerprint(instructionText: string): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(instructionText, "utf8").digest("hex");
}

/** Fingerprint of the exact inspectable/authorized/transmitted contract bytes. */
export function technicalContractFingerprint(body: TechnicalContractBody): string {
  return createHash("sha256")
    .update(
      canonical({
        title: body.title,
        engagements: body.engagements,
        volets: body.volets,
        instructionText: body.instructionText,
        instructionFp: instructionFingerprint(body.instructionText),
        risks: body.risks,
        exclusions: body.exclusions,
        acceptance: body.acceptance,
        executor: body.executor,
        stopConditions: body.stopConditions,
        reversibilityLimits: body.reversibilityLimits,
        gitScope: body.gitScope ?? null,
      }),
    )
    .digest("hex");
}

export function isMaterialContractChange(
  authorizedFingerprint: string,
  currentFingerprint: string,
): boolean {
  return authorizedFingerprint !== currentFingerprint;
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * CF-02 — READY qualification is server-owned.
 * Client `sourcesSufficient` / `unknownRestrictions` are never authoritative.
 */

import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import { technicalContracts } from "@/db/schema";
import { StudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";
import { loadInvestigationSnapshot } from "@/domains/conversation/investigation-persistence";
import { evaluateContractReadiness as evaluateInvestigation } from "@/domains/conversation/investigation-state";
import {
  evaluateContractReadiness,
  getTechnicalContract,
  technicalContractFingerprint,
} from "./technical-contract";

export async function qualifyTechnicalContractReadyServerSide(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  contractId: string;
  preparationId?: string | null;
}) {
  const row = await getTechnicalContract(input);
  if (row.status === "READY") {
    return {
      contractId: row.id,
      status: "READY" as const,
      idempotent: true as const,
      fingerprint: row.fingerprint,
      readiness: row.readiness,
    };
  }

  let unknownRestrictions: string[] = [];
  let sourcesSufficient = false;

  if (input.preparationId) {
    const snap = await loadInvestigationSnapshot({
      pilotId: input.pilotId,
      preparationId: input.preparationId,
      intentFallback: row.body.title,
    });
    if (!snap) {
      throw new StudioError(
        "REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION",
        "Investigation absente — READY serveur impossible",
        { exposeMessage: true },
      );
    }
    const inv = evaluateInvestigation(snap);
    if (!inv.contractReady) {
      throw new StudioError(
        "REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION",
        inv.contractReadyBlockedReason ?? "Investigation non prête",
        { exposeMessage: true },
      );
    }
    sourcesSufficient = inv.sufficiency === "SUFFICIENT";
    unknownRestrictions = inv.questions
      .filter((q) => q.importance === "DETERMINANT" && q.status !== "ANSWERED")
      .map((q) => q.id);
    if (inv.sufficiency === "BLOCKED_BY_UNKNOWN_RESTRICTION") {
      unknownRestrictions.push("UNKNOWN_RESTRICTION");
    }
  } else {
    // Without preparation linkage, refuse READY — no client substitute.
    throw new StudioError(
      "REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION",
      "preparationId requis pour qualification READY serveur",
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }

  const readiness = evaluateContractReadiness({
    body: row.body,
    unknownRestrictions,
    sourcesSufficient,
  });
  if (!readiness.ready) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION",
      `Promotion READY refusée: ${readiness.blockedReasons.join("; ")}`,
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }

  const recomputed = technicalContractFingerprint(row.body);
  if (recomputed !== row.fingerprint) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION",
      "Empreinte ≠ représentation persistée — nouvelle version requise",
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }

  const updated = await db
    .update(technicalContracts)
    .set({
      status: "READY",
      readinessJson: JSON.stringify(readiness),
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(technicalContracts.id, input.contractId),
        eq(technicalContracts.projectId, input.projectId),
        eq(technicalContracts.pilotId, input.pilotId),
        eq(technicalContracts.status, "DRAFT"),
      ),
    )
    .returning({ id: technicalContracts.id });

  if (!updated[0]) {
    throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", "Promotion READY concurrente ou statut non DRAFT");
  }

  return {
    contractId: input.contractId,
    status: "READY" as const,
    idempotent: false as const,
    fingerprint: row.fingerprint,
    readiness,
  };
}
```

```typescript
import { and, desc, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import { projects, technicalContracts } from "@/db/schema";
import { StudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";
import { newId } from "@/lib/ids";
import type { TechnicalContractBody } from "./types";
import {
  instructionFingerprint,
  technicalContractFingerprint,
} from "./technical-contract-fingerprint";

export {
  instructionFingerprint,
  isMaterialContractChange,
  technicalContractFingerprint,
} from "./technical-contract-fingerprint";

export type ContractReadiness = {
  documentComplete: boolean;
  sourcesSufficient: boolean;
  unknownRestrictions: string[];
  blockedReasons: string[];
  ready: boolean;
};

export function assertContractBodyComplete(body: TechnicalContractBody): void {
  const e = body.engagements;
  if (!e?.willDo?.trim() || !e.willNotDo?.trim() || !e.expectedResult?.trim() || !e.pilotControl?.trim()) {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "Quatre engagements incomplets", { exposeMessage: true });
  }
  const v = body.volets;
  if (
    !v?.mission?.trim() ||
    !v.perimeter?.trim() ||
    !v.capabilitiesAuthority?.trim() ||
    !v.stopConditions?.trim() ||
    !v.proofsSources?.trim() ||
    !v.integrity?.trim()
  ) {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "Six volets incomplets", { exposeMessage: true });
  }
  if (!body.instructionText || body.instructionText.length === 0) {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "Instruction technique vide", { exposeMessage: true });
  }
  if (body.instructionText.includes("\u0000")) {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "Instruction technique invalide", { exposeMessage: true });
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(body.reversibilityLimits)) {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "reversibilityLimits requis", { exposeMessage: true });
  }
}

/**
 * Document completeness ≠ authorization readiness.
 * READY requires no unknown determinant restrictions and an explicit readiness gate.
 */
export function evaluateContractReadiness(input: {
  body: TechnicalContractBody;
  unknownRestrictions?: string[];
  sourcesSufficient?: boolean;
}): ContractReadiness {
  const unknownRestrictions = (input.unknownRestrictions ?? []).filter((r) => r.trim());
  const documentComplete = (() => {
    try {
      assertContractBodyComplete(input.body);
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  })();
  const sourcesSufficient = input.sourcesSufficient !== false;
  const blockedReasons: string[] = [];
  if (!documentComplete) blockedReasons.push("DOCUMENT_INCOMPLETE");
  if (!sourcesSufficient) blockedReasons.push("SOURCES_INSUFFICIENT");
  if (unknownRestrictions.length > 0) {
    blockedReasons.push(`UNKNOWN_RESTRICTIONS:${unknownRestrictions.join(",")}`);
  }
  return {
    documentComplete,
    sourcesSufficient,
    unknownRestrictions,
    blockedReasons,
    ready: blockedReasons.length === 0,
  };
}

async function assertProject(pilotId: string, projectId: string) {
  const p = (
    await db
      .select({ id: projects.id })
      .from(projects)
      .where(and(eq(projects.id, projectId), eq(projects.ownerPilotId, pilotId)))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!p) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Projet introuvable");
}

export async function createTechnicalContract(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  preparationId?: string | null;
  contractKey: string;
  body: TechnicalContractBody;
  sourceTurnCommandId?: string | null;
  supersedesContractId?: string | null;
  /** When false or omitted with unknowns → DRAFT even if document is complete. */
  markReady?: boolean;
  unknownRestrictions?: string[];
  sourcesSufficient?: boolean;
}) {
  await assertProject(input.pilotId, input.projectId);
  assertContractBodyComplete(input.body);
  const readiness = evaluateContractReadiness({
    body: input.body,
    unknownRestrictions: input.unknownRestrictions,
    sourcesSufficient: input.sourcesSufficient,
  });
  // Explicit markReady required for READY — syntax alone never promotes.
  const status =
    input.markReady === true && readiness.ready ? "READY" : "DRAFT";
  if (input.markReady === true && !readiness.ready) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION",
      `Contrat non prêt: ${readiness.blockedReasons.join("; ")}`,
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }

  const fingerprint = technicalContractFingerprint(input.body);
  const instructionFp = instructionFingerprint(input.body.instructionText);

  const latest = (
    await db
      .select({ version: technicalContracts.version })
      .from(technicalContracts)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(technicalContracts.projectId, input.projectId),
          eq(technicalContracts.contractKey, input.contractKey),
        ),
      )
      .orderBy(desc(technicalContracts.version))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  const version = (latest?.version ?? 0) + 1;
  const id = newId("tctr");
  const now = new Date();
  await db.insert(technicalContracts).values({
    id,
    projectId: input.projectId,
    pilotId: input.pilotId,
    preparationId: input.preparationId ?? null,
    contractKey: input.contractKey,
    version,
    fingerprint,
    status,
    title: input.body.title,
    engagementsJson: JSON.stringify(input.body.engagements),
    voletsJson: JSON.stringify(input.body.volets),
    instructionText: input.body.instructionText,
    risksJson: JSON.stringify(input.body.risks),
    exclusionsJson: JSON.stringify(input.body.exclusions),
    acceptanceJson: JSON.stringify(input.body.acceptance),
    executorJson: JSON.stringify(input.body.executor),
    stopConditionsJson: JSON.stringify(input.body.stopConditions),
    reversibilityLimitsJson: JSON.stringify(input.body.reversibilityLimits ?? []),
    gitScopeJson: input.body.gitScope ? JSON.stringify(input.body.gitScope) : null,
    readinessJson: JSON.stringify(readiness),
    sourceTurnCommandId: input.sourceTurnCommandId ?? null,
    supersedesContractId: input.supersedesContractId ?? null,
    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now,
  });

  return {
    contractId: id,
    contractKey: input.contractKey,
    version,
    fingerprint,
    instructionFingerprint: instructionFp,
    status: status as "READY" | "DRAFT",
    readiness,
  };
}

/** Promote DRAFT → READY after D3/D6 sufficiency re-check. */
export async function markTechnicalContractReady(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  contractId: string;
  unknownRestrictions?: string[];
  sourcesSufficient?: boolean;
}) {
  const row = await getTechnicalContract(input);
  const readiness = evaluateContractReadiness({
    body: row.body,
    unknownRestrictions: input.unknownRestrictions,
    sourcesSufficient: input.sourcesSufficient,
  });
  if (!readiness.ready) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION",
      `Promotion READY refusée: ${readiness.blockedReasons.join("; ")}`,
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }
  // Recompute fingerprint from persisted body — refuse if storage drifted.
  const recomputed = technicalContractFingerprint(row.body);
  if (recomputed !== row.fingerprint) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION",
      "Empreinte ≠ représentation persistée — nouvelle version requise",
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }
  await db
    .update(technicalContracts)
    .set({
      status: "READY",
      readinessJson: JSON.stringify(readiness),
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(technicalContracts.id, input.contractId),
        eq(technicalContracts.projectId, input.projectId),
        eq(technicalContracts.pilotId, input.pilotId),
        eq(technicalContracts.status, "DRAFT"),
      ),
    );
  return { contractId: input.contractId, status: "READY" as const, readiness, fingerprint: row.fingerprint };
}

export async function getTechnicalContract(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  contractId: string;
}) {
  await assertProject(input.pilotId, input.projectId);
  const row = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(technicalContracts)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(technicalContracts.id, input.contractId),
          eq(technicalContracts.projectId, input.projectId),
          eq(technicalContracts.pilotId, input.pilotId),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!row) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Contrat technique introuvable");
  return rowToContract(row);
}

export async function listTechnicalContracts(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  contractKey?: string;
}) {
  await assertProject(input.pilotId, input.projectId);
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(technicalContracts)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(technicalContracts.projectId, input.projectId),
        eq(technicalContracts.pilotId, input.pilotId),
        ...(input.contractKey
          ? [eq(technicalContracts.contractKey, input.contractKey)]
          : []),
      ),
    )
    .orderBy(desc(technicalContracts.createdAt));
  return rows.map(rowToContract);
}

function rowToContract(row: typeof technicalContracts.$inferSelect) {
  const body: TechnicalContractBody = {
    title: row.title,
    engagements: JSON.parse(row.engagementsJson) as TechnicalContractBody["engagements"],
    volets: JSON.parse(row.voletsJson) as TechnicalContractBody["volets"],
    instructionText: row.instructionText,
    risks: JSON.parse(row.risksJson || "[]") as string[],
    exclusions: JSON.parse(row.exclusionsJson || "[]") as string[],
    acceptance: JSON.parse(row.acceptanceJson || "{}") as TechnicalContractBody["acceptance"],
    executor: JSON.parse(row.executorJson || "{}") as TechnicalContractBody["executor"],
    stopConditions: JSON.parse(row.stopConditionsJson || "[]") as string[],
    reversibilityLimits: JSON.parse(row.reversibilityLimitsJson || "[]") as string[],
    gitScope: row.gitScopeJson
      ? (JSON.parse(row.gitScopeJson) as TechnicalContractBody["gitScope"])
      : null,
  };
  let readiness: ContractReadiness | null = null;
  if (row.readinessJson) {
    try {
      readiness = JSON.parse(row.readinessJson) as ContractReadiness;
    } catch {
      readiness = null;
    }
  }
  return {
    id: row.id,
    contractKey: row.contractKey,
    version: row.version,
    fingerprint: row.fingerprint,
    instructionFingerprint: instructionFingerprint(row.instructionText),
    status: row.status,
    preparationId: row.preparationId,
    body,
    readiness,
    createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}
```

```typescript
import type { AuthorityRestriction, AuthorityVerdict } from "@/domains/decisions/types";

const CYCLE_OPS = new Set(["OPEN_CYCLE", "CLOSE_CYCLE", "TRANSITION_CYCLE"]);
const METHOD_OPS = new Set(["CHOOSE_METHOD", "REPLACE_METHOD", "WITHDRAW_METHOD"]);
const TRAJECTORY_OPS = new Set(["RETAIN_TRAJECTORY"]);

function active(restrictions: AuthorityRestriction[]): AuthorityRestriction[] {
  return restrictions.filter((r) => r.status === "ACTIVE");
}

function matchesMethod(targetRef: string, methodRef: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (targetRef === "*") return true;
  const ref = (methodRef ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!ref) return targetRef === "*";
  return targetRef.trim().toLowerCase() === ref;
}

function isGlobalTarget(targetRef: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  const value = (targetRef ?? "").trim();
  return value === "" || value === "*";
}

/** Case-insensitive match against a non-global restriction target. `*` and empty are global. */
function matchesScopedTarget(
  targetRef: string,
  candidates: Array<string | null | undefined>,
): boolean {
  if (isGlobalTarget(targetRef)) return true;
  const needle = targetRef.trim().toLowerCase();
  return candidates.some((candidate) => {
    const value = (candidate ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
    return value.length > 0 && value !== "*" && value === needle;
  });
}

/**
 * Identities actually mutated by the operation. TRANSITION_CYCLE mutates both
 * the active source (A) and the target type being opened (B). Client-only strings
 * that do not identify A or B are ignored when the server supplies the active cycle.
 */
export function cycleMutationCandidates(input: {
  operation: string;
  cycleId?: string | null;
  cycleType?: string | null;
  toCycleType?: string | null;
  toCycleId?: string | null;
}): Array<string | null | undefined> {
  if (input.operation === "TRANSITION_CYCLE") {
    return [input.cycleId, input.cycleType, input.toCycleType, input.toCycleId];
  }
  return [input.cycleId, input.cycleType];
}

/**
 * Point-of-effect authority. A lifted restriction does not count.
 * METHOD_USE limits use in the projection; it does not erase the retained method
 * and it does not block a later governance act.
 * CYCLE_MUTATION / PILOTAGE_EFFECT: `*` or empty blocks every matching operation;
 * any other targetRef blocks only the cycle, method, or effect it names.
 * For TRANSITION_CYCLE, a restriction on source A or target B blocks the whole
 * atomic CLOSE+OPEN (no partial effect).
 * LIFT / REVOKE / APPLY / RECORD / REVISE / PROPOSE stay available so the pilot can govern.
 */
export function evaluateCurrentAuthority(input: {
  operation: string;
  restrictions: AuthorityRestriction[];
  methodRef?: string | null;
  cycleId?: string | null;
  cycleType?: string | null;
  toCycleType?: string | null;
  toCycleId?: string | null;
  effectTargetRef?: string | null;
}): AuthorityVerdict {
  const rows = active(input.restrictions);
  let usageRestricted = false;
  for (const r of rows) {
    if (r.targetKind === "METHOD_USE" && matchesMethod(r.targetRef, input.methodRef)) {
      usageRestricted = true;
    }
  }
  const cycleCandidates = cycleMutationCandidates(input);
  for (const r of rows) {
    if (
      r.targetKind === "CYCLE_MUTATION" &&
      CYCLE_OPS.has(input.operation) &&
      matchesScopedTarget(r.targetRef, cycleCandidates)
    ) {
      return {
        allowed: false,
        usageRestricted,
        restrictionId: r.id,
        reason: "Mutation de cycle restreinte",
      };
    }
    if (
      r.targetKind === "PILOTAGE_EFFECT" &&
      (CYCLE_OPS.has(input.operation) ||
        METHOD_OPS.has(input.operation) ||
        TRAJECTORY_OPS.has(input.operation)) &&
      matchesScopedTarget(r.targetRef, [
        input.effectTargetRef,
        ...cycleCandidates,
        input.methodRef,
      ])
    ) {
      return {
        allowed: false,
        usageRestricted,
        restrictionId: r.id,
        reason: "Effet de pilotage restreint",
      };
    }
  }
  return { allowed: true, usageRestricted };
}

/** Projection flag: retained method whose use is restricted. Absence is not a restriction. */
export function methodUsageRestricted(
  restrictions: AuthorityRestriction[],
  methodRef: string | null | undefined,
): boolean {
  if (!methodRef) return false;
  return active(restrictions).some(
    (r) => r.targetKind === "METHOD_USE" && matchesMethod(r.targetRef, methodRef),
  );
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * B13 v0.1 — assisted contradictions (VALIDATED IN CONTENT BY MORRIS, 2026-11-06).
 *
 * Level A — POTENTIAL / cognitive signal for Nora. Never D6 authority.
 * Level B — MATERIAL conflict: typed deterministic checks at point of effect only.
 *
 * C01: a single APPLICABLE D6 decision can be confronted with a new USER message
 * without requiring a second persisted decision.
 */

export type DecisionBrief = {
  id: string;
  kind: string;
  objectRef: string;
  scope: string;
  statement: string;
  state: string;
  sourceKind: string;
};

/** Structured Level A signal passed to Nora (fixture and LIVE path). Never authority. */
export type LevelASignal = {
  kind: "MESSAGE_DECISION_CONFRONTATION" | "STORED_DECISION_DIVERGENCE";
  objectRef: string;
  scope: string;
  decisionId: string;
  decisionIds?: string[];
  priorStatement: string;
  currentExpression: string;
  /** Context selection framing — not a D6 verdict. */
  framing: "POSSIBLE_CHANGE" | "COMPATIBLE_RESTATEMENT" | "AMBIGUOUS";
  authorityClaim: "NONE";
};

export type PotentialDivergence = {
  level: "A_POTENTIAL";
  kind: string;
  objectRef: string;
  scope: string;
  decisionIds: string[];
  statements: string[];
  authorityClaim: "NONE";
};

const MAX_APPLICABLE_FOR_CONTEXT = 12;
const MAX_SIGNALS = 3;

const OPPOSITION_PAIRS: Array<[RegExp, RegExp]> = [
  [/\b(obligatoire|requis|required|mandatory|must)\b/i, /\b(facultatif|optionnel|optional|volontaire)\b/i],
  [/\b(interdit|prohibé|banned|forbidden)\b/i, /\b(autorisé|permis|allowed|autoriser)\b/i],
  [/\b(actif|ouverte?|open)\b/i, /\b(fermé|clos|closed|inactif)\b/i],
];

/** Modality terms whose affirmed/negated polarity must not be collapsed by lexical overlap. */
const MODALITY_TERMS = [
  "obligatoire",
  "requis",
  "required",
  "mandatory",
  "interdit",
  "prohibé",
  "banned",
  "forbidden",
  "autorisé",
  "permis",
  "allowed",
  "facultatif",
  "optionnel",
  "optional",
  "volontaire",
] as const;

/** Affirmed synonym groups — shared group ⇒ possible COMPATIBLE_RESTATEMENT (still Level A). */
const MODALITY_SYNONYM_GROUPS: string[][] = [
  ["obligatoire", "requis", "required", "mandatory"],
  ["facultatif", "optionnel", "optional", "volontaire"],
  ["interdit", "prohibé", "banned", "forbidden"],
  ["autorisé", "permis", "allowed"],
];

const GLOBAL_SCOPE_RE =
  /\b(tout\s+le\s+projet|ensemble\s+du\s+projet|global(?:e|ement)?|pour\s+tout)\b/i;
const LOCAL_SCOPE_RE =
  /\b(seulement|uniquement|juste\s+pour|pour\s+(?:ce\s+)?(?:cycle|ux|cadrage|activité))\b/i;

/** Keep recent applicable decisions for Nora context — project-scoped, bounded. */
export function selectApplicableBriefs(rows: DecisionBrief[]): DecisionBrief[] {
  return rows
    .filter((r) => r.state === "APPLICABLE" && (r.objectRef ?? "").trim().length > 0)
    .slice(-MAX_APPLICABLE_FOR_CONTEXT);
}

/**
 * CR-01 — all APPLICABLE briefs for D6 authority resolution.
 * Never apply the Nora cognitive window (MAX_APPLICABLE_FOR_CONTEXT).
 * Bounded context ≠ uniqueness of an opposable target.
 */
export function selectAllApplicableBriefs(rows: DecisionBrief[]): DecisionBrief[] {
  return rows.filter(
    (r) => r.state === "APPLICABLE" && (r.objectRef ?? "").trim().length > 0,
  );
}

export type AuthorityReviseCandidate = DecisionBrief & {
  framing: LevelASignal["framing"];
};

/**
 * CR-01 — D6 revise-target candidates across the full applicable set.
 * Level A framing filters relevance only — never authorizes mutation.
 * No chronological / newest-wins / truncation selection.
 * Caller must require exactly one candidate before REVISE.
 */
/**
 * C05 — when objectRef is weak/noisy, an explicit « je révise… » may still
 * designate a prior RECORD via shared statement tokens (e.g. « remplace la
 * priorité sur le suivi des décisions »). Requires ≥2 significant overlaps.
 */
function utteranceTouchesPriorStatement(userText: string, statement: string): boolean {
  const hay = normalizeText(userText);
  const tokens = significantTokens(statement).filter((t) => t.length >= 5);
  if (tokens.length === 0) return false;
  const hits = tokens.filter((t) => hay.includes(t));
  return hits.length >= 2;
}

export function findAuthorityReviseCandidates(
  userText: string,
  rows: DecisionBrief[],
): AuthorityReviseCandidate[] {
  const text = userText.trim();
  if (!text) return [];
  const applicable = selectAllApplicableBriefs(rows);
  const explicitRevise = /\bje\s+(?:révise|revise|corrige|remplace|modifie)\b/i.test(text);
  const out: AuthorityReviseCandidate[] = [];
  for (const row of applicable) {
    const touchesObject = utteranceTouchesObject(text, row.objectRef);
    const touchesStatement =
      explicitRevise && utteranceTouchesPriorStatement(text, row.statement);
    if (!touchesObject && !touchesStatement) continue;
    if (normalizeText(text) === normalizeText(row.statement)) continue;
    const framing = frameConfrontation(row.statement, text);
    // Compatible restatement is not a revise target.
    if (framing === "COMPATIBLE_RESTATEMENT") continue;
    out.push({ ...row, framing });
  }
  return out;
}

function normalizeText(text: string): string {
  // Normalize typographic apostrophes so « n’est » and « n'est » share one path.
  return text
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[\u2019\u2018\u02bc`]/g, "'")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ");
}

function significantTokens(text: string): string[] {
  return normalizeText(text)
    .split(/[^a-z0-9àâäéèêëïîôùûüç]+/i)
    .filter((t) => t.length >= 4);
}

/** True when user text appears to revisit a recorded object (heuristic, cognitive only). */
export function utteranceTouchesObject(userText: string, objectRef: string): boolean {
  const needle = objectRef.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!needle || needle.length < 3) return false;
  const hay = normalizeText(userText);
  if (hay.includes(needle)) return true;
  const tokens = needle.split(/[^a-z0-9àâäéèêëïîôùûüç]+/i).filter((t) => t.length >= 4);
  if (tokens.length === 0) return false;
  return tokens.some((t) => hay.includes(t));
}

function tokenOverlapRatio(a: string, b: string): number {
  const ta = new Set(significantTokens(a));
  const tb = new Set(significantTokens(b));
  if (ta.size === 0 || tb.size === 0) return 0;
  let inter = 0;
  for (const t of ta) if (tb.has(t)) inter += 1;
  return inter / Math.max(ta.size, tb.size);
}

function looksOpposed(prior: string, current: string): boolean {
  for (const [left, right] of OPPOSITION_PAIRS) {
    if ((left.test(prior) && right.test(current)) || (right.test(prior) && left.test(current))) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * R2 — detect affirmed vs negated polarity of a modality term in a short window.
 * Heuristic only (Niveau A). Prefer AMBIGUOUS/POSSIBLE_CHANGE over false COMPATIBLE.
 * Bounded FR family: n'est plus|pas|jamais|aucunement ; ne doit/peut pas (être) ; pas / never / not.
 */
function modalityPolarity(text: string, term: string): "affirm" | "negate" | "absent" {
  const n = normalizeText(text);
  const idx = n.indexOf(term);
  if (idx < 0) return "absent";
  const before = n.slice(Math.max(0, idx - 56), idx);
  // Apostrophe already normalized to ASCII in normalizeText.
  if (
    /(?:n'est\s+(?:plus|pas|jamais|aucunement)|ne\s+(?:doit|peut|saurait)\s+pas(?:\s+être)?|ne\s+\w{1,20}\s+pas|pas\s+(?:plus\s+|du\s+tout\s+|aucunement\s+)?|plus\s+(?:d[e']\s+)?|non\s+|is\s+no\s+longer\s+|is\s+not\s+|no\s+longer\s+|never\s+|not\s+)\s*$/i.test(
      before,
    )
  ) {
    return "negate";
  }
  const after = n.slice(idx + term.length, idx + term.length + 32);
  if (
    /^\s*(?:n'est\s+(?:plus|pas|jamais|aucunement)|is\s+no\s+longer|is\s+not|never)\b/i.test(after)
  ) {
    return "negate";
  }
  return "affirm";
}

function looksPolarityInverted(prior: string, current: string): boolean {
  for (const term of MODALITY_TERMS) {
    const p = modalityPolarity(prior, term);
    const c = modalityPolarity(current, term);
    if (p !== "absent" && c !== "absent" && p !== c) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function sharesAffirmedModalitySynonym(prior: string, current: string): boolean {
  for (const group of MODALITY_SYNONYM_GROUPS) {
    const priorAffirm = group.some((t) => modalityPolarity(prior, t) === "affirm");
    const currentAffirm = group.some((t) => modalityPolarity(current, t) === "affirm");
    if (priorAffirm && currentAffirm) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** Distinct global vs local scope markers → clarify; never auto-equate. */
function looksScopeShift(prior: string, current: string): boolean {
  return (
    (GLOBAL_SCOPE_RE.test(prior) && LOCAL_SCOPE_RE.test(current)) ||
    (LOCAL_SCOPE_RE.test(prior) && GLOBAL_SCOPE_RE.test(current))
  );
}

/**
 * R2 — Level A framing only. Never D6 authority.
 * Negation / polarity inversion must not become COMPATIBLE_RESTATEMENT via token overlap.
 */
function frameConfrontation(prior: string, current: string): LevelASignal["framing"] {
  if (looksOpposed(prior, current) || looksPolarityInverted(prior, current)) {
    return "POSSIBLE_CHANGE";
  }
  if (looksScopeShift(prior, current)) {
    return "AMBIGUOUS";
  }
  if (sharesAffirmedModalitySynonym(prior, current)) {
    return "COMPATIBLE_RESTATEMENT";
  }
  const overlap = tokenOverlapRatio(prior, current);
  // High lexical overlap alone is weak evidence — prefer AMBIGUOUS over false compatible
  // when modality synonyms are absent (R2: shared words ≠ same sense).
  if (overlap >= 0.65) return "COMPATIBLE_RESTATEMENT";
  if (overlap >= 0.2) return "AMBIGUOUS";
  return "AMBIGUOUS";
}

/**
 * C01 — confront a new USER message with existing APPLICABLE D6 decisions.
 * Does not require a second persisted decision. Never creates authority.
 */
export function findMessageDecisionConfrontations(
  userText: string,
  rows: DecisionBrief[],
): LevelASignal[] {
  const text = userText.trim();
  if (!text) return [];
  const applicable = selectApplicableBriefs(rows);
  const out: LevelASignal[] = [];
  for (const row of applicable) {
    if (!utteranceTouchesObject(text, row.objectRef)) continue;
    // Exact same statement → no signal beyond the applicable list itself.
    if (normalizeText(text) === normalizeText(row.statement)) continue;
    out.push({
      kind: "MESSAGE_DECISION_CONFRONTATION",
      objectRef: row.objectRef,
      scope: row.scope,
      decisionId: row.id,
      priorStatement: row.statement,
      currentExpression: text.slice(0, 500),
      framing: frameConfrontation(row.statement, text),
      authorityClaim: "NONE",
    });
    if (out.length >= MAX_SIGNALS) break;
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Level A among already-stored APPLICABLE rows (same kind+objectRef+scope,
 * ≥2 distinct statements). Secondary to message confrontation. Cognitive only.
 */
export function findPotentialDivergences(rows: DecisionBrief[]): PotentialDivergence[] {
  const applicable = selectApplicableBriefs(rows);
  const groups = new Map<string, DecisionBrief[]>();
  for (const row of applicable) {
    const key = `${row.kind}\u0000${row.objectRef.trim().toLowerCase()}\u0000${row.scope}`;
    const bucket = groups.get(key) ?? [];
    bucket.push(row);
    groups.set(key, bucket);
  }
  const out: PotentialDivergence[] = [];
  for (const bucket of groups.values()) {
    const statements = [...new Set(bucket.map((b) => b.statement.trim()).filter(Boolean))];
    if (statements.length < 2) continue;
    out.push({
      level: "A_POTENTIAL",
      kind: bucket[0].kind,
      objectRef: bucket[0].objectRef,
      scope: bucket[0].scope,
      decisionIds: bucket.map((b) => b.id),
      statements,
      authorityClaim: "NONE",
    });
    if (out.length >= MAX_SIGNALS) break;
  }
  return out;
}

export function storedDivergencesToSignals(divs: PotentialDivergence[]): LevelASignal[] {
  return divs.map((d) => ({
    kind: "STORED_DECISION_DIVERGENCE" as const,
    objectRef: d.objectRef,
    scope: d.scope,
    decisionId: d.decisionIds[0],
    decisionIds: d.decisionIds,
    priorStatement: d.statements[0] ?? "",
    currentExpression: d.statements[1] ?? d.statements[0] ?? "",
    framing: looksOpposed(d.statements[0] ?? "", d.statements[1] ?? "")
      ? ("POSSIBLE_CHANGE" as const)
      : ("AMBIGUOUS" as const),
    authorityClaim: "NONE" as const,
  }));
}

export function formatLevelASignalSnippets(signals: LevelASignal[]): string[] {
  if (signals.length === 0) {
    return [
      "### Niveau A — rapprochement message / décisions",
      "Aucun signal de revisite pertinente pour l'énoncé courant.",
    ];
  }
  const lines: string[] = [
    "### Niveau A — rapprochement message / décisions (cognitive, PAS un blocage D6)",
    "Nora peut expliquer et clarifier. Elle ne révoque, ne remplace, ni ne suspend.",
    "Une suspicion n'est pas un conflit matériel déterministe.",
  ];
  for (const s of signals) {
    lines.push(
      `- signal=${s.kind} framing=${s.framing} objet=${s.objectRef} scope=${s.scope} décision=${s.decisionId} authorityClaim=${s.authorityClaim}`,
      `  décision existante: « ${s.priorStatement.slice(0, 160)} »`,
      `  expression courante: « ${s.currentExpression.slice(0, 160)} »`,
    );
  }
  return lines;
}

/** @deprecated Prefer formatLevelASignalSnippets — kept for callers that still pass raw divergences. */
export function formatDivergenceSnippets(
  divergences: PotentialDivergence[],
  userText?: string,
): string[] {
  const filtered = userText
    ? divergences.filter((d) => utteranceTouchesObject(userText, d.objectRef))
    : divergences;
  return formatLevelASignalSnippets(storedDivergencesToSignals(filtered));
}

export function formatApplicableDecisionSnippets(rows: DecisionBrief[]): string[] {
  const briefs = selectApplicableBriefs(rows);
  if (briefs.length === 0) {
    return ["### Décisions D6 applicables", "(aucune décision applicable avec objectRef)"];
  }
  const lines = [
    "### Décisions D6 applicables (sources — Nora n'en tire aucune autorité)",
  ];
  for (const b of briefs) {
    lines.push(
      `- ${b.id} kind=${b.kind} object=${b.objectRef} scope=${b.scope} state=${b.state} source=${b.sourceKind} « ${b.statement.slice(0, 160)} »`,
    );
  }
  return lines;
}

export function buildLevelAClarification(input: {
  priorStatement: string;
  newExpression: string;
  objectRef: string;
  framing?: LevelASignal["framing"];
}): string {
  if (input.framing === "COMPATIBLE_RESTATEMENT") {
    return (
      `Tu as une décision applicable sur « ${input.objectRef} » : « ${input.priorStatement.slice(0, 200)} ».\n` +
      `Ton message (« ${input.newExpression.slice(0, 200)} ») semble compatible — pas de conflit matériel établi.\n` +
      `(Niveau A — pas une HumanDecision, pas une interdiction D6.)`
    );
  }
  return (
    `Tu avais retenu : « ${input.priorStatement.slice(0, 200)} » (objet ${input.objectRef}).\n` +
    `Tu exprimes maintenant : « ${input.newExpression.slice(0, 200)} ».\n` +
    `Souhaites-tu remplacer ce choix pour l'ensemble du projet ou seulement pour cette activité ?\n` +
    `(Proposition cognitive Niveau A — pas une décision D6, pas une interdiction.)`
  );
}

/**
 * C02 — qualify pilotage command outcomes for UX.
 * CONFLICT alone is never an authority block (STALE_REVISION / HUMAN_INTENT / FINGERPRINT / ACTIVE_CYCLE).
 */
export type CommandOutcomeKind =
  | "authority_block"
  | "technical_conflict"
  | "d5_state"
  | "business_refusal"
  | "unknown"
  | "applied"
  | "other";

export function qualifyCommandOutcome(input: {
  status: string;
  reasonCode?: string | null;
}): { kind: CommandOutcomeKind; label: string; testId: string } {
  const status = (input.status ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
  const code = (input.reasonCode ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();

  if (status === "APPLIED" || status === "ALREADY_APPLIED") {
    return { kind: "applied", label: "Effet confirmé.", testId: "outcome-applied" };
  }
  if (status === "UNKNOWN" || status.startsWith("UNKNOWN")) {
    return {
      kind: "unknown",
      label: "Résultat non confirmé — réconcilier avant une nouvelle tentative.",
      testId: "outcome-unknown",
    };
  }
  if (status === "REJECTED" && code === "RESTRICTION") {
    return {
      kind: "authority_block",
      label: "Restriction D6 applicable — refus d'autorité borné au point d'effet.",
      testId: "authority-block-established",
    };
  }
  if (status === "CONFLICT" && (code === "STALE_REVISION" || code === "HUMAN_INTENT" || code === "FINGERPRINT")) {
    const labels: Record<string, string> = {
      STALE_REVISION: "Révision périmée — actualiser / réconcilier.",
      HUMAN_INTENT: "Intention humaine déjà enregistrée — consulter le résultat, pas de double effet.",
      FINGERPRINT: "Clé d'idempotence réutilisée avec paramètres incompatibles.",
    };
    return {
      kind: "technical_conflict",
      label: labels[code] ?? "Conflit technique — pas un blocage d'autorité D6.",
      testId: `outcome-technical-${code.toLowerCase()}`,
    };
  }
  if (status === "CONFLICT" && (code === "ACTIVE_CYCLE" || code === "ALREADY_PRESENT")) {
    return {
      kind: "d5_state",
      label: "Invariant d'état D5 — pas une contradiction entre décisions humaines.",
      testId: "outcome-d5-state",
    };
  }
  if (status === "REJECTED") {
    return {
      kind: "business_refusal",
      label: "Refus métier — pas une décision APPLIED.",
      testId: "authority-refusal",
    };
  }
  if (status === "CONFLICT") {
    return {
      kind: "technical_conflict",
      label: "Conflit technique/état — pas un blocage d'autorité D6 établi.",
      testId: "outcome-technical-other",
    };
  }
  return { kind: "other", label: "", testId: "outcome-other" };
}
```

```typescript
import { and, asc, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import { governanceRestrictions, humanDecisions, projects } from "@/db/schema";
import type { DbTx } from "@/domains/pilotage/command-runner";
import { StudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";
import { newId } from "@/lib/ids";

export type InsertDecisionInput = {
  projectId: string;
  pilotId: string;
  sourceKind: string;
  sourceRef: string;
  kind: string;
  objectRef: string;
  scope?: string;
  statement: string;
  /** Mandate body (fingerprint + envelope) — required for Git effect authority. */
  effectConditions?: string | null;
  supersedesDecisionId?: string | null;
  revokesDecisionId?: string | null;
  liftsRestrictionId?: string | null;
};

export async function insertHumanDecision(tx: DbTx, input: InsertDecisionInput): Promise<string> {
  const id = newId("dec");
  const now = new Date();
  await tx.insert(humanDecisions).values({
    id,
    projectId: input.projectId,
    pilotId: input.pilotId,
    sourceKind: input.sourceKind,
    sourceRef: input.sourceRef,
    kind: input.kind,
    objectRef: input.objectRef.slice(0, 300),
    scope: input.scope ?? "PROJECT",
    statement: input.statement.slice(0, 500),
    state: "APPLICABLE",
    effectConditions: input.effectConditions ?? null,
    supersedesDecisionId: input.supersedesDecisionId ?? null,
    revokesDecisionId: input.revokesDecisionId ?? null,
    liftsRestrictionId: input.liftsRestrictionId ?? null,
    effectiveAt: now,
    createdAt: now,
  });
  return id;
}

export async function markDecisionState(
  tx: DbTx,
  decisionId: string,
  state: "SUPERSEDED" | "REVOKED" | "REVISED",
): Promise<void> {
  await tx.update(humanDecisions).set({ state }).where(eq(humanDecisions.id, decisionId));
}

export async function insertRestriction(
  tx: DbTx,
  input: {
    projectId: string;
    targetKind: string;
    targetRef: string;
    originDecisionId: string;
  },
): Promise<string> {
  const id = newId("grs");
  await tx.insert(governanceRestrictions).values({
    id,
    projectId: input.projectId,
    targetKind: input.targetKind,
    targetRef: input.targetRef || "*",
    effect: "BLOCK",
    originDecisionId: input.originDecisionId,
    status: "ACTIVE",
    createdAt: new Date(),
  });
  return id;
}

export async function liftRestrictionRow(
  tx: DbTx,
  input: { projectId: string; restrictionId: string; liftDecisionId: string },
): Promise<"ok" | "missing" | "inactive"> {
  const row = (
    await tx
      .select()
      .from(governanceRestrictions)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(governanceRestrictions.id, input.restrictionId),
          eq(governanceRestrictions.projectId, input.projectId),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!row) return "missing";
  if (row.status !== "ACTIVE") return "inactive";
  await tx
    .update(governanceRestrictions)
    .set({
      status: "LIFTED",
      liftDecisionId: input.liftDecisionId,
      liftedAt: new Date(),
    })
    .where(eq(governanceRestrictions.id, row.id));
  return "ok";
}

/** Journal is a D6 projection. It does not authorize a new effect. */
export async function listDecisionJournal(pilotId: string, projectId: string) {
  const project = (
    await db
      .select({ id: projects.id })
      .from(projects)
      .where(and(eq(projects.id, projectId), eq(projects.ownerPilotId, pilotId)))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!project) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Projet introuvable");

  return db
    .select({
      id: humanDecisions.id,
      kind: humanDecisions.kind,
      state: humanDecisions.state,
      scope: humanDecisions.scope,
      statement: humanDecisions.statement,
      objectRef: humanDecisions.objectRef,
      sourceKind: humanDecisions.sourceKind,
      sourceRef: humanDecisions.sourceRef,
      supersedesDecisionId: humanDecisions.supersedesDecisionId,
      revokesDecisionId: humanDecisions.revokesDecisionId,
      liftsRestrictionId: humanDecisions.liftsRestrictionId,
      effectiveAt: humanDecisions.effectiveAt,
      createdAt: humanDecisions.createdAt,
    })
    .from(humanDecisions)
    .where(eq(humanDecisions.projectId, projectId))
    .orderBy(asc(humanDecisions.createdAt));
}
```

```typescript
import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import { governanceRestrictions, humanDecisions } from "@/db/schema";
import { evaluateCurrentAuthority } from "@/domains/decisions/authority";
import type { AuthorityRestriction } from "@/domains/decisions/types";
import { StudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";
import { parseEffectConditionsFingerprint } from "./effect-authority";

export type CurrentCursorAuthorityContext = {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  decisionId: string | null;
  attemptId: string;
  fingerprint: string;
  effectConditionsFingerprint?: string | null;
};

/**
 * Point-of-effect authority for Cursor execution.
 * Reuses D6 HumanDecision + governanceRestrictions — no second engine.
 */
export async function assertCurrentCursorAuthority(
  ctx: CurrentCursorAuthorityContext,
): Promise<{ decisionId: string }> {
  if (!ctx.decisionId) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Mandat D6 Cursor absent");
  }

  const decision = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(humanDecisions)
      .where(eq(humanDecisions.id, ctx.decisionId))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!decision) throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Décision D6 introuvable");
  if (decision.pilotId !== ctx.pilotId) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Décision D6 d'un autre Pilote");
  }
  if (decision.projectId !== ctx.projectId) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Décision D6 d'un autre projet");
  }
  if (decision.kind !== "CURSOR_EXECUTION_MANDATE") {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Kind de mandat incompatible");
  }
  if (decision.state !== "APPLICABLE") {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", `Décision D6 non applicable: ${decision.state}`);
  }
  if (decision.sourceRef !== ctx.attemptId || decision.objectRef !== ctx.attemptId) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Mandat D6 non lié à cette tentative Cursor");
  }

  const decisionMandateFp = parseEffectConditionsFingerprint(decision.effectConditions);
  const attemptMandateFp = ctx.effectConditionsFingerprint;
  const mandateFp = decisionMandateFp ?? attemptMandateFp;
  if (!mandateFp || mandateFp.length === 0) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Conditions d'effet D6 absentes — fail-closed");
  }
  if (mandateFp !== ctx.fingerprint) {
    throw new StudioError("REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION", "Empreinte mandat ≠ contrat courant");
  }
  if (decisionMandateFp && attemptMandateFp && decisionMandateFp !== attemptMandateFp) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION",
      "Conditions d'effet décision ≠ tentative",
    );
  }

  const restrictionRows = await db
    .select()
    .from(governanceRestrictions)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(governanceRestrictions.projectId, ctx.projectId),
        eq(governanceRestrictions.status, "ACTIVE"),
      ),
    );
  const restrictions: AuthorityRestriction[] = restrictionRows.map((r) => ({
    id: r.id,
    targetKind: r.targetKind,
    targetRef: r.targetRef,
    status: r.status,
  }));

  const verdict = evaluateCurrentAuthority({
    operation: "PILOTAGE_EFFECT",
    restrictions,
    effectTargetRef: ctx.attemptId,
  });
  if (!verdict.allowed) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", `Restriction D6 active: ${verdict.reason ?? "BLOCK"}`);
  }

  const cursorBlocked = restrictions.some(
    (r) =>
      r.status === "ACTIVE" &&
      (r.targetKind === "CURSOR" ||
        r.targetKind === "EFFECT" ||
        r.targetKind === "*" ||
        r.targetRef === "*" ||
        r.targetRef === ctx.attemptId),
  );
  if (cursorBlocked) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Restriction Cursor active");
  }

  return { decisionId: decision.id };
}
```

```typescript
import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import {
  authorizedRepositories,
  governanceRestrictions,
  humanDecisions,
  integrationAuthorizations,
  projectGitLinks,
} from "@/db/schema";
import { evaluateCurrentAuthority } from "@/domains/decisions/authority";
import type { AuthorityRestriction } from "@/domains/decisions/types";
import { StudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";
import {
  assertPermissionMap,
  type RequiredPermission,
} from "./permission-level";

export type CurrentGitAuthorityContext = {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  decisionId: string | null;
  expectedKind: "GIT_PUBLICATION_MANDATE" | "GIT_MERGE_MANDATE";
  attemptId: string;
  repositoryId: string;
  authorizationId: string;
  installationId: string;
  /** Actor frozen in the inspected plan — must match current authz. */
  expectedActorLogin: string | null;
  fingerprint: string;
  effectConditionsFingerprint?: string | null;
  requiredPermissions: RequiredPermission[];
};

/**
 * Point-of-effect authority for Git mutations.
 * Reuses D6 HumanDecision + governanceRestrictions — does not create a second engine.
 */
export async function assertCurrentGitAuthority(ctx: CurrentGitAuthorityContext): Promise<{
  decisionId: string;
  actorLogin: string | null;
  permissions: Record<string, string>;
  repositoryFullName: string;
  authorizationId: string;
  installationId: string;
}> {
  if (!ctx.decisionId) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Mandat D6 absent");
  }

  const decision = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(humanDecisions)
      .where(eq(humanDecisions.id, ctx.decisionId))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!decision) throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Décision D6 introuvable");
  if (decision.pilotId !== ctx.pilotId) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Décision D6 d'un autre Pilote");
  }
  if (decision.projectId !== ctx.projectId) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Décision D6 d'un autre projet");
  }
  if (decision.kind !== ctx.expectedKind) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Kind de mandat incompatible");
  }
  if (decision.state !== "APPLICABLE") {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", `Décision D6 non applicable: ${decision.state}`);
  }
  if (ctx.expectedKind === "GIT_PUBLICATION_MANDATE") {
    // Both bindings required — OR previously allowed a same-project foreign mandate.
    if (decision.sourceRef !== ctx.attemptId || decision.objectRef !== ctx.attemptId) {
      throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Mandat D6 non lié à cette tentative");
    }
  } else if (ctx.expectedKind === "GIT_MERGE_MANDATE") {
    if (decision.sourceRef !== ctx.attemptId) {
      throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Mandat merge D6 non lié à cette tentative");
    }
  }

  const decisionMandateFp = parseEffectConditionsFingerprint(decision.effectConditions);
  const attemptMandateFp = ctx.effectConditionsFingerprint;
  // Prefer decision.effect_conditions (mandate of record); attempt JSON is legacy fallback.
  const mandateFp = decisionMandateFp ?? attemptMandateFp;
  if (!mandateFp || mandateFp.length === 0) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Conditions d'effet D6 absentes — fail-closed");
  }
  if (mandateFp !== ctx.fingerprint) {
    throw new StudioError("REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION", "Empreinte mandat ≠ plan courant");
  }
  if (decisionMandateFp && attemptMandateFp && decisionMandateFp !== attemptMandateFp) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION",
      "Conditions d'effet décision ≠ tentative",
    );
  }

  const restrictionRows = await db
    .select()
    .from(governanceRestrictions)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(governanceRestrictions.projectId, ctx.projectId),
        eq(governanceRestrictions.status, "ACTIVE"),
      ),
    );
  const restrictions: AuthorityRestriction[] = restrictionRows.map((r) => ({
    id: r.id,
    targetKind: r.targetKind,
    targetRef: r.targetRef,
    status: r.status,
  }));

  const verdict = evaluateCurrentAuthority({
    operation: "PILOTAGE_EFFECT",
    restrictions,
    effectTargetRef: ctx.repositoryId,
  });
  const gitBlocked = restrictions.some(
    (r) =>
      r.status === "ACTIVE" &&
      (r.targetKind === "PILOTAGE_EFFECT" ||
        r.targetKind === "GIT_EFFECT" ||
        r.targetKind === "EXTERNAL_EFFECT") &&
      (r.targetRef === "*" ||
        r.targetRef === "" ||
        r.targetRef === ctx.repositoryId ||
        r.targetRef === ctx.decisionId ||
        r.targetRef === ctx.attemptId),
  );
  if (!verdict.allowed || gitBlocked) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Restriction D6 active au point d'effet", {
      exposeMessage: true,
    });
  }

  const authz = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(integrationAuthorizations)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(integrationAuthorizations.id, ctx.authorizationId),
          eq(integrationAuthorizations.pilotId, ctx.pilotId),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!authz || authz.status !== "CONNECTED") {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Intégration GitHub non CONNECTED");
  }
  if (!authz.installationId) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Installation GitHub non attribuable");
  }
  if (authz.installationId !== ctx.installationId) {
    throw new StudioError("REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION", "Installation GitHub modifiée");
  }
  // B7 — actor frozen at inspection must match current
  if ((authz.accountLogin ?? null) !== (ctx.expectedActorLogin ?? null)) {
    throw new StudioError("REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION", "Acteur GitHub modifié depuis inspection", {
      exposeMessage: true,
    });
  }
  if (ctx.expectedActorLogin == null || ctx.expectedActorLogin.length === 0) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Acteur GitHub non attribuable pour écriture");
  }

  const link = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(projectGitLinks)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(projectGitLinks.projectId, ctx.projectId),
          eq(projectGitLinks.repositoryId, ctx.repositoryId),
          eq(projectGitLinks.pilotId, ctx.pilotId),
          eq(projectGitLinks.status, "ATTACHED"),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!link) throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Dépôt non rattaché au projet");

  const repo = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(authorizedRepositories)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(authorizedRepositories.id, ctx.repositoryId),
          eq(authorizedRepositories.pilotId, ctx.pilotId),
          eq(authorizedRepositories.status, "ACTIVE"),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!repo) throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Dépôt inactif ou retiré");
  if (repo.authorizationId !== ctx.authorizationId) {
    throw new StudioError("REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION", "Autorisation dépôt incohérente");
  }

  let permissions: Record<string, string> = {};
  try {
    permissions = JSON.parse(repo.permissionsJson || "{}") as Record<string, string>;
  } catch {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Permissions dépôt illisibles — fail-closed");
  }

  // REAL path: refuse fixture/unknown permission snapshots (operator env, not a D6 bypass).
  const providerMode = (process.env.STUDIO_GITHUB_PROVIDER ?? "").toLowerCase().trim();
  if (providerMode === "real") {
    if (permissions.source !== "user_token_observed") {
      throw new StudioError(
        "ACCESS_DENIED",
        "Permissions REAL non observées via user token — fail-closed",
        { exposeMessage: true },
      );
    }
  }

  try {
    assertPermissionMap(permissions, ctx.requiredPermissions);
  } catch (e) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "ACCESS_DENIED",
      e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Permission insuffisante",
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }

  return {
    decisionId: decision.id,
    actorLogin: authz.accountLogin,
    permissions,
    repositoryFullName: repo.fullName,
    authorizationId: authz.id,
    installationId: authz.installationId,
  };
}

export function parseEffectConditionsFingerprint(raw: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    const j = JSON.parse(raw) as { fingerprint?: string };
    return typeof j.fingerprint === "string" ? j.fingerprint : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
```

```typescript
export type PermissionLevel = "none" | "read" | "write" | "admin";

const RANK: Record<PermissionLevel, number> = {
  none: 0,
  read: 1,
  write: 2,
  admin: 3,
};

export function normalizePermissionLevel(raw: unknown): PermissionLevel | null {
  if (raw == null) return null;
  const v = String(raw).trim().toLowerCase();
  if (v === "none" || v === "read" || v === "write" || v === "admin") return v;
  // GitHub sometimes uses "pull"/"push"
  if (v === "pull") return "read";
  if (v === "push") return "write";
  return null;
}

/** True iff `have` satisfies `need` (write never satisfied by read). */
export function permissionSatisfies(have: unknown, need: PermissionLevel): boolean {
  const h = normalizePermissionLevel(have);
  if (!h) return false;
  return RANK[h] >= RANK[need];
}

export type RequiredPermission = { key: string; level: PermissionLevel };

export function assertPermissionMap(
  permissions: Record<string, string>,
  required: RequiredPermission[],
): void {
  for (const req of required) {
    const have = permissions[req.key];
    if (!permissionSatisfies(have, req.level)) {
      const err = new Error(
        `Permission insuffisante: ${req.key} exige ${req.level}, reçu ${have ?? "absent"}`,
      );
      (err as Error & { code: string }).code = "ACCESS_DENIED";
      throw err;
    }
  }
}
```
