import { and, desc, eq, gt, isNull, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import {
  authorizedRepositories,
  integrationAuthorizations,
  integrationOauthStates,
  pilots,
} from "@/db/schema";
import { StudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";
import { newId } from "@/lib/ids";
import { isTokenEncryptionConfigured, openSecret, sealSecret } from "@/lib/token-crypto";
import { resolveGitHubProvider } from "./github-provider";
import {
  assertInstallationAuthorized,
  assertSandboxRepoInList,
  buildGitHubAppUserAuthorizeUrl,
  exchangeAuthorizationCode,
  fetchGitHubUserIdentity,
  isGitHubAppUserOauthConfigured,
  listUserInstallationRepos,
  listUserInstallationsForApp,
  mintPkcePair,
  readGitHubAppUserOauthConfig,
  refreshUserAccessToken,
} from "./github-app-user-oauth";
import { safeReturnPath } from "./oauth-return-path";
import {
  assertScriptedGithubAuthAllowed,
  resolveGithubUserAuthFlow,
} from "./scripted-github-guard";
import { OAuthConcurrencyBarrier } from "./oauth-concurrency-barrier";
import type { IntegrationStatus } from "./types";

const STATE_TTL_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000;
const REFRESH_LEASE_MS = 20_000;

function isUniqueViolation(e: unknown): boolean {
  if (!e || typeof e !== "object") return false;
  const code = "code" in e ? String((e as { code: unknown }).code) : "";
  if (code === "23505") return true;
  const cause = "cause" in e ? (e as { cause: unknown }).cause : null;
  if (cause && typeof cause === "object" && "code" in cause) {
    return String((cause as { code: unknown }).code) === "23505";
  }
  // drizzle/postgres may wrap message
  const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
  return /duplicate key|unique constraint|one_connected/i.test(msg);
}

export type RepoPermissionSnapshot = {
  source: "scripted_fixture" | "user_token_observed" | "unknown";
  contents: "read" | "write" | "admin" | "unknown" | "none";
  pull_requests: "read" | "write" | "admin" | "unknown" | "none";
};

function scriptedFixturePermissions(): RepoPermissionSnapshot {
  // Fixture only — tagged so REAL paths never inherit these levels.
  return {
    source: "scripted_fixture",
    contents: "write",
    pull_requests: "write",
  };
}

function unknownPermissions(): RepoPermissionSnapshot {
  return { source: "unknown", contents: "unknown", pull_requests: "unknown" };
}

function normalizeObservedLevel(raw: unknown): RepoPermissionSnapshot["contents"] {
  const v = String(raw ?? "")
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();
  if (v === "read" || v === "pull") return "read";
  if (v === "write" || v === "push") return "write";
  if (v === "admin") return "admin";
  if (v === "none") return "none";
  return "unknown";
}

function permissionsFromObserved(input?: {
  contents?: unknown;
  pull_requests?: unknown;
}): RepoPermissionSnapshot {
  if (!input) return unknownPermissions();
  return {
    source: "user_token_observed",
    contents: normalizeObservedLevel(input.contents),
    pull_requests: normalizeObservedLevel(input.pull_requests),
  };
}

export async function getIntegrationStatus(pilotId: string) {
  const provider = resolveGitHubProvider();
  const connected = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(integrationAuthorizations)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(integrationAuthorizations.pilotId, pilotId),
          eq(integrationAuthorizations.status, "CONNECTED"),
        ),
      )
      .orderBy(desc(integrationAuthorizations.createdAt))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  const latest = connected
    ? connected
    : (
        await db
          .select()
          .from(integrationAuthorizations)
          .where(eq(integrationAuthorizations.pilotId, pilotId))
          .orderBy(desc(integrationAuthorizations.updatedAt))
          .limit(1)
      )[0];

  const status = (latest?.status ?? "DISCONNECTED") as IntegrationStatus;
  const repos =
    status === "CONNECTED"
      ? await db
          .select({
            id: authorizedRepositories.id,
            fullName: authorizedRepositories.fullName,
            defaultBranch: authorizedRepositories.defaultBranch,
            status: authorizedRepositories.status,
            permissionsJson: authorizedRepositories.permissionsJson,
          })
          .from(authorizedRepositories)
          .where(
            and(
              eq(authorizedRepositories.pilotId, pilotId),
              eq(authorizedRepositories.status, "ACTIVE"),
            ),
          )
      : [];

  return {
    provider: "github" as const,
    providerMode: provider.mode,
    status,
    authorizationId: latest?.id ?? null,
    installationId: latest?.installationId ?? null,
    githubUserId: latest?.githubUserId ?? null,
    accountLogin: latest?.accountLogin ?? null,
    tokenExpiresAt: latest?.tokenExpiresAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    lastValidatedAt: latest?.lastValidatedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    userOauthConfigured: isGitHubAppUserOauthConfigured(),
    repositories: repos.map((r) => ({
      id: r.id,
      fullName: r.fullName,
      defaultBranch: r.defaultBranch,
      status: r.status,
      // Expose only non-secret permission snapshot (never tokens).
      permissions: (() => {
        try {
          return JSON.parse(r.permissionsJson || "{}") as RepoPermissionSnapshot;
        } catch {
          return unknownPermissions();
        }
      })(),
    })),
  };
}

/**
 * Start voluntary GitHub App user-to-server authorization (distinct from D1 Better Auth).
 * Flow is chosen server-side — never from client scripted/code flags.
 */
export async function startGitHubAuthorization(
  pilotId: string,
  returnPath: string,
  studioSessionId: string,
  opts?: { requestHost?: string | null },
) {
  if (!studioSessionId) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Session Studio requise pour démarrer OAuth", {
      httpStatus: 401,
    });
  }
  const flow = resolveGithubUserAuthFlow({ requestHost: opts?.requestHost });
  const stateToken = newId("ghst");
  const now = new Date();
  const expiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + STATE_TTL_MS);
  const pkce = mintPkcePair();
  const nonce = newId("ghnc");
  const safePath = safeReturnPath(returnPath);
  const storedFlow = flow === "real" ? "github_app_user_oauth" : "scripted";

  await db.insert(integrationOauthStates).values({
    id: newId("ghos"),
    pilotId,
    stateToken,
    returnPath: safePath,
    codeVerifier: pkce.codeVerifier,
    nonce,
    codeChallengeMethod: pkce.method,
    studioSessionId,
    flow: storedFlow,
    expiresAt,
    createdAt: now,
  });

  if (flow === "real") {
    const config = readGitHubAppUserOauthConfig();
    const authorizeUrl = buildGitHubAppUserAuthorizeUrl({
      config,
      state: stateToken,
      codeChallenge: pkce.codeChallenge,
      codeChallengeMethod: pkce.method,
    });
    return {
      authorizeUrl,
      state: stateToken,
      flow: "github_app_user_oauth" as const,
      pkce: true,
    };
  }

  assertScriptedGithubAuthAllowed({ requestHost: opts?.requestHost });
  // SCRIPTED complete uses JSON API — authorizeUrl is informational only.
  const authorizeUrl = `/api/integrations/github/authorize/complete`;
  return {
    authorizeUrl,
    state: stateToken,
    flow: "scripted" as const,
    pkce: true,
  };
}

type SeedRepo = {
  owner: string;
  name: string;
  fullName: string;
  defaultBranch: string;
  permissions: RepoPermissionSnapshot;
};

async function seedAuthorizedReposInTx(
  tx: Parameters<Parameters<typeof db.transaction>[0]>[0],
  pilotId: string,
  authorizationId: string,
  repos: SeedRepo[],
) {
  const now = new Date();
  const activeNames = new Set(repos.map((r) => r.fullName.toLowerCase()));

  // Mark repos no longer present as REMOVED (no elevation on refresh).
  const existingActive = await tx
    .select()
    .from(authorizedRepositories)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(authorizedRepositories.pilotId, pilotId),
        eq(authorizedRepositories.status, "ACTIVE"),
      ),
    );
  for (const row of existingActive) {
    if (!activeNames.has(row.fullName.toLowerCase())) {
      await tx
        .update(authorizedRepositories)
        .set({ status: "REMOVED", syncedAt: now })
        .where(eq(authorizedRepositories.id, row.id));
    }
  }

  for (const r of repos) {
    const existing = (
      await tx
        .select({ id: authorizedRepositories.id })
        .from(authorizedRepositories)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(authorizedRepositories.pilotId, pilotId),
            eq(authorizedRepositories.fullName, r.fullName),
          ),
        )
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    const permissionsJson = JSON.stringify(r.permissions);
    if (existing) {
      await tx
        .update(authorizedRepositories)
        .set({
          authorizationId,
          status: "ACTIVE",
          defaultBranch: r.defaultBranch,
          permissionsJson,
          syncedAt: now,
        })
        .where(eq(authorizedRepositories.id, existing.id));
    } else {
      await tx.insert(authorizedRepositories).values({
        id: newId("arepo"),
        pilotId,
        authorizationId,
        owner: r.owner,
        name: r.name,
        fullName: r.fullName,
        defaultBranch: r.defaultBranch,
        status: "ACTIVE",
        permissionsJson,
        syncedAt: now,
        createdAt: now,
      });
    }
  }
}

async function loadPilotGithubUserId(pilotId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const row = (
    await db
      .select({ githubUserId: pilots.githubUserId })
      .from(pilots)
      .where(eq(pilots.id, pilotId))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  return row?.githubUserId ?? null;
}

/**
 * Atomic consume of OAuth state (TTL + single-use) bound to pilot AND studio session.
 */
export async function consumeOauthStateAtomic(input: {
  state: string;
  pilotId: string;
  studioSessionId: string;
}) {
  const now = new Date();
  const updated = await db
    .update(integrationOauthStates)
    .set({ consumedAt: now })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(integrationOauthStates.stateToken, input.state),
        eq(integrationOauthStates.pilotId, input.pilotId),
        eq(integrationOauthStates.studioSessionId, input.studioSessionId),
        isNull(integrationOauthStates.consumedAt),
        gt(integrationOauthStates.expiresAt, now),
      ),
    )
    .returning();
  return updated[0] ?? null;
}

/** Read-only peek used by callback for pilot binding before consume. */
export async function peekOauthState(state: string) {
  const row = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(integrationOauthStates)
      .where(and(eq(integrationOauthStates.stateToken, state), isNull(integrationOauthStates.consumedAt)))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  return row ?? null;
}

/** @deprecated alias — prefer peekOauthState */
export const consumeOauthStateForCallback = peekOauthState;

export async function completeGitHubAuthorization(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  state: string;
  studioSessionId: string;
  /** Authorization code from GitHub user OAuth callback — REAL flow only. */
  code?: string;
  /** SCRIPTED install hint — ignored unless server-stored flow is scripted AND guard allows. */
  installationId?: string;
  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch;
  requestHost?: string | null;
}) {
  if (!input.studioSessionId) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Session Studio requise", { httpStatus: 401 });
  }

  const oauthRow = await consumeOauthStateAtomic({
    state: input.state,
    pilotId: input.pilotId,
    studioSessionId: input.studioSessionId,
  });
  if (!oauthRow) {
    const any = (
      await db
        .select()
        .from(integrationOauthStates)
        .where(eq(integrationOauthStates.stateToken, input.state))
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    if (!any) throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "State OAuth invalide");
    if (any.pilotId !== input.pilotId) {
      throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "State OAuth non lié à la session");
    }
    if (any.studioSessionId && any.studioSessionId !== input.studioSessionId) {
      throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "State OAuth non lié à la session Studio courante");
    }
    if (any.consumedAt) throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", "State OAuth déjà consommé");
    if (any.expiresAt <= new Date()) throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "State OAuth expiré");
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "State OAuth invalide");
  }

  const storedFlow = oauthRow.flow === "github_app_user_oauth" ? "real" : "scripted";
  // Client cannot override server-stored flow.
  if (storedFlow === "scripted") {
    assertScriptedGithubAuthAllowed({ requestHost: input.requestHost });
  } else if (!input.code) {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "Code OAuth requis pour le flux REAL", {
      httpStatus: 400,
    });
  }

  const pilotGithubUserId = await loadPilotGithubUserId(input.pilotId);
  const now = new Date();
  const provider = resolveGitHubProvider();

  let githubUserId: string;
  let accountLogin: string;
  let installId: string;
  let tokenFields: {
    tokenCiphertext: string | null;
    tokenNonce: string | null;
    tokenKeyVersion: string | null;
    refreshCiphertext: string | null;
    refreshNonce: string | null;
    tokenExpiresAt: Date | null;
    scopesJson: string;
  } = {
    tokenCiphertext: null,
    tokenNonce: null,
    tokenKeyVersion: null,
    refreshCiphertext: null,
    refreshNonce: null,
    tokenExpiresAt: null,
    scopesJson: "[]",
  };
  let repoSeed: SeedRepo[] = [];

  if (storedFlow === "real") {
    if (!isGitHubAppUserOauthConfigured() || !isTokenEncryptionConfigured()) {
      throw new StudioError(
        "NOT_CONFIGURED",
        "Credentials user-to-server absents — pas de CONNECTED fictif",
        { httpStatus: 503 },
      );
    }
    if (!oauthRow.codeVerifier) {
      throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "PKCE code_verifier absent du state", {
        httpStatus: 400,
      });
    }
    const config = readGitHubAppUserOauthConfig();
    // GitHub I/O OUTSIDE the DB transaction.
    const tokens = await exchangeAuthorizationCode({
      config,
      code: input.code!,
      codeVerifier: oauthRow.codeVerifier,
      fetchImpl: input.fetchImpl,
    });
    const identity = await fetchGitHubUserIdentity(tokens.accessToken, input.fetchImpl);
    if (!pilotGithubUserId) {
      throw new StudioError(
        "ACCESS_DENIED",
        "Pilot sans githubUserId D1 — liaison identité requise, pas d'auto-fusion",
        { httpStatus: 403 },
      );
    }
    if (identity.id !== pilotGithubUserId) {
      throw new StudioError(
        "ACCESS_DENIED",
        "GitHub user ID divergent de l'identité Studio D1",
        { httpStatus: 403 },
      );
    }
    const installations = await listUserInstallationsForApp(
      tokens.accessToken,
      config.appId,
      input.fetchImpl,
    );
    const install = assertInstallationAuthorized(installations, config);
    const repos = await listUserInstallationRepos(
      tokens.accessToken,
      install.id,
      input.fetchImpl,
    );
    assertSandboxRepoInList(repos, config.allowedFullName);

    const sealedAccess = sealSecret(tokens.accessToken);
    const sealedRefresh = tokens.refreshToken ? sealSecret(tokens.refreshToken) : null;
    githubUserId = identity.id;
    accountLogin = identity.login;
    installId = install.id;
    tokenFields = {
      tokenCiphertext: sealedAccess.ciphertext,
      tokenNonce: sealedAccess.nonce,
      tokenKeyVersion: sealedAccess.keyVersion,
      refreshCiphertext: sealedRefresh?.ciphertext ?? null,
      refreshNonce: sealedRefresh?.nonce ?? null,
      tokenExpiresAt: tokens.expiresAt,
      scopesJson: JSON.stringify(tokens.scopes),
    };
    repoSeed = repos.map((r) => {
      const [owner, name] = r.fullName.split("/");
      const perms = (r as { permissions?: { contents?: string; pull_requests?: string } })
        .permissions;
      return {
        owner: owner ?? "",
        name: name ?? r.fullName,
        fullName: r.fullName,
        defaultBranch: r.defaultBranch,
        permissions: permissionsFromObserved(perms),
      };
    });
  } else {
    // SCRIPTED deterministic — guard already asserted.
    if (!pilotGithubUserId) {
      throw new StudioError(
        "ACCESS_DENIED",
        "Pilot sans githubUserId D1 — liaison identité requise",
        { httpStatus: 403 },
      );
    }
    // Never trust client installation_id for REAL; SCRIPTED uses fixed fixture id.
    installId = "scripted-install-1";
    if (input.installationId && input.installationId !== installId) {
      // Foreign installation_id cannot authorize a different install in SCRIPTED.
      throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "installation_id SCRIPTED non autorisé", {
        httpStatus: 403,
      });
    }
    const listed = await provider.listInstallationRepos(input.pilotId, installId);
    githubUserId = pilotGithubUserId;
    accountLogin = "scripted-user";
    if (isTokenEncryptionConfigured()) {
      const sealed = sealSecret(`scripted-access:${input.pilotId}`);
      tokenFields = {
        tokenCiphertext: sealed.ciphertext,
        tokenNonce: sealed.nonce,
        tokenKeyVersion: sealed.keyVersion,
        refreshCiphertext: null,
        refreshNonce: null,
        tokenExpiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + 3600_000),
        scopesJson: JSON.stringify([]),
      };
    }
    const fixturePerms = scriptedFixturePermissions();
    repoSeed = listed.map((r) => ({
      owner: r.owner,
      name: r.name,
      fullName: r.fullName,
      defaultBranch: r.defaultBranch,
      permissions: fixturePerms,
    }));
  }

  const authId = newId("iauth");
  // Short PG transaction: revoke prior CONNECTED + insert + seed — no GitHub I/O inside.
  // C2: partial UNIQUE (pilot_id, provider) WHERE CONNECTED enforces cross-process exclusivity.
  try {
    await OAuthConcurrencyBarrier.before("before:AUTH_INSERT");
    await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx
        .update(integrationAuthorizations)
        .set({
          status: "REVOKED",
          revokedAt: now,
          updatedAt: now,
          tokenCiphertext: null,
          tokenNonce: null,
          tokenKeyVersion: null,
          refreshCiphertext: null,
          refreshNonce: null,
          tokenExpiresAt: null,
          refreshLeaseToken: null,
          refreshLeaseExpiresAt: null,
        })
        .where(
          and(
            eq(integrationAuthorizations.pilotId, input.pilotId),
            eq(integrationAuthorizations.provider, "github"),
            eq(integrationAuthorizations.status, "CONNECTED"),
          ),
        );

      await tx.insert(integrationAuthorizations).values({
        id: authId,
        pilotId: input.pilotId,
        provider: "github",
        status: "CONNECTED",
        installationId: installId,
        accountLogin,
        githubUserId,
        ...tokenFields,
        lastValidatedAt: now,
        metadataJson: JSON.stringify({
          mode: storedFlow === "real" ? "REAL_USER_OAUTH" : "SCRIPTED_FIXTURE",
          flow: storedFlow === "real" ? "github_app_user_oauth" : "scripted",
          // SCRIPTED fixtures are not GitHub consent proof.
          consentProven: storedFlow === "real",
        }),
        connectedAt: now,
        createdAt: now,
        updatedAt: now,
      });
      await seedAuthorizedReposInTx(tx, input.pilotId, authId, repoSeed);
    });
  } catch (e) {
    if (isUniqueViolation(e)) {
      // R2: losing callback must NOT present another callback's CONNECTED as own success.
      // UI may reload status separately; this attempt returns CONFLICT only.
      throw new StudioError(
        "CONFLICT",
        "Collision CONNECTED — cette tentative n'a pas créé l'autorisation",
      );
    }
    throw e;
  }

  return getIntegrationStatus(input.pilotId);
}

/**
 * Refresh repository inventory without elevating permissions.
 * REAL_USER_OAUTH: uses sealed user token (refresh if expired) — never installation token substitute.
 * SCRIPTED_FIXTURE: re-lists scripted provider under guard.
 */
export async function refreshRepositories(
  pilotId: string,
  opts?: { fetchImpl?: typeof fetch; requestHost?: string | null },
) {
  const auth = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(integrationAuthorizations)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(integrationAuthorizations.pilotId, pilotId),
          eq(integrationAuthorizations.status, "CONNECTED"),
        ),
      )
      .orderBy(desc(integrationAuthorizations.createdAt))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!auth?.installationId) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Intégration non connectée");

  let meta: { mode?: string; flow?: string } = {};
  try {
    meta = JSON.parse(auth.metadataJson || "{}") as { mode?: string; flow?: string };
  } catch {
    meta = {};
  }

  let repoSeed: SeedRepo[] = [];

  if (meta.mode === "REAL_USER_OAUTH" || meta.flow === "github_app_user_oauth") {
    const accessToken = await loadOrRefreshUserAccessToken(auth, opts?.fetchImpl);
    const config = readGitHubAppUserOauthConfig();
    const repos = await listUserInstallationRepos(
      accessToken,
      auth.installationId,
      opts?.fetchImpl,
    );
    assertSandboxRepoInList(repos, config.allowedFullName);
    repoSeed = repos.map((r) => {
      const [owner, name] = r.fullName.split("/");
      const perms = (r as { permissions?: { contents?: string; pull_requests?: string } })
        .permissions;
      return {
        owner: owner ?? "",
        name: name ?? r.fullName,
        fullName: r.fullName,
        defaultBranch: r.defaultBranch,
        permissions: permissionsFromObserved(perms),
      };
    });
  } else {
    assertScriptedGithubAuthAllowed({ requestHost: opts?.requestHost });
    const provider = resolveGitHubProvider();
    const listed = await provider.listInstallationRepos(pilotId, auth.installationId);
    const fixturePerms = scriptedFixturePermissions();
    repoSeed = listed.map((r) => ({
      owner: r.owner,
      name: r.name,
      fullName: r.fullName,
      defaultBranch: r.defaultBranch,
      permissions: fixturePerms,
    }));
  }

  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await seedAuthorizedReposInTx(tx, pilotId, auth.id, repoSeed);
    await tx
      .update(integrationAuthorizations)
      .set({ lastValidatedAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date() })
      .where(eq(integrationAuthorizations.id, auth.id));
  });
  return getIntegrationStatus(pilotId);
}

async function reloadAuthorization(authId: string) {
  return (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(integrationAuthorizations)
      .where(eq(integrationAuthorizations.id, authId))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
}

type RefreshLeaseClaim = {
  leaseToken: string;
  /** True when reclaiming an expired lease — prior GitHub call may have had effect. */
  priorLeaseExpired: boolean;
};

/**
 * Claim exclusive refresh lease for one generation (refresh_ciphertext).
 * Cross-process via PostgreSQL — no long-held txn during GitHub I/O.
 * Prefers a clean claim (lease NULL); reclaim of expired lease is flagged fail-closed.
 */
async function claimRefreshLease(
  auth: typeof integrationAuthorizations.$inferSelect,
  expectedRefreshCiphertext: string,
): Promise<RefreshLeaseClaim | null> {
  const leaseToken = newId("rfl");
  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + REFRESH_LEASE_MS);
  await OAuthConcurrencyBarrier.before("before:REFRESH_CLAIM");

  // Prefer virgin lease slot — safe to call GitHub with this generation.
  const clean = await db
    .update(integrationAuthorizations)
    .set({
      refreshLeaseToken: leaseToken,
      refreshLeaseExpiresAt: expiresAt,
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(integrationAuthorizations.id, auth.id),
        eq(integrationAuthorizations.pilotId, auth.pilotId),
        eq(integrationAuthorizations.status, "CONNECTED"),
        sql`${integrationAuthorizations.refreshCiphertext} = ${expectedRefreshCiphertext}`,
        sql`${integrationAuthorizations.refreshLeaseToken} IS NULL`,
        sql`${integrationAuthorizations.refreshLeaseExpiresAt} IS NULL`,
      ),
    )
    .returning({ id: integrationAuthorizations.id });
  if (clean[0]) return { leaseToken, priorLeaseExpired: false };

  // Expired lease present: take ownership only to fail-closed — do NOT blind-refresh.
  const reclaimed = await db
    .update(integrationAuthorizations)
    .set({
      refreshLeaseToken: leaseToken,
      refreshLeaseExpiresAt: expiresAt,
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(integrationAuthorizations.id, auth.id),
        eq(integrationAuthorizations.pilotId, auth.pilotId),
        eq(integrationAuthorizations.status, "CONNECTED"),
        sql`${integrationAuthorizations.refreshCiphertext} = ${expectedRefreshCiphertext}`,
        sql`${integrationAuthorizations.refreshLeaseExpiresAt} <= now()`,
      ),
    )
    .returning({ id: integrationAuthorizations.id });
  if (reclaimed[0]) return { leaseToken, priorLeaseExpired: true };
  return null;
}

/**
 * Clear lease only while ownership is still active (R1-B).
 * Never opens a virgin slot after expiry or after an ambiguous remote attempt (R1-A).
 */
async function clearRefreshLease(authId: string, leaseToken: string) {
  await db
    .update(integrationAuthorizations)
    .set({
      refreshLeaseToken: null,
      refreshLeaseExpiresAt: null,
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(integrationAuthorizations.id, authId),
        eq(integrationAuthorizations.refreshLeaseToken, leaseToken),
        sql`${integrationAuthorizations.refreshLeaseExpiresAt} > now()`,
      ),
    );
}

function openAccessIfPresent(
  row: typeof integrationAuthorizations.$inferSelect,
): string | null {
  if (!row.tokenCiphertext || !row.tokenNonce || !row.tokenKeyVersion) return null;
  return openSecret({
    ciphertext: row.tokenCiphertext,
    nonce: row.tokenNonce,
    keyVersion: row.tokenKeyVersion,
  });
}

/**
 * Load user access token; refresh with durable lease + generation+lease fencing.
 * A stale/expired lease owner must never wipe a current owner's tokens (R1).
 */
export async function loadOrRefreshUserAccessToken(
  auth: typeof integrationAuthorizations.$inferSelect,
  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch,
): Promise<string> {
  if (!auth.tokenCiphertext || !auth.tokenNonce || !auth.tokenKeyVersion) {
    await markRequiresReauth(auth.pilotId, auth.id, auth.refreshCiphertext, null);
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "User token absent — REQUIRES_REAUTH", {
      httpStatus: 403,
    });
  }
  const now = Date.now();
  const expiresAt = auth.tokenExpiresAt?.getTime() ?? null;
  if (expiresAt == null || expiresAt > now + 30_000) {
    return openSecret({
      ciphertext: auth.tokenCiphertext,
      nonce: auth.tokenNonce,
      keyVersion: auth.tokenKeyVersion,
    });
  }
  if (!auth.refreshCiphertext || !auth.refreshNonce) {
    await markRequiresReauth(auth.pilotId, auth.id, null, null);
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Refresh token absent — REQUIRES_REAUTH", {
      httpStatus: 403,
    });
  }
  if (!isGitHubAppUserOauthConfigured()) {
    throw new StudioError("NOT_CONFIGURED", "Credentials refresh absents", { httpStatus: 503 });
  }

  const expectedRefreshCiphertext = auth.refreshCiphertext;
  const claim = await claimRefreshLease(auth, expectedRefreshCiphertext);
  if (!claim) {
    // Another worker holds an active lease — reload; do not steal.
    await OAuthConcurrencyBarrier.before("before:REFRESH_WAIT_ACTIVE");
    const fresh = await reloadAuthorization(auth.id);
    if (!fresh || fresh.status !== "CONNECTED") {
      throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Autorisation plus CONNECTED pendant refresh", {
        httpStatus: 403,
      });
    }
    if (fresh.refreshCiphertext !== expectedRefreshCiphertext) {
      const access = openAccessIfPresent(fresh);
      if (access) return access;
      throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", "Génération refresh avancée — token inaccessible");
    }
    // Same generation, active lease held by other — bounded conflict (no blind second remote).
    throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", "Refresh lease concurrent — réessayer");
  }

  // Expired-lease reclaim: prior GitHub call may have rotated — fail-closed, no second remote.
  if (claim.priorLeaseExpired) {
    await markRequiresReauth(
      auth.pilotId,
      auth.id,
      expectedRefreshCiphertext,
      claim.leaseToken,
    );
    throw new StudioError(
      "ACCESS_DENIED",
      "Refresh ambigu après lease expiré — REQUIRES_REAUTH",
      { httpStatus: 403 },
    );
  }

  auth = (await reloadAuthorization(auth.id)) ?? auth;
  const leaseToken = claim.leaseToken;

  const refreshPlain = openSecret({
    ciphertext: expectedRefreshCiphertext,
    nonce: auth.refreshNonce!,
    keyVersion: auth.tokenKeyVersion!,
  });
  const config = readGitHubAppUserOauthConfig();

  let tokens;
  try {
    await OAuthConcurrencyBarrier.before("before:REFRESH_GITHUB");
    tokens = await refreshUserAccessToken({
      config,
      refreshToken: refreshPlain,
      fetchImpl,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof StudioError && e.code === "ACCESS_DENIED") {
      // Proven invalid credentials for THIS active lease owner + generation only (R1-B).
      await markRequiresReauth(
        auth.pilotId,
        auth.id,
        expectedRefreshCiphertext,
        leaseToken,
      );
    }
    // R1-A: ambiguous network/timeout after remote engaged — do NOT clearRefreshLease.
    // Keep lease token+expiry so concurrent workers cannot blind-refresh G1; after expiry,
    // reclaim fail-closed forces REQUIRES_REAUTH without a second GitHub rotation.
    throw e;
  }

  const sealedAccess = sealSecret(tokens.accessToken);
  const sealedRefresh = tokens.refreshToken ? sealSecret(tokens.refreshToken) : null;
  // Persist only if we still own an *active* lease AND the expected generation (R1-B).
  const updated = await db
    .update(integrationAuthorizations)
    .set({
      tokenCiphertext: sealedAccess.ciphertext,
      tokenNonce: sealedAccess.nonce,
      tokenKeyVersion: sealedAccess.keyVersion,
      refreshCiphertext: sealedRefresh?.ciphertext ?? null,
      refreshNonce: sealedRefresh?.nonce ?? null,
      tokenExpiresAt: tokens.expiresAt,
      refreshLeaseToken: null,
      refreshLeaseExpiresAt: null,
      lastValidatedAt: new Date(),
      updatedAt: new Date(),
      scopesJson: JSON.stringify(tokens.scopes),
    })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(integrationAuthorizations.id, auth.id),
        eq(integrationAuthorizations.pilotId, auth.pilotId),
        eq(integrationAuthorizations.status, "CONNECTED"),
        sql`${integrationAuthorizations.refreshCiphertext} = ${expectedRefreshCiphertext}`,
        eq(integrationAuthorizations.refreshLeaseToken, leaseToken),
        sql`${integrationAuthorizations.refreshLeaseExpiresAt} > now()`,
      ),
    )
    .returning({ id: integrationAuthorizations.id });

  if (!updated[0]) {
    // Lost CAS (lease expired/stolen or generation moved) — never wipe current owner.
    // clearRefreshLease is no-op if expired (R1-A/B): leave durable ambiguous/expired trace.
    await clearRefreshLease(auth.id, leaseToken);
    const fresh = await reloadAuthorization(auth.id);
    if (!fresh || fresh.status !== "CONNECTED") {
      throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", "Autorisation remplacée pendant refresh");
    }
    // Only accept another owner's successful rotation (generation advanced).
    // Same G1 after our failed persist must NOT return the pre-refresh expired access (R1-B).
    if (fresh.refreshCiphertext !== expectedRefreshCiphertext) {
      const access = openAccessIfPresent(fresh);
      if (access) return access;
    }
    throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", "Rotation concurrente — token indisponible");
  }
  return tokens.accessToken;
}

/**
 * REQUIRES_REAUTH only when generation AND lease ownership match (R1 fencing).
 * expectedLeaseToken null = virgin lease slot only (missing-token paths).
 * Non-null owner must still hold an *active* lease at DB time (R1-B).
 */
export async function markRequiresReauth(
  pilotId: string,
  authId: string,
  expectedRefreshCiphertext: string | null,
  expectedLeaseToken: string | null,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const now = new Date();
  const genPred =
    expectedRefreshCiphertext == null
      ? sql`${integrationAuthorizations.refreshCiphertext} IS NULL`
      : sql`${integrationAuthorizations.refreshCiphertext} = ${expectedRefreshCiphertext}`;
  const leasePred =
    expectedLeaseToken == null
      ? and(
          sql`${integrationAuthorizations.refreshLeaseToken} IS NULL`,
          sql`${integrationAuthorizations.refreshLeaseExpiresAt} IS NULL`,
        )
      : and(
          eq(integrationAuthorizations.refreshLeaseToken, expectedLeaseToken),
          sql`${integrationAuthorizations.refreshLeaseExpiresAt} > now()`,
        );
  const updated = await db
    .update(integrationAuthorizations)
    .set({
      status: "REQUIRES_REAUTH",
      updatedAt: now,
      tokenCiphertext: null,
      tokenNonce: null,
      tokenKeyVersion: null,
      refreshCiphertext: null,
      refreshNonce: null,
      tokenExpiresAt: null,
      refreshLeaseToken: null,
      refreshLeaseExpiresAt: null,
    })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(integrationAuthorizations.id, authId),
        eq(integrationAuthorizations.pilotId, pilotId),
        eq(integrationAuthorizations.status, "CONNECTED"),
        genPred,
        leasePred,
      ),
    )
    .returning({ id: integrationAuthorizations.id });
  return Boolean(updated[0]);
}

export async function disconnectIntegration(pilotId: string) {
  const now = new Date();
  // Local wipe only — KNOWN GAP: no remote GitHub OAuth revocation without dedicated API call.
  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx
      .update(integrationAuthorizations)
      .set({
        status: "REVOKED",
        revokedAt: now,
        updatedAt: now,
        tokenCiphertext: null,
        tokenNonce: null,
        tokenKeyVersion: null,
        refreshCiphertext: null,
        refreshNonce: null,
        tokenExpiresAt: null,
        refreshLeaseToken: null,
        refreshLeaseExpiresAt: null,
      })
      .where(
        and(
          eq(integrationAuthorizations.pilotId, pilotId),
          eq(integrationAuthorizations.status, "CONNECTED"),
        ),
      );
    await tx
      .update(authorizedRepositories)
      .set({ status: "REMOVED", syncedAt: now })
      .where(
        and(
          eq(authorizedRepositories.pilotId, pilotId),
          eq(authorizedRepositories.status, "ACTIVE"),
        ),
      );
  });
  return getIntegrationStatus(pilotId);
}

export async function setPendingApproval(pilotId: string) {
  const auth = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(integrationAuthorizations)
      .where(eq(integrationAuthorizations.pilotId, pilotId))
      .orderBy(desc(integrationAuthorizations.createdAt))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  const now = new Date();
  if (auth) {
    await db
      .update(integrationAuthorizations)
      .set({ status: "PENDING_APPROVAL", updatedAt: now })
      .where(eq(integrationAuthorizations.id, auth.id));
  } else {
    await db.insert(integrationAuthorizations).values({
      id: newId("iauth"),
      pilotId,
      provider: "github",
      status: "PENDING_APPROVAL",
      metadataJson: "{}",
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    });
  }
  return getIntegrationStatus(pilotId);
}

export async function markAccessRemoved(pilotId: string) {
  const now = new Date();
  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx
      .update(integrationAuthorizations)
      .set({
        status: "ACCESS_REMOVED",
        updatedAt: now,
        tokenCiphertext: null,
        tokenNonce: null,
        refreshCiphertext: null,
        refreshNonce: null,
      })
      .where(
        and(
          eq(integrationAuthorizations.pilotId, pilotId),
          eq(integrationAuthorizations.status, "CONNECTED"),
        ),
      );
    await tx
      .update(authorizedRepositories)
      .set({ status: "REMOVED", syncedAt: now })
      .where(
        and(
          eq(authorizedRepositories.pilotId, pilotId),
          eq(authorizedRepositories.status, "ACTIVE"),
        ),
      );
  });
  return getIntegrationStatus(pilotId);
}

/**
 * F01/F02 — bridge from a persisted USER message to the existing D5/D6
 * command boundary. Never invents authority from Nora or D4 content.
 *
 * Sequencing contract:
 * 1. USER message already durable (COMPLETE) before this runs.
 * 2. Short business TX via executePilotageCommand only — never around Nora.
 * 3. Ambiguous / insufficient acts do not call the command runner
 *    (avoids HUMAN_INTENT locks on clarification turns).
 * 4. C02 — durable effects are recoverable via business_commands
 *    (conv-auth:{clientTurnKey} / USER_MESSAGE sourceRef), not only resultJson.
 */
import { and, asc, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import { businessCommandEffects, businessCommands, humanDecisions } from "@/db/schema";
import {
  findAuthorityReviseCandidates,
  type DecisionBrief,
} from "@/domains/decisions/divergence-assist";
import { toCommandResult } from "@/domains/pilotage/command-runner";
import {
  resolveLiftRestrictionTarget,
  resolveReviseDecisionTarget,
} from "@/domains/pilotage/durable-target-resolve";
import type { IntentQualification } from "@/domains/pilotage/intent";
import {
  executePilotageCommand,
  getPilotageProjection,
  reconcileCommandByClientKey,
} from "@/domains/pilotage/service";
import { conversationalClientCommandKey } from "@/domains/pilotage/thread-recovery";
import type { CommandResult, PilotageRequestBody } from "@/domains/pilotage/types";

const D5_FOUNDING_KINDS = new Set([
  "OPEN_CYCLE",
  "CLOSE_CYCLE",
  "TRANSITION_CYCLE",
  "CHOOSE_METHOD",
  "REPLACE_METHOD",
  "WITHDRAW_METHOD",
  "RETAIN_TRAJECTORY",
  "PROPOSE_TRAJECTORY",
  "APPLY_RESTRICTION",
  "LIFT_RESTRICTION",
  "REVOKE_DECISION",
]);

export type ConversationalAuthorityOutcome = {
  /** Whether a D5/D6 command was attempted. */
  attempted: boolean;
  /** Intent recognized before any command. */
  intentClarity: "CLEAR" | "AMBIGUOUS" | "NONE";
  intentReason?: string;
  operation?: string;
  /** Honest command result when attempted. */
  command: CommandResult | null;
  /** True only when a HumanDecision id was produced or already applied. */
  humanDecisionCreated: boolean;
  decisionId: string | null;
  clarification?: string;
  source: "none" | "user_message_command" | "clarification_only" | "reconstituted";
  /** Stable business key — searchable after Nora/HTTP interruption. */
  clientCommandKey?: string;
};

/** Stable D5/D6 client key for a conversational turn — not a second registry. */
export function conversationalCommandKey(clientTurnKey: string): string {
  return conversationalClientCommandKey(clientTurnKey);
}

/** @deprecated retained for lexical helper tests only — authority path uses durable resolvers. */
export async function loadDecisionBriefs(projectId: string): Promise<DecisionBrief[]> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: humanDecisions.id,
      kind: humanDecisions.kind,
      objectRef: humanDecisions.objectRef,
      scope: humanDecisions.scope,
      statement: humanDecisions.statement,
      state: humanDecisions.state,
      sourceKind: humanDecisions.sourceKind,
    })
    .from(humanDecisions)
    .where(eq(humanDecisions.projectId, projectId))
    .orderBy(asc(humanDecisions.createdAt));
  return rows.map((r) => ({
    id: r.id,
    kind: r.kind,
    objectRef: r.objectRef ?? "",
    scope: r.scope ?? "PROJECT",
    statement: r.statement ?? "",
    state: r.state,
    sourceKind: r.sourceKind,
  }));
}

/**
 * C05 rework — pilot explicitly designates a founding D5 act as the revise target
 * (e.g. « je révise la décision d'ouverture du cycle »). Must not fall through
 * to an opportunistic RECORD_DECISION match.
 */
/** @deprecated Lot D2 — lexical founding revise designation retired from authority path. */
export function designatesFoundingReviseTarget(utterance: string): string | null {
  const t = utterance.trim();
  if (
    /\b(?:d[eé]cision\s+d['’]ouverture|ouverture\s+du\s+cycle|d[eé]cision\s+d['’]ouvrir)\b/i.test(
      t,
    ) ||
    /\br[eé]vise\s+la\s+d[eé]cision\s+d['’]ouverture\b/i.test(t)
  ) {
    return "OPEN_CYCLE";
  }
  if (
    /\b(?:d[eé]cision\s+de\s+cl[oô]ture|cl[oô]ture\s+du\s+cycle|d[eé]cision\s+de\s+cl[oô]turer)\b/i.test(
      t,
    )
  ) {
    return "CLOSE_CYCLE";
  }
  if (/\b(?:d[eé]cision\s+de\s+(?:retenir|choisir)\s+la\s+m[eé]thode)\b/i.test(t)) {
    return "CHOOSE_METHOD";
  }
  if (/\b(?:d[eé]cision\s+(?:d['’]appliquer|de\s+restriction)|restriction\s+appliqu[eé]e)\b/i.test(t)) {
    return "APPLY_RESTRICTION";
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Resolve a documentary REVISE target (CR-01 / C05 LIVE / C05 rework).
 * Uses the full APPLICABLE set — never the Nora cognitive window of 12.
 * Level A framing filters relevance only — never authorizes by itself.
 * Qualify must already be CLEAR (caller).
 *
 * Eligibility before uniqueness: only RECORD_DECISION compete for generic
 * REVISE — unless the pilot explicitly designates a founding D5 target, in
 * which case refuse typed (never rewrite OPEN via documentary REVISE).
 * 0 / many admissible candidates ⇒ clarification; never chronological newest-wins.
 */
/** @deprecated Lot D2 — lexical revise target selection retired from authority path. */
export function resolveReviseTargetLexical(
  utterance: string,
  briefs: DecisionBrief[],
):
  | { ok: true; decisionId: string; statement: string }
  | { ok: false; reason: string } {
  const designatedFounding = designatesFoundingReviseTarget(utterance);
  if (designatedFounding) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: `Révision générique refusée pour ${designatedFounding} — utiliser l'opération métier typée`,
    };
  }

  const lexical = findAuthorityReviseCandidates(utterance, briefs);
  const documentary = lexical.filter((c) => c.kind === "RECORD_DECISION");

  if (documentary.length === 0) {
    const founding = lexical.find((c) => D5_FOUNDING_KINDS.has(c.kind));
    if (founding) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        reason: `Révision générique refusée pour ${founding.kind} — utiliser l'opération métier typée`,
      };
    }
    const other = lexical[0];
    if (other) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        reason: `Révision conversationnelle limitée aux décisions documentaires (kind=${other.kind})`,
      };
    }
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: "Aucune décision applicable clairement revisitée — précisez la cible",
    };
  }
  if (documentary.length > 1) {
    const scopes = new Set(documentary.map((c) => c.scope));
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason:
        scopes.size > 1
          ? "Plusieurs décisions candidates à portées distinctes — précisez la portée et la cible"
          : "Plusieurs décisions candidates — précisez laquelle réviser",
    };
  }
  const target = documentary[0];
  if (!target || target.state !== "APPLICABLE") {
    return { ok: false, reason: "Cible de révision non applicable" };
  }
  const statement = utterance
    .replace(/^(?:finalement|désormais|dorénavant)[,:]?\s+/i, "")
    .trim();
  return { ok: true, decisionId: target.id, statement: statement.slice(0, 500) };
}

function outcomeFromCommand(
  command: CommandResult,
  operation: string,
  clientCommandKey: string,
  source: ConversationalAuthorityOutcome["source"] = "user_message_command",
): ConversationalAuthorityOutcome {
  const applied = command.status === "APPLIED" || command.status === "ALREADY_APPLIED";
  return {
    attempted: true,
    intentClarity: "CLEAR",
    operation,
    command,
    humanDecisionCreated: applied && Boolean(command.decisionId),
    decisionId: command.decisionId,
    source,
    clientCommandKey,
    intentReason:
      command.status === "REJECTED" || command.status === "CONFLICT" || command.status === "UNKNOWN"
        ? command.reason
        : undefined,
    clarification:
      command.status === "REJECTED" && command.reasonCode === "AMBIGUOUS"
        ? command.reason
        : undefined,
  };
}

/**
 * C02 — reconstitute a prior conversational D5/D6 effect from the durable registry.
 * Prefer clientCommandKey; fall back to USER_MESSAGE sourceRef (= userMessageId).
 * Never invents APPLIED/REJECTED when nothing is found.
 */
export async function reconstituteConversationalAuthority(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  clientTurnKey?: string | null;
  userMessageId?: string | null;
}): Promise<ConversationalAuthorityOutcome | null> {
  const key = input.clientTurnKey?.trim()
    ? conversationalCommandKey(input.clientTurnKey)
    : null;
  if (key) {
    try {
      const command = await reconcileCommandByClientKey(input.pilotId, input.projectId, key);
      return outcomeFromCommand(
        command,
        command.effects[0]?.effectKind ?? "UNKNOWN",
        key,
        "reconstituted",
      );
    } catch {
      /* fall through to sourceRef */
    }
  }
  const messageId = input.userMessageId?.trim();
  if (!messageId) return null;
  const cmd = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(businessCommands)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(businessCommands.projectId, input.projectId),
          eq(businessCommands.actorPilotId, input.pilotId),
          eq(businessCommands.sourceKind, "USER_MESSAGE"),
          eq(businessCommands.sourceRef, messageId),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!cmd) return null;
  const effects = await db
    .select()
    .from(businessCommandEffects)
    .where(eq(businessCommandEffects.commandId, cmd.id))
    .orderBy(asc(businessCommandEffects.ordinal));
  const command = toCommandResult(cmd, effects, "replay");
  return outcomeFromCommand(
    command,
    cmd.operation || effects[0]?.effectKind || "UNKNOWN",
    cmd.clientCommandKey,
    "reconstituted",
  );
}

/**
 * Attempt a governed D5/D6 command from a persisted USER message.
 * Caller must pass the durable message id as sourceRef / actInstanceId.
 */
export async function applyConversationalAuthority(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  userMessageId: string;
  content: string;
  clientTurnKey: string;
  /**
   * SEM/TV-02: semantic qualification from Nora (correlated to USER message).
   * When omitted, do NOT fall back to lexical qualifyPilotageIntent — fail closed.
   */
  preQualified?: IntentQualification | null;
}): Promise<ConversationalAuthorityOutcome> {
  const content = input.content.trim();
  const clientCommandKey = conversationalCommandKey(input.clientTurnKey);
  const empty: ConversationalAuthorityOutcome = {
    attempted: false,
    intentClarity: "NONE",
    command: null,
    humanDecisionCreated: false,
    decisionId: null,
    source: "none",
    clientCommandKey,
  };
  if (!content || !input.projectId || !input.userMessageId) return empty;

  // C02 — if this turn key already produced a durable command, return it (no second effect).
  const prior = await reconstituteConversationalAuthority({
    pilotId: input.pilotId,
    projectId: input.projectId,
    clientTurnKey: input.clientTurnKey,
    userMessageId: input.userMessageId,
  });
  if (prior?.attempted && prior.command) {
    return prior;
  }

  const qualified: IntentQualification =
    input.preQualified ??
    ({
      clarity: "NONE",
      reason: "NO_SEMANTIC_PILOTAGE_QUALIFICATION",
    } as IntentQualification);
  // Lexical qualifyPilotageIntent removed from this production path (SEM-02 / TV-05).
  if (qualified.clarity === "NONE") {
    return { ...empty, intentClarity: "NONE", intentReason: qualified.reason };
  }
  if (qualified.clarity === "AMBIGUOUS") {
    return {
      ...empty,
      intentClarity: "AMBIGUOUS",
      intentReason: qualified.reason,
      clarification: qualified.reason,
      source: "clarification_only",
    };
  }

  const projection = await getPilotageProjection(input.pilotId, input.projectId);
  const base: PilotageRequestBody = {
    clientCommandKey,
    expectedRevision: projection.revision,
    sourceKind: "USER_MESSAGE",
    sourceRef: input.userMessageId,
    utterance: content,
    // Server-derived act identity — ignore any client-supplied actInstanceId.
    actInstanceId: qualified.semanticIntentId
      ? `${input.userMessageId}:${qualified.semanticIntentId}`
      : input.userMessageId,
    operation: qualified.operation,
    semanticIntentId: qualified.semanticIntentId,
    semanticSchemaVersion: qualified.semanticSchemaVersion,
    cycleType: qualified.cycleType,
    toCycleType: qualified.toCycleType,
    methodRef: qualified.methodRef,
    methodVersion: qualified.methodVersion,
    decisionId: qualified.decisionId,
    objectRef: qualified.objectRef,
    // Statement only for documentary D6 — never echo full utterance as statement on D5 opens.
    statement:
      qualified.operation === "RECORD_DECISION" || qualified.operation === "REVISE_DECISION"
        ? qualified.statement
        : undefined,
  };

  if (qualified.operation === "REVISE_DECISION") {
    // Same owner resolver as classifyCommand — unique durable target only.
    const statement =
      (qualified.statement ?? "").trim() || content.replace(/^(?:finalement|désormais|dorénavant)[,:]?\s+/i, "").trim();
    const resolved = await resolveReviseDecisionTarget(db, input.projectId, {
      decisionId: qualified.decisionId,
      objectRef: qualified.objectRef,
    });
    if (!resolved.ok) {
      return {
        attempted: false,
        intentClarity: "AMBIGUOUS",
        intentReason: resolved.reason,
        command: null,
        humanDecisionCreated: false,
        decisionId: null,
        clarification: resolved.reason,
        source: "clarification_only",
        operation: "REVISE_DECISION",
        clientCommandKey,
      };
    }
    const command = await executePilotageCommand(input.pilotId, input.projectId, {
      ...base,
      operation: "REVISE_DECISION",
      decisionId: resolved.id,
      statement: statement.slice(0, 500),
      objectRef: qualified.objectRef,
    });
    return outcomeFromCommand(command, "REVISE_DECISION", clientCommandKey);
  }

  if (qualified.operation === "RECORD_DECISION") {
    const command = await executePilotageCommand(input.pilotId, input.projectId, {
      ...base,
      operation: "RECORD_DECISION",
      statement: qualified.statement ?? qualified.objective ?? content,
      objectRef: qualified.objectRef,
      objective: qualified.objective,
    });
    return outcomeFromCommand(command, "RECORD_DECISION", clientCommandKey);
  }

  /** C06 — same owner LIFT resolver as classifyCommand (unique ACTIVE target). */
  if (qualified.operation === "LIFT_RESTRICTION") {
    const resolved = await resolveLiftRestrictionTarget(db, input.projectId, {
      restrictionKindHint: qualified.restrictionKindHint,
      restrictionTargetRefHint: qualified.restrictionTargetRefHint,
      activeCycle: projection.cycle
        ? { id: projection.cycle.id, cycleType: projection.cycle.cycleType }
        : null,
    });
    if (!resolved.ok) {
      return {
        attempted: false,
        intentClarity: "AMBIGUOUS",
        intentReason: resolved.reason,
        command: null,
        humanDecisionCreated: false,
        decisionId: null,
        clarification: resolved.reason,
        source: "clarification_only",
        operation: "LIFT_RESTRICTION",
        clientCommandKey,
      };
    }
    const command = await executePilotageCommand(input.pilotId, input.projectId, {
      ...base,
      operation: "LIFT_RESTRICTION",
      restrictionId: resolved.id,
    });
    return outcomeFromCommand(command, "LIFT_RESTRICTION", clientCommandKey);
  }

  // FIX-08 — RETAIN: do not send orientation/trajectoryRevisionId on USER_MESSAGE body
  // (SEM rejects client-supplied D5 targets). mutateCommand resolves current PROPOSED.
  if (qualified.operation === "RETAIN_TRAJECTORY") {
    if (!projection.trajectory.proposed?.id) {
      return {
        ...empty,
        attempted: false,
        intentClarity: "AMBIGUOUS",
        intentReason: "Aucune trajectoire PROPOSED à retenir",
        clarification: "Aucune trajectoire proposée n'est disponible à retenir.",
        source: "clarification_only",
        operation: "RETAIN_TRAJECTORY",
      };
    }
    const command = await executePilotageCommand(input.pilotId, input.projectId, {
      ...base,
      operation: "RETAIN_TRAJECTORY",
      objective: qualified.objective,
    });
    return outcomeFromCommand(command, "RETAIN_TRAJECTORY", clientCommandKey);
  }

  const command = await executePilotageCommand(input.pilotId, input.projectId, {
    ...base,
    operation: qualified.operation,
    cycleType: qualified.cycleType,
    toCycleType: qualified.toCycleType,
    methodRef: qualified.methodRef,
    methodVersion: qualified.methodVersion,
    objective: qualified.objective,
  });
  return outcomeFromCommand(command, qualified.operation, clientCommandKey);
}

import { newId } from "@/lib/ids";

/** Lease duration for exclusive DISPATCHED ownership (local fencing, not exactly-once remote). */
export const CLAIM_LEASE_MS = 60_000;

export type EffectClaim = {
  claimToken: string;
  claimedAt: string;
  leaseExpiresAt: string;
  generation: number;
  /** Set when the owning execution releases the claim (completion / controlled abandon). */
  releasedAt?: string | null;
};

export function readClaim(resultJson: string | null | undefined): EffectClaim | null {
  try {
    const j = JSON.parse(resultJson || "{}") as { claim?: EffectClaim };
    const c = j.claim;
    if (!c || typeof c.claimToken !== "string" || typeof c.leaseExpiresAt !== "string") return null;
    return {
      claimToken: c.claimToken,
      claimedAt: c.claimedAt,
      leaseExpiresAt: c.leaseExpiresAt,
      generation: typeof c.generation === "number" ? c.generation : 0,
      releasedAt: c.releasedAt ?? null,
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function isClaimActive(claim: EffectClaim | null, nowMs = Date.now()): boolean {
  if (!claim) return false;
  if (claim.releasedAt) return false;
  const exp = Date.parse(claim.leaseExpiresAt);
  if (Number.isNaN(exp)) return false;
  return exp > nowMs;
}

export function mintClaim(prev: EffectClaim | null, now = new Date()): EffectClaim {
  return {
    claimToken: newId("claim"),
    claimedAt: now.toISOString(),
    leaseExpiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + CLAIM_LEASE_MS).toISOString(),
    generation: (prev?.generation ?? 0) + 1,
    releasedAt: null,
  };
}

export function releaseClaim(claim: EffectClaim | null, now = new Date()): EffectClaim | null {
  if (!claim) return null;
  return { ...claim, releasedAt: now.toISOString() };
}

/** Controlled lease renewal for a still-owning execution (memory helper; persist via SQL fence). */
export function extendClaim(claim: EffectClaim, now = new Date()): EffectClaim {
  return {
    ...claim,
    leaseExpiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + CLAIM_LEASE_MS).toISOString(),
    releasedAt: null,
  };
}

export function writeClaimInto(
  existingResultJson: string,
  claim: EffectClaim | null,
): string {
  let base: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  try {
    base = JSON.parse(existingResultJson || "{}") as Record<string, unknown>;
  } catch {
    base = {};
  }
  if (!claim) {
    const { claim: _drop, ...rest } = base;
    void _drop;
    return JSON.stringify(rest);
  }
  return JSON.stringify({ ...base, claim });
}

/**
 * Test-only deterministic barrier between effect steps.
 * Production keeps this disabled — no external coupling.
 */
type Deferred = { promise: Promise<void>; resolve: () => void };

class ExecutionBarrierRegistryImpl {
  enabled = false;
  private gates = new Map<string, Deferred>();

  arm(step: string) {
    let resolve!: () => void;
    const promise = new Promise<void>((r) => {
      resolve = r;
    });
    this.gates.set(step, { promise, resolve });
    this.enabled = true;
  }

  async before(step: string) {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    const g = this.gates.get(step);
    if (g) await g.promise;
  }

  release(step: string) {
    const g = this.gates.get(step);
    if (g) {
      g.resolve();
      this.gates.delete(step);
    }
    if (this.gates.size === 0) this.enabled = false;
  }

  clear() {
    for (const g of this.gates.values()) g.resolve();
    this.gates.clear();
    this.enabled = false;
  }
}

export const ExecutionBarrierRegistry = new ExecutionBarrierRegistryImpl();

function planFingerprintPayload(plan: CursorExecutionPlan): string {
  return JSON.stringify({
    kind: plan.kind,

    contractFingerprint: plan.contractFingerprint,
