```typescript
    workspaceCwd: plan.workspaceCwd,
    workspaceKey: plan.workspaceKey ?? null,
    effectProviderMode: plan.effectProviderMode,
    gitScope: plan.gitScope ?? null,
    mcpRequired: [...(plan.mcpRequired ?? [])].sort(),
  });
}

export async function prepareCursorExecution(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  contractId: string;
  correlationKey: string;
  /** Server-side key only — never an absolute client path. */
  workspaceKey?: string | null;
  /** Legacy client field — absolute paths are rejected. */
  workspaceCwd?: string | null;
  mcpRequired?: string[];
}) {
  await assertProject(input.pilotId, input.projectId);

  const contract = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(technicalContracts)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(technicalContracts.id, input.contractId),
          eq(technicalContracts.projectId, input.projectId),
          eq(technicalContracts.pilotId, input.pilotId),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!contract) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Contrat technique introuvable");
  if (contract.status !== "READY") {
    throw new StudioError(
      "INVALID_REQUEST",
      `Contrat non prêt pour tentative: ${contract.status}`,
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }

  const workspace = resolveCursorWorkspace({
    pilotId: input.pilotId,
    projectId: input.projectId,
    workspaceKey: input.workspaceKey,
    clientDeclaredCwd: input.workspaceCwd,
    ensureDir: true,
  });

  const prior = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(effectAttempts)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(effectAttempts.pilotId, input.pilotId),
          eq(effectAttempts.projectId, input.projectId),
          eq(effectAttempts.correlationKey, input.correlationKey),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];

  const mode = resolveCursorAdapterMode();
  const gitScope = contract.gitScopeJson
    ? (JSON.parse(contract.gitScopeJson) as CursorExecutionPlan["gitScope"])
    : null;
  // DÉC-ML5-GIT Option A — CP-01 independent Git observations (never contract SHA echo).
  if (gitScope?.required) {
    const {
      buildCursorGitMandateFromScope,
      observeWorkspaceGitFacts,
      preflightCursorGitOptionA,
    } = await import("./cursor-git-option-a");
    const mandate = buildCursorGitMandateFromScope(gitScope);
    const authorized =
      process.env.SFIA_CURSOR_GIT_AUTHORIZED_REPOS?.split(",")
        .map((s) => s.trim())
        .filter(Boolean) ?? [];
    // DEV SCRIPTED: allow the declared repo name when authorized list empty and mode SCRIPTED.
    const repos =
      authorized.length > 0
        ? authorized
        : mode === "SCRIPTED" && gitScope.repositoryFullName
          ? [gitScope.repositoryFullName]
          : [];
    const observations = observeWorkspaceGitFacts(
      workspace.workspaceCwd,
      gitScope.baseRef ?? "main",
      gitScope.workBranch ?? "cursor/work",
    );
    const pre = preflightCursorGitOptionA({
      mandate,
      workspacePath: workspace.workspaceCwd,
      authorizedRepos: repos,
      observations,
    });
    if (!pre.ok) {
      throw new StudioError(
        "INVALID_REQUEST",
        `Préflight Git Cursor option A refusé: ${pre.reason}`,
        { exposeMessage: true },
      );
    }
  }
  // E12 / C8 A3 — MCP fail-closed: UNKNOWN blocks; SCRIPTED may simulate explicitly.
  const mcpRequired = input.mcpRequired ?? [];
  if (mcpRequired.length > 0) {
    const { assertMcpReadyForDispatch, checkRequiredMcpCapabilities } = await import(
      "./mcp-capability-check"
    );
    const scriptedSimulation = mode === "SCRIPTED";
    const mcpResults = checkRequiredMcpCapabilities(mcpRequired, process.env, {
      scriptedSimulation,
    });
    const mcpGate = assertMcpReadyForDispatch(mcpResults, {
      allowScriptedSimulation: scriptedSimulation,
    });
    if (!mcpGate.ok) {
      throw new StudioError(
        "INVALID_REQUEST",
        `Préflight MCP refusé: ${mcpGate.reason}`,
        { exposeMessage: true },
      );
    }
  }
  const modelId = (process.env.SFIA_CURSOR_MODEL_ID || "").trim() || undefined;
  const plan: CursorExecutionPlan = {
    kind: "CURSOR_EXECUTION",
    contractId: contract.id,
    contractKey: contract.contractKey,
    contractVersion: contract.version,
    contractFingerprint: contract.fingerprint,
    instructionFingerprint: instructionFingerprint(contract.instructionText),
    workspaceCwd: workspace.workspaceCwd,
    workspaceKey: workspace.workspaceKey,
    effectProviderMode: mode,
    ...(modelId ? { modelId } : {}),
    gitScope,
    mcpRequired,
  };
  const fingerprint = contract.fingerprint;
  const planFp = planFingerprintPayload(plan);

  if (prior) {
    if (prior.kind !== "CURSOR_EXECUTION") {
      throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", "correlationKey déjà utilisé par un autre kind");
    }
    if (prior.fingerprint !== fingerprint) {
      throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", "PAYLOAD_MISMATCH pour correlationKey", {
        exposeMessage: true,
      });
    }
    const priorPlan = JSON.parse(prior.planJson) as CursorExecutionPlan;
    if (planFingerprintPayload(priorPlan) !== planFp) {
      throw new StudioError(
        "CONFLICT",
        "PAYLOAD_MISMATCH — même correlationKey, cible/workspace/capacités différents",
        { exposeMessage: true },
      );
    }
    return {
      attemptId: prior.id,
      status: prior.status,
      idempotent: true as const,
      fingerprint: prior.fingerprint,
      plan: priorPlan,
    };
  }

  const attemptId = newId("efx");
  const now = new Date();
  await db.insert(effectAttempts).values({
    id: attemptId,
    pilotId: input.pilotId,
    projectId: input.projectId,
    kind: "CURSOR_EXECUTION",
    status: "PREPARED",
    correlationKey: input.correlationKey,
    fingerprint,
    planJson: JSON.stringify(plan),
    resultJson: JSON.stringify({ reportStatus: "EXPECTED" } satisfies CursorLiveProjection),
    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now,
  });

  return {
    attemptId,
    status: "PREPARED" as const,
    idempotent: false as const,
    fingerprint,
    plan,
  };
}

/**
 * Authenticated D6 Non — records an explicit HumanDecision refusal.
 * No AUTHORIZED transition, no dispatch, no Cursor effect.
 * Attempt moves PREPARED → CANCELLED (still the same attemptId).
 */
export async function refuseCursorExecution(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  attemptId: string;
  statement: string;
  inspectedFingerprint: string;
}) {
  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const row = (
      await tx
        .select()
        .from(effectAttempts)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(effectAttempts.id, input.attemptId),
            eq(effectAttempts.projectId, input.projectId),
            eq(effectAttempts.pilotId, input.pilotId),
          ),
        )
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    if (!row) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Tentative introuvable");
    if (row.kind !== "CURSOR_EXECUTION") {
      throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "Tentative non Cursor");
    }
    if (row.status === "CANCELLED" && row.decisionId) {
      return {
        attemptId: row.id,
        status: "CANCELLED" as const,
        decisionId: row.decisionId,
        idempotent: true as const,
        fingerprint: row.fingerprint,
        refused: true as const,
      };
    }
    if (row.status !== "PREPARED") {
      throw new StudioError(
        "CONFLICT",
        `Refus D6 impossible depuis statut ${row.status}`,
        { exposeMessage: true },
      );
    }
    if (input.inspectedFingerprint !== row.fingerprint) {
      throw new StudioError(
        "REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION",
        "Empreinte inspectée ≠ tentative — relire le contrat",
        { exposeMessage: true },
      );
    }
    const effectConditions = JSON.stringify({
      fingerprint: row.fingerprint,
      kind: "CURSOR_EXECUTION_REFUSAL",
      attemptId: row.id,
    });
    const decisionId = await insertHumanDecision(tx, {
      projectId: input.projectId,
      pilotId: input.pilotId,
      sourceKind: "CURSOR_EXECUTION",
      sourceRef: row.id,
      kind: "CURSOR_EXECUTION_REFUSAL",
      objectRef: row.id,
      statement: (input.statement || "Refus explicite D6 — pas d'exécution Cursor").slice(0, 500),
      effectConditions,
    });
    const now = new Date();
    await tx
      .update(effectAttempts)
      .set({
        status: "CANCELLED",
        decisionId,
        effectConditions,
        updatedAt: now,
      })
      .where(eq(effectAttempts.id, row.id));
    return {
      attemptId: row.id,
      status: "CANCELLED" as const,
      decisionId,
      idempotent: false as const,
      fingerprint: row.fingerprint,
      refused: true as const,
    };
  });
}

export async function authorizeCursorExecution(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  attemptId: string;
  statement: string;
  inspectedFingerprint: string;
  /** Explicit confirmation — required. */
  confirmed: boolean;
}) {
  if (!input.confirmed) {
    return refuseCursorExecution({
      pilotId: input.pilotId,
      projectId: input.projectId,
      attemptId: input.attemptId,
      statement: input.statement,
      inspectedFingerprint: input.inspectedFingerprint,
    });
  }
  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const row = (
      await tx
        .select()
        .from(effectAttempts)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(effectAttempts.id, input.attemptId),
            eq(effectAttempts.projectId, input.projectId),
            eq(effectAttempts.pilotId, input.pilotId),
          ),
        )
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    if (!row) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Tentative introuvable");
    if (row.kind !== "CURSOR_EXECUTION") {
      throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "Tentative non Cursor");
    }
    if (row.status !== "PREPARED" && row.status !== "AUTHORIZED") {
      throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", `Statut non autorisable: ${row.status}`);
    }
    if (input.inspectedFingerprint !== row.fingerprint) {
      throw new StudioError(
        "REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION",
        "Empreinte inspectée ≠ tentative — relire le contrat",
        { exposeMessage: true },
      );
    }

    const contract = (
      await tx
        .select()
        .from(technicalContracts)
        .where(eq(technicalContracts.id, (JSON.parse(row.planJson) as CursorExecutionPlan).contractId))
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    if (!contract || contract.status !== "READY") {
      throw new StudioError("REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION", "Contrat non READY au moment D6");
    }
    if (contract.fingerprint !== row.fingerprint) {
      throw new StudioError("REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION", "Contrat divergé depuis prepare");
    }

    if (row.status === "AUTHORIZED" && row.decisionId) {
      return {
        attemptId: row.id,
        status: "AUTHORIZED" as const,
        decisionId: row.decisionId,
        idempotent: true as const,
        fingerprint: row.fingerprint,
      };
    }

    const effectConditions = JSON.stringify({
      fingerprint: row.fingerprint,
      kind: "CURSOR_EXECUTION_MANDATE",
      attemptId: row.id,
    });
    const decisionId = await insertHumanDecision(tx, {
      projectId: input.projectId,
      pilotId: input.pilotId,
      sourceKind: "CURSOR_EXECUTION",
      sourceRef: row.id,
      kind: "CURSOR_EXECUTION_MANDATE",
      objectRef: row.id,
      statement: input.statement.slice(0, 500),
      effectConditions,
    });

    const now = new Date();
    await tx
      .update(effectAttempts)
      .set({
        status: "AUTHORIZED",
        decisionId,
        effectConditions,
        updatedAt: now,
      })
      .where(eq(effectAttempts.id, row.id));

    return {
      attemptId: row.id,
      status: "AUTHORIZED" as const,
      decisionId,
      idempotent: false as const,
      fingerprint: row.fingerprint,
    };
  });
}

export async function dispatchCursorExecution(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  attemptId: string;
}) {
  const row = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(effectAttempts)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(effectAttempts.id, input.attemptId),
          eq(effectAttempts.projectId, input.projectId),
          eq(effectAttempts.pilotId, input.pilotId),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!row) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Tentative introuvable");
  if (row.kind !== "CURSOR_EXECUTION") {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "Tentative non Cursor");
  }

  const live = parseLive(row.resultJson);

  // Terminal / in-flight: never blind redispatches.
  if (row.status === "DISPATCHED") {
    throw new StudioError(
      "CONFLICT",
      "Exécution déjà DISPATCHED — reconcile puis reprise contrôlée (AMBIGUOUS) requise",
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }
  if (row.status === "COMPLETED" || row.status === "FAILED" || row.status === "CONFLICT") {
    return {
      attemptId: row.id,
      status: row.status,
      idempotent: true as const,
      live,
      limits: ["NO_BLIND_REDISPATCH", ...(live.limits ?? [])],
    };
  }
  if (row.status !== "AUTHORIZED" && row.status !== "AMBIGUOUS") {
    throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", `Dispatch refusé depuis statut ${row.status}`, {
      exposeMessage: true,
    });
  }

  await assertCurrentCursorAuthority({
    pilotId: input.pilotId,
    projectId: input.projectId,
    decisionId: row.decisionId,
    attemptId: row.id,
    fingerprint: row.fingerprint,
    effectConditionsFingerprint: row.effectConditions
      ? (JSON.parse(row.effectConditions) as { fingerprint?: string }).fingerprint ?? null
      : null,
  });

  const plan = JSON.parse(row.planJson) as CursorExecutionPlan;
  if (plan.contractFingerprint !== row.fingerprint) {
    throw new StudioError("REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION", "Plan ≠ fingerprint tentative");
  }

  // Re-resolve workspace — refuse if confinement broken since prepare.
  const workspace = resolveCursorWorkspace({
    pilotId: input.pilotId,
    projectId: input.projectId,
    workspaceKey: plan.workspaceKey ?? "default",
    ensureDir: true,
  });
  if (workspace.workspaceCwd !== plan.workspaceCwd) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION",
      "Workspace résolu ≠ plan préparé — nouvel acte requis",
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }

  const contract = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(technicalContracts)
      .where(eq(technicalContracts.id, plan.contractId))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!contract) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Contrat disparu");
  if (contract.fingerprint !== row.fingerprint || contract.status !== "READY") {
    throw new StudioError(
      "REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION",
      "Contrat modifié ou non READY depuis l'autorisation",
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }

  const fromStatus = row.status as "AUTHORIZED" | "AMBIGUOUS";
  if (fromStatus === "AMBIGUOUS") {
    const { priorSendMayHaveOccurred } = await import("./cursor-claim");
    if (priorSendMayHaveOccurred(row.resultJson)) {
      throw new StudioError(
        "CONFLICT",
        "AMBIGUOUS avec envoi antérieur possible — pas de redispatch ; réconcilier ou conserver UNKNOWN",
        { exposeMessage: true },
      );
    }
  }
  // P0: claim + sendRequestedAt in one durable write BEFORE any external SDK call.
  // Crash between this point and SDK ⇒ priorSendMayHaveOccurred ⇒ no blind redispatch.
  const claimed = await claimCursorAttempt(row.id, fromStatus, { stampSendIntent: true });
  if (!claimed) {
    const again = (
      await db.select().from(effectAttempts).where(eq(effectAttempts.id, row.id)).limit(1)
    )[0];
    if (again?.status === "DISPATCHED") {
      throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", "Claim concurrent — un seul dispatch", {
        exposeMessage: true,
      });
    }
    const { priorSendMayHaveOccurred } = await import("./cursor-claim");
    if (fromStatus === "AMBIGUOUS" && priorSendMayHaveOccurred(again?.resultJson)) {
      throw new StudioError(
        "CONFLICT",
        "Claim refusé — effet externe possible après ACK perdu ; pas de second envoi",
        { exposeMessage: true },
      );
    }
    throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", "Claim atomique échoué — pas de dispatch", {
      exposeMessage: true,
    });
  }

  const claimToken = claimed.claim.claimToken;
  const sendRequestedAt =
    claimed.sendRequestedAt ?? new Date().toISOString();

  let dispatched;
  try {
    const { isScriptedPhasedMode } = await import("./cursor-sdk-adapter");
    const scriptedPhased =
      plan.effectProviderMode === "SCRIPTED" && isScriptedPhasedMode();
    const liveWait =
      plan.effectProviderMode === "LIVE" &&
      (process.env.SFIA_CURSOR_LIVE_WAIT || "").trim() === "1";
    dispatched = await dispatchCursorRun({
      attemptId: row.id,
      instructionText: contract.instructionText,
      instructionFingerprint: plan.instructionFingerprint,
      workspaceCwd: plan.workspaceCwd,
      idempotencyKey: row.id,
      modelId: plan.modelId,
      /**
       * LIVE default: return after ACK — reconcile observes terminal without resend.
       * SFIA_CURSOR_LIVE_WAIT=1: block until terminal (DEV worker-style, C11).
       * SCRIPTED default: finish immediately unless SFIA_CURSOR_SCRIPTED_PHASED=1.
       */
      waitForTerminal:
        liveWait || (plan.effectProviderMode === "SCRIPTED" && !scriptedPhased),
    });
  } catch (e) {
    const failLive: CursorLiveProjection = {
      ...live,
      sendRequestedAt,
      terminalStatus: "unknown",
      limits: ["DISPATCH_SEND_FAILED", String((e as Error)?.message ?? "error").slice(0, 120)],
    };
    await persistCursorOwnedResult({
      attemptId: row.id,
      claimToken,
      resultJson: JSON.stringify(failLive),
      status: "AMBIGUOUS",
      release: true,
    });
    throw e;
  }

  const nextLive: CursorLiveProjection = {
    sendRequestedAt: dispatched.sendRequestedAt ?? sendRequestedAt,
    ackReceivedAt: dispatched.ackReceivedAt,
    runObservedAt: dispatched.runObservedAt,
    agentId: dispatched.agentId,
    runId: dispatched.runId,
    lastActivitySummary: dispatched.lastActivitySummary,
    terminalStatus: dispatched.terminalStatus,
    reportStatus: "EXPECTED",
    limits: dispatched.limits,
  };

  const terminal =
    dispatched.terminalStatus === "finished" ||
    dispatched.terminalStatus === "error" ||
    dispatched.terminalStatus === "cancelled";

  await persistCursorOwnedResult({
    attemptId: row.id,
    claimToken,
    resultJson: JSON.stringify(nextLive),
    status: terminal ? "COMPLETED" : "DISPATCHED",
    release: terminal,
  });

  // C13 — durable observation independent of browser/HTTP when LIVE ACK returns early.
  // Observation only (reconcile); never a second send.
  if (
    !terminal &&
    plan.effectProviderMode === "LIVE" &&
    nextLive.runId
  ) {
    try {
      const { ensureCursorLiveSupervisor } = await import(
        "./cursor-live-supervisor"
      );
      ensureCursorLiveSupervisor({
        pilotId: input.pilotId,
        projectId: input.projectId,
        attemptId: row.id,
      });
    } catch {
      /* supervisor start must not fail dispatch ACK */
    }
  }

  return {
    attemptId: row.id,
    status: terminal ? ("COMPLETED" as const) : ("DISPATCHED" as const),
    idempotent: false as const,
    live: nextLive,
    scriptedReportMarkdown: dispatched.resultText,
    limits: dispatched.limits,
    claimToken,
  };
}

export async function requestStopCursorExecution(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  attemptId: string;
}) {
  const row = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(effectAttempts)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(effectAttempts.id, input.attemptId),
          eq(effectAttempts.projectId, input.projectId),
          eq(effectAttempts.pilotId, input.pilotId),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!row) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Tentative introuvable");
  const live = parseLive(row.resultJson);
  const plan = JSON.parse(row.planJson) as CursorExecutionPlan;
  const stop = await stopCursorRun({
    attemptId: row.id,
    agentId: live.agentId ?? null,
    runId: live.runId ?? null,
    workspaceCwd: plan.workspaceCwd,
    mode: plan.effectProviderMode,
  });
  const nextLive: CursorLiveProjection = {
    ...live,
    stopRequestedAt: stop.stopRequestedAt,
    stopObservedAt: stop.stopObservedAt,
    terminalStatus: stop.stopObservedAt
      ? stop.terminalStatus ?? live.terminalStatus
      : live.terminalStatus ?? "unknown",
    limits: [
      ...(live.limits ?? []),
      ...stop.limits,
      stop.stopObservedAt ? "STOP_OBSERVED" : "STOP_REQUESTED_NOT_CONFIRMED",
    ],
  };
  // STOP requested ≠ STOP observed. If uncertain after possible effect → keep
  // DISPATCHED/AMBIGUOUS; never invent cancelled without observation.
  let nextStatus = row.status;
  if (stop.stopObservedAt && stop.terminalStatus === "cancelled") {
    nextStatus = "COMPLETED";
  } else if (
    !stop.stopObservedAt &&
    (live.agentId || live.runId || live.sendRequestedAt) &&
    row.status === "DISPATCHED"
  ) {
    nextLive.limits = [
      ...(nextLive.limits ?? []),
      "STOP_UNCERTAIN_AFTER_POSSIBLE_EFFECT — conserver DISPATCHED, pas de succès inventé",
    ];
  }
  await db
    .update(effectAttempts)
    .set({
      resultJson: JSON.stringify(nextLive),
      status: nextStatus,
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    })
    .where(eq(effectAttempts.id, row.id));
  return {
    attemptId: row.id,
    status: nextStatus,
    live: nextLive,
    limits: nextLive.limits ?? [],
    stopRequested: true as const,
    stopObserved: Boolean(stop.stopObservedAt),
  };
}

export async function reconcileCursorExecution(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  attemptId: string;
}) {
  try {
    const { ensureLiveSupervisorsResumedOnce } = await import(
      "./cursor-live-supervisor"
    );
    await ensureLiveSupervisorsResumedOnce();
  } catch {
    /* resume must not block reconcile */
  }

  const row = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(effectAttempts)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(effectAttempts.id, input.attemptId),
          eq(effectAttempts.projectId, input.projectId),
          eq(effectAttempts.pilotId, input.pilotId),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!row) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Tentative introuvable");
  const live = parseLive(row.resultJson);
  const claim = readClaim(row.resultJson);
  const limits = [...(live.limits ?? [])];
  const plan = JSON.parse(row.planJson) as CursorExecutionPlan;

  // Re-attach durable observer only for LIVE DISPATCHED with known run handle.
  if (
    row.status === "DISPATCHED" &&
    plan.effectProviderMode === "LIVE" &&
    live.runId
  ) {
    try {
      const { ensureCursorLiveSupervisor } = await import(
        "./cursor-live-supervisor"
      );
      ensureCursorLiveSupervisor({
        pilotId: input.pilotId,
        projectId: input.projectId,
        attemptId: input.attemptId,
      });
    } catch {
      /* ensure must not block reconcile */
    }
  }

  // SCRIPTED phased: advance in-memory run → COMPLETED without a second send.
  if (
    row.status === "DISPATCHED" &&
    plan.effectProviderMode === "SCRIPTED" &&
    !live.terminalStatus
  ) {
    const { advanceScriptedRunToFinished } = await import("./cursor-sdk-adapter");
    const advanced = advanceScriptedRunToFinished(row.id);
    if (advanced) {
      const nextLive: CursorLiveProjection = {
        ...live,
        agentId: advanced.agentId,
        runId: advanced.runId,
        terminalStatus: "finished",
        lastActivitySummary: advanced.lastActivitySummary,
        reportStatus: "RECEIVED",
        limits: [
          ...limits,
          "SCRIPTED_MODE",
          "SCRIPTED_PHASED_RECONCILED",
          "NO_REAL_SIDE_EFFECT",
        ],
      };
      if (claim && isClaimActive(claim)) {
        await persistCursorOwnedResult({
          attemptId: row.id,
          claimToken: claim.claimToken,
          resultJson: JSON.stringify({
            ...nextLive,
            reportMarkdown: advanced.resultText,
          }),
          status: "COMPLETED",
          release: true,
        });
      } else {
        await db
          .update(effectAttempts)
          .set({
            status: "COMPLETED",
            resultJson: JSON.stringify({
              ...nextLive,
              reportMarkdown: advanced.resultText,
            }),
            updatedAt: new Date(),
          })
          .where(eq(effectAttempts.id, row.id));
      }
      return {
        attemptId: row.id,
        status: "COMPLETED" as const,
        live: nextLive,
        limits: nextLive.limits ?? [],
        scriptedReportMarkdown: advanced.resultText,
      };
    }
  }

  // LIVE: observe existing run — never a second send.
  // "unknown" from a prior failed observe is NOT terminal — re-observe.
  const liveNeedsObserve =
    !live.terminalStatus || live.terminalStatus === "unknown";
  if (
    row.status === "DISPATCHED" &&
    plan.effectProviderMode === "LIVE" &&
    liveNeedsObserve &&
    live.runId
  ) {
    const { observeLiveCursorRun } = await import("./cursor-sdk-adapter");
    const observed = await observeLiveCursorRun({
      runId: live.runId,
      agentId: live.agentId,
      workspaceCwd: plan.workspaceCwd,
    });
    const nextLive: CursorLiveProjection = {
      ...live,
      terminalStatus: observed.terminalStatus ?? live.terminalStatus,
      lastActivitySummary:
        observed.lastActivitySummary ?? live.lastActivitySummary,
      reportStatus:
        observed.terminalStatus === "finished" ? "EXPECTED" : live.reportStatus,
      limits: [...new Set([...limits, ...(observed.limits ?? [])])],
    };
    const terminal =
      nextLive.terminalStatus === "finished" ||
      nextLive.terminalStatus === "error" ||
      nextLive.terminalStatus === "cancelled";
    if (terminal) {
      const payload = {
        ...nextLive,
        ...(observed.resultText
          ? { reportMarkdown: observed.resultText }
          : {}),
      };
      if (claim && isClaimActive(claim)) {
        await persistCursorOwnedResult({
          attemptId: row.id,
          claimToken: claim.claimToken,
          resultJson: JSON.stringify(payload),
          status: "COMPLETED",
          release: true,
        });
      } else {
        await db
          .update(effectAttempts)
          .set({
            status: "COMPLETED",
            resultJson: JSON.stringify(payload),
            updatedAt: new Date(),
          })
          .where(
            and(
              eq(effectAttempts.id, row.id),
              eq(effectAttempts.status, "DISPATCHED"),
            ),
          );
      }
      return {
        attemptId: row.id,
        status: "COMPLETED" as const,
        live: nextLive,
        limits: nextLive.limits ?? [],
        scriptedReportMarkdown: observed.resultText,
      };
    }
    // Non-terminal observation — persist activity, stay DISPATCHED.
    await db
      .update(effectAttempts)
      .set({
        resultJson: JSON.stringify(nextLive),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(
        and(
          eq(effectAttempts.id, row.id),
          eq(effectAttempts.status, "DISPATCHED"),
        ),
      );
    return {
      attemptId: row.id,
      status: "DISPATCHED" as const,
      live: nextLive,
      limits: nextLive.limits ?? [],
    };
  }

  if (row.status === "DISPATCHED" && !isClaimActive(claim)) {
    if (!live.runId && !live.agentId) {
      limits.push("ACK_OR_OWNERSHIP_LOST — état UNKNOWN, pas de redispatch aveugle");
      const nextLive: CursorLiveProjection = {
        ...live,
        terminalStatus: live.terminalStatus ?? "unknown",
        limits,
      };
      await db
        .update(effectAttempts)
        .set({
          status: "AMBIGUOUS",
          resultJson: JSON.stringify(nextLive),
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(and(eq(effectAttempts.id, row.id), eq(effectAttempts.status, "DISPATCHED")));
      return { attemptId: row.id, status: "AMBIGUOUS" as const, live: nextLive, limits };
    }
    limits.push("LEASE_INACTIVE_WITH_RUN_IDS — conserver DISPATCHED/UNKNOWN, pas de second send");
    return { attemptId: row.id, status: row.status, live, limits };
  }

  return { attemptId: row.id, status: row.status, live, limits };
}

export async function getCursorAttempt(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  attemptId: string;
}) {
  const row = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(effectAttempts)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(effectAttempts.id, input.attemptId),
          eq(effectAttempts.projectId, input.projectId),
          eq(effectAttempts.pilotId, input.pilotId),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!row) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Tentative introuvable");
  return {
    attemptId: row.id,
    kind: row.kind,
    status: row.status,
    fingerprint: row.fingerprint,
    decisionId: row.decisionId,
    correlationKey: row.correlationKey,
    plan: JSON.parse(row.planJson) as CursorExecutionPlan,
    live: parseLive(row.resultJson),
    createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

export async function listCursorAttempts(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
}) {
  await assertProject(input.pilotId, input.projectId);
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(effectAttempts)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(effectAttempts.pilotId, input.pilotId),
        eq(effectAttempts.projectId, input.projectId),
        eq(effectAttempts.kind, "CURSOR_EXECUTION"),
      ),
    );
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    attemptId: row.id,
    status: row.status,
    fingerprint: row.fingerprint,
    correlationKey: row.correlationKey,
    decisionId: row.decisionId,
    plan: JSON.parse(row.planJson) as CursorExecutionPlan,
    live: parseLive(row.resultJson),
    createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  }));
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Atomic Cursor attempt claim — mirrors Git publication fencing (P0-01).
 */

import { and, eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import { effectAttempts } from "@/db/schema";
import { StudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";
import {
  extendClaim,
  isClaimActive,
  mintClaim,
  readClaim,
  releaseClaim,
  writeClaimInto,
  type EffectClaim,
} from "./claim-lease";

function sqlClaimInactive() {
  return sql`(
    ${effectAttempts.resultJson}::jsonb->'claim' IS NULL
    OR NULLIF(${effectAttempts.resultJson}::jsonb->'claim'->>'releasedAt', '') IS NOT NULL
    OR (${effectAttempts.resultJson}::jsonb->'claim'->>'leaseExpiresAt')::timestamptz <= now()
  )`;
}

export function sqlCursorClaimTokenEquals(claimToken: string) {
  return sql`${effectAttempts.resultJson}::jsonb->'claim'->>'claimToken' = ${claimToken}`;
}

/**
 * Evidence that an external send may already have occurred.
 * Claim expiry alone never proves absence of effect (CF-03 / T-04).
 */
export function priorSendMayHaveOccurred(resultJson: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  try {
    const live = JSON.parse(resultJson || "{}") as {
      sendRequestedAt?: string | null;
      ackReceivedAt?: string | null;
      runObservedAt?: string | null;
      agentId?: string | null;
      runId?: string | null;
    };
    return Boolean(
      live.sendRequestedAt ||
        live.ackReceivedAt ||
        live.runObservedAt ||
        live.agentId ||
        live.runId,
    );
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * AUTHORIZED|AMBIGUOUS → DISPATCHED with claim minted in the same SQL predicate.
 * Concurrent callers: at most one wins (0 rows for the loser).
 *
 * When stampSendIntent is true (default for live dispatch), `sendRequestedAt` is
 * written in the same UPDATE as the claim — before any external SDK call.
 * Crash after claim / before SDK ⇒ priorSendMayHaveOccurred ⇒ no blind redispatch.
 *
 * AMBIGUOUS reclaim is refused when a prior send may have produced an effect —
 * expired lease ≠ proof of no side effect. Caller must reconcile / keep UNKNOWN.
 */
export async function claimCursorAttempt(
  attemptId: string,
  fromStatus: "AUTHORIZED" | "AMBIGUOUS",
  opts?: { stampSendIntent?: boolean },
): Promise<{ claim: EffectClaim; sendRequestedAt: string | null } | null> {
  const now = new Date();
  const stampSend = opts?.stampSendIntent !== false;
  const row = (
    await db.select().from(effectAttempts).where(eq(effectAttempts.id, attemptId)).limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!row || row.status !== fromStatus) return null;
  if (row.kind !== "CURSOR_EXECUTION") return null;
  const prev = readClaim(row.resultJson);
  if (fromStatus === "AMBIGUOUS") {
    if (isClaimActive(prev, now.getTime())) return null;
    // CF-03: never blind-redispatch after a possible external send.
    if (priorSendMayHaveOccurred(row.resultJson)) return null;
  }
  const claim = mintClaim(prev, now);
  let baseJson = row.resultJson || "{}";
  const sendRequestedAt = stampSend ? now.toISOString() : null;
  if (sendRequestedAt) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(baseJson) as Record<string, unknown>;
      // Do not overwrite an earlier sendRequestedAt.
      if (!parsed.sendRequestedAt) parsed.sendRequestedAt = sendRequestedAt;
      baseJson = JSON.stringify(parsed);
    } catch {
      baseJson = JSON.stringify({ sendRequestedAt });
    }
  }
  const nextJson = writeClaimInto(baseJson, claim);
  const where =
    fromStatus === "AMBIGUOUS"
      ? and(
          eq(effectAttempts.id, attemptId),
          eq(effectAttempts.status, fromStatus),
          eq(effectAttempts.kind, "CURSOR_EXECUTION"),
          sqlClaimInactive(),
          // SQL fence: refuse if any send/run identity already recorded.
          sql`(
            NULLIF(${effectAttempts.resultJson}::jsonb->>'sendRequestedAt', '') IS NULL
            AND NULLIF(${effectAttempts.resultJson}::jsonb->>'ackReceivedAt', '') IS NULL
            AND NULLIF(${effectAttempts.resultJson}::jsonb->>'runObservedAt', '') IS NULL
            AND NULLIF(${effectAttempts.resultJson}::jsonb->>'agentId', '') IS NULL
            AND NULLIF(${effectAttempts.resultJson}::jsonb->>'runId', '') IS NULL
          )`,
        )
      : and(
          eq(effectAttempts.id, attemptId),
          eq(effectAttempts.status, fromStatus),
          eq(effectAttempts.kind, "CURSOR_EXECUTION"),
        );
  const claimed = await db
    .update(effectAttempts)
    .set({ status: "DISPATCHED", resultJson: nextJson, updatedAt: now })
    .where(where)
    .returning({ id: effectAttempts.id });
  return claimed[0] ? { claim, sendRequestedAt } : null;
}

export async function persistCursorOwnedResult(input: {
  attemptId: string;
  claimToken: string;
  resultJson: string;
  status: "DISPATCHED" | "COMPLETED" | "AMBIGUOUS" | "FAILED";
  release?: boolean;
}): Promise<void> {
  const fresh = (
    await db.select().from(effectAttempts).where(eq(effectAttempts.id, input.attemptId)).limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!fresh || fresh.status !== "DISPATCHED") {
    throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", "DISPATCHED perdu — écriture refusée");
  }
  const claim = readClaim(fresh.resultJson);
  if (!claim || claim.claimToken !== input.claimToken || claim.releasedAt) {
    throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", "Claim fence invalide — écriture refusée");
  }
  const nextClaim = input.release ? releaseClaim(extendClaim(claim)) : extendClaim(claim);
  const nextJson = writeClaimInto(input.resultJson, nextClaim);
  const updated = await db
    .update(effectAttempts)
    .set({
      status: input.status,
      resultJson: nextJson,
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(effectAttempts.id, input.attemptId),
        eq(effectAttempts.status, "DISPATCHED"),
        sqlCursorClaimTokenEquals(input.claimToken),
      ),
    )
    .returning({ id: effectAttempts.id });
  if (!updated[0]) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "CONFLICT",
      "Progression refusée — claimToken non propriétaire (fencing SQL)",
    );
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import { effectAttempts, realizationHandoffs } from "@/db/schema";
import { StudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";
import { newId } from "@/lib/ids";
import {
  handoffIntegrityHash,
  inventoryComplete,
  type HandoffManifest,
} from "./handoff-integrity";
import type { CursorExecutionPlan, CursorLiveProjection } from "./types";

export type { HandoffManifest } from "./handoff-integrity";
export { handoffIntegrityHash } from "./handoff-integrity";

export type HandoffProvenance = {
  /** How Studio obtained the report — never inferred from hash alone. */
  acquisition: "CLIENT_DECLARED" | "SCRIPTED_ADAPTER" | "RUNTIME_COLLECTED" | "UNKNOWN";
  declaredExecutorId?: string | null;
  observedAgentId?: string | null;
  observedRunId?: string | null;
};

/**
 * Ingest a realization handoff bound to a Cursor attempt.
 * Hash proves content integrity for a binding — not authorship by Cursor.
 */
export async function ingestRealizationHandoff(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  attemptId: string;
  reportMarkdown: string;
  manifest: HandoffManifest;
  expectedContractFingerprint: string;
  provenance?: HandoffProvenance;
}) {
  const row = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(effectAttempts)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(effectAttempts.id, input.attemptId),
          eq(effectAttempts.projectId, input.projectId),
          eq(effectAttempts.pilotId, input.pilotId),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!row) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Tentative introuvable");
  if (row.kind !== "CURSOR_EXECUTION") {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "Handoff réservé aux tentatives Cursor");
  }

  // Restrict ingestion by attempt state — refuse PREPARED / AUTHORIZED without dispatch evidence.
  const allowedStatuses = new Set(["DISPATCHED", "COMPLETED", "AMBIGUOUS", "FAILED"]);
  if (!allowedStatuses.has(row.status)) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "CONFLICT",
      `Handoff refusé depuis statut ${row.status} — tentative non exécutée ou non réconciliable`,
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }

  const plan = JSON.parse(row.planJson) as CursorExecutionPlan;
  if (input.expectedContractFingerprint !== plan.contractFingerprint) {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "Handoff fingerprint contrat incompatible", {
      exposeMessage: true,
    });
  }
  if (input.expectedContractFingerprint !== row.fingerprint) {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "Handoff ≠ empreinte tentative", {
      exposeMessage: true,
    });
  }

  let live: CursorLiveProjection = {};
  try {
    live = JSON.parse(row.resultJson || "{}") as CursorLiveProjection;
  } catch {
    live = {};
  }

  const provenance: HandoffProvenance = input.provenance ?? {
    acquisition: "CLIENT_DECLARED",
  };
  const limits: string[] = [];

  // Bind to observed executor identities when present.
  if (live.agentId && provenance.declaredExecutorId && provenance.declaredExecutorId !== live.agentId) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "INVALID_REQUEST",
      "Exécuteur déclaré ≠ agent observé — provenance refusée",
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }
  if (live.runId && provenance.observedRunId && provenance.observedRunId !== live.runId) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "INVALID_REQUEST",
      "runId déclaré ≠ run observé — provenance refusée",
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }
  if (provenance.acquisition === "CLIENT_DECLARED") {
    limits.push("PROVENANCE_CLIENT_DECLARED — hash ≠ preuve d'auteur Cursor");
  }
  if (provenance.acquisition === "SCRIPTED_ADAPTER") {
    limits.push("PROVENANCE_SCRIPTED — pas une preuve LIVE");
  }
  if (!live.agentId && !live.runId && provenance.acquisition !== "SCRIPTED_ADAPTER") {
    limits.push("NO_OBSERVED_RUN_IDENTITY — rapport non rattaché à un run observé");
  }

  const existing = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(realizationHandoffs)
      .where(eq(realizationHandoffs.attemptId, row.id))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (existing) {
    throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", "Handoff déjà lié à cette tentative — immuable", {
      exposeMessage: true,
    });
  }

  const report = input.reportMarkdown ?? "";
  let status: "RECEIVED" | "INCOMPLETE" | "REJECTED" = "RECEIVED";
  if (!report.trim()) {
    status = "INCOMPLETE";
    limits.push("REPORT_EMPTY");
  }
  // C13 — early handoff before terminal observation stays honest (INCOMPLETE).
  if (
    row.status === "DISPATCHED" &&
    (!live.terminalStatus || live.terminalStatus === "unknown")
  ) {
    status = "INCOMPLETE";
    limits.push("EARLY_HANDOFF_BEFORE_TERMINAL_OBSERVATION");
  }
  // Long but incomplete inventory cannot succeed.
  if (!inventoryComplete(input.manifest)) {
    status = "INCOMPLETE";
    limits.push("INVENTORY_INCOMPLETE");
    if (report.trim().length >= 200) {
      limits.push("LONG_REPORT_WITHOUT_COMPLETE_INVENTORY — succès refusé");
    }
  }
  // C13 — tests announced without captured output cannot imply verified execution.
  const testsDeclared = input.manifest.testsDeclared?.length ?? 0;
  const testsExecuted = input.manifest.testsExecuted?.length ?? 0;
  const testsCaptured = input.manifest.testsCaptured?.length ?? 0;
  if (testsDeclared + testsExecuted > 0 && testsCaptured === 0) {
    status = "INCOMPLETE";
    limits.push(
      "TESTS_DECLARED_WITHOUT_CAPTURED_OUTPUT — RESULT file ≠ verified unit test",
    );
  }
  if (report.includes("BEGIN PRIVATE KEY") || /\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}\b/.test(report)) {
    status = "REJECTED";
    limits.push("SECRET_MATERIAL_DETECTED");
  }
  // Hostile instruction markers in report body — treat as data, never authority.
  if (/ignore\s+previous\s+instructions/i.test(report) || /<\/?system>/i.test(report)) {
    limits.push("HOSTILE_CONTENT_MARKERS — rapport traité comme données non instructions");
  }

  const integrityHash = handoffIntegrityHash({
    attemptId: row.id,
    contractFingerprint: plan.contractFingerprint,
    reportMarkdown: report,
    manifest: input.manifest,
  });

  const id = newId("rhf");
  const now = new Date();
  const enrichedManifest = {
    ...input.manifest,
    _provenance: provenance,
    _observedAgentId: live.agentId ?? null,
    _observedRunId: live.runId ?? null,
  };

  await db.insert(realizationHandoffs).values({
    id,
    attemptId: row.id,
    projectId: input.projectId,
    pilotId: input.pilotId,
    contractId: plan.contractId,
    contractVersion: plan.contractVersion,
    contractFingerprint: plan.contractFingerprint,
    status,
    reportMarkdown: status === "REJECTED" ? null : report,
    manifestJson: JSON.stringify(enrichedManifest),
    integrityHash,
    sourceKind: provenance.acquisition === "SCRIPTED_ADAPTER" ? "SCRIPTED" : "CURSOR",
    limitsJson: JSON.stringify(limits),
    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now,
  });

  live.reportStatus =
    status === "RECEIVED" ? "RECEIVED" : status === "REJECTED" ? "REJECTED" : "INCOMPLETE";
  live.limits = [...(live.limits ?? []), ...limits];
  await db
    .update(effectAttempts)
    .set({ resultJson: JSON.stringify(live), updatedAt: now })
    .where(eq(effectAttempts.id, row.id));

  return {
    handoffId: id,
    attemptId: row.id,
    status,
    integrityHash,
    limits,
    provenance,
  };
}

export async function getRealizationHandoff(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  attemptId: string;
}) {
  const row = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(realizationHandoffs)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(realizationHandoffs.attemptId, input.attemptId),
          eq(realizationHandoffs.projectId, input.projectId),
          eq(realizationHandoffs.pilotId, input.pilotId),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!row) {
    return {
      status: "MISSING" as const,
      handoff: null,
      limits: ["REPORT_MISSING"],
    };
  }
  return {
    status: row.status,
    handoff: {
      id: row.id,
      attemptId: row.attemptId,
      contractId: row.contractId,
      contractVersion: row.contractVersion,
      contractFingerprint: row.contractFingerprint,
      status: row.status,
      reportMarkdown: row.reportMarkdown,
      manifest: JSON.parse(row.manifestJson || "{}") as HandoffManifest,
      integrityHash: row.integrityHash,
      limits: JSON.parse(row.limitsJson || "[]") as string[],
      createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
    },
    limits: JSON.parse(row.limitsJson || "[]") as string[],
  };
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * C13 — durable in-process observation for LIVE Cursor attempts.
 * Owner remains D7 (cursor-attempt-service). This is not a second orchestrator:
 * it only calls reconcileCursorExecution (observe / no resend) until terminal.
 *
 * Survives browser disconnect. Survives HTTP request end.
 * Process restart: call resumeDispatchedLiveSupervisors() (observation only).
 */

import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import { effectAttempts } from "@/db/schema";
import type { CursorExecutionPlan, CursorLiveProjection } from "./types";

export type LiveSupervisorHandle = {
  attemptId: string;
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  startedAt: string;
  ticks: number;
  stopped: boolean;
  stopReason?: string;
};

type SupervisorEntry = LiveSupervisorHandle & {
  timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null;
  runningTick: boolean;
};

type SupervisorGlobal = {
  __sfiaCursorLiveSupervisors?: Map<string, SupervisorEntry>;
  __sfiaCursorLiveSupervisorResumeOnce?: boolean;
};

const TICK_MS = 3_000;
const MAX_TICKS = 800; // ~40 min at 3s

function store(): Map<string, SupervisorEntry> {
  const g = globalThis as unknown as SupervisorGlobal;
  if (!g.__sfiaCursorLiveSupervisors) {
    g.__sfiaCursorLiveSupervisors = new Map();
  }
  return g.__sfiaCursorLiveSupervisors;
}

function parseLive(resultJson: string | null | undefined): CursorLiveProjection {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(resultJson || "{}") as CursorLiveProjection;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function isTerminalStatus(status: string, live: CursorLiveProjection): boolean {
  if (status === "COMPLETED" || status === "FAILED" || status === "AMBIGUOUS") {
    return true;
  }
  const t = live.terminalStatus;
  return t === "finished" || t === "error" || t === "cancelled";
}

async function tickOnce(entry: SupervisorEntry): Promise<void> {
  if (entry.stopped || entry.runningTick) return;
  entry.runningTick = true;
  entry.ticks += 1;
  try {
    const { reconcileCursorExecution } = await import("./cursor-attempt-service");
    const result = await reconcileCursorExecution({
      pilotId: entry.pilotId,
      projectId: entry.projectId,
      attemptId: entry.attemptId,
    });
    if (
      isTerminalStatus(result.status, result.live) ||
      entry.ticks >= MAX_TICKS
    ) {
      stopCursorLiveSupervisor(
        entry.attemptId,
        entry.ticks >= MAX_TICKS ? "MAX_TICKS" : "TERMINAL",
      );
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // Provider errors: keep supervising; annotate via reconcile path when possible.
    if (entry.ticks >= MAX_TICKS) {
      stopCursorLiveSupervisor(entry.attemptId, "MAX_TICKS_AFTER_ERROR");
    }
    void e;
  } finally {
    entry.runningTick = false;
  }
}

/**
 * Start (or no-op if already active) a durable observer for a LIVE DISPATCHED attempt.
 * Never sends a second Cursor dispatch.
 */
export function ensureCursorLiveSupervisor(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  attemptId: string;
}): { started: boolean; alreadyActive: boolean; handle: LiveSupervisorHandle } {
  const map = store();
  const existing = map.get(input.attemptId);
  if (existing && !existing.stopped) {
    return {
      started: false,
      alreadyActive: true,
      handle: {
        attemptId: existing.attemptId,
        pilotId: existing.pilotId,
        projectId: existing.projectId,
        startedAt: existing.startedAt,
        ticks: existing.ticks,
        stopped: existing.stopped,
        stopReason: existing.stopReason,
      },
    };
  }

  const entry: SupervisorEntry = {
    attemptId: input.attemptId,
    pilotId: input.pilotId,
    projectId: input.projectId,
    startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    ticks: 0,
    stopped: false,
    timer: null,
    runningTick: false,
  };
  map.set(input.attemptId, entry);

  // Immediate first tick (async) then interval — independent of HTTP/browser.
  void tickOnce(entry);
  entry.timer = setInterval(() => {
    void tickOnce(entry);
  }, TICK_MS);
  // Allow process to exit in tests if only timer remains (unref).
  if (typeof entry.timer === "object" && entry.timer && "unref" in entry.timer) {
    try {
      (entry.timer as NodeJS.Timeout).unref();
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }

  return {
    started: true,
    alreadyActive: false,
    handle: {
      attemptId: entry.attemptId,
      pilotId: entry.pilotId,
      projectId: entry.projectId,
      startedAt: entry.startedAt,
      ticks: entry.ticks,
      stopped: entry.stopped,
    },
  };
}

export function stopCursorLiveSupervisor(
  attemptId: string,
  reason = "STOPPED",
): boolean {
  const map = store();
  const entry = map.get(attemptId);
  if (!entry) return false;
  entry.stopped = true;
  entry.stopReason = reason;
  if (entry.timer) {
    clearInterval(entry.timer);
    entry.timer = null;
  }
  return true;
}

export function getCursorLiveSupervisor(
  attemptId: string,
): LiveSupervisorHandle | null {
  const entry = store().get(attemptId);
  if (!entry) return null;
  return {
    attemptId: entry.attemptId,
    pilotId: entry.pilotId,
    projectId: entry.projectId,
    startedAt: entry.startedAt,
    ticks: entry.ticks,
    stopped: entry.stopped,
    stopReason: entry.stopReason,
  };
}

export function listActiveCursorLiveSupervisors(): LiveSupervisorHandle[] {
  return [...store().values()]
    .filter((e) => !e.stopped)
    .map((e) => ({
      attemptId: e.attemptId,
      pilotId: e.pilotId,
      projectId: e.projectId,
      startedAt: e.startedAt,
      ticks: e.ticks,
      stopped: e.stopped,
      stopReason: e.stopReason,
    }));
}

/**
 * After process restart: re-attach observers for LIVE DISPATCHED attempts that
 * already have runId (ACK received). Observation only — never redispatch.
 */
export async function resumeDispatchedLiveSupervisors(): Promise<{
  resumed: number;
  skipped: number;
  attemptIds: string[];
}> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: effectAttempts.id,
      pilotId: effectAttempts.pilotId,
      projectId: effectAttempts.projectId,
      planJson: effectAttempts.planJson,
      resultJson: effectAttempts.resultJson,
      status: effectAttempts.status,
    })
    .from(effectAttempts)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(effectAttempts.status, "DISPATCHED"),
        eq(effectAttempts.kind, "CURSOR_EXECUTION"),
      ),
    );

  let resumed = 0;
  let skipped = 0;
  const attemptIds: string[] = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    let plan: CursorExecutionPlan;
    try {
      plan = JSON.parse(row.planJson) as CursorExecutionPlan;
    } catch {
      skipped += 1;
      continue;
    }
    if (plan.effectProviderMode !== "LIVE") {
      skipped += 1;
      continue;
    }
    const live = parseLive(row.resultJson);
    if (!live.runId) {
      // ACK lost / no handle — leave AMBIGUOUS path to reconcile; do not supervise blindly.
      skipped += 1;
      continue;
    }
    const r = ensureCursorLiveSupervisor({
      pilotId: row.pilotId,
      projectId: row.projectId,
      attemptId: row.id,
    });
    if (r.started) {
      resumed += 1;
      attemptIds.push(row.id);
    } else {
      skipped += 1;
    }
  }
  return { resumed, skipped, attemptIds };
}

/** Idempotent once-per-process resume hook for server boot / first request. */
export async function ensureLiveSupervisorsResumedOnce(): Promise<void> {
  const g = globalThis as unknown as SupervisorGlobal;
  if (g.__sfiaCursorLiveSupervisorResumeOnce) return;
  g.__sfiaCursorLiveSupervisorResumeOnce = true;
  try {
    await resumeDispatchedLiveSupervisors();
  } catch {
    // Boot resume must not crash request path.
    g.__sfiaCursorLiveSupervisorResumeOnce = false;
  }
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * D7 Cursor SDK adapter — SCRIPTED (tests) or LIVE (@cursor/sdk local).
 * Studio does not administer Cursor Desktop / MCP / OAuth here.
 *
 * Invariants:
 * - send() requested ≠ run observed
 * - ACK received ≠ work finished
 * - timeout ≠ absence of effect
 * - silence ≠ failure
 * - STOP requested ≠ stop observed
 * - cancel ≠ rollback
 * - run finished ≠ conforming result
 * - missing report ≠ no work done
 */

import type { CursorLiveProjection } from "./types";

export type CursorAdapterMode = "SCRIPTED" | "LIVE";

export type CursorDispatchInput = {
  attemptId: string;
  /** Exact authorized instruction bytes. */
  instructionText: string;
  instructionFingerprint: string;
  workspaceCwd: string;
  /** SDK idempotency — must equal attemptId to prevent blind retry. */
  idempotencyKey: string;
  modelId?: string;
  /**
   * When false (LIVE default for HTTP), return after ACK / first observation.
   * SCRIPTED still completes immediately. Full wait remains available for workers.
   */
  waitForTerminal?: boolean;
};

export type CursorDispatchResult = {
  mode: CursorAdapterMode;
  sendRequestedAt: string;
  ackReceivedAt: string | null;
  runObservedAt: string | null;
  agentId: string | null;
  runId: string | null;
  terminalStatus: CursorLiveProjection["terminalStatus"];
  lastActivitySummary: string | null;
  resultText: string | null;
  limits: string[];
};

export type CursorStopResult = {
  stopRequestedAt: string;
  stopObservedAt: string | null;
  terminalStatus: CursorLiveProjection["terminalStatus"];
  limits: string[];
};

export function resolveCursorAdapterMode(
  env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env,
): CursorAdapterMode {
  const raw = (env.SFIA_CURSOR_EFFECT_MODE || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (raw === "LIVE") return "LIVE";
  return "SCRIPTED";
}

/**
 * Resolve Cursor SDK API key: env first, then FileCredentialStore (~/.cursor/sdk/auth.json).
 * Never logs or returns the secret to callers beyond Agent.create.
 */
export async function resolveCursorApiKey(
  env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env,
): Promise<{ apiKey: string | null; source: "ENV" | "FILE_CREDENTIAL_STORE" | "NONE" }> {
  const fromEnv = (env.CURSOR_API_KEY || "").trim();
  if (fromEnv) return { apiKey: fromEnv, source: "ENV" };
  try {
    const { FileCredentialStore } = await import("@cursor/sdk");
    const store = new FileCredentialStore();
    const creds = await store.load();
    const key = typeof creds?.apiKey === "string" ? creds.apiKey.trim() : "";
    if (key) return { apiKey: key, source: "FILE_CREDENTIAL_STORE" };
  } catch {
    /* store unavailable */
  }
  return { apiKey: null, source: "NONE" };
}

/** Default model when plan omits modelId — SDK rejects create without a model. */
export function resolveCursorModelId(
  modelId: string | undefined,
  env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env,
): string {
  const fromInput = (modelId || "").trim();
  if (fromInput) return fromInput;
  const fromEnv = (env.SFIA_CURSOR_MODEL_ID || "").trim();
  if (fromEnv) return fromEnv;
  return "composer-2.5";
}

export type CursorObserveResult = {
  terminalStatus: CursorLiveProjection["terminalStatus"];
  lastActivitySummary: string | null;
  resultText: string | null;
  limits: string[];
};

/**
 * Observational LIVE reconcile — never sends a second instruction.
 * Uses Agent.getRun + wait when a runId is known.
 */
export async function observeLiveCursorRun(input: {
  runId: string;
  agentId: string | null;
  workspaceCwd: string;
  waitMs?: number;
}): Promise<CursorObserveResult> {
  const limits: string[] = ["LIVE_SDK", "OBSERVE_NO_RESEND"];
  try {
    const keyResolved = await resolveCursorApiKey();
    if (!keyResolved.apiKey) {
      return {
        terminalStatus: null,
        lastActivitySummary: "SDK_OBSERVE_NO_API_KEY",
        resultText: null,
        limits: [...limits, "OBSERVE_NO_API_KEY — rester DISPATCHED"],
      };
    }
    const { Agent } = await import("@cursor/sdk");
    const run = await Agent.getRun(input.runId, {
      runtime: "local",
      cwd: input.workspaceCwd,
      apiKey: keyResolved.apiKey,
    });
    if (!run) {
      return {
        terminalStatus: null,
        lastActivitySummary: "SDK_GET_RUN_EMPTY",
        resultText: null,
        limits: [...limits, "GET_RUN_EMPTY — pas de terminal inventé"],
      };
    }
    const statusRaw = run.status;
    const statusNow =
      typeof statusRaw === "string"
        ? statusRaw
        : statusRaw && typeof statusRaw === "object" && "type" in (statusRaw as object)
          ? String((statusRaw as { type?: string }).type ?? "")
          : statusRaw != null
            ? String(statusRaw)
            : null;
    const normalized = (statusNow || "").toLowerCase();
    if (
      normalized === "finished" ||
      normalized === "error" ||
      normalized === "cancelled"
    ) {
      return {
        terminalStatus: normalized as "finished" | "error" | "cancelled",
        lastActivitySummary: `SDK_OBSERVED_${normalized.toUpperCase()}`,
        resultText: typeof run.result === "string" ? run.result : null,
        limits: [...limits, `API_KEY_SOURCE_${keyResolved.source}`],
      };
    }
    // Detached runs may refuse wait() — never invent terminal from that failure.
    if (typeof run.wait === "function") {
      try {
        const waited = await run.wait();
        const wStatus = String(waited.status ?? "").toLowerCase();
        const terminal =
          wStatus === "finished" ||
          wStatus === "error" ||
          wStatus === "cancelled"
            ? (wStatus as "finished" | "error" | "cancelled")
            : null;
        return {
          terminalStatus: terminal,
          lastActivitySummary: `SDK_WAIT_${wStatus.toUpperCase() || "EMPTY"}`,
          resultText: typeof waited.result === "string" ? waited.result : null,
          limits: [
            ...limits,
            `API_KEY_SOURCE_${keyResolved.source}`,
            "WAIT_COMPLETED_IN_OBSERVE",
          ],
        };
      } catch (waitErr) {
        return {
          terminalStatus: null,
          lastActivitySummary: "SDK_WAIT_DETACHED_OR_FAILED",
          resultText: null,
          limits: [
            ...limits,
            `WAIT_FAILED:${String((waitErr as Error)?.message ?? waitErr).slice(0, 80)}`,
            statusNow ? `LAST_STATUS_${statusNow}` : "LAST_STATUS_NONE",
          ],
        };
      }
    }
    return {
      terminalStatus: null,
      lastActivitySummary: statusNow
        ? `SDK_STATUS_${statusNow.toUpperCase()}`
        : "SDK_STATUS_UNKNOWN_NON_TERMINAL",
      resultText: null,
      limits: [...limits, "NON_TERMINAL_NO_WAIT"],
    };
  } catch (e) {
    // Fail closed: do NOT stamp terminalStatus=unknown (would look like resolution).
    return {
      terminalStatus: null,
      lastActivitySummary: "SDK_OBSERVE_FAILED",
      resultText: null,
      limits: [
        ...limits,
        `OBSERVE_FAILED:${String((e as Error)?.message ?? e).slice(0, 80)}`,
      ],
    };
  }
}

/** In-memory scripted runs for DETERMINISTIC tests — not a parallel business path. */
const scriptedRuns = new Map<
  string,
  {
    agentId: string;
    runId: string;
    status: "running" | "finished" | "error" | "cancelled";
    instructionFingerprint: string;
    resultText: string;
  }
>();

export function __resetScriptedCursorRunsForTests(): void {
  scriptedRuns.clear();
}

/** When true, SCRIPTED returns DISPATCHED/RUNNING first; reconcile advances to finished. */
export function isScriptedPhasedMode(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): boolean {
  return (env.SFIA_CURSOR_SCRIPTED_PHASED || "").trim() === "1";
}

export function getScriptedRun(attemptId: string) {
  return scriptedRuns.get(attemptId) ?? null;
}

/** Advance a phased SCRIPTED run to finished — used by reconcile, never a second send. */
export function advanceScriptedRunToFinished(attemptId: string): {
  agentId: string;
  runId: string;
  resultText: string;
  lastActivitySummary: string;
} | null {
  const existing = scriptedRuns.get(attemptId);
  if (!existing) return null;
  if (existing.status === "finished") {
    return {
      agentId: existing.agentId,
      runId: existing.runId,
      resultText: existing.resultText,
      lastActivitySummary: "SCRIPTED_ALREADY_FINISHED",
    };
  }
  if (existing.status !== "running") return null;
  existing.status = "finished";
  return {
    agentId: existing.agentId,
    runId: existing.runId,
    resultText: existing.resultText,
    lastActivitySummary: "SCRIPTED_OBSERVATION_FINISHED",
  };
}

function buildScriptedReport(attemptId: string, instructionFingerprint: string): string {
  return [
    `# Rapport de réalisation (SCRIPTED)`,
    ``,
    `attemptId: ${attemptId}`,
    `instructionFingerprint: ${instructionFingerprint}`,
    ``,
    `## Inventaire`,
    `- Aucun fichier modifié (mode scripted)`,
    ``,
    `## Tests`,
    `- Non exécutés (SCRIPTED)`,
    ``,
    `## Réserves`,
    `- Preuve LIVE SDK non produite`,
  ].join("\n");
}

export async function dispatchCursorRun(
  input: CursorDispatchInput,
  mode = resolveCursorAdapterMode(),
): Promise<CursorDispatchResult> {
  const sendRequestedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  if (mode === "SCRIPTED") {
    const existing = scriptedRuns.get(input.idempotencyKey);
    if (existing) {
      return {
        mode,
        sendRequestedAt,
        ackReceivedAt: sendRequestedAt,
        runObservedAt: sendRequestedAt,
        agentId: existing.agentId,
        runId: existing.runId,
        terminalStatus: existing.status === "running" ? null : existing.status,
        lastActivitySummary: "SCRIPTED_IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY",
        resultText: existing.status === "finished" ? existing.resultText : null,
        limits: ["SCRIPTED_MODE", "IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY"],
      };
    }
    const agentId = `scripted-agent-${input.attemptId}`;
    const runId = `scripted-run-${input.attemptId}`;
    const resultText = buildScriptedReport(input.attemptId, input.instructionFingerprint);
    const phased =
      isScriptedPhasedMode() || input.waitForTerminal === false;
    scriptedRuns.set(input.idempotencyKey, {
      agentId,
      runId,
      status: phased ? "running" : "finished",
      instructionFingerprint: input.instructionFingerprint,
      resultText,
    });
    // C12 T-04 — same DROP_ACK fault as LIVE (deterministic SCRIPTED path).
    if ((process.env.SFIA_CURSOR_FAULT_AFTER_SEND || "").trim().toUpperCase() === "DROP_ACK") {
      throw new Error(
        "SFIA_CURSOR_FAULT_AFTER_SEND=DROP_ACK — ACK perdu après effet SDK possible",
      );
    }
    if (phased) {
      return {
        mode,
        sendRequestedAt,
        ackReceivedAt: sendRequestedAt,
        runObservedAt: sendRequestedAt,
        agentId,
        runId,
        terminalStatus: null,
        lastActivitySummary: "SCRIPTED_OBSERVATION_RUNNING",
        resultText: null,
        limits: [
          "SCRIPTED_MODE",
          "SCRIPTED_PHASED",
          "NO_REAL_SIDE_EFFECT",
          "REQUIRES_RECONCILE_TO_FINISH",
        ],
      };
    }
    return {
      mode,
      sendRequestedAt,
      ackReceivedAt: sendRequestedAt,
      runObservedAt: sendRequestedAt,
      agentId,
      runId,
      terminalStatus: "finished",
      lastActivitySummary: "SCRIPTED_FINISHED",
      resultText,
      limits: ["SCRIPTED_MODE", "NO_REAL_SIDE_EFFECT"],
    };
  }

  // LIVE path — dynamic import so unit tests without entitlement still load.
  const keyResolved = await resolveCursorApiKey();
  if (!keyResolved.apiKey) {
    throw new Error(
      "CURSOR_SDK_UNAVAILABLE — ni CURSOR_API_KEY ni FileCredentialStore",
    );
  }
  const modelId = resolveCursorModelId(input.modelId);
  const { Agent } = await import("@cursor/sdk");
  const agent = await Agent.create({
    apiKey: keyResolved.apiKey,
    model: { id: modelId },
    local: { cwd: input.workspaceCwd },
  });
  let ackReceivedAt: string | null = null;
  let runObservedAt: string | null = null;
  let lastActivitySummary: string | null = null;
  const run = await agent.send(input.instructionText, {
    idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey,
    onDelta: () => {
      if (!runObservedAt) runObservedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      lastActivitySummary = "SDK_DELTA";
    },
  });
  /**
   * C12 / T-04 — deterministic fault injection AFTER SDK send accepted.
   * DROP_ACK: throw before Studio persists agentId/runId → AMBIGUOUS + priorSend.
   * Never use outside DEV fault tests.
   */
  const fault = (process.env.SFIA_CURSOR_FAULT_AFTER_SEND || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (fault === "DROP_ACK") {
    throw new Error(
      "SFIA_CURSOR_FAULT_AFTER_SEND=DROP_ACK — ACK perdu après effet SDK possible",
    );
  }
  ackReceivedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  if (!runObservedAt) runObservedAt = ackReceivedAt;

  const waitForTerminal = input.waitForTerminal === true;
  if (!waitForTerminal) {
    return {
      mode,
      sendRequestedAt,
      ackReceivedAt,
      runObservedAt,
      agentId: agent.agentId,
      runId: run.id ?? null,
      terminalStatus: null,
      lastActivitySummary: lastActivitySummary ?? "SDK_ACK_ACCEPTED_NOT_TERMINAL",
      resultText: null,
      limits: [
        "LIVE_SDK",
        "DISPATCH_ACCEPTED_WITHOUT_WAIT",
        `API_KEY_SOURCE_${keyResolved.source}`,
        `MODEL_${modelId}`,
        "REPORT_MUST_BE_INGESTED_SEPARATELY",
        "SUPERVISION_VIA_D7_LIVE_SUPERVISOR_OR_RECONCILE",
      ],
    };
  }

  const waited = await run.wait();
  const terminal =
    waited.status === "finished" ||
    waited.status === "error" ||
    waited.status === "cancelled"
      ? waited.status
      : "unknown";
  return {
    mode,
    sendRequestedAt,
    ackReceivedAt,
    runObservedAt,
    agentId: agent.agentId,
    runId: run.id ?? null,
    terminalStatus: terminal,
    lastActivitySummary: lastActivitySummary ?? `SDK_${String(waited.status).toUpperCase()}`,
    resultText: typeof waited.result === "string" ? waited.result : null,
    limits: [
      "LIVE_SDK",
      `API_KEY_SOURCE_${keyResolved.source}`,
      `MODEL_${modelId}`,
      "REPORT_MUST_BE_INGESTED_SEPARATELY",
      "WAIT_COMPLETED_IN_ADAPTER",
    ],
  };
}

export async function stopCursorRun(input: {
  attemptId: string;
  agentId: string | null;
  runId: string | null;
  workspaceCwd: string;
  mode?: CursorAdapterMode;
}): Promise<CursorStopResult> {
  const mode = input.mode ?? resolveCursorAdapterMode();
  const stopRequestedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  if (mode === "SCRIPTED") {
    const existing = scriptedRuns.get(input.attemptId);
    if (existing && existing.status === "running") {
      existing.status = "cancelled";
    }
    return {
      stopRequestedAt,
      stopObservedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      terminalStatus: "cancelled",
      limits: ["SCRIPTED_MODE", "CANCEL_IS_NOT_ROLLBACK"],
    };
  }
  // LIVE: best-effort cancel via run handle if recoverable; otherwise UNKNOWN.
  if (!input.runId || !input.agentId) {
    return {
      stopRequestedAt,
      stopObservedAt: null,
      terminalStatus: "unknown",
      limits: ["STOP_REQUESTED_WITHOUT_RUN_HANDLE", "CANCEL_IS_NOT_ROLLBACK"],
    };
  }
  try {
    const keyResolved = await resolveCursorApiKey();
    const { Agent } = await import("@cursor/sdk");
    const run = await Agent.getRun(input.runId, {
      runtime: "local",
      cwd: input.workspaceCwd,
      ...(keyResolved.apiKey ? { apiKey: keyResolved.apiKey } : {}),
    });
    if (run && typeof run.cancel === "function") {
      await run.cancel();
      return {
        stopRequestedAt,
        stopObservedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        terminalStatus: "cancelled",
        limits: ["LIVE_CANCEL_OBSERVED", "CANCEL_IS_NOT_ROLLBACK"],
      };
    }
  } catch {
    // fall through
  }
  return {
    stopRequestedAt,
    stopObservedAt: null,
    terminalStatus: "unknown",
    limits: ["STOP_REQUESTED_OBSERVATION_UNCERTAIN", "CANCEL_IS_NOT_ROLLBACK"],
  };
}
```

```typescript
  revisionContentFingerprint,
} from "./fingerprint";
import type {
  DiffKind,
  InspectionDiff,
  MergePlan,
  PrCurrentState,
  PublicationPlan,
  PublicationProgress,
  PublicationStep,
} from "./types";
import {
  assertPlanPublicationSteps,
  assertPublicationEffectProof,
  qualifyPlanEffectProviderMode,
  resolvePublicationSteps,
} from "./publication-steps";

async function assertProject(pilotId: string, projectId: string) {
  const p = (
    await db
      .select({ id: projects.id })
      .from(projects)
      .where(and(eq(projects.id, projectId), eq(projects.ownerPilotId, pilotId)))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!p) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Projet introuvable");
}

async function loadRepoContext(pilotId: string, projectId: string, repositoryId: string) {
  const link = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(projectGitLinks)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(projectGitLinks.projectId, projectId),
          eq(projectGitLinks.repositoryId, repositoryId),
          eq(projectGitLinks.pilotId, pilotId),
          eq(projectGitLinks.status, "ATTACHED"),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!link) throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Dépôt non rattaché");

  const repo = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(authorizedRepositories)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(authorizedRepositories.id, repositoryId),
          eq(authorizedRepositories.pilotId, pilotId),
          eq(authorizedRepositories.status, "ACTIVE"),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!repo) throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Dépôt inactif");

  const authz = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(integrationAuthorizations)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(integrationAuthorizations.id, repo.authorizationId),
          eq(integrationAuthorizations.pilotId, pilotId),
          eq(integrationAuthorizations.status, "CONNECTED"),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!authz) throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Intégration non CONNECTED");
  if (!authz.installationId) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Installation GitHub absente");
  }

  let permissions: Record<string, string> = {};
  try {
    permissions = JSON.parse(repo.permissionsJson || "{}") as Record<string, string>;
  } catch {
    permissions = {};
  }

  return { repo, authz, permissions };
}

async function assertDocumentForProject(
  pilotId: string,
  projectId: string,
  documentId: string,
): Promise<{ preparationId: string }> {
  const doc = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(documents)
      .where(and(eq(documents.id, documentId), eq(documents.ownerPilotId, pilotId)))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!doc) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Document introuvable");

  if (doc.projectId && doc.projectId !== projectId) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Document d'un autre projet");
  }

  if (!doc.projectId) {
    const link = (
      await db
        .select()
        .from(preparationProjectLinks)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(preparationProjectLinks.preparationId, doc.preparationId),
            eq(preparationProjectLinks.projectId, projectId),
          ),
        )
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    if (!link) {
      throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Document hors périmètre projet/préparation");
    }
  }

  return { preparationId: doc.preparationId };
}

function classifyRemoteReadError(e: unknown): DiffKind {
  const code =
    e && typeof e === "object" && "code" in e ? String((e as { code: string }).code) : "";
  if (code === "NOT_FOUND") return "CREATE";
  if (code === "FORBIDDEN") return "FORBIDDEN";
  if (code === "TIMEOUT") return "TIMEOUT";
  if (code === "AMBIGUOUS") return "AMBIGUOUS_READ";
  if (code === "CONFLICT") return "REF_STALE";
  return "INACCESSIBLE";
}

/** Inspection kinds that may proceed to a D6 mandate. */
export function inspectionAllowsAuthorization(kind: DiffKind): boolean {
  return kind === "CREATE" || kind === "MODIFY" || kind === "UNCHANGED";
}

async function buildInspection(input: {
  pilotId: string;
  fullName: string;
  targetPath: string;
  baseRef: string;
  baseSha: string | null;
  revisionId: string;
  revisionFingerprint: string;
  proposedContent: string;
}): Promise<InspectionDiff> {
  const provider = resolveGitHubProvider();
  let baseContent: string | null = null;
  let kind: DiffKind = "CREATE";
  let remoteReadCode: string | null = null;

  if (!input.baseSha) {
    kind = "MISSING_BASE";
  } else {
    // Prefer SHA-pinned read — mobile ref alone is not an immutable envelope.
    const readRef = input.baseSha;
    try {
      // Coherence: tip of baseRef must still equal frozen baseSha.
      const tip = await provider.getRefSha(input.pilotId, input.fullName, input.baseRef);
      if (tip !== input.baseSha) {
        kind = "REF_STALE";
        remoteReadCode = "REF_ADVANCED";
      } else {
        const file = await provider.getFileContent(
          input.pilotId,
          input.fullName,
          input.targetPath,
          readRef,
        );
        baseContent = file.content;
        kind = file.content === input.proposedContent ? "UNCHANGED" : "MODIFY";
      }
    } catch (e) {
      const classified = classifyRemoteReadError(e);
      kind = classified;
      remoteReadCode =
        e && typeof e === "object" && "code" in e
          ? String((e as { code: string }).code)
          : "UNKNOWN";
      // Only a qualified NOT_FOUND may become CREATE (file absent at frozen SHA).
      if (classified === "CREATE") {
        baseContent = null;
      } else {
        baseContent = null;
      }
    }
  }

  const unifiedDiff =
    kind === "FORBIDDEN" ||
    kind === "TIMEOUT" ||
    kind === "AMBIGUOUS_READ" ||
    kind === "INACCESSIBLE" ||
    kind === "REF_STALE"
      ? `# inspection unavailable (${kind})\n`
      : buildUnifiedDiff(input.targetPath, baseContent, input.proposedContent);

  const fp = inspectionFingerprint({
    revisionId: input.revisionId,
    revisionFingerprint: input.revisionFingerprint,
    targetPath: input.targetPath,
    baseSha: input.baseSha,
    baseContent,
    proposedContent: input.proposedContent,
    unifiedDiff,
  });
  return {
    kind,
    basePath: input.targetPath,
    baseSha: input.baseSha,
    baseContent,
    proposedContent: input.proposedContent,
    unifiedDiff,
    inspectionFingerprint: fp,
    remoteReadCode,
  };
}

function readProgress(resultJson: string): PublicationProgress {
  try {
    const j = JSON.parse(resultJson) as { progress?: PublicationProgress };
    return j.progress ?? {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function writeProgress(
  existingResultJson: string,
  progress: PublicationProgress,
  claim?: EffectClaim | null,
): string {
  let base: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  try {
    base = JSON.parse(existingResultJson || "{}") as Record<string, unknown>;
  } catch {
    base = {};
  }
  const next: Record<string, unknown> = { ...base, progress };
  if (claim !== undefined) {
    if (claim) next.claim = claim;
    else delete next.claim;
  }
  return JSON.stringify(next);
}

/** SQL: stored claimToken must equal the caller's fence token (atomic ownership). */
function sqlClaimTokenEquals(claimToken: string) {
  return sql`${effectAttempts.resultJson}::jsonb->'claim'->>'claimToken' = ${claimToken}`;
}

/**
 * SQL: no active owner — absent claim, released, or lease expired.
 * Expiration ≠ remote effect finished; only permits controlled reclaim after observation.
 */
function sqlClaimInactive() {
  return sql`(
    ${effectAttempts.resultJson}::jsonb->'claim' IS NULL
    OR NULLIF(${effectAttempts.resultJson}::jsonb->'claim'->>'releasedAt', '') IS NOT NULL
    OR (${effectAttempts.resultJson}::jsonb->'claim'->>'leaseExpiresAt')::timestamptz <= now()
  )`;
}

function sqlClaimLeaseActive() {
  return sql`(
    NULLIF(${effectAttempts.resultJson}::jsonb->'claim'->>'releasedAt', '') IS NULL
    AND (${effectAttempts.resultJson}::jsonb->'claim'->>'leaseExpiresAt')::timestamptz > now()
  )`;
}

/**
 * Atomic claim: AUTHORIZED|AMBIGUOUS → DISPATCHED before any provider mutation.
 * Reclaim requires inactive prior claim IN THE SAME SQL predicate (not memory-only).
 */
async function claimAttempt(attemptId: string, fromStatus: "AUTHORIZED" | "AMBIGUOUS") {
  const now = new Date();
  const row = await loadAttemptRow(attemptId);
  if (!row || row.status !== fromStatus) return null;
  const prev = readClaim(row.resultJson);
  // Fast-fail without writing when AMBIGUOUS still has an active lease (defense in depth).
  if (fromStatus === "AMBIGUOUS" && isClaimActive(prev, now.getTime())) {
    return null;
  }
  const claim = mintClaim(prev, now);
  const nextJson = writeClaimInto(row.resultJson, claim);
  const where =
    fromStatus === "AMBIGUOUS"
      ? and(
          eq(effectAttempts.id, attemptId),
          eq(effectAttempts.status, fromStatus),
          sqlClaimInactive(),
        )
      : and(eq(effectAttempts.id, attemptId), eq(effectAttempts.status, fromStatus));
  const claimed = await db
    .update(effectAttempts)
    .set({ status: "DISPATCHED", resultJson: nextJson, updatedAt: now })
    .where(where)
    .returning({ id: effectAttempts.id });
  return claimed[0] ? { id: claimed[0].id, claim } : null;
}

async function loadAttemptRow(attemptId: string) {
  return (
    await db.select().from(effectAttempts).where(eq(effectAttempts.id, attemptId)).limit(1)
  )[0];
}

/**
 * Before each external mutation: renew lease only if this claimToken still owns DISPATCHED
 * with an active lease in PostgreSQL. Stale/expired owners get CONFLICT (0 rows).
 * Re-reads resultJson so a renew cannot clobber fresher progress from the same owner.
 */
async function assertAndTouchOwnership(
  attemptId: string,
  claimToken: string,
  _existingResultJson: string,
): Promise<string> {
  void _existingResultJson;
  const fresh = await loadAttemptRow(attemptId);
  if (!fresh || fresh.status !== "DISPATCHED") {
    throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", "DISPATCHED perdu — mutation refusée");
  }
  const claim = readClaim(fresh.resultJson);
  if (!claim || claim.claimToken !== claimToken || claim.releasedAt) {
    throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", "Claim fence invalide — mutation refusée");
  }
  const renewed = extendClaim(claim);
  const nextJson = writeClaimInto(fresh.resultJson, renewed);
  const updated = await db
    .update(effectAttempts)
    .set({ resultJson: nextJson, updatedAt: new Date() })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(effectAttempts.id, attemptId),
        eq(effectAttempts.status, "DISPATCHED"),
        sqlClaimTokenEquals(claimToken),
        sqlClaimLeaseActive(),
      ),
    )
    .returning({ id: effectAttempts.id, resultJson: effectAttempts.resultJson });
  if (!updated[0]) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "CONFLICT",
      "Propriété ou lease perdue — mutation provider refusée (fencing SQL)",
    );
  }
  return updated[0].resultJson;
}

/**
 * Persist progress under ownership. CAS predicate includes claimToken in SQL —
 * never trust a post-UPDATE readback of a token this UPDATE just wrote.
 */
async function persistOwnedProgress(
  attemptId: string,
  claimToken: string,
  existingResultJson: string,
  progress: PublicationProgress,
) {
  const claim = readClaim(existingResultJson);
  if (!claim || claim.claimToken !== claimToken) {
    throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", "Claim fence invalide — progression non écrite");
  }
  const nextJson = writeProgress(existingResultJson, progress, claim);
  const updated = await db
    .update(effectAttempts)
    .set({ resultJson: nextJson, updatedAt: new Date() })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(effectAttempts.id, attemptId),
        eq(effectAttempts.status, "DISPATCHED"),
        sqlClaimTokenEquals(claimToken),
```
