```typescript
              status: pubStatus,
              publicationBranch: plan.publicationBranch,
              prCurrentState: observed.prCurrentState,
              prCreatedHistorically: Boolean(observed.prCreated || observed.prOpened),
              extraDetail: {
                reconciled: true,
                effectProviderMode: plan.effectProviderMode ?? null,
              },
            },
          });
          nextStatus = "COMPLETED";
        } catch (e) {
          if (e instanceof StudioError && e.code === "CONFLICT") {
            // Losing reconciler — no D8 orphan (txn rolled back).
            nextStatus = row.status;
          } else {
            throw e;
          }
        }
      } else if (stepsDone) {
        // Proven steps but missing commitSha — fail-closed AMBIGUOUS.
        const released = releaseClaim(claim);
        const cas = await casLiberateInactiveDispatch({
          attemptId: row.id,
          fromStatus: row.status,
          toStatus: "AMBIGUOUS",
          resultJson: writeProgress(row.resultJson, observed, released),
        });
        nextStatus = cas ? "AMBIGUOUS" : row.status;
      } else {
        // Historical prCreated without remote proof stays AMBIGUOUS / UNKNOWN.
        const released = releaseClaim(claim);
        const cas = await casLiberateInactiveDispatch({
          attemptId: row.id,
          fromStatus: row.status,
          toStatus: "AMBIGUOUS",
          resultJson: writeProgress(row.resultJson, observed, released),
        });
        nextStatus = cas ? "AMBIGUOUS" : row.status;
      }
    }

    return {
      attemptId,
      status: nextStatus,
      progress: observed,
      remoteHead: observed.branchSha ?? null,
      facts,
      prCurrentState: observed.prCurrentState ?? null,
      note:
        nextStatus === "COMPLETED"
          ? "Réconciliation: étapes historiques observées (état courant PR séparé)"
          : "Réconciliation: effet partiel — AMBIGUOUS si reprise exclusive possible",
    };
  }

  if (row.kind === "GIT_MERGE") {
    const plan = JSON.parse(row.planJson) as MergePlan;
    if (row.status === "DISPATCHED" && claimActive) {
      return {
        attemptId,
        status: row.status,
        facts,
        note: "READ-ONLY: claim merge actif",
      };
    }

    // ML4-REC-01 parity — never attribute a merge COMPLETED from the wrong provider mode.
    const historicalMode = qualifyPlanEffectProviderMode(plan);
    const liveMode = resolveConfiguredEffectProviderMode();
    const providerMismatch =
      (historicalMode === "REAL" || historicalMode === "SCRIPTED") &&
      historicalMode !== liveMode;
    const provenanceUnknown = historicalMode === "UNKNOWN";
    if (providerMismatch || provenanceUnknown) {
      const note = providerMismatch
        ? `ML4-REC-01: mode fournisseur divergé (plan=${historicalMode}, live=${liveMode}) — observation merge refusée`
        : "ML4-REC-01: provenance fournisseur UNKNOWN — aucune attribution D7/D8 merge depuis le provider live";
      if (row.status === "COMPLETED") {
        return {
          attemptId,
          status: "COMPLETED" as const,
          facts,
          note: `${note} — COMPLETED historique préservé`,
        };
      }
      if (providerMismatch && (row.status === "AMBIGUOUS" || row.status === "DISPATCHED")) {
        const released = releaseClaim(claim);
        const cas = await casLiberateInactiveDispatch({
          attemptId: row.id,
          fromStatus: row.status,
          toStatus: "REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION",
          resultJson: writeClaimInto(row.resultJson, released),
        });
        return {
          attemptId,
          status: cas ? ("REQUIRES_REQUALIFICATION" as const) : row.status,
          facts,
          note,
        };
      }
      return { attemptId, status: row.status, facts, note };
    }

    const provider = resolveGitHubProvider();
    try {
      const pr = await provider.getPullRequest(pilotId, plan.repositoryFullName, plan.prNumber);
      if (pr.state === "merged" && (row.status === "AMBIGUOUS" || row.status === "DISPATCHED")) {
        // Provenance gate — attribute only when remote PR matches the frozen merge plan.
        // Target base SHA may advance after merge; do not require expectedBaseSha equality.
        const mergeSha =
          typeof pr.mergeCommitSha === "string" && /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/i.test(pr.mergeCommitSha)
            ? pr.mergeCommitSha
            : null;
        const provenanceOk =
          pr.number === plan.prNumber &&
          pr.headRef === plan.expectedHeadRef &&
          pr.baseRef === plan.expectedBaseRef &&
          pr.headSha.toLowerCase() === plan.expectedHeadSha.toLowerCase() &&
          Boolean(mergeSha) &&
          mergeSha!.toLowerCase() !== plan.expectedHeadSha.toLowerCase();
        if (!mergeSha) {
          return {
            attemptId,
            status: row.status,
            prState: pr.state,
            prCurrentState: mapPrState(pr.state),
            facts,
            note: "PR mergée — merge_commit_sha absent ; COMPLETED non inventé",
          };
        }
        if (!provenanceOk) {
          return {
            attemptId,
            status: row.status,
            prState: pr.state,
            prCurrentState: mapPrState(pr.state),
            facts,
            note: "PR mergée — provenance plan/distante insuffisante ou contradictoire ; succès non attribué",
          };
        }

        const pubRef = (
          await db
            .select()
            .from(documentPublicationRefs)
            .where(eq(documentPublicationRefs.id, plan.publicationRefId))
            .limit(1)
        )[0];
        if (
          !pubRef ||
          pubRef.projectId !== projectId ||
          pubRef.pilotId !== pilotId ||
          pubRef.prNumber !== plan.prNumber ||
          pubRef.effectAttemptId !== plan.publicationAttemptId
        ) {
          return {
            attemptId,
            status: row.status,
            prState: pr.state,
            prCurrentState: mapPrState(pr.state),
            facts,
            note: "PR mergée — publication documentaire associée incohérente ; succès non attribué",
          };
        }

        const released = releaseClaim(claim);
        const cas = await casLiberateInactiveDispatch({
          attemptId: row.id,
          fromStatus: row.status,
          toStatus: "COMPLETED",
          resultJson: JSON.stringify({
            merged: true,
            sha: mergeSha,
            sourceHeadSha: plan.expectedHeadSha,
            reconciled: true,
            claim: released,
          }),
        });
        if (cas) {
          let nextDetail: Record<string, unknown> = {};
          try {
            nextDetail = JSON.parse(pubRef.detailJson || "{}") as Record<string, unknown>;
          } catch {
            nextDetail = {};
          }
          nextDetail.prCurrentState = "MERGED";
          nextDetail.mergeCommitSha = mergeSha;
          nextDetail.sourceHeadSha = pubRef.headSha ?? plan.expectedHeadSha;
          await db
            .update(documentPublicationRefs)
            .set({
              status: "MERGED",
              // Preserve publication source HEAD — merge commit is in detail + MERGE fact.
              headSha: pubRef.headSha ?? plan.expectedHeadSha,
              detailJson: JSON.stringify(nextDetail),
              updatedAt: new Date(),
            })
            .where(eq(documentPublicationRefs.id, plan.publicationRefId));
          const hasMergeFact = facts.some((f) => f.factKind === "MERGE");
          if (!hasMergeFact) {
            await recordFact({
              attemptId: row.id,
              pilotId,
              projectId,
              factKind: "MERGE",
              repositoryFullName: plan.repositoryFullName,
              refName: plan.expectedBaseRef,
              sha: mergeSha,
              prNumber: plan.prNumber,
              detail: {
                merged: true,
                reconciled: true,
                publicationRefId: plan.publicationRefId,
                sourceHeadSha: plan.expectedHeadSha,
                mergeCommitSha: mergeSha,
              },
            });
          }
        }
        return {
          attemptId,
          status: cas ? "COMPLETED" : row.status,
          prState: pr.state,
          facts,
          mergeSha,
          sourceHeadSha: plan.expectedHeadSha,
        };
      }
      return {
        attemptId,
        status: row.status,
        prState: pr.state,
        prCurrentState: mapPrState(pr.state),
        facts,
      };
    } catch {
      return {
        attemptId,
        status: row.status,
        prState: null,
        prCurrentState: "UNKNOWN" as const,
        facts,
        note: "PR illisible — statut conservé",
      };
    }
  }

  return { attemptId, status: row.status, facts };
}

async function recordFact(input: {
  attemptId: string;
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  factKind: string;
  repositoryFullName: string;
  refName: string;
  sha: string;
  prNumber: number | null;
  detail: Record<string, unknown>;
}) {
  await db.insert(observedGitFacts).values({
    id: newId("ogf"),
    attemptId: input.attemptId,
    pilotId: input.pilotId,
    projectId: input.projectId,
    factKind: input.factKind,
    repositoryFullName: input.repositoryFullName,
    refName: input.refName,
    sha: input.sha,
    prNumber: input.prNumber,
    observedAt: new Date(),
    detailJson: JSON.stringify(input.detail),
    createdAt: new Date(),
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { createHash } from "crypto";

export type HandoffManifest = {
  filesCreated?: string[];
  filesModified?: string[];
  filesDeleted?: string[];
  filesMoved?: Array<{ from: string; to: string }>;
  /** Declared by report author — not proof of FS presence. */
  filesDeclared?: string[];
  /** Observed on disk at handoff time (server check). */
  filesObserved?: string[];
  /** Content actually read/consulted (SHA when available). */
  filesConsulted?: Array<{ path: string; sha256?: string }>;
  testsDeclared?: string[];
  testsExecuted?: string[];
  /** Captured stdout/stderr or exit code present — required to claim verified run. */
  testsCaptured?: string[];
  sourcesConsulted?: string[];
  commands?: string[];
  commandsExecuted?: string[];
  gaps?: string[];
  git?: {
    branch?: string | null;
    baseSha?: string | null;
    tipSha?: string | null;
  };
};

/**
 * C13 honesty helper — distinguish declaration vs observation vs consultation.
 * Never treat RESULT_*.txt alone as proof that an announced unit test ran.
 */
export function classifyManifestHonesty(manifest: HandoffManifest): {
  filesDeclared: number;
  filesObserved: number;
  filesConsulted: number;
  testsDeclared: number;
  testsExecuted: number;
  testsCaptured: number;
  canClaimVerifiedTests: boolean;
  notes: string[];
} {
  const filesDeclared =
    (manifest.filesDeclared?.length ?? 0) ||
    (manifest.filesCreated?.length ?? 0) + (manifest.filesModified?.length ?? 0);
  const filesObserved = manifest.filesObserved?.length ?? 0;
  const filesConsulted = manifest.filesConsulted?.length ?? 0;
  const testsDeclared = manifest.testsDeclared?.length ?? 0;
  const testsExecuted = manifest.testsExecuted?.length ?? 0;
  const testsCaptured = manifest.testsCaptured?.length ?? 0;
  const notes: string[] = [];
  if (filesDeclared > filesObserved) {
    notes.push("FILES_DECLARED_EXCEED_OBSERVED");
  }
  if (testsDeclared + testsExecuted > 0 && testsCaptured === 0) {
    notes.push("TESTS_ANNOUNCED_WITHOUT_CAPTURE");
  }
  return {
    filesDeclared,
    filesObserved,
    filesConsulted,
    testsDeclared,
    testsExecuted,
    testsCaptured,
    canClaimVerifiedTests: testsCaptured > 0,
    notes,
  };
}

export function handoffIntegrityHash(input: {
  attemptId: string;
  contractFingerprint: string;
  reportMarkdown: string;
  manifest: HandoffManifest;
}): string {
  return createHash("sha256")
    .update(
      JSON.stringify({
        attemptId: input.attemptId,
        contractFingerprint: input.contractFingerprint,
        reportFp: createHash("sha256").update(input.reportMarkdown, "utf8").digest("hex"),
        manifest: input.manifest,
      }),
    )
    .digest("hex");
}

export function inventoryComplete(manifest: HandoffManifest): boolean {
  const n =
    (manifest.filesCreated?.length ?? 0) +
    (manifest.filesModified?.length ?? 0) +
    (manifest.filesDeleted?.length ?? 0) +
    (manifest.filesMoved?.length ?? 0);
  if (n === 0) return (manifest.gaps ?? []).some((g) => /inventaire|aucune?\s+modif/i.test(g));
  return true;
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * E12 / Cycle 8 A3 — conditional MCP capability check when mcpRequired is set.
 * Studio does NOT administer MCP. UNKNOWN / missing auth / missing invoke → fail-closed
 * for any dispatch that requires MCP. SCRIPTED may record simulation explicitly — never OK.
 */

export type McpCapabilityResult = {
  name: string;
  required: boolean;
  present: boolean;
  loadable: boolean;
  authenticated: boolean | null;
  invocable: boolean | null;
  status: "OK" | "MISSING" | "UNAVAILABLE" | "UNKNOWN" | "NOT_REQUIRED" | "SCRIPTED_SIMULATED";
  limits: string[];
};

export function checkRequiredMcpCapabilities(
  mcpRequired: string[],
  env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv | Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env,
  opts?: { scriptedSimulation?: boolean },
): McpCapabilityResult[] {
  if (!mcpRequired.length) {
    return [
      {
        name: "(none)",
        required: false,
        present: true,
        loadable: true,
        authenticated: null,
        invocable: null,
        status: "NOT_REQUIRED",
        limits: ["E12_NO_MCP_REQUIRED"],
      },
    ];
  }

  const declared =
    (env.SFIA_CURSOR_MCP_AVAILABLE ?? "")
      .split(",")
      .map((s) => s.trim())
      .filter(Boolean);

  const inventoryKnown = declared.length > 0 || env.SFIA_CURSOR_MCP_INVENTORY_PROVEN === "1";
  const authProven = env.SFIA_CURSOR_MCP_AUTH_PROVEN === "1";
  const invokeProven = env.SFIA_CURSOR_MCP_INVOKE_PROVEN === "1";

  return mcpRequired.map((name) => {
    const limits = ["E12_STUDIO_DOES_NOT_ADMIN_MCP", "MCP_REAL_GATED"];

    if (opts?.scriptedSimulation) {
      return {
        name,
        required: true,
        present: false,
        loadable: false,
        authenticated: null,
        invocable: null,
        status: "SCRIPTED_SIMULATED" as const,
        limits: [...limits, "SCRIPTED_MCP_NOT_REAL_CAPABILITY"],
      };
    }

    if (!inventoryKnown) {
      return {
        name,
        required: true,
        present: false,
        loadable: false,
        authenticated: null,
        invocable: null,
        status: "UNKNOWN" as const,
        limits: [...limits, "MCP_INVENTORY_UNPROVEN"],
      };
    }

    const present = declared.includes(name) || declared.includes("*");
    if (!present) {
      return {
        name,
        required: true,
        present: false,
        loadable: false,
        authenticated: false,
        invocable: false,
        status: "MISSING" as const,
        limits,
      };
    }

    // Declarative inventory alone is never OK for dispatch.
    if (!authProven || !invokeProven) {
      return {
        name,
        required: true,
        present: true,
        loadable: true,
        authenticated: authProven ? true : null,
        invocable: invokeProven ? true : null,
        status: "UNKNOWN" as const,
        limits: [
          ...limits,
          "INVENTORY_ONLY_NOT_OK",
          !authProven ? "MCP_AUTH_UNPROVEN" : "",
          !invokeProven ? "MCP_INVOKE_UNPROVEN" : "",
        ].filter(Boolean),
      };
    }

    return {
      name,
      required: true,
      present: true,
      loadable: true,
      authenticated: true,
      invocable: true,
      status: "OK" as const,
      limits: [...limits, "AUTH_AND_INVOKE_FLAGS_SET — still not MCP REAL mutative proof"],
    };
  });
}

/**
 * Fail-closed for required MCP: UNKNOWN / MISSING / UNAVAILABLE block.
 * SCRIPTED_SIMULATED allowed only when caller opts into scripted path.
 * NOT_REQUIRED always ok.
 */
export function assertMcpReadyForDispatch(
  results: McpCapabilityResult[],
  opts?: { allowScriptedSimulation?: boolean },
): { ok: boolean; reason?: string } {
  for (const r of results) {
    if (!r.required || r.status === "NOT_REQUIRED") continue;
    if (r.status === "SCRIPTED_SIMULATED") {
      if (opts?.allowScriptedSimulation) continue;
      return { ok: false, reason: `MCP_SCRIPTED_NOT_ALLOWED:${r.name}` };
    }
    if (r.status === "OK") continue;
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: `MCP_REQUIRED_${r.status}:${r.name}`,
    };
  }
  return { ok: true };
}
```

```typescript
import { StudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";
import type { PublicationPlan, PublicationProgress, PublicationStep } from "./types";

/**
 * Canonical ML4 documentary publication sequence.
 * Contracted vertical: branch → file → PR. No empty/partial client override.
 */
export const NOMINAL_PUBLICATION_STEPS: readonly PublicationStep[] = [
  "CREATE_BRANCH",
  "PUBLISH_FILE",
  "OPEN_PR",
] as const;

const KNOWN = new Set<string>(NOMINAL_PUBLICATION_STEPS);

function reject(message: string): never {
  throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", message, { exposeMessage: true, httpStatus: 400 });
}

/**
 * Strict validation of a steps list.
 * Rejects null, empty, non-array, unknown, duplicates, wrong order, partial sequences.
 */
export function validatePublicationSteps(raw: unknown): PublicationStep[] {
  if (raw === null) reject("steps null refusé");
  if (!Array.isArray(raw)) reject("steps doit être un tableau");
  if (raw.length === 0) reject("steps vide refusé — PUBLISH_FILE obligatoire");

  const steps = raw.map((s) => String(s)) as string[];
  for (const s of steps) {
    if (!KNOWN.has(s)) reject(`étape inconnue refusée: ${s}`);
  }
  if (new Set(steps).size !== steps.length) reject("étape dupliquée refusée");

  const expected = [...NOMINAL_PUBLICATION_STEPS];
  if (steps.length !== expected.length) {
    reject(
      `séquence invalide — attendu exactement ${expected.join("→")} (PUBLISH_FILE obligatoire)`,
    );
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < expected.length; i++) {
    if (steps[i] !== expected[i]) {
      reject(`ordre invalide — attendu ${expected.join("→")}, reçu ${steps.join("→")}`);
    }
  }
  return steps as PublicationStep[];
}

/** undefined → nominal default; otherwise strict validate (null/[] rejected). */
export function resolvePublicationSteps(raw: unknown): PublicationStep[] {
  if (raw === undefined) return [...NOMINAL_PUBLICATION_STEPS];
  return validatePublicationSteps(raw);
}

export function assertPlanPublicationSteps(plan: Pick<PublicationPlan, "steps">): void {
  validatePublicationSteps(plan.steps);
}

/** Historical plans omit effectProviderMode → UNKNOWN (never invent REAL). */
export function qualifyPlanEffectProviderMode(
  plan: Pick<PublicationPlan, "effectProviderMode">,
): "REAL" | "SCRIPTED" | "UNKNOWN" {
  if (plan.effectProviderMode === "REAL" || plan.effectProviderMode === "SCRIPTED") {
    return plan.effectProviderMode;
  }
  return "UNKNOWN";
}

/**
 * Fail-closed gate before COMPLETED / D8 publicationRef.
 * Base SHA alone is never documentary proof.
 */
export function assertPublicationEffectProof(input: {
  plan: PublicationPlan;
  progress: PublicationProgress;
  commitSha: string | null | undefined;
}): void {
  assertPlanPublicationSteps(input.plan);

  if (!input.progress.filePublished) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "AMBIGUOUS",
      "PUBLISH_FILE non prouvé — COMPLETED / D8 refusés",
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }
  if (!input.commitSha || input.commitSha.length === 0) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "AMBIGUOUS",
      "commitSha documentaire absent — COMPLETED / D8 refusés",
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }
  if (input.plan.baseSha && input.commitSha === input.plan.baseSha) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "AMBIGUOUS",
      "SHA de base seul insuffisant comme preuve de publication documentaire",
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }
  if (input.plan.steps.includes("CREATE_BRANCH") && !input.progress.branchCreated) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "AMBIGUOUS",
      "CREATE_BRANCH non prouvé — COMPLETED / D8 refusés",
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }
  if (input.plan.steps.includes("OPEN_PR")) {
    const st = input.progress.prCurrentState;
    if (
      input.progress.prNumber == null ||
      !st ||
      st === "UNKNOWN" ||
      st === "ABSENT"
    ) {
      throw new StudioError(
        "AMBIGUOUS",
        "OPEN_PR non prouvée à distance — COMPLETED / D8 refusés",
        { exposeMessage: true },
      );
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * P0-02 — server-side Cursor workspace confinement.
 * Browser never chooses an arbitrary server path.
 */

import { createHash } from "crypto";
import { mkdirSync, realpathSync, existsSync } from "fs";
import { isAbsolute, join, normalize, relative, resolve, sep } from "path";
import { StudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";

export type WorkspaceResolveInput = {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  /** Optional short key under the project sandbox — never an absolute client path. */
  workspaceKey?: string | null;
  /** Rejected if absolute or escaping — kept only to fail closed on legacy clients. */
  clientDeclaredCwd?: string | null;
  ensureDir?: boolean;
  env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv;
};

export type WorkspaceResolveResult = {
  workspaceCwd: string;
  root: string;
  workspaceKey: string;
  created: boolean;
};

function assertSafeKey(key: string): string {
  const k = key.trim();
  if (!k || k.length > 64) {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "workspaceKey invalide", { exposeMessage: true });
  }
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/.test(k)) {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "workspaceKey caractères refusés", {
      exposeMessage: true,
    });
  }
  if (k.includes("..") || k.includes("/") || k.includes("\\")) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "workspaceKey path traversal", { exposeMessage: true });
  }
  return k;
}

function resolveRoot(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): string {
  const raw = (env.SFIA_CURSOR_WORKSPACE_ROOT || "").trim();
  if (!raw) {
    throw new StudioError(
      "INVALID_REQUEST",
      "SFIA_CURSOR_WORKSPACE_ROOT requis — workspace non choisi par le navigateur",
      { exposeMessage: true },
    );
  }
  if (!isAbsolute(raw)) {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "SFIA_CURSOR_WORKSPACE_ROOT doit être absolu", {
      exposeMessage: true,
    });
  }
  const normalized = normalize(raw);
  if (!existsSync(normalized)) {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "Racine workspace Cursor absente", {
      exposeMessage: true,
    });
  }
  let real: string;
  try {
    real = realpathSync(normalized);
  } catch {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "Racine workspace non résolvable", {
      exposeMessage: true,
    });
  }
  return real;
}

/**
 * Resolve a confined workspace under SFIA_CURSOR_WORKSPACE_ROOT/<pilot>/<project>/<key>.
 * Client absolute paths are always rejected.
 */
export function resolveCursorWorkspace(input: WorkspaceResolveInput): WorkspaceResolveResult {
  const env = input.env ?? process.env;
  if (input.clientDeclaredCwd && input.clientDeclaredCwd.trim()) {
    const declared = input.clientDeclaredCwd.trim();
    if (isAbsolute(declared) || declared.includes("..") || declared.includes("~")) {
      throw new StudioError(
        "ACCESS_DENIED",
        "workspaceCwd client arbitraire refusé — utiliser workspaceKey serveur",
        { exposeMessage: true },
      );
    }
  }

  const root = resolveRoot(env);
  const pilotSeg = createHash("sha256").update(input.pilotId, "utf8").digest("hex").slice(0, 16);
  const projectSeg = createHash("sha256").update(input.projectId, "utf8").digest("hex").slice(0, 16);
  const workspaceKey = assertSafeKey(input.workspaceKey?.trim() || "default");
  const candidate = resolve(join(root, pilotSeg, projectSeg, workspaceKey));

  const rel = relative(root, candidate);
  if (rel.startsWith("..") || isAbsolute(rel)) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Workspace hors racine approuvée", {
      exposeMessage: true,
    });
  }

  let created = false;
  if (input.ensureDir !== false) {
    if (!existsSync(candidate)) {
      mkdirSync(candidate, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
      created = true;
    }
  } else if (!existsSync(candidate)) {
    throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Workspace absent", { exposeMessage: true });
  }

  let real: string;
  try {
    real = realpathSync(candidate);
  } catch {
    throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "Workspace non résolvable", { exposeMessage: true });
  }
  const relReal = relative(root, real);
  if (relReal.startsWith("..") || isAbsolute(relReal) || relReal.split(sep).includes("..")) {
    throw new StudioError("ACCESS_DENIED", "Workspace réel hors confinement", {
      exposeMessage: true,
    });
  }

  return { workspaceCwd: real, root, workspaceKey, created };
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * D8 — qualification of a Cursor realization attempt.
 * Nine rubrics remain consultable. Never merges with D6 reception or Nora opinion.
 */

export type D8RubricKey =
  | "resume"
  | "prevu"
  | "realise"
  | "evaluation"
  | "ecarts"
  | "impact"
  | "verdict"
  | "recommandations"
  | "sources";

export type D8Rubric = {
  key: D8RubricKey;
  title: string;
  content: string;
  coverage: "COMPLETE" | "PARTIAL" | "MISSING" | "UNKNOWN";
};

export type CursorQualificationInput = {
  contractFingerprint: string;
  /** Acceptance criteria from the technical contract (server-side). */
  acceptanceCriteria?: string[];
  expectedProofs?: string[];
  handoffStatus: string | null;
  reportMarkdown: string | null;
  manifest: {
    filesCreated?: string[];
    filesModified?: string[];
    filesDeleted?: string[];
    filesMoved?: Array<{ from: string; to: string }>;
    testsDeclared?: string[];
    testsExecuted?: string[];
    testsCaptured?: string[];
    sourcesConsulted?: string[];
    gaps?: string[];
    git?: { branch?: string | null; baseSha?: string | null; tipSha?: string | null };
  } | null;
  gitFacts?: Array<{ path: string; sha?: string | null }>;
  /** Independent Git facts from D9 when available — null = not checked. */
  gitFactsVerified?: boolean | null;
  terminalStatus?: string | null;
};

export type CursorQualificationResult = {
  rubrics: D8Rubric[];
  verdict: "CONFORMING" | "PARTIAL" | "NON_CONFORMING" | "INDETERMINATE";
  limits: string[];
  testsPass: false;
  conformityProven: false;
  morrisAcceptance: false;
  adopted: false;
};

const RUBRIC_TITLES: Record<D8RubricKey, string> = {
  resume: "Résumé",
  prevu: "Prévu",
  realise: "Réalisé",
  evaluation: "Évaluation",
  ecarts: "Écarts",
  impact: "Impact",
  verdict: "Verdict",
  recommandations: "Recommandations",
  sources: "Sources",
};

export function qualifyCursorRealization(
  input: CursorQualificationInput,
): CursorQualificationResult {
  const limits = [
    "Déclaration Cursor ≠ observation Studio",
    "Observation ≠ conformité D8",
    "Verdict D8 ≠ avis Nora",
    "Avis Nora ≠ réception D6 / acceptation Morris",
    "Aucun ADOPTED depuis une tentative seule",
  ];

  const report = input.reportMarkdown?.trim() || "";
  const hasReport = report.length > 0;
  const handoffOk = input.handoffStatus === "RECEIVED";
  const manifest = input.manifest ?? {};
  const inventory =
    (manifest.filesCreated?.length ?? 0) +
    (manifest.filesModified?.length ?? 0) +
    (manifest.filesDeleted?.length ?? 0);
  const testsDeclared = manifest.testsDeclared?.length ?? 0;
  const testsExecuted = manifest.testsExecuted?.length ?? 0;
  const testsCaptured = manifest.testsCaptured?.length ?? 0;

  const criteria = input.acceptanceCriteria ?? [];
  const expectedProofs = input.expectedProofs ?? [];
  const moved = manifest.filesMoved?.length ?? 0;
  const inventoryAll = inventory + moved;

  if (!hasReport || !handoffOk) {
    limits.push("Rapport absent ou handoff non RECEIVED — bilan PARTIAL/UNKNOWN");
  }
  if (testsDeclared > testsCaptured) {
    limits.push("Tests déclarés sans preuve capturée — PASS refusé (T-07 / PF-PRV)");
  }
  if (testsExecuted > testsCaptured) {
    limits.push("Tests exécutés déclarés sans sortie capturée — non certifiables");
  }
  if (inventoryAll === 0 && hasReport) {
    limits.push("Inventaire fichiers vide — synthèse seule insuffisante");
  }
  if (criteria.length > 0) {
    // Lexical presence of criterion text in Markdown is NOT satisfaction proof (CA-07).
    limits.push(
      `Critères d'acceptation à confronter: ${criteria.length} — présence textuelle ≠ satisfaction`,
    );
    if (!hasReport) {
      limits.push("Rapport absent — critères non évaluables");
    } else {
      limits.push(
        "Évaluation critères: PARTIAL/UNKNOWN jusqu'à preuves indépendantes (tests capturés / D9)",
      );
    }
  }
  if (expectedProofs.length > 0 && (manifest.sourcesConsulted?.length ?? 0) === 0) {
    limits.push("Preuves attendues du contrat sans sources consultées listées");
  }
  if (input.gitFactsVerified === false) {
    limits.push("Faits Git D9 contradictoires ou non vérifiés — D8 refuse conformité");
  }
  if (manifest.git?.tipSha && input.gitFacts?.length) {
    const tip = manifest.git.tipSha;
    const match = input.gitFacts.some((f) => f.sha && f.sha === tip);
    if (!match) {
      limits.push("tipSha manifeste ≠ faits Git D9 — contradiction (T-08)");
    }
  }

  const rubrics: D8Rubric[] = [
    {
      key: "resume",
      title: RUBRIC_TITLES.resume,
      content: hasReport ? report.slice(0, 800) : "Rapport manquant",
      coverage: hasReport ? "PARTIAL" : "MISSING",
    },
    {
      key: "prevu",
      title: RUBRIC_TITLES.prevu,
      content: [
        `Contrat fingerprint ${input.contractFingerprint}`,
        criteria.length ? `Critères: ${criteria.join(" · ")}` : "Critères absents",
        expectedProofs.length
          ? `Preuves attendues: ${expectedProofs.join(" · ")}`
          : "Preuves attendues non listées",
      ].join("\n"),
      coverage: input.contractFingerprint && criteria.length > 0 ? "COMPLETE" : "PARTIAL",
    },
    {
      key: "realise",
      title: RUBRIC_TITLES.realise,
      content: `Inventaire: +${manifest.filesCreated?.length ?? 0} ~${manifest.filesModified?.length ?? 0} -${manifest.filesDeleted?.length ?? 0} ↔${moved}`,
      coverage: inventoryAll > 0 ? "PARTIAL" : hasReport ? "PARTIAL" : "MISSING",
    },
    {
      key: "evaluation",
      title: RUBRIC_TITLES.evaluation,
      content: `Tests déclarés=${testsDeclared} exécutés=${testsExecuted} capturés=${testsCaptured} — PASS certifié=non`,
      coverage: testsCaptured > 0 && testsCaptured >= testsDeclared ? "PARTIAL" : "MISSING",
    },
    {
      key: "ecarts",
      title: RUBRIC_TITLES.ecarts,
      content: (manifest.gaps ?? []).join("; ") || "Écarts non inventoriés",
      coverage: (manifest.gaps?.length ?? 0) > 0 ? "PARTIAL" : "UNKNOWN",
    },
    {
      key: "impact",
      title: RUBRIC_TITLES.impact,
      content: [
        `Terminal SDK: ${input.terminalStatus ?? "unknown"}`,
        manifest.git?.tipSha ? `Git tip déclaré: ${manifest.git.tipSha}` : "Git tip absent",
        input.gitFactsVerified == null
          ? "D9 non consulté"
          : input.gitFactsVerified
            ? "D9 aligné"
            : "D9 divergent",
      ].join("\n"),
      coverage: input.terminalStatus ? "PARTIAL" : "UNKNOWN",
    },
    {
      key: "verdict",
      title: RUBRIC_TITLES.verdict,
      content: "Verdict agrégé ci-dessous — jamais ADOPTED ni réception D6",
      coverage: "PARTIAL",
    },
    {
      key: "recommandations",
      title: RUBRIC_TITLES.recommandations,
      content: "Suite éventuelle = nouveau contrat + acte D6 (pas de relance aveugle)",
      coverage: "COMPLETE",
    },
    {
      key: "sources",
      title: RUBRIC_TITLES.sources,
      content: (manifest.sourcesConsulted ?? []).join(", ") || "Sources non listées",
      coverage: (manifest.sourcesConsulted?.length ?? 0) > 0 ? "PARTIAL" : "MISSING",
    },
  ];

  let verdict: CursorQualificationResult["verdict"] = "INDETERMINATE";
  if (!hasReport || !handoffOk) verdict = "INDETERMINATE";
  else if (
    testsDeclared > testsCaptured ||
    (manifest.gaps?.length ?? 0) > 0 ||
    input.gitFactsVerified === false
  ) {
    verdict = "PARTIAL";
  } else if (inventoryAll > 0 && testsCaptured >= testsDeclared) {
    // Still not CONFORMING without independent proof — stay PARTIAL.
    verdict = "PARTIAL";
    limits.push("Conformité forte non prouvée sans preuves indépendantes D9/tests");
  }

  return {
    rubrics,
    verdict,
    limits,
    testsPass: false,
    conformityProven: false,
    morrisAcceptance: false,
    adopted: false,
  };
}

/**
 * Deterministic technical brief for the dossier — NOT Nora's cognitive analysis.
 * Distinct from D8 qualification, Nora opinion, and D6 decision.
 */
export function buildNoraFinalAnalysisBrief(q: CursorQualificationResult): string {
  const lines = [
    "[BRIEF TECHNIQUE DÉTERMINISTE — pas un avis Nora cognitif]",
    "Dossier de tentative (après fin ou interruption réconciliée).",
    `Verdict D8: ${q.verdict}`,
    "Rubriques:",
    ...q.rubrics.map((r) => `- ${r.title} [${r.coverage}]: ${r.content.slice(0, 200)}`),
    "Limites:",
    ...q.limits.map((l) => `- ${l}`),
    "Distinctions: brief technique ≠ qualification D8 ≠ avis Nora ≠ décision D6.",
    "Ceci n'est pas une HumanDecision ni une acceptation Morris.",
    "Un avis Nora cognitif requiert un run Nora sur ce dossier (sources attachées).",
  ];
  return lines.join("\n");
}

export type NoraAnalysisKind =
  | "TECHNICAL_BRIEF"
  | "DETERMINISTIC_SYNTHESIS"
  | "NORA_COGNITIVE"
  | "UNAVAILABLE";

export function classifyAttachedNoraPayload(markdown: string | null | undefined): NoraAnalysisKind {
  if (!markdown?.trim()) return "UNAVAILABLE";
  if (markdown.includes("BRIEF TECHNIQUE DÉTERMINISTE")) return "TECHNICAL_BRIEF";
  if (markdown.includes("SYNTHÈSE DÉTERMINISTE CONSULTATIVE")) return "DETERMINISTIC_SYNTHESIS";
  if (markdown.includes("ANALYSE COGNITIVE NORA (D3)")) return "NORA_COGNITIVE";
  // Legacy mislabel from cycle 3 — treat as deterministic synthesis, not Nora cognitive.
  if (markdown.includes("ANALYSE COGNITIVE NORA — consultative")) {
    return "DETERMINISTIC_SYNTHESIS";
  }
  return "UNAVAILABLE";
}

/**
 * Deterministic consultative synthesis of the D8 dossier — NOT a Nora D3 cognitive run.
 * Kept for handoff packaging; classify as DETERMINISTIC_SYNTHESIS.
 */
export function buildDeterministicDossierSynthesis(input: {
  qualification: CursorQualificationResult;
  contractTitle?: string | null;
  attemptId: string;
  sourcesAccessible?: string[];
  dossierIncomplete?: boolean;
}): string {
  const q = input.qualification;
  const sources =
    input.sourcesAccessible?.length
      ? input.sourcesAccessible
      : q.rubrics.find((r) => r.key === "sources")?.content
        ? [q.rubrics.find((r) => r.key === "sources")!.content]
        : [];
  const incomplete =
    input.dossierIncomplete ||
    q.verdict === "INDETERMINATE" ||
    q.limits.some((l) => /absent|manqu|incomplet|contradict/i.test(l));

  const lines = [
    "[SYNTHÈSE DÉTERMINISTE CONSULTATIVE — pas un run cognitif Nora D3]",
    `Tentative: ${input.attemptId}`,
    input.contractTitle ? `Contrat: ${input.contractTitle}` : null,
    `Verdict D8 déjà établi: ${q.verdict} (cette synthèse ne le remplace pas).`,
    "",
    "## Lecture du dossier accessible",
    ...q.rubrics
      .filter((r) => r.coverage !== "MISSING")
      .map((r) => `- ${r.title} [${r.coverage}]: ${r.content.slice(0, 240)}`),
    "",
    "## Sources prises en compte",
    ...(sources.length ? sources.map((s) => `- ${s}`) : ["- Aucune source listée dans le dossier"]),
    "",
    "## Réserves",
    ...q.limits.map((l) => `- ${l}`),
    incomplete
      ? "- Dossier incomplet ou contradictoire — aucune conformité fabriquée."
      : "- Dossier partiellement lisible — conformité forte non affirmée.",
    "",
    "## Note",
    "Un avis cognitif Nora requiert un run D3 sur ce dossier (attachNoraCognitive + generateNoraReply).",
    "Distinctions: synthèse déterministe ≠ brief technique ≠ qualification D8 ≠ avis Nora ≠ HumanDecision D6.",
  ];
  return lines.filter((l) => l != null).join("\n");
}

/** @deprecated Use buildDeterministicDossierSynthesis — name was misleading in cycle 3. */
export function buildNoraCognitiveAnalysis(
  input: Parameters<typeof buildDeterministicDossierSynthesis>[0],
): string {
  return buildDeterministicDossierSynthesis(input);
}

/**
 * Prompt envelope for a real D3 Nora cognitive analysis (CA-08).
 * Caller must invoke generateNoraReply; do not treat this string as NORA_COGNITIVE alone.
 */
export function buildNoraCognitiveAnalysisPrompt(input: {
  qualification: CursorQualificationResult;
  contractTitle?: string | null;
  attemptId: string;
  sourcesAccessible?: string[];
}): string {
  const syn = buildDeterministicDossierSynthesis({
    ...input,
    dossierIncomplete: input.qualification.verdict === "INDETERMINATE",
  });
  return [
    "Analyse cognitive finale unique pour la tentative suivante.",
    "Lis le dossier D8 ci-dessous. Produis un avis sourcé, consultatif, sans HumanDecision.",
    "Si le dossier est incomplet, dis-le explicitement. Ne fabrique pas de conformité.",
    "Préfixe ta réponse par: [ANALYSE COGNITIVE NORA (D3)]",
    "",
    syn,
  ].join("\n");
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * C12 / CA-08 — read-only access to D8 realization pieces for Nora.
 * Owner remains D8; Nora never invents paths or reads outside attempt scope.
 * C13: physical confinement (realpath + lstat + O_NOFOLLOW) — no symlink escape.
 */

import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import { effectAttempts, realizationHandoffs } from "@/db/schema";
import type { CursorExecutionPlan } from "@/domains/execution/types";
import type { ToolSourceJournal } from "@/domains/conversation/tool-source-journal";
import { recordToolSource } from "@/domains/conversation/tool-source-journal";
import {
  listEvidenceCapturesForAttempt,
  type EvidenceCaptureMeta,
} from "./evidence-captures";
import {
  D8_MAX_FILE_BYTES,
  readConfinedWorkspaceFile,
  type ConfineDenyReason,
} from "./d8-path-confine";

const MAX_TEXT_CHARS = 24_000;

export type D8ReadCoverage =
  | "FOUND"
  | "OPENED"
  | "CONSULTED"
  | "PARTIAL"
  | "DENIED"
  | "NOT_FOUND"
  | "INTEGRITY_FAIL";

export type D8EvidenceScope = {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  attemptId: string;
  budget: { remainingCalls: number; remainingChars: number };
  /** C13 — per-tool provenance journal (not mere toolCallsObserved). */
  sourceJournal?: ToolSourceJournal | null;
};

function journalD8(
  scope: D8EvidenceScope,
  entry: {
    tool: string;
    ref: string;
    coverage: string;
    title?: string;
    versionOrSha?: string | null;
    notes?: string;
  },
): void {
  recordToolSource(scope.sourceJournal, {
    kind: "DOCUMENT",
    ref: `d8:${entry.tool}:${entry.ref}`,
    coverage: entry.coverage,
    title: entry.title ?? entry.tool,
    versionOrSha: entry.versionOrSha,
    notes: entry.notes,
  });
}

function confineReasonToCoverage(reason: ConfineDenyReason): {
  coverage: D8ReadCoverage;
  reason: string;
} {
  switch (reason) {
    case "FILE_ABSENT":
      return { coverage: "NOT_FOUND", reason: "FILE_ABSENT" };
    case "FILE_TOO_LARGE":
      return { coverage: "DENIED", reason: "FILE_TOO_LARGE" };
    case "SYMLINK_ESCAPE":
    case "SYMLINK_COMPONENT":
      return { coverage: "DENIED", reason: "SYMLINK_REFUSED" };
    case "ROOT_UNRESOLVABLE":
      return { coverage: "DENIED", reason: "WORKSPACE_INVALID" };
    case "NOT_REGULAR_FILE":
      return { coverage: "DENIED", reason: "NOT_REGULAR_FILE" };
    case "OPEN_FAILED":
      return { coverage: "INTEGRITY_FAIL", reason: "OPEN_FAILED" };
    default:
      return { coverage: "DENIED", reason };
  }
}

function charge(scope: D8EvidenceScope, payload: unknown): void {
  const n = JSON.stringify(payload).length;
  scope.budget.remainingChars = Math.max(0, scope.budget.remainingChars - n);
}

function trimText(text: string, max = MAX_TEXT_CHARS): { text: string; coverage: D8ReadCoverage } {
  if (text.length <= max) return { text, coverage: "CONSULTED" };
  return { text: text.slice(0, max), coverage: "PARTIAL" };
}

async function loadAttempt(scope: D8EvidenceScope) {
  const row = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(effectAttempts)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(effectAttempts.id, scope.attemptId),
          eq(effectAttempts.projectId, scope.projectId),
          eq(effectAttempts.pilotId, scope.pilotId),
          eq(effectAttempts.kind, "CURSOR_EXECUTION"),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  return row ?? null;
}

/** List authorized pieces for an attempt — metadata only (FOUND ≠ CONSULTED). */
export async function listRealizationEvidence(scope: D8EvidenceScope) {
  if (scope.budget.remainingCalls <= 0 || scope.budget.remainingChars <= 0) {
    journalD8(scope, {
      tool: "list_realization_evidence",
      ref: scope.attemptId,
      coverage: "DENIED",
      notes: "budget exhausted",
    });
    return {
      coverage: "DENIED" as const,
      reason: "D8_TOOL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED",
      pieces: [] as unknown[],
    };
  }
  scope.budget.remainingCalls -= 1;
  const attempt = await loadAttempt(scope);
  if (!attempt) {
    const out = { coverage: "DENIED" as const, reason: "ATTEMPT_NOT_IN_SCOPE", pieces: [] };
    journalD8(scope, {
      tool: "list_realization_evidence",
      ref: scope.attemptId,
      coverage: "DENIED",
      notes: "out of scope",
    });
    charge(scope, out);
    return out;
  }
  const handoff = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(realizationHandoffs)
      .where(eq(realizationHandoffs.attemptId, scope.attemptId))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  const captures = listEvidenceCapturesForAttempt(scope.attemptId).filter(
    (c) => c.pilotId === scope.pilotId && c.projectId === scope.projectId,
  );
  let plan: CursorExecutionPlan | null = null;
  try {
    plan = JSON.parse(attempt.planJson) as CursorExecutionPlan;
  } catch {
    plan = null;
  }
  const pieces = [
    {
      kind: "HANDOFF_REPORT",
      id: handoff?.id ?? null,
      status: handoff?.status ?? "MISSING",
      integrityHash: handoff?.integrityHash ?? null,
      reportChars: handoff?.reportMarkdown?.length ?? 0,
      coverage: handoff ? ("FOUND" as const) : ("NOT_FOUND" as const),
    },
    ...captures.map((c) => ({
      kind: "EVIDENCE_CAPTURE",
      id: c.id,
      label: c.label,
      mimeType: c.mimeType,
      contentSha256: c.contentSha256,
      byteLength: c.byteLength,
      coverage: "FOUND" as const,
    })),
    {
      kind: "WORKSPACE",
      id: plan?.workspaceKey ?? "default",
      workspaceCwdPresent: Boolean(plan?.workspaceCwd),
      coverage: plan?.workspaceCwd ? ("FOUND" as const) : ("NOT_FOUND" as const),
      note: "Lecture fichier uniquement via read_attempt_workspace_file + chemin relatif",
    },
  ];
  const out = {
    coverage: "OPENED" as const,
    attemptId: scope.attemptId,
    attemptStatus: attempt.status,
    pieces,
  };
  journalD8(scope, {
    tool: "list_realization_evidence",
    ref: scope.attemptId,
    coverage: "DISCOVERED",
    notes: `pieces=${pieces.length} metadata only — content not consulted`,
  });
  charge(scope, out);
  return out;
}

/** Read full handoff report markdown when authorized. */
export async function readRealizationHandoffReport(scope: D8EvidenceScope) {
  if (scope.budget.remainingCalls <= 0 || scope.budget.remainingChars <= 0) {
    journalD8(scope, {
      tool: "read_realization_handoff_report",
      ref: scope.attemptId,
      coverage: "DENIED",
      notes: "budget exhausted",
    });
    return {
      coverage: "DENIED" as const,
      reason: "D8_TOOL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED",
      content: null as string | null,
    };
  }
  scope.budget.remainingCalls -= 1;
  const attempt = await loadAttempt(scope);
  if (!attempt) {
    const out = {
      coverage: "DENIED" as const,
      reason: "ATTEMPT_NOT_IN_SCOPE",
      content: null,
    };
    journalD8(scope, {
      tool: "read_realization_handoff_report",
      ref: scope.attemptId,
      coverage: "DENIED",
      notes: "out of scope",
    });
    charge(scope, out);
    return out;
  }
  const handoff = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(realizationHandoffs)
      .where(eq(realizationHandoffs.attemptId, scope.attemptId))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!handoff?.reportMarkdown?.trim()) {
    const out = {
      coverage: "NOT_FOUND" as const,
      reason: "HANDOFF_REPORT_ABSENT",
      handoffId: handoff?.id ?? null,
      content: null,
    };
    journalD8(scope, {
      tool: "read_realization_handoff_report",
      ref: handoff?.id ?? "absent",
      coverage: "NOT_FOUND",
    });
    charge(scope, out);
    return out;
  }
  const trimmed = trimText(handoff.reportMarkdown);
  const sha = createHash("sha256")
    .update(handoff.reportMarkdown, "utf8")
    .digest("hex");
  const out = {
    coverage: trimmed.coverage,
    handoffId: handoff.id,
    status: handoff.status,
    integrityHash: handoff.integrityHash,
    contentSha256: sha,
    content: trimmed.text,
    consulted: true,
    limits: [
      "D8_HANDOFF_READ — contenu original consulté",
      trimmed.coverage === "PARTIAL" ? "REPORT_TRUNCATED_BY_BUDGET" : null,
    ].filter(Boolean),
  };
  journalD8(scope, {
    tool: "read_realization_handoff_report",
    ref: handoff.id,
    coverage: trimmed.coverage,
    versionOrSha: sha,
    notes:
      trimmed.coverage === "PARTIAL"
        ? "content partial (truncated)"
        : "content consulted",
  });
  charge(scope, out);
  return out;
}

/**
 * Read a text file under the attempt's server-resolved workspaceCwd.
 * relativePath only — physical confinement via readConfinedWorkspaceFile (C13).
 */
export async function readAttemptWorkspaceFile(
  scope: D8EvidenceScope,
  relativePath: string,
) {
  if (scope.budget.remainingCalls <= 0 || scope.budget.remainingChars <= 0) {
    journalD8(scope, {
      tool: "read_attempt_workspace_file",
      ref: relativePath || "(empty)",
      coverage: "DENIED",
      notes: "budget exhausted",
    });
    return {
      coverage: "DENIED" as const,
      reason: "D8_TOOL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED",
      content: null as string | null,
    };
  }
  scope.budget.remainingCalls -= 1;
  const attempt = await loadAttempt(scope);
  if (!attempt) {
    const out = {
      coverage: "DENIED" as const,
      reason: "ATTEMPT_NOT_IN_SCOPE",
      content: null,
    };
    journalD8(scope, {
      tool: "read_attempt_workspace_file",
      ref: relativePath || "(empty)",
      coverage: "DENIED",
      notes: "out of scope",
    });
    charge(scope, out);
    return out;
  }
  let plan: CursorExecutionPlan;
  try {
    plan = JSON.parse(attempt.planJson) as CursorExecutionPlan;
  } catch {
    const out = {
      coverage: "DENIED" as const,
      reason: "PLAN_UNPARSEABLE",
      content: null,
    };
    journalD8(scope, {
      tool: "read_attempt_workspace_file",
      ref: relativePath || "(empty)",
      coverage: "DENIED",
      notes: "plan unparseable",
    });
    charge(scope, out);
    return out;
  }
  if (!plan.workspaceCwd?.trim()) {
    const out = {
      coverage: "DENIED" as const,
      reason: "WORKSPACE_ABSENT",
      content: null,
    };
    journalD8(scope, {
      tool: "read_attempt_workspace_file",
      ref: relativePath || "(empty)",
      coverage: "DENIED",
      notes: "workspace absent",
    });
    charge(scope, out);
    return out;
  }

  // Absolute client paths refused before confinement (contract: relative only).
  const rawPath = (relativePath || "").trim();
  if (rawPath.startsWith("/") || rawPath.startsWith("~")) {
    const out = {
      coverage: "DENIED" as const,
      reason: "ABSOLUTE_PATH_REFUSED",
      content: null,
    };
    journalD8(scope, {
      tool: "read_attempt_workspace_file",
      ref: rawPath.slice(0, 80),
      coverage: "DENIED",
      notes: "absolute path refused",
    });
    charge(scope, out);
    return out;
  }

  const confined = readConfinedWorkspaceFile(plan.workspaceCwd, rawPath, {
    maxBytes: D8_MAX_FILE_BYTES,
  });
  if (!confined.ok) {
    const mapped = confineReasonToCoverage(confined.reason);
    const out = {
      coverage: mapped.coverage,
      reason: mapped.reason,
      path: rawPath,
      content: null as string | null,
      detail: confined.detail,
    };
    journalD8(scope, {
      tool: "read_attempt_workspace_file",
      ref: rawPath || "(empty)",
      coverage: mapped.coverage,
      notes: `${mapped.reason}${confined.detail ? `:${confined.detail}` : ""}`,
    });
    charge(scope, out);
    return out;
  }

  const buf = confined.bytes;
  if (buf.includes(0)) {
    const out = {
      coverage: "DENIED" as const,
      reason: "BINARY_FILE_REFUSED",
      path: rawPath,
      content: null as string | null,
      contentSha256: createHash("sha256").update(buf).digest("hex"),
      byteLength: buf.length,
    };
    journalD8(scope, {
      tool: "read_attempt_workspace_file",
      ref: rawPath,
      coverage: "DENIED",
      versionOrSha: out.contentSha256,
      notes: "binary refused — content not disclosed",
    });
    charge(scope, out);
    return out;
  }
  const raw = buf.toString("utf8");
  if (/BEGIN (RSA |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY|\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}\b/.test(raw)) {
    const out = {
      coverage: "DENIED" as const,
      reason: "SECRET_MATERIAL_REFUSED",
      path: rawPath,
      content: null as string | null,
    };
    journalD8(scope, {
      tool: "read_attempt_workspace_file",
      ref: rawPath,
      coverage: "DENIED",
      notes: "secret material refused — content not disclosed",
    });
    charge(scope, out);
    return out;
  }
  const trimmed = trimText(raw);
  const sha = createHash("sha256").update(buf).digest("hex");
  const out = {
    coverage: trimmed.coverage,
    path: rawPath,
    contentSha256: sha,
    byteLength: buf.length,
    content: trimmed.text,
    consulted: true,
    limits: [
      "D8_WORKSPACE_FILE_READ — contenu original consulté sous cwd tentative",
      "D8_PATH_CONFINED — realpath+lstat+O_NOFOLLOW (C13)",
      trimmed.coverage === "PARTIAL" ? "CONTENT_TRUNCATED_BY_BUDGET" : null,
    ].filter(Boolean),
  };
  journalD8(scope, {
    tool: "read_attempt_workspace_file",
    ref: rawPath,
    coverage: trimmed.coverage,
    versionOrSha: sha,
    notes:
      trimmed.coverage === "PARTIAL"
        ? "content partial (truncated)"
        : "content consulted",
  });
  charge(scope, out);
  return out;
}

/** Capture metadata — image bytes not inlined into Nora text. */
export async function readEvidenceCaptureMeta(
  scope: D8EvidenceScope,
  captureId: string,
): Promise<{
  coverage: D8ReadCoverage;
  reason?: string;
  capture?: EvidenceCaptureMeta;
  note?: string;
}> {
  if (scope.budget.remainingCalls <= 0 || scope.budget.remainingChars <= 0) {
    journalD8(scope, {
      tool: "read_evidence_capture_meta",
      ref: captureId,
      coverage: "DENIED",
      notes: "budget exhausted",
    });
    return { coverage: "DENIED", reason: "D8_TOOL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED" };
  }
  scope.budget.remainingCalls -= 1;
  const attempt = await loadAttempt(scope);
  if (!attempt) {
    const out = { coverage: "DENIED" as const, reason: "ATTEMPT_NOT_IN_SCOPE" };
    journalD8(scope, {
      tool: "read_evidence_capture_meta",
      ref: captureId,
      coverage: "DENIED",
      notes: "out of scope",
    });
    charge(scope, out);
    return out;
  }
  const cap = listEvidenceCapturesForAttempt(scope.attemptId).find(
    (c) =>
      c.id === captureId &&
      c.pilotId === scope.pilotId &&
      c.projectId === scope.projectId,
  );
  if (!cap) {
    const out = { coverage: "NOT_FOUND" as const, reason: "CAPTURE_NOT_FOUND" };
    journalD8(scope, {
      tool: "read_evidence_capture_meta",
      ref: captureId,
      coverage: "NOT_FOUND",
    });
    charge(scope, out);
    return out;
  }
  const out = {
    coverage: "OPENED" as const,
    capture: cap,
    note: "Capture image — métadonnées + SHA uniquement (pas d'inline binaire dans Nora)",
  };
  journalD8(scope, {
    tool: "read_evidence_capture_meta",
    ref: captureId,
    coverage: "DISCOVERED",
    versionOrSha: cap.contentSha256,
    notes: "metadata opened — binary content not consulted",
  });
  charge(scope, out);
  return out;
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Agents SDK wrappers — D8 evidence read tools for post-attempt Nora analysis.
 */
import {
  listRealizationEvidence,
  readAttemptWorkspaceFile,
  readEvidenceCaptureMeta,
  readRealizationHandoffReport,
  type D8EvidenceScope,
} from "./d8-evidence-read";

export type D8ToolBuildScope = {
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  attemptId: string;
  budget: { remainingCalls: number; remainingChars: number };
  /** C13 — shared tool-source journal for per-piece provenance. */
  sourceJournal?: D8EvidenceScope["sourceJournal"];
};

export async function buildNoraD8EvidenceTools(scope: D8ToolBuildScope) {
  const { tool } = await import("@openai/agents");
  const { z } = await import("zod");
  const d8: D8EvidenceScope = {
    pilotId: scope.pilotId,
    projectId: scope.projectId,
    attemptId: scope.attemptId,
    budget: scope.budget,
    sourceJournal: scope.sourceJournal,
  };

  return [
    tool({
      name: "list_realization_evidence",
      description:
        "Liste les pièces D8 autorisées de la tentative (handoff, captures, workspace). Métadonnées seulement — ne pas inventer de chemins.",
      parameters: z.object({}),
      execute: async () => listRealizationEvidence(d8),
    }),
    tool({
      name: "read_realization_handoff_report",
      description:
        "Lit le rapport de handoff original de la tentative courante (contenu markdown). Distingue CONSULTED vs PARTIAL vs NOT_FOUND.",
      parameters: z.object({}),
      execute: async () => readRealizationHandoffReport(d8),
    }),
    tool({
      name: "read_attempt_workspace_file",
      description:
        "Lit un fichier texte relatif au workspace Cursor de la tentative (cwd serveur). Chemin relatif uniquement. Preuve originale ≠ déclaration Cursor.",
      parameters: z.object({
        relativePath: z.string().min(1).max(400),
      }),
      execute: async (args) => readAttemptWorkspaceFile(d8, args.relativePath),
    }),
    tool({
      name: "read_evidence_capture_meta",
      description:
        "Ouvre les métadonnées d'une capture ecap_* liée à la tentative (SHA, mime). Pas d'inline binaire.",
      parameters: z.object({
        captureId: z.string().min(1).max(80),
      }),
      execute: async (args) => readEvidenceCaptureMeta(d8, args.captureId),
    }),
  ];
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * C13 — physical workspace confinement for D8 file reads.
 * Lexical relative-path checks are insufficient: symlinks must not escape.
 */

import {
  closeSync,
  constants as fsConstants,
  fstatSync,
  lstatSync,
  openSync,
  readFileSync,
  realpathSync,
} from "node:fs";
import { join, normalize, relative, resolve, sep } from "node:path";

export const D8_MAX_FILE_BYTES = 256_000;

export type ConfineDenyReason =
  | "UNSAFE_RELATIVE_PATH"
  | "PATH_OUTSIDE_WORKSPACE"
  | "SYMLINK_ESCAPE"
  | "SYMLINK_COMPONENT"
  | "NOT_REGULAR_FILE"
  | "FILE_ABSENT"
  | "FILE_TOO_LARGE"
  | "ROOT_UNRESOLVABLE"
  | "OPEN_FAILED";

export type ConfineResult =
  | {
      ok: true;
      absolutePath: string;
      realPath: string;
      byteLength: number;
      bytes: Buffer;
    }
  | {
      ok: false;
      reason: ConfineDenyReason;
      detail?: string;
    };

function isInsideRoot(rootReal: string, candidateReal: string): boolean {
  if (candidateReal === rootReal) return true;
  const prefix = rootReal.endsWith(sep) ? rootReal : rootReal + sep;
  return candidateReal.startsWith(prefix);
}

/**
 * Resolve and open a relative path under workspaceRoot with symlink confinement.
 * Uses lstat on each path component + final open(O_NOFOLLOW) when available.
 */
export function readConfinedWorkspaceFile(
  workspaceRoot: string,
  relativePath: string,
  opts?: { maxBytes?: number },
): ConfineResult {
  const maxBytes = opts?.maxBytes ?? D8_MAX_FILE_BYTES;
  const rel = (relativePath || "").trim().replace(/^\/+/, "");
  if (
    !rel ||
    rel.includes("\0") ||
    rel.includes("..") ||
    rel.startsWith("~") ||
    rel.startsWith("/") ||
    normalize(rel) !== rel
  ) {
    return { ok: false, reason: "UNSAFE_RELATIVE_PATH" };
  }

  let rootReal: string;
  try {
    rootReal = realpathSync(resolve(workspaceRoot));
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, reason: "ROOT_UNRESOLVABLE" };
  }

  // Walk components: refuse any symlink component (intermediate or final via lstat).
  const parts = rel.split(/[/\\]+/).filter(Boolean);
  let cursor = rootReal;
  for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
    const part = parts[i]!;
    if (part === "." || part === "..") {
      return { ok: false, reason: "UNSAFE_RELATIVE_PATH" };
    }
    const next = join(cursor, part);
    let lst;
    try {
      lst = lstatSync(next);
    } catch {
      return { ok: false, reason: "FILE_ABSENT", detail: rel };
    }
    if (lst.isSymbolicLink()) {
      // Resolve link target and require it stays inside rootReal.
      let targetReal: string;
      try {
        targetReal = realpathSync(next);
      } catch {
        return { ok: false, reason: "SYMLINK_ESCAPE", detail: "unresolvable symlink" };
      }
      if (!isInsideRoot(rootReal, targetReal)) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "SYMLINK_ESCAPE", detail: part };
      }
      // Intermediate symlink into root: follow for continuation but record refusal
      // of opaque escapes. Policy C13: refuse ALL symlinks for D8 Nora reads
      // (simpler, fail-closed) — no symlink components allowed.
      return { ok: false, reason: "SYMLINK_COMPONENT", detail: part };
    }
    if (i < parts.length - 1) {
      if (!lst.isDirectory()) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "NOT_REGULAR_FILE", detail: "non-directory component" };
      }
      cursor = next;
    } else {
      if (!lst.isFile()) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "NOT_REGULAR_FILE" };
      }
      if (lst.size > maxBytes) {
        return {
          ok: false,
          reason: "FILE_TOO_LARGE",
          detail: `size=${lst.size} max=${maxBytes}`,
        };
      }
      cursor = next;
    }
  }

  // Lexical candidate must still resolve under root (defense in depth).
  const lexical = resolve(join(rootReal, rel));
  const relCheck = relative(rootReal, lexical);
  if (relCheck.startsWith("..") || relCheck === "") {
    return { ok: false, reason: "PATH_OUTSIDE_WORKSPACE" };
  }

  let fd: number | null = null;
  try {
    const flags =
      typeof fsConstants.O_NOFOLLOW === "number"
        ? fsConstants.O_RDONLY | fsConstants.O_NOFOLLOW
        : fsConstants.O_RDONLY;
    fd = openSync(cursor, flags);
    const st = fstatSync(fd);
    if (!st.isFile()) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "NOT_REGULAR_FILE" };
    }
    if (st.size > maxBytes) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        reason: "FILE_TOO_LARGE",
        detail: `size=${st.size} max=${maxBytes}`,
      };
    }
    // Read via path after open succeeded — fd already proves no symlink at open time
    // when O_NOFOLLOW is set. Size bounded above.
    const bytes = readFileSync(fd);
    let realPath: string;
    try {
      realPath = realpathSync(cursor);
    } catch {
      realPath = cursor;
    }
    if (!isInsideRoot(rootReal, realPath)) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "SYMLINK_ESCAPE", detail: "realpath escaped after open" };
    }
    return {
      ok: true,
      absolutePath: cursor,
      realPath,
      byteLength: bytes.length,
      bytes,
    };
  } catch (e) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: "OPEN_FAILED",
      detail: String((e as Error)?.message ?? e).slice(0, 120),
    };
  } finally {
    if (fd != null) {
      try {
        closeSync(fd);
      } catch {
        /* ignore */
      }
    }
  }
}

/** Test helper — does not read content. */
export function probeConfinedPath(
  workspaceRoot: string,
  relativePath: string,
): { ok: boolean; reason?: ConfineDenyReason } {
  const r = readConfinedWorkspaceFile(workspaceRoot, relativePath, { maxBytes: 1 });
  if (r.ok) return { ok: true };
  // FILE_TOO_LARGE still means path was confined and existed as regular file
  if (r.reason === "FILE_TOO_LARGE") return { ok: true };
  return { ok: false, reason: r.reason };
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * G07 / Cycle 8 B3 — original evidence captures bound to a Cursor attempt.
 * Local DEV store; SHA integrity; PNG/JPEG magic checks; path safety.
 */

import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { basename, join } from "node:path";
import { newId } from "@/lib/ids";

const MAX_BYTES = 2_000_000;

export type EvidenceCaptureMeta = {
  id: string;
  attemptId: string;
  projectId: string;
  pilotId: string;
  source: "BROWSER" | "PLAYWRIGHT" | "FIGMA_ORACLE" | "MANUAL" | "CLIENT_UPLOAD";
  environment: "DEV" | "RECETTE" | "STABLE" | "TEST";
  createdAt: string;
  viewport: { w: number; h: number } | null;
  buildSha: string | null;
  contentSha256: string;
  mimeType: string;
  label: string;
  relativePath: string;
  byteLength: number;
};

function evidenceRoot(): string {
  const root = process.env.SFIA_EVIDENCE_ROOT?.trim() || join(process.cwd(), ".sfia-evidence");
  if (!existsSync(root)) mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
  return root;
}

export function sha256Buffer(buf: Buffer): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(buf).digest("hex");
}

export function detectImageMime(buf: Buffer): "image/png" | "image/jpeg" | null {
  if (buf.length >= 8 && buf[0] === 0x89 && buf[1] === 0x50 && buf[2] === 0x4e && buf[3] === 0x47) {
    return "image/png";
  }
  if (buf.length >= 3 && buf[0] === 0xff && buf[1] === 0xd8 && buf[2] === 0xff) {
    return "image/jpeg";
  }
  return null;
}

function safeAttemptSegment(attemptId: string): string {
  const base = basename(attemptId);
  if (!/^efx_[a-z0-9-]+$/i.test(base) && !/^[a-z0-9_-]+$/i.test(base)) {
    throw new Error("UNSAFE_ATTEMPT_ID");
  }
  return base;
}

export function storeEvidenceCapture(input: {
  attemptId: string;
  projectId: string;
  pilotId: string;
  bytes: Buffer;
  mimeType?: string;
  label: string;
  source?: EvidenceCaptureMeta["source"];
  environment?: EvidenceCaptureMeta["environment"];
  viewport?: { w: number; h: number } | null;
  buildSha?: string | null;
}): EvidenceCaptureMeta {
  if (!input.bytes?.length) throw new Error("CAPTURE_EMPTY");
  if (input.bytes.length > MAX_BYTES) throw new Error("CAPTURE_TOO_LARGE");
  const detected = detectImageMime(input.bytes);
  if (!detected) throw new Error("CAPTURE_NOT_PNG_OR_JPEG");
  if (input.mimeType && input.mimeType !== detected) {
    throw new Error("CAPTURE_MIME_MISMATCH");
  }
  const attemptSeg = safeAttemptSegment(input.attemptId);
  const id = newId("ecap");
  const contentSha256 = sha256Buffer(input.bytes);
  const ext = detected === "image/jpeg" ? "jpg" : "png";
  const relativePath = join(attemptSeg, `${id}.${ext}`);
  const absDir = join(evidenceRoot(), attemptSeg);
  if (!existsSync(absDir)) mkdirSync(absDir, { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(join(evidenceRoot(), relativePath), input.bytes);
  const meta: EvidenceCaptureMeta = {
    id,
    attemptId: input.attemptId,
    projectId: input.projectId,
    pilotId: input.pilotId,
    source: input.source ?? "BROWSER",
    environment: input.environment ?? "DEV",
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    viewport: input.viewport ?? null,
    buildSha: input.buildSha ?? null,
    contentSha256,
    mimeType: detected,
    label: input.label.slice(0, 200),
    relativePath,
    byteLength: input.bytes.length,
  };
  writeFileSync(join(absDir, `${id}.json`), JSON.stringify(meta, null, 2));
  return meta;
}

export function listEvidenceCapturesForAttempt(attemptId: string): EvidenceCaptureMeta[] {
  let attemptSeg: string;
  try {
    attemptSeg = safeAttemptSegment(attemptId);
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
  const dir = join(evidenceRoot(), attemptSeg);
  if (!existsSync(dir)) return [];
  return readdirSync(dir)
    .filter((f) => f.endsWith(".json"))
    .map((f) => {
      try {
        return JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(dir, f), "utf8")) as EvidenceCaptureMeta;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    })
    .filter((m): m is EvidenceCaptureMeta => Boolean(m && m.attemptId === attemptId));
}

export function readEvidenceCaptureBytes(meta: EvidenceCaptureMeta): Buffer | null {
  const abs = join(evidenceRoot(), meta.relativePath);
  if (!existsSync(abs)) return null;
  const buf = readFileSync(abs);
  if (sha256Buffer(buf) !== meta.contentSha256) return null;
  if (!detectImageMime(buf)) return null;
  return buf;
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * CP-03 / G15 / Cycle 8 B1 — verify requalify proof refs with exact identity.
 * No substring matching. No silent fallback to an old handoff as "new proof".
 */

export type ProofRefCandidate = {
  ref: string;
  kind: "handoff" | "manifest_file" | "capture" | "integrity" | "unknown";
  accessible: boolean;
  attemptId: string | null;
  reason?: string;
};

export type ProofRefVerification =
  | { ok: true; candidate: ProofRefCandidate }
  | { ok: false; reason: string; candidate: ProofRefCandidate };

export type RequalifyProofMode = "new_proof" | "judgment_correction";

export function verifyNewProofRef(input: {
  newProofRef: string;
  attemptId: string;
  handoffId: string | null;
  handoffIntegrityHash: string | null;
  /** Exact paths / ids listed in handoff manifest. */
  manifestRefs: string[];
  captureIds?: string[];
  /**
   * new_proof: requires explicit newProofRef that is not merely the pre-existing handoff id
   *            unless `allowExistingHandoffAsNew` is set with a distinct newer capture/integrity.
   * judgment_correction: may reference existing handoff without claiming a new artifact.
   */
  mode?: RequalifyProofMode;
  /** Prior qualification handoff id — if newProofRef equals this alone in new_proof mode → refuse. */
  priorHandoffId?: string | null;
}): ProofRefVerification {
  const ref = (input.newProofRef || "").trim();
  const mode = input.mode ?? "new_proof";
  const base: ProofRefCandidate = {
    ref,
    kind: "unknown",
    accessible: false,
    attemptId: null,
  };
  if (!ref) {
    return { ok: false, reason: "PROOF_REF_EMPTY", candidate: base };
  }

  const exactManifest = (input.manifestRefs ?? []).find((m) => m === ref);
  const exactCapture = (input.captureIds ?? []).find((c) => c === ref);

  if (exactCapture) {
    return {
      ok: true,
      candidate: {
        ref,
        kind: "capture",
        accessible: true,
        attemptId: input.attemptId,
      },
    };
  }

  if (exactManifest) {
    return {
      ok: true,
      candidate: {
        ref,
        kind: "manifest_file",
        accessible: true,
        attemptId: input.attemptId,
      },
    };
  }

  if (input.handoffIntegrityHash && ref === input.handoffIntegrityHash) {
    return {
      ok: true,
      candidate: {
        ref,
        kind: "integrity",
        accessible: true,
        attemptId: input.attemptId,
      },
    };
  }

  if (input.handoffId && ref === input.handoffId) {
    if (mode === "new_proof") {
      // Echoing the same handoff already on the dossier is not a new proof.
      if (!input.priorHandoffId || ref === input.priorHandoffId) {
        return {
          ok: false,
          reason: "PROOF_REF_NOT_NEW — handoff déjà connu du dossier",
          candidate: { ...base, kind: "handoff", attemptId: input.attemptId },
        };
      }
    }
    return {
      ok: true,
      candidate: {
        ref,
        kind: "handoff",
        accessible: true,
        attemptId: input.attemptId,
      },
    };
  }

  const otherAttempt = /(?:attempt|efx|att)[_-]([a-z0-9-]{8,})/i.exec(ref);
  if (otherAttempt && !input.attemptId.includes(otherAttempt[1]!)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: "PROOF_REF_FOREIGN_ATTEMPT",
      candidate: { ...base, reason: "foreign_attempt_marker" },
    };
  }

  return {
    ok: false,
    reason: "PROOF_REF_NOT_ACCESSIBLE",
    candidate: base,
  };
}

export function collectManifestRefs(manifest: {
  filesCreated?: string[];
  filesModified?: string[];
  captures?: string[];
  gaps?: string[];
  sourcesConsulted?: string[];
} | null): string[] {
  if (!manifest) return [];
  return [
    ...(manifest.filesCreated ?? []),
    ...(manifest.filesModified ?? []),
    ...(manifest.captures ?? []),
    ...(manifest.sourcesConsulted ?? []),
  ].filter(Boolean);
}
```

```typescript
export type ObservedFactInput = {
  factKind: string;
  sha: string;
  prNumber?: number | null;
  detailJson?: string;
};

export type PrCurrentState = "OPEN" | "CLOSED" | "MERGED" | "UNKNOWN" | "ABSENT";

export type QualificationResult = {
  /** Historical: a COMMIT fact was recorded. */
  commitObserved: boolean;
  /** Historical: a PR_OPEN fact was recorded (creation observed). */
  prCreatedHistorically: boolean;
  /**
   * @deprecated Prefer prCreatedHistorically — does NOT mean PR is currently open.
   * Kept for backward-compatible callers; equals prCreatedHistorically.
   */
  prOpen: boolean;
  /** Live remote state when known; UNKNOWN if not supplied. */
  prCurrentState: PrCurrentState;
  mergeObserved: boolean;
  testsPass: false;
  conformityProven: false;
  morrisAcceptance: false;
  adopted: false;
  limits: string[];
};

/**
 * Qualify observed Git facts without inventing live PR openness.
 * Historical PR_OPEN ≠ currently OPEN.
 */
export function qualifyObservedFacts(
  facts: ObservedFactInput[],
  opts?: { prCurrentState?: PrCurrentState },
): QualificationResult {
  const kinds = new Set(facts.map((f) => f.factKind));
  const prCreatedHistorically = kinds.has("PR_OPEN");
  const prCurrentState = opts?.prCurrentState ?? "UNKNOWN";
  const limits = [
    "Commit/PR observés ≠ tests conformes",
    "Merge observé ≠ acceptation Morris",
    "Aucune preuve ADOPTED/STABLE depuis Git seul",
    "Fait historique PR_OPEN ≠ état courant OPEN",
  ];
  if (prCreatedHistorically && prCurrentState === "CLOSED") {
    limits.push("PR créée historiquement puis CLOSED — merge interdit sans nouvelle inspection");
  }
  return {
    commitObserved: kinds.has("COMMIT"),
    prCreatedHistorically,
    prOpen: prCreatedHistorically,
    prCurrentState,
    mergeObserved: kinds.has("MERGE"),
    testsPass: false,
    conformityProven: false,
    morrisAcceptance: false,
    adopted: false,
    limits,
  };
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * DÉC-ML5-GIT Option A — Cursor publishes Git directly under D6 mandate.
 * Studio does NOT publish Cursor code. Studio D9 reads/verifies remote facts.
 *
 * CP-01: preflight uses independent workspace/remote observations — never
 * contract-declared SHA as "observed". No GitHub REAL mutation in this module.
```
