```typescript
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";

export type CursorGitMandate = {
  repositoryFullName: string;
  baseRef: string;
  workBranch: string;
  baseSha: string | null;
  allowedOps: Array<"commit" | "push" | "create_branch">;
  /** PR/merge require distinct mandate — never implied by develop/push. */
  allowPullRequest: boolean;
  allowMerge: boolean;
};

export type ObservedWorkspaceGitFacts = {
  workspacePath: string;
  workspaceExists: boolean;
  gitDirExists: boolean;
  isGitRepo: boolean;
  currentBranch: string | null;
  localHeadSha: string | null;
  originUrl: string | null;
  /** Normalized owner/repo from origin when recognizable. */
  originRepoFullName: string | null;
  /** SHA of base ref — prefer ls-remote (fresh); may fall back to tracking ref. */
  observedRemoteBaseSha: string | null;
  observedWorkBranchRemoteSha: string | null;
  /** true only when SHA came from ls-remote / fresh transport read. */
  remoteBaseFresh: boolean;
  limits: string[];
  errors: string[];
};

/** Map SSH/HTTPS Git remotes to `owner/repo` when possible. */
export function normalizeGitHubRepoFromUrl(url: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!url) return null;
  const raw = url.trim().replace(/\.git$/i, "");
  const https = /^(?:https?:\/\/)?(?:www\.)?github\.com[/:]([^/\s]+)\/([^/\s#?]+)/i.exec(raw);
  if (https) return `${https[1]}/${https[2]}`.toLowerCase();
  const ssh = /^git@github\.com:([^/\s]+)\/([^/\s]+)/i.exec(raw);
  if (ssh) return `${ssh[1]}/${ssh[2]}`.toLowerCase();
  // Local bare / path alias — last two path segments when they look like owner/repo
  const pathish = /(?:^|\/)([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)\/([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)$/.exec(raw.replace(/\/+$/, ""));
  if (pathish && !pathish[1]!.includes(":")) {
    return `${pathish[1]}/${pathish[2]}`.toLowerCase();
  }
  return null;
}

export function reposMatch(authorized: string, observed: string | null): boolean {
  if (!observed) return false;
  return authorized.trim().toLowerCase() === observed.trim().toLowerCase();
}

export type CursorGitPreflightResult =
  | {
      ok: true;
      mandate: CursorGitMandate;
      workspacePath: string;
      remoteUrl: string | null;
      observedBaseSha: string | null;
      observedLocalHead: string | null;
      observedBranch: string | null;
      limits: string[];
    }
  | {
      ok: false;
      reason: string;
      limits: string[];
      observations?: ObservedWorkspaceGitFacts;
    };

export type CursorGitObservation = {
  at: string;
  workBranch: string;
  baseShaDeclared: string | null;
  localHeadSha: string | null;
  remoteHeadShaVerified: string | null;
  publicationStatus:
    | "LOCAL_ONLY"
    | "PUSHED_UNVERIFIED"
    | "REMOTE_VERIFIED"
    | "DIVERGED"
    | "INACCESSIBLE"
    | "DENIED";
  limits: string[];
};

function gitExec(cwd: string, args: string[]): string {
  return execFileSync("git", args, {
    cwd,
    encoding: "utf8",
    stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"],
  }).trim();
}

/** Prompt text alone is never a permission barrier — preflight must check facts. */
export function buildCursorGitMandateFromScope(
  gitScope: {
    required?: boolean;
    repositoryFullName?: string | null;
    baseRef?: string | null;
    workBranch?: string | null;
    baseSha?: string | null;
  } | null | undefined,
  opts?: { allowPullRequest?: boolean; allowMerge?: boolean },
): CursorGitMandate | null {
  if (!gitScope?.required) return null;
  const repositoryFullName = (gitScope.repositoryFullName ?? "").trim();
  const baseRef = (gitScope.baseRef ?? "").trim();
  const workBranch = (gitScope.workBranch ?? "").trim();
  if (!repositoryFullName || !baseRef || !workBranch) return null;
  if (workBranch === "main" || workBranch === "master") {
    return null;
  }
  return {
    repositoryFullName,
    baseRef,
    workBranch,
    baseSha: gitScope.baseSha?.trim() || null,
    allowedOps: ["commit", "push", "create_branch"],
    allowPullRequest: Boolean(opts?.allowPullRequest),
    allowMerge: Boolean(opts?.allowMerge),
  };
}

/**
 * Independent observation of workspace Git facts.
 * Never copies mandate/contract SHA into observed fields.
 */
export function observeWorkspaceGitFacts(workspacePath: string, baseRef: string, workBranch: string): ObservedWorkspaceGitFacts {
  const limits: string[] = ["INDEPENDENT_GIT_OBSERVATION", "CONTRACT_SHA_NOT_USED_AS_OBSERVED"];
  const errors: string[] = [];
  const workspaceExists = existsSync(workspacePath);
  if (!workspaceExists) {
    return {
      workspacePath,
      workspaceExists: false,
      gitDirExists: false,
      isGitRepo: false,
      currentBranch: null,
      localHeadSha: null,
      originUrl: null,
      originRepoFullName: null,
      observedRemoteBaseSha: null,
      observedWorkBranchRemoteSha: null,
      remoteBaseFresh: false,
      limits,
      errors: ["WORKSPACE_MISSING"],
    };
  }
  const gitDirExists = existsSync(join(workspacePath, ".git"));
  let isGitRepo = false;
  try {
    const top = gitExec(workspacePath, ["rev-parse", "--is-inside-work-tree"]);
    isGitRepo = top === "true";
  } catch {
    errors.push("NOT_A_GIT_REPO");
  }

  let currentBranch: string | null = null;
  let localHeadSha: string | null = null;
  let originUrl: string | null = null;
  let observedRemoteBaseSha: string | null = null;
  let observedWorkBranchRemoteSha: string | null = null;
  let remoteBaseFresh = false;

  if (isGitRepo) {
    try {
      currentBranch = gitExec(workspacePath, ["rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD"]);
    } catch {
      errors.push("BRANCH_UNREADABLE");
    }
    try {
      localHeadSha = gitExec(workspacePath, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"]);
    } catch {
      errors.push("LOCAL_HEAD_UNREADABLE");
    }
    try {
      originUrl = gitExec(workspacePath, ["remote", "get-url", "origin"]);
    } catch {
      errors.push("ORIGIN_MISSING");
      limits.push("ORIGIN_URL_UNAVAILABLE");
    }
    /** Fresh read first (ls-remote); tracking ref is stale-cache only. */
    const lsRemoteSha = (ref: string): string | null => {
      try {
        const out = gitExec(workspacePath, ["ls-remote", "origin", `refs/heads/${ref}`]);
        const sha = out.split(/\s+/)[0]?.trim();
        return sha && /^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$/i.test(sha) ? sha : null;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    };
    const trackingSha = (ref: string): string | null => {
      try {
        return gitExec(workspacePath, ["rev-parse", `refs/remotes/origin/${ref}`]);
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    };
    const freshBase = lsRemoteSha(baseRef);
    if (freshBase) {
      observedRemoteBaseSha = freshBase;
      remoteBaseFresh = true;
      limits.push("REMOTE_BASE_VIA_LS_REMOTE");
    } else {
      observedRemoteBaseSha = trackingSha(baseRef);
      if (observedRemoteBaseSha) {
        limits.push("REMOTE_BASE_VIA_TRACKING_REF_MAY_BE_STALE");
      } else {
        errors.push("REMOTE_BASE_UNREADABLE");
        limits.push("REMOTE_BASE_SHA_NOT_OBSERVED");
      }
    }
    const freshWork = lsRemoteSha(workBranch);
    observedWorkBranchRemoteSha = freshWork ?? trackingSha(workBranch);
  }

  return {
    workspacePath,
    workspaceExists,
    gitDirExists,
    isGitRepo,
    currentBranch,
    localHeadSha,
    originUrl,
    originRepoFullName: normalizeGitHubRepoFromUrl(originUrl),
    observedRemoteBaseSha,
    observedWorkBranchRemoteSha,
    remoteBaseFresh,
    limits,
    errors,
  };
}

/**
 * Preflight Option A — requires independent observations.
 * Do NOT pass contract baseSha as observedRemoteBaseSha.
 */
export function preflightCursorGitOptionA(input: {
  mandate: CursorGitMandate | null;
  workspacePath: string;
  authorizedRepos: string[];
  /** Independent observations — prefer observeWorkspaceGitFacts(). */
  observations?: ObservedWorkspaceGitFacts | null;
  /**
   * @deprecated CP-01 — do not use contract SHA. Kept only for explicit fail when
   * callers still pass self-confirming values without observations.
   */
  observedRemoteBaseSha?: string | null;
  workspaceExists?: boolean;
}): CursorGitPreflightResult {
  const limits: string[] = ["OPTION_A_CURSOR_PUBLISHES", "STUDIO_IS_NOT_CODE_PUBLISHER"];
  if (!input.mandate) {
    return { ok: false, reason: "GIT_MANDATE_MISSING", limits: [...limits, "NO_GIT_SCOPE"] };
  }
  const m = input.mandate;
  if (!input.authorizedRepos.includes(m.repositoryFullName)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: "REPO_NOT_AUTHORIZED",
      limits: [...limits, `repo:${m.repositoryFullName}`],
    };
  }
  if (m.allowMerge || m.allowPullRequest) {
    limits.push("PR_OR_MERGE_REQUIRES_DISTINCT_MANDATE_FLAG");
  }

  // CP-01: self-confirming call pattern (contract SHA as observed, workspaceExists:true forced)
  // without independent observations → refuse.
  const obs =
    input.observations ??
    (input.workspaceExists === true && input.observedRemoteBaseSha != null && !existsSync(input.workspacePath)
      ? null
      : observeWorkspaceGitFacts(input.workspacePath, m.baseRef, m.workBranch));

  if (!obs) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: "GIT_OBSERVATION_REQUIRED",
      limits: [...limits, "SELF_CONFIRMING_PREFLIGHT_REFUSED"],
    };
  }

  limits.push(...obs.limits);

  if (!obs.workspaceExists) {
    return { ok: false, reason: "WORKSPACE_MISSING", limits, observations: obs };
  }
  if (!obs.isGitRepo) {
    return { ok: false, reason: "WORKSPACE_NOT_GIT", limits, observations: obs };
  }
  if (!obs.originUrl) {
    return { ok: false, reason: "ORIGIN_MISSING", limits, observations: obs };
  }

  // Origin must match mandate repositoryFullName (normalized), or be an explicit local-bare alias.
  const originMatchesMandate = reposMatch(m.repositoryFullName, obs.originRepoFullName);
  const localBareAlias =
    m.repositoryFullName.startsWith("local-bare/") &&
    input.authorizedRepos.includes(m.repositoryFullName);
  if (!originMatchesMandate && !localBareAlias) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: "ORIGIN_REPO_MISMATCH",
      limits: [
        ...limits,
        `mandate:${m.repositoryFullName}`,
        `origin:${obs.originRepoFullName ?? "unparsed"}`,
      ],
      observations: obs,
    };
  }
  if (localBareAlias && !originMatchesMandate) {
    limits.push("LOCAL_BARE_ALIAS_ORIGIN");
  }

  // Work-branch mandate: refuse if currently on protected default when about to mutate.
  if (obs.currentBranch === "main" || obs.currentBranch === "master") {
    limits.push(`CURRENT_BRANCH_IS_DEFAULT:${obs.currentBranch}`);
  }
  if (
    obs.currentBranch &&
    obs.currentBranch !== m.workBranch &&
    obs.currentBranch !== "HEAD" &&
    obs.currentBranch !== m.baseRef
  ) {
    limits.push(`CURRENT_BRANCH_DIFFERS:${obs.currentBranch}≠${m.workBranch}`);
  }

  // Independent remote base SHA required when mandate declares a baseSha.
  if (m.baseSha) {
    if (!obs.observedRemoteBaseSha) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        reason: "REMOTE_BASE_UNOBSERVED",
        limits: [...limits, `declared:${m.baseSha.slice(0, 12)}`],
        observations: obs,
      };
    }
    if (m.baseSha !== obs.observedRemoteBaseSha) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        reason: "BASE_SHA_DIVERGED",
        limits: [
          ...limits,
          `declared:${m.baseSha.slice(0, 12)}`,
          `observed:${obs.observedRemoteBaseSha.slice(0, 12)}`,
        ],
        observations: obs,
      };
    }
  }

  // Reject legacy callers that pass observedRemoteBaseSha equal to mandate without matching real obs
  // (defense in depth — already covered by observeWorkspaceGitFacts).
  if (
    input.observedRemoteBaseSha != null &&
    input.observations == null &&
    input.observedRemoteBaseSha === m.baseSha &&
    obs.observedRemoteBaseSha !== input.observedRemoteBaseSha
  ) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: "SELF_CONFIRMING_SHA_REFUSED",
      limits: [...limits, "CONTRACT_SHA_ECHO_REJECTED"],
      observations: obs,
    };
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    mandate: m,
    workspacePath: input.workspacePath,
    remoteUrl: obs.originUrl,
    observedBaseSha: obs.observedRemoteBaseSha,
    observedLocalHead: obs.localHeadSha,
    observedBranch: obs.currentBranch,
    limits,
  };
}

/**
 * Publication is only REMOTE_VERIFIED after independent re-read AND local HEAD
 * matches the verified remote SHA for the expected realization.
 * A remote SHA alone (without local HEAD) is not publication of the expected work.
 * Cursor declaring `git push` is never enough.
 */
export function qualifyCursorGitPublication(input: {
  localHeadSha: string | null;
  remoteHeadShaVerified: string | null;
  pushDeclaredByCursor: boolean;
}): CursorGitObservation["publicationStatus"] {
  if (!input.remoteHeadShaVerified) {
    return input.pushDeclaredByCursor ? "PUSHED_UNVERIFIED" : "LOCAL_ONLY";
  }
  if (!input.localHeadSha) {
    // Remote ref exists but we cannot attest the realization commit without local HEAD.
    return input.pushDeclaredByCursor ? "PUSHED_UNVERIFIED" : "INACCESSIBLE";
  }
  if (input.localHeadSha === input.remoteHeadShaVerified) return "REMOTE_VERIFIED";
  return "DIVERGED";
}

export function buildCursorGitObservation(input: {
  workBranch: string;
  baseShaDeclared: string | null;
  localHeadSha: string | null;
  remoteHeadShaVerified: string | null;
  pushDeclaredByCursor: boolean;
  limits?: string[];
}): CursorGitObservation {
  return {
    at: new Date().toISOString(),
    workBranch: input.workBranch,
    baseShaDeclared: input.baseShaDeclared,
    localHeadSha: input.localHeadSha,
    remoteHeadShaVerified: input.remoteHeadShaVerified,
    publicationStatus: qualifyCursorGitPublication(input),
    limits: input.limits ?? ["DETERMINISTIC_GIT_OBS"],
  };
}

/** Re-read remote branch SHA from a workspace (independent of Cursor claim). */
export function verifyRemoteBranchSha(workspacePath: string, branch: string): string | null {
  if (!existsSync(workspacePath)) return null;
  try {
    return gitExec(workspacePath, ["rev-parse", `refs/remotes/origin/${branch}`]);
  } catch {
    try {
      const out = gitExec(workspacePath, ["ls-remote", "origin", `refs/heads/${branch}`]);
      const sha = out.split(/\s+/)[0]?.trim();
      return sha && /^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$/i.test(sha) ? sha : null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
}

/** Local bare + clone harness — DETERMINISTIC only, never GitHub REAL. */
export type LocalGitHarness = {
  root: string;
  barePath: string;
  workPath: string;
  remoteName: string;
  cleanup: () => void;
  run: (cwd: string, args: string[]) => string;
  headSha: (cwd: string) => string;
  pushWorkBranch: (branch: string) => void;
  remoteHead: (branch: string) => string;
};

export function createLocalBareGitHarness(prefix = "sfia-ml5-git-a-"): LocalGitHarness {
  const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), prefix));
  const barePath = join(root, "remote.git");
  const workPath = join(root, "work");
  const run = (cwd: string, args: string[]) =>
    execFileSync("git", args, { cwd, encoding: "utf8" }).trim();
  run(root, ["init", "--bare", barePath]);
  mkdirSync(workPath);
  run(workPath, ["init"]);
  run(workPath, ["config", "user.email", "ml5-git-a@studio.local"]);
  run(workPath, ["config", "user.name", "ML5 Git A Harness"]);
  writeFileSync(join(workPath, "README.md"), "# ML5 Git A harness\n");
  run(workPath, ["add", "README.md"]);
  run(workPath, ["commit", "-m", "init"]);
  run(workPath, ["branch", "-M", "main"]);
  run(workPath, ["remote", "add", "origin", barePath]);
  run(workPath, ["push", "-u", "origin", "main"]);
  const headSha = (cwd: string) => run(cwd, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"]);
  return {
    root,
    barePath,
    workPath,
    remoteName: "local-bare/ml5-git-a",
    cleanup: () => {
      try {
        rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
      } catch {
        /* best-effort */
      }
    },
    run,
    headSha,
    pushWorkBranch: (branch: string) => {
      run(workPath, ["checkout", "-B", branch]);
      writeFileSync(join(workPath, "change.txt"), `change ${Date.now()}\n`);
      run(workPath, ["add", "change.txt"]);
      run(workPath, ["commit", "-m", `ml5 work on ${branch}`]);
      run(workPath, ["push", "-u", "origin", branch]);
    },
    remoteHead: (branch: string) => run(barePath, ["rev-parse", branch]),
  };
}

export function readLocalFileAtRef(repoPath: string, ref: string, filePath: string): string | null {
  try {
    return execFileSync("git", ["show", `${ref}:${filePath}`], {
      cwd: repoPath,
      encoding: "utf8",
    });
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function assertHarnessFile(path: string, expectedSubstring: string): boolean {
  if (!existsSync(path)) return false;
  return readFileSync(path, "utf8").includes(expectedSubstring);
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import {
  createDevAutoSession,
  isDevAutoSessionAllowed,
  resolveStudioSession,
  STUDIO_SESSION_COOKIE,
} from "@/domains/identity/session";
import { probeDevListenConfinement } from "@/domains/identity/dev-listen-probe";

function gateFrom(req: Request) {
  return {
    host: req.headers.get("host"),
    forwardedHost: req.headers.get("x-forwarded-host"),
    forwardedFor: req.headers.get("x-forwarded-for"),
    realIp: req.headers.get("x-real-ip"),
  };
}

async function assertListenConfinedOr403() {
  const port = Number(process.env.STUDIO_PORT || "3100");
  const bind = process.env.STUDIO_DEV_BIND || "";
  const probe = await probeDevListenConfinement({ port, declaredBind: bind });
  if (!probe.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        ok: false,
        autoSessionAvailable: false,
        error: "DEV_AUTO_SESSION_LISTEN_NOT_CONFINED",
        reason: probe.reason,
      },
      { status: 403 },
    );
  }
  return null;
}

function safeNext(raw: string | null): string {
  if (!raw || !raw.startsWith("/") || raw.startsWith("//")) return "/portfolio";
  if (raw.startsWith("/api/")) return "/portfolio";
  return raw.slice(0, 512);
}

/**
 * DÉC-ML5-DEV — establish Pilot A test session without /login UI.
 * GET: capability + optional redirect when auto-session allowed.
 * POST: issue cookie (idempotent if already authenticated).
 * Fail-closed outside DEV + loopback + STUDIO_DEV_AUTO_SESSION=1.
 */
export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const gate = gateFrom(req);
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const next = safeNext(url.searchParams.get("next"));
  const allowed = isDevAutoSessionAllowed(gate);
  if (!allowed) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        ok: false,
        autoSessionAvailable: false,
        error: "DEV_AUTO_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE",
      },
      { status: 403 },
    );
  }
  const listenBlock = await assertListenConfinedOr403();
  if (listenBlock) return listenBlock;
  const existing = await resolveStudioSession().catch(() => null);
  if (existing) {
    if (url.searchParams.has("next")) {
      return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(next, req.url));
    }
    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      alreadyAuthenticated: true,
      pilotId: existing.pilotId,
      authMode: existing.authMode,
      autoSessionAvailable: true,
    });
  }
  try {
    const created = await createDevAutoSession(gate);
    if (url.searchParams.has("next")) {
      const res = NextResponse.redirect(new URL(next, req.url));
      res.cookies.set(STUDIO_SESSION_COOKIE, created.token, {
        httpOnly: true,
        sameSite: "lax",
        path: "/",
        secure: false,
      });
      return res;
    }
    const res = NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      alreadyAuthenticated: false,
      pilotId: created.pilotId,
      authMode: "dev-test-login",
      which: created.which,
      autoSessionAvailable: true,
      notice:
        "FAKE/REAL: DEV auto-session — NOT GitHub OAuth — NOT REAL auth — loopback/DEV only",
    });
    res.cookies.set(STUDIO_SESSION_COOKIE, created.token, {
      httpOnly: true,
      sameSite: "lax",
      path: "/",
      secure: false,
    });
    return res;
  } catch (e) {
    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "FORBIDDEN";
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: msg, autoSessionAvailable: false }, { status: 403 });
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const gate = gateFrom(req);
  if (!isDevAutoSessionAllowed(gate)) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { ok: false, error: "DEV_AUTO_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE", autoSessionAvailable: false },
      { status: 403 },
    );
  }
  const listenBlock = await assertListenConfinedOr403();
  if (listenBlock) return listenBlock;
  const existing = await resolveStudioSession().catch(() => null);
  if (existing) {
    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      alreadyAuthenticated: true,
      pilotId: existing.pilotId,
      authMode: existing.authMode,
      autoSessionAvailable: true,
    });
  }
  try {
    const created = await createDevAutoSession(gate);
    const res = NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      alreadyAuthenticated: false,
      pilotId: created.pilotId,
      authMode: "dev-test-login",
      which: created.which,
      autoSessionAvailable: true,
      notice:
        "FAKE/REAL: DEV auto-session — NOT GitHub OAuth — NOT REAL auth — loopback/DEV only",
    });
    res.cookies.set(STUDIO_SESSION_COOKIE, created.token, {
      httpOnly: true,
      sameSite: "lax",
      path: "/",
      secure: false,
    });
    return res;
  } catch (e) {
    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "FORBIDDEN";
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: msg }, { status: 403 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { completeGitHubAuthorization } from "@/domains/integrations/authorization-service";
import { requireStudioSession } from "@/domains/identity/session";
import { assertScriptedGithubAuthAllowed } from "@/domains/integrations/scripted-github-guard";
import { studioErrorResponse } from "@/lib/http-errors";

/**
 * SCRIPTED completion only — gated by central SCRIPTED guard.
 * Never creates REAL CONNECTED. Client cannot force scripted=true for REAL.
 */
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const session = await requireStudioSession();
    const host = req.headers.get("host");
    assertScriptedGithubAuthAllowed({ requestHost: host });

    const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
      state?: string;
      installationId?: string;
    };
    if (!body.state) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "INVALID_REQUEST", message: "state required" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    // installationId from body is rejected inside complete unless it matches fixture.
    const status = await completeGitHubAuthorization({
      pilotId: session.pilotId,
      state: body.state,
      studioSessionId: session.sessionId,
      installationId: body.installationId,
      requestHost: host,
    });
    return NextResponse.json(status);
  } catch (e) {
    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { requireStudioSession } from "@/domains/identity/session";
import { listMessages, postUserMessageAndNora } from "@/domains/conversation/service";
import { studioErrorResponse } from "@/lib/http-errors";
import { emitObs, newRequestId } from "@/lib/observability";

export async function GET(_: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ preparationId: string }> }) {
  const requestId = newRequestId();
  try {
    const session = await requireStudioSession();
    const { preparationId } = await ctx.params;
    const messages = await listMessages(session.pilotId, preparationId);
    return NextResponse.json({ messages, requestId });
  } catch (e) {
    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    emitObs({
      event_name: "api.messages.get_error",
      component: "api.messages",
      request_id: requestId,
      outcome: "FAILED",
      error_category: mapped.body.errorCategory,
    });
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ preparationId: string }> }) {
  const requestId = newRequestId();
  try {
    const session = await requireStudioSession();
    const { preparationId } = await ctx.params;
    const body = (await req.json()) as {
      content?: string;
      correlationKey?: string;
      clientTurnKey?: string;
      unresolvedPendingClientTurnKey?: string;
      documentFocus?: {
        documentId: string;
        sourceRevisionId: string;
        sourceRevisionNumber?: number;
        /** Client body ignored by server drafting authority (R1). */
        sourceContentMarkdown?: string;
        observedHeadRevisionId: string;
        observedHeadRevisionNumber?: number;
        confirmedHistoricalSource?: boolean;
        historicalConfirmation?: {
          documentId: string;
          sourceRevisionId: string;
          observedHeadRevisionId: string;
          choice: "USE_SOURCE" | "USE_HEAD" | "REFUSED";
        };
        historicalAuthorizationId?: string;
        conserveProposal?: boolean;
        pendingCandidateId?: string;
        pendingCandidateContentSha256?: string;
      } | null;
    };
    if (!body.content?.trim()) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "INVALID_REQUEST", errorCategory: "INVALID_REQUEST" },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }
    const result = await postUserMessageAndNora(
      session.pilotId,
      preparationId,
      body.content.trim(),
      {
        correlationKey: body.correlationKey,
        clientTurnKey: body.clientTurnKey ?? body.correlationKey,
        unresolvedPendingClientTurnKey: body.unresolvedPendingClientTurnKey,
        documentFocus: body.documentFocus ?? null,
        requestId,
      },
    );
    const messages = await listMessages(session.pilotId, preparationId);
    // Pass through factual flags from the turn — never force humanDecisionCreated=false.
    return NextResponse.json({
      ...result,
      messages,
      humanDecisionCreated: Boolean(result.humanDecisionCreated),
      pilotageEffect: result.pilotageEffect ?? null,
      requestId,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    emitObs({
      event_name: "api.messages.post_error",
      component: "api.messages",
      request_id: requestId,
      outcome: "FAILED",
      error_category: mapped.body.errorCategory,
    });
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { requireStudioSession } from "@/domains/identity/session";
import { lookupDurableTurnByClientKey } from "@/domains/conversation/service";
import { studioErrorResponse } from "@/lib/http-errors";
import { emitObs, newRequestId } from "@/lib/observability";

/**
 * GET — R05 cognitive recovery read path.
 * Returns durable turn status by clientTurnKey. Never mutates, never calls Nora.
 */
export async function GET(
  _: Request,
  ctx: { params: Promise<{ preparationId: string; clientTurnKey: string }> },
) {
  const requestId = newRequestId();
  try {
    const session = await requireStudioSession();
    const { preparationId, clientTurnKey } = await ctx.params;
    const decoded = decodeURIComponent(clientTurnKey);
    const result = await lookupDurableTurnByClientKey(
      session.pilotId,
      preparationId,
      decoded,
    );
    emitObs({
      event_name: "d3.turn.durable_lookup",
      component: "api.turns.by_key",
      request_id: requestId,
      operation_id: result.operationId ?? undefined,
      generation_id: result.generationId ?? undefined,
      outcome: result.found ? "SUCCESS" : "UNKNOWN",
      meta: {
        status: result.status,
        found: result.found,
        effect_attempted: Boolean(result.pilotageEffect?.attempted),
      },
    });
    if (!result.found) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          found: false,
          status: null,
          pilotageEffect: null,
          requestId,
          errorCategory: "TURN_NOT_FOUND",
        },
        { status: 404 },
      );
    }
    return NextResponse.json({
      found: true,
      turnCommandId: result.turnCommandId,
      status: result.status,
      generationId: result.generationId,
      operationId: result.operationId,
      userMessageId: result.userMessageId,
      assistantMessageId: result.assistantMessageId,
      pilotageEffect: result.pilotageEffect,
      idempotentReplay: true,
      noraMode: result.noraMode,
      requestId,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    emitObs({
      event_name: "api.turns.by_key_error",
      component: "api.turns.by_key",
      request_id: requestId,
      outcome: "FAILED",
      error_category: mapped.body.errorCategory,
    });
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import { effectAttempts } from "@/db/schema";
import {
  attemptIsNoraMission,
  resumeMissionAfterPublicationAuthorize,
} from "@/domains/conversation/mission-continuity";
import { reconcileAttempt } from "@/domains/execution/effect-service";
import { requireStudioSession } from "@/domains/identity/session";
import { studioErrorResponse } from "@/lib/http-errors";

/**
 * Nominal recovery surface (P0-B): for Nora-mission attempts left AUTHORIZED
 * after a crash between D6 commit and dispatch, reconcile triggers mission resume.
 * Classic (non-mission) attempts keep pure reconcileAttempt behavior.
 */
export async function POST(
  _req: Request,
  ctx: { params: Promise<{ projectId: string; attemptId: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const session = await requireStudioSession();
    const { projectId, attemptId } = await ctx.params;

    const row = (
      await db
        .select()
        .from(effectAttempts)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(effectAttempts.id, attemptId),
            eq(effectAttempts.projectId, projectId),
            eq(effectAttempts.pilotId, session.pilotId),
          ),
        )
        .limit(1)
    )[0];

    if (row && attemptIsNoraMission(row) && (row.status === "AUTHORIZED" || row.status === "DISPATCHED")) {
      const missionResume = await resumeMissionAfterPublicationAuthorize({
        pilotId: session.pilotId,
        projectId,
        attemptId,
        decisionId: row.decisionId,
      });
      return NextResponse.json({
        attemptId,
        status: missionResume.status,
        noraMission: true,
        missionResume,
      });
    }

    const result = await reconcileAttempt(session.pilotId, projectId, attemptId);
    return NextResponse.json({ ...result, noraMission: false });
  } catch (e) {
    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import { effectAttempts } from "@/db/schema";
import {
  attemptIsNoraMission,
  resumeMissionAfterPublicationAuthorize,
} from "@/domains/conversation/mission-continuity";
import { authorizePublication } from "@/domains/execution/effect-service";
import { requireStudioSession } from "@/domains/identity/session";
import { studioErrorResponse } from "@/lib/http-errors";

export async function POST(
  req: Request,
  ctx: { params: Promise<{ projectId: string; attemptId: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const session = await requireStudioSession();
    const { projectId, attemptId } = await ctx.params;
    const body = (await req.json()) as {
      statement?: string;
      inspectedFingerprint?: string;
      /**
       * Test escape hatch only. Membership to a Nora mission is decided SERVER-SIDE
       * via correlationKey `pub:mission:*` — never via this client flag alone.
       */
      autoResumeMission?: boolean;
    };
    if (!body.inspectedFingerprint) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "INVALID_REQUEST", message: "inspectedFingerprint requis" },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }
    const result = await authorizePublication({
      pilotId: session.pilotId,
      projectId,
      attemptId,
      statement: body.statement ?? "Mandat publication Git",
      inspectedFingerprint: body.inspectedFingerprint,
    });

    // P0-A: auto-resume ONLY for server-qualified Nora missions.
    // Classic panel prepares (`pub-${projectId}-…`) keep authorize → manual dispatch.
    const attemptRow = (
      await db
        .select()
        .from(effectAttempts)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(effectAttempts.id, attemptId),
            eq(effectAttempts.projectId, projectId),
            eq(effectAttempts.pilotId, session.pilotId),
          ),
        )
        .limit(1)
    )[0];

    let missionResume: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof resumeMissionAfterPublicationAuthorize>> | null =
      null;
    const isMission = attemptRow ? attemptIsNoraMission(attemptRow) : false;
    if (
      isMission &&
      body.autoResumeMission !== false &&
      (result.status === "AUTHORIZED" || result.status === "COMPLETED" || result.status === "DISPATCHED")
    ) {
      // Immediate resume in this request; P0-B recoverAuthorizedNoraMissions covers crash window.
      missionResume = await resumeMissionAfterPublicationAuthorize({
        pilotId: session.pilotId,
        projectId,
        attemptId,
        decisionId: result.decisionId,
      });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      ...result,
      noraMission: isMission,
      missionResume,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import { preparationProjectLinks, preparations, projects } from "@/db/schema";
import { requireStudioSession } from "@/domains/identity/session";
import {
  readConversationMessages,
  resolveAuthorizedHistoryScope,
} from "@/domains/conversation/history-tools";
import { studioErrorResponse } from "@/lib/http-errors";

/**
 * J-C13 — exact message re-read under project-authorized history scope.
 * Rights revalidated at read time; never auto-sends.
 */
export async function GET(
  _: Request,
  ctx: { params: Promise<{ projectId: string; messageId: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const session = await requireStudioSession();
    const { projectId, messageId } = await ctx.params;

    const project = (
      await db
        .select()
        .from(projects)
        .where(and(eq(projects.id, projectId), eq(projects.ownerPilotId, session.pilotId)))
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    if (!project) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "NOT_FOUND", reason: "Projet introuvable", message: null },
        { status: 404 },
      );
    }

    const link = (
      await db
        .select({ preparationId: preparationProjectLinks.preparationId })
        .from(preparationProjectLinks)
        .innerJoin(preparations, eq(preparations.id, preparationProjectLinks.preparationId))
        .where(
          and(
            eq(preparationProjectLinks.projectId, projectId),
            eq(preparations.ownerPilotId, session.pilotId),
          ),
        )
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    if (!link) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "NOT_FOUND", reason: "Aucune préparation liée", message: null },
        { status: 404 },
      );
    }

    const scope = await resolveAuthorizedHistoryScope({
      pilotId: session.pilotId,
      preparationId: link.preparationId,
    });
    if ("denied" in scope) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { status: "DENIED", reason: scope.reason, message: null },
        { status: 403 },
      );
    }
    const read = await readConversationMessages({
      scope,
      messageIds: [messageId],
    });
    const item = read.items[0] ?? null;
    if (!item) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          status: "NOT_FOUND",
          reason: "message absent, hors périmètre, ou inaccessible",
          message: null,
          coverage: read.coverage,
        },
        { status: 404 },
      );
    }
    return NextResponse.json({
      status: "AVAILABLE",
      message: item,
      coverage: read.coverage,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { authorizeCursorExecution } from "@/domains/execution/cursor-attempt-service";
import { requireStudioSession } from "@/domains/identity/session";
import { studioErrorResponse } from "@/lib/http-errors";

export async function POST(
  req: Request,
  ctx: { params: Promise<{ projectId: string; attemptId: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const session = await requireStudioSession();
    const { projectId, attemptId } = await ctx.params;
    const body = (await req.json()) as {
      statement?: string;
      inspectedFingerprint?: string;
      /** Explicit Oui/Non — must be boolean. Absent/null/invalid = no HumanDecision. */
      confirmed?: unknown;
    };
    if (!body.statement || !body.inspectedFingerprint) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "INVALID_REQUEST" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    // C10 / T-02 — confirmed must be an explicit boolean.
    // Absent, null, or non-boolean → reject without HumanDecision / mutation.
    if (typeof body.confirmed !== "boolean") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: "CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED",
          message:
            "confirmed doit être true (Oui) ou false (Non) — absence/null/invalide = aucun acte D6",
        },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }
    const result = await authorizeCursorExecution({
      pilotId: session.pilotId,
      projectId,
      attemptId,
      statement: body.statement,
      inspectedFingerprint: body.inspectedFingerprint,
      confirmed: body.confirmed,
    });
    return NextResponse.json(result);
  } catch (e) {
    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getCursorAttempt } from "@/domains/execution/cursor-attempt-service";
import {
  listEvidenceCapturesForAttempt,
  storeEvidenceCapture,
} from "@/domains/proofs/evidence-captures";
import { requireStudioSession } from "@/domains/identity/session";
import { studioErrorResponse, StudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";

/** G07 — list / store original evidence captures for an attempt (DEV). */
export async function GET(
  _req: Request,
  ctx: { params: Promise<{ projectId: string; attemptId: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const session = await requireStudioSession();
    const { projectId, attemptId } = await ctx.params;
    await getCursorAttempt({
      pilotId: session.pilotId,
      projectId,
      attemptId,
    });
    const captures = listEvidenceCapturesForAttempt(attemptId).filter(
      (c) => c.pilotId === session.pilotId && c.projectId === projectId,
    );
    return NextResponse.json({ captures });
  } catch (e) {
    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}

export async function POST(
  req: Request,
  ctx: { params: Promise<{ projectId: string; attemptId: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const session = await requireStudioSession();
    const { projectId, attemptId } = await ctx.params;
    await getCursorAttempt({
      pilotId: session.pilotId,
      projectId,
      attemptId,
    });
    const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
      /** Base64 PNG/JPEG — DEV fixtures only; no secrets. */
      dataBase64?: string;
      label?: string;
      mimeType?: string;
      viewport?: { w: number; h: number };
    };
    if (!body.dataBase64 || !body.label) {
      throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "dataBase64 et label requis", {
        exposeMessage: true,
      });
    }
    if (body.dataBase64.length > 2_500_000) {
      throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "capture trop volumineuse", {
        exposeMessage: true,
      });
    }
    const bytes = Buffer.from(body.dataBase64, "base64");
    const meta = storeEvidenceCapture({
      attemptId,
      projectId,
      pilotId: session.pilotId,
      bytes,
      label: body.label,
      mimeType: body.mimeType,
      viewport: body.viewport ?? null,
      source: "BROWSER",
      environment: "DEV",
      buildSha: process.env.SFIA_BUILD_SHA ?? null,
    });
    return NextResponse.json({ capture: meta });
  } catch (e) {
    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import {
  getRealizationHandoff,
  ingestRealizationHandoff,
  type HandoffManifest,
} from "@/domains/execution/cursor-handoff";
import { requireStudioSession } from "@/domains/identity/session";
import { studioErrorResponse } from "@/lib/http-errors";

export async function GET(
  _req: Request,
  ctx: { params: Promise<{ projectId: string; attemptId: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const session = await requireStudioSession();
    const { projectId, attemptId } = await ctx.params;
    const result = await getRealizationHandoff({
      pilotId: session.pilotId,
      projectId,
      attemptId,
    });
    return NextResponse.json(result);
  } catch (e) {
    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}

export async function POST(
  req: Request,
  ctx: { params: Promise<{ projectId: string; attemptId: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const session = await requireStudioSession();
    const { projectId, attemptId } = await ctx.params;
    const body = (await req.json()) as {
      reportMarkdown?: string;
      manifest?: HandoffManifest;
      expectedContractFingerprint?: string;
      provenance?: {
        acquisition?: "CLIENT_DECLARED" | "SCRIPTED_ADAPTER" | "RUNTIME_COLLECTED" | "UNKNOWN";
        declaredExecutorId?: string | null;
        observedAgentId?: string | null;
        observedRunId?: string | null;
      };
    };
    if (
      typeof body.reportMarkdown !== "string" ||
      !body.manifest ||
      !body.expectedContractFingerprint
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "INVALID_REQUEST" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    // Client may never self-attest RUNTIME_COLLECTED (CF-09).
    const clientAcquisition = body.provenance?.acquisition;
    if (clientAcquisition === "RUNTIME_COLLECTED") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: "INVALID_REQUEST",
          message: "RUNTIME_COLLECTED réservé au runtime serveur — pas au client",
        },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }
    const acquisition =
      clientAcquisition === "SCRIPTED_ADAPTER" ||
      clientAcquisition === "CLIENT_DECLARED" ||
      clientAcquisition === "UNKNOWN"
        ? clientAcquisition
        : "CLIENT_DECLARED";
    const result = await ingestRealizationHandoff({
      pilotId: session.pilotId,
      projectId,
      attemptId,
      reportMarkdown: body.reportMarkdown,
      manifest: body.manifest,
      expectedContractFingerprint: body.expectedContractFingerprint,
      provenance: {
        acquisition,
        declaredExecutorId: body.provenance?.declaredExecutorId,
        observedAgentId: body.provenance?.observedAgentId,
        observedRunId: body.provenance?.observedRunId,
      },
    });
    return NextResponse.json(result);
  } catch (e) {
    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { and, eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import { effectAttempts, realizationHandoffs, realizationQualifications } from "@/db/schema";
import { getCursorAttempt } from "@/domains/execution/cursor-attempt-service";
import { getTechnicalContract } from "@/domains/execution/technical-contract";
import type { HandoffManifest } from "@/domains/execution/handoff-integrity";
import {
  buildDeterministicDossierSynthesis,
  buildNoraCognitiveAnalysisPrompt,
  buildNoraFinalAnalysisBrief,
  classifyAttachedNoraPayload,
  qualifyCursorRealization,
} from "@/domains/proofs/cursor-qualify";
import { generateNoraReply } from "@/domains/conversation/nora-adapter";
import {
  collectManifestRefs,
  verifyNewProofRef,
} from "@/domains/proofs/proof-ref-verify";
import { listEvidenceCapturesForAttempt } from "@/domains/proofs/evidence-captures";
import { requireStudioSession } from "@/domains/identity/session";
import { newId } from "@/lib/ids";
import { studioErrorResponse, StudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";

export async function GET(
  _req: Request,
  ctx: { params: Promise<{ projectId: string; attemptId: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const session = await requireStudioSession();
    const { projectId, attemptId } = await ctx.params;
    await getCursorAttempt({
      pilotId: session.pilotId,
      projectId,
      attemptId,
    });
    const row = (
      await db
        .select()
        .from(realizationQualifications)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(realizationQualifications.attemptId, attemptId),
            eq(realizationQualifications.projectId, projectId),
            eq(realizationQualifications.pilotId, session.pilotId),
          ),
        )
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    if (!row) return NextResponse.json({ status: "MISSING", qualification: null });
    const markdown = row.noraAnalysisMarkdown;
    let history: unknown[] = [];
    try {
      history = JSON.parse(row.historyJson || "[]") as unknown[];
    } catch {
      history = [];
    }
    return NextResponse.json({
      status: row.status,
      qualification: {
        id: row.id,
        verdict: row.verdict,
        rubrics: JSON.parse(row.rubricsJson || "{}"),
        noraAnalysisMarkdown: markdown,
        noraAnalysisKind: classifyAttachedNoraPayload(markdown),
        noraAnalysisAt: row.noraAnalysisAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
        limits: JSON.parse(row.limitsJson || "[]"),
        history,
        updatedAt: row.updatedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}

export async function POST(
  req: Request,
  ctx: { params: Promise<{ projectId: string; attemptId: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const session = await requireStudioSession();
    const { projectId, attemptId } = await ctx.params;
    const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
      attachNoraAnalysis?: boolean;
      /** Prefer cognitive analysis (CA-08). Technical brief remains available. */
      attachNoraCognitive?: boolean;
      /** G15 — dated requalification on new proofs; never re-dispatches Cursor. */
      requalify?: boolean;
      reason?: string;
      /** Optional optimistic concurrency — ISO updatedAt from GET. */
      expectedUpdatedAt?: string;
      /** Optional — correlate requalify to new proof artifact id/ref. */
      newProofRef?: string;
    };
    const attempt = await getCursorAttempt({
      pilotId: session.pilotId,
      projectId,
      attemptId,
    });
    const handoff = (
      await db
        .select()
        .from(realizationHandoffs)
        .where(eq(realizationHandoffs.attemptId, attemptId))
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    const manifest = handoff
      ? (JSON.parse(handoff.manifestJson || "{}") as HandoffManifest)
      : null;

    let contractTitle: string | null = null;
    let acceptanceCriteria: string[] = [];
    let expectedProofs: string[] = [];
    let preparationId: string | null = null;
    try {
      const contract = await getTechnicalContract({
        pilotId: session.pilotId,
        projectId,
        contractId: attempt.plan.contractId,
      });
      contractTitle = contract.body.title;
      acceptanceCriteria = contract.body.acceptance?.criteria ?? [];
      expectedProofs = contract.body.acceptance?.expectedProofs ?? [];
      preparationId = contract.preparationId ?? null;
    } catch {
      /* contract may be missing — qualify with fingerprint only */
    }

    const existing = (
      await db
        .select()
        .from(realizationQualifications)
        .where(eq(realizationQualifications.attemptId, attemptId))
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    const requalify =
      Boolean(body.requalify) && Boolean((body.reason ?? "").trim());
    if (existing && !requalify) {
      throw new StudioError("CONFLICT", "Qualification déjà enregistrée pour cette tentative", {
        exposeMessage: true,
      });
    }
    if (existing && body.requalify && !(body.reason ?? "").trim()) {
      throw new StudioError("INVALID_REQUEST", "requalify exige une raison datée", {
        exposeMessage: true,
      });
    }
    const efx = (
      await db
        .select({ id: effectAttempts.id })
        .from(effectAttempts)
        .where(eq(effectAttempts.id, attemptId))
        .limit(1)
    )[0];
    if (!efx) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Tentative introuvable");

    const now = new Date();

    /** CP-03 — build qualification from currently observed dossier (handoff + captures). */
    function evaluateQualificationOnly() {
      return qualifyCursorRealization({
        contractFingerprint: attempt.fingerprint,
        acceptanceCriteria,
        expectedProofs,
        handoffStatus: handoff?.status ?? null,
        reportMarkdown: handoff?.reportMarkdown ?? null,
        manifest,
        terminalStatus: attempt.live.terminalStatus ?? null,
      });
    }

    /**
     * CA-08 — real D3 Nora cognitive analysis when attachNoraCognitive.
     * Never invent NORA_COGNITIVE from the deterministic synthesis alone.
     * Provider failure → deterministic fallback with explicit limit (not silent success).
     */
    async function attachNoraAnalysisMarkdown(
      q: ReturnType<typeof qualifyCursorRealization>,
    ): Promise<{ finalMarkdown: string | null; noraKind: ReturnType<typeof classifyAttachedNoraPayload>; limits: string[] }> {
      const dossierIncomplete =
        q.verdict === "INDETERMINATE" || !handoff || handoff.status !== "RECEIVED";
      const limits: string[] = [...q.limits];

      if (body.attachNoraCognitive) {
        const prompt = [
          buildNoraCognitiveAnalysisPrompt({
            qualification: q,
            contractTitle,
            attemptId,
            sourcesAccessible: manifest?.sourcesConsulted,
          }),
          "",
          "OUTILS D8 OBLIGATOIRES pour cette analyse:",
          "- list_realization_evidence",
          "- read_realization_handoff_report (rapport intégral, pas un extrait fourni)",
          "- read_attempt_workspace_file pour tout fichier témoin cité (chemin relatif)",
          "Distingue explicitement: pièce CONSULTÉE vs métadonnée vs déclaration Cursor vs inaccessible.",
          "N'affirme jamais avoir lu un fichier sans l'avoir ouvert via outil.",
        ].join("\n");
        try {
          const reply = await generateNoraReply({
            userText: prompt,
            contextSnippets: [
              `attemptId=${attemptId}`,
              `contractTitle=${contractTitle ?? ""}`,
              `handoffStatus=${handoff?.status ?? "NONE"}`,
              `verdict=${q.verdict}`,
              `terminalStatus=${attempt.live.terminalStatus ?? "null"}`,
              `agentId=${attempt.live.agentId ?? "null"}`,
              `runId=${attempt.live.runId ?? "null"}`,
              // C12: excerpt is navigation only — full report via D8 tool.
              `reportExcerptHint=${(handoff?.reportMarkdown ?? "").slice(0, 500)}`,
              `workspaceHint=${attempt.plan.workspaceCwd ?? ""}`,
            ],
            toolScope: preparationId
              ? {
                  pilotId: session.pilotId,
                  preparationId,
                  operationId: `d8-nora-${attemptId}`,
                  projectId,
                  attemptId,
                }
              : undefined,
          });
          const raw = (reply.content ?? "").trim();
          const prefixed = raw.includes("ANALYSE COGNITIVE NORA (D3)")
            ? raw
            : `[ANALYSE COGNITIVE NORA (D3)]\n\n${raw}`;
          const liveOk =
            reply.mode === "openai-agents-sdk-live" &&
            reply.status === "COMPLETE" &&
            raw.length > 0;
          const toolsUsed = reply.toolCallsObserved ?? 0;
          if (liveOk) {
            limits.push(
              "NORA_COGNITIVE — run D3 post-tentative",
              `NORA_MODE_${reply.mode}`,
              reply.modelApplied
                ? `NORA_MODEL_${reply.modelApplied}`
                : "NORA_MODEL_UNVERIFIED",
              `NORA_TOOL_CALLS_${toolsUsed}`,
              toolsUsed > 0
                ? "NORA_D8_TOOLS_OBSERVED"
                : "NORA_D8_TOOLS_NOT_OBSERVED — consultation originale non prouvée par toolCalls",
            );
            return {
              finalMarkdown: prefixed,
              noraKind: "NORA_COGNITIVE",
              limits,
            };
          }
          limits.push(
            `NORA_COGNITIVE_UNAVAILABLE — mode=${reply.mode} status=${reply.status}`,
            "FALLBACK_DETERMINISTIC_SYNTHESIS",
          );
        } catch (e) {
          limits.push(
            `NORA_COGNITIVE_ERROR:${String((e as Error)?.message ?? e).slice(0, 80)}`,
            "FALLBACK_DETERMINISTIC_SYNTHESIS",
          );
        }
        const syn = buildDeterministicDossierSynthesis({
          qualification: q,
          contractTitle,
          attemptId,
          sourcesAccessible: manifest?.sourcesConsulted,
          dossierIncomplete,
        });
        return {
          finalMarkdown: syn,
          noraKind: classifyAttachedNoraPayload(syn),
          limits: [
            ...limits,
            "DETERMINISTIC_SYNTHESIS — pas un run cognitif Nora D3 ; CA-08 LIVE encore ouvert",
          ],
        };
      }

      if (body.attachNoraAnalysis) {
        const brief = buildNoraFinalAnalysisBrief(q);
        return {
          finalMarkdown: brief,
          noraKind: classifyAttachedNoraPayload(brief),
          limits: [
            ...limits,
            "NORA_ATTACHMENT_IS_TECHNICAL_BRIEF — avis cognitif Nora non exécuté",
          ],
        };
      }

      return { finalMarkdown: null, noraKind: "UNAVAILABLE", limits };
    }

    async function evaluateFromObserved() {
      const q = evaluateQualificationOnly();
      const attached = await attachNoraAnalysisMarkdown(q);
      return { q, ...attached };
    }

    if (existing && requalify) {
      const reason = (body.reason ?? "").trim().slice(0, 500);
      const newProofRef = (body.newProofRef ?? "").trim().slice(0, 200);
      const requalifyMode =
        (body as { requalifyMode?: string }).requalifyMode === "judgment_correction"
          ? ("judgment_correction" as const)
          : ("new_proof" as const);
      if (requalifyMode === "new_proof" && !newProofRef) {
        throw new StudioError(
          "INVALID_REQUEST",
          "requalify new_proof exige newProofRef explicite — pas de fallback handoff",
          { exposeMessage: true },
        );
      }
      const captures = listEvidenceCapturesForAttempt(attemptId).filter(
        (c) => c.pilotId === session.pilotId && c.projectId === projectId,
      );
      const proofCheck = verifyNewProofRef({
        newProofRef: newProofRef || (requalifyMode === "judgment_correction" ? handoff?.id || "" : ""),
        attemptId,
        handoffId: handoff?.id ?? null,
        handoffIntegrityHash: handoff?.integrityHash ?? null,
        manifestRefs: collectManifestRefs(manifest),
        captureIds: captures.map((c) => c.id),
        mode: requalifyMode,
        priorHandoffId: existing.handoffId,
      });
      if (!proofCheck.ok) {
        throw new StudioError(
          "INVALID_REQUEST",
          `requalify preuve non vérifiée: ${proofCheck.reason}`,
          { exposeMessage: true },
        );
      }
      // G15 + CP-03 — lock first, then evaluate from observed dossier, then write.
      const txResult = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(
          sql`select id from realization_qualifications where id = ${existing.id} for update`,
        );
        const locked = (
          await tx
            .select()
            .from(realizationQualifications)
            .where(eq(realizationQualifications.id, existing.id))
            .limit(1)
        )[0];
        if (!locked) throw new StudioError("NOT_FOUND", "Qualification introuvable");
        if (
          body.expectedUpdatedAt &&
          locked.updatedAt.toISOString() !== body.expectedUpdatedAt
        ) {
          throw new StudioError(
            "CONFLICT",
            "REQUALIFY_VERSION_CONFLICT — relire puis réessayer",
            { exposeMessage: true },
          );
        }
        // Re-evaluate qualification inside TX after lock (Nora call stays outside TX).
        const q = evaluateQualificationOnly();
        let history: unknown[] = [];
        try {
          history = JSON.parse(locked.historyJson || "[]") as unknown[];
        } catch {
          history = [];
        }
        if (!Array.isArray(history)) history = [];
        const previousVerdict = locked.verdict;
        history.push({
          at: locked.updatedAt.toISOString(),
          verdict: locked.verdict,
          rubrics: JSON.parse(locked.rubricsJson || "{}"),
          limits: JSON.parse(locked.limitsJson || "[]"),
          noraAnalysisKind: classifyAttachedNoraPayload(locked.noraAnalysisMarkdown),
          authorPilotId: locked.pilotId,
          supersededAt: now.toISOString(),
          requalifyReason: reason,
          newProofRef: proofCheck.candidate.ref,
          proofKind: proofCheck.candidate.kind,
          handoffId: handoff?.id ?? locked.handoffId,
        });
        // Persist rubrics/verdict first; Nora markdown filled after TX.
        await tx
          .update(realizationQualifications)
          .set({
            handoffId: handoff?.id ?? locked.handoffId,
            status: "REQUALIFIED",
            rubricsJson: JSON.stringify(q.rubrics),
            verdict: q.verdict,
            limitsJson: JSON.stringify([
              ...q.limits,
              `REQUALIFIED_AT:${now.toISOString()}`,
              `PREVIOUS_VERDICT:${previousVerdict}`,
              `PROOF_VERIFIED:${proofCheck.candidate.kind}`,
              `NEW_PROOF_REF:${proofCheck.candidate.ref}`,
            ]),
            historyJson: JSON.stringify(history),
            updatedAt: now,
          })
          .where(eq(realizationQualifications.id, locked.id));
        return {
          previousVerdict,
          history,
          qualificationId: locked.id,
          q,
        };
      });
      const attached = await attachNoraAnalysisMarkdown(txResult.q);
      if (attached.finalMarkdown) {
        await db
          .update(realizationQualifications)
          .set({
            noraAnalysisMarkdown: attached.finalMarkdown,
            noraAnalysisAt: now,
            limitsJson: JSON.stringify([
              ...attached.limits,
              `REQUALIFIED_AT:${now.toISOString()}`,
              `PREVIOUS_VERDICT:${txResult.previousVerdict}`,
              `PROOF_VERIFIED:${proofCheck.candidate.kind}`,
              `NEW_PROOF_REF:${proofCheck.candidate.ref}`,
            ]),
            updatedAt: new Date(),
          })
          .where(eq(realizationQualifications.id, txResult.qualificationId));
      }
      return NextResponse.json({
        qualificationId: txResult.qualificationId,
        requalified: true,
        previousVerdict: txResult.previousVerdict,
        verdict: txResult.q.verdict,
        rubrics: txResult.q.rubrics,
        limits: attached.limits,
        history: txResult.history,
        noraAnalysisMarkdown: attached.finalMarkdown,
        noraAnalysisKind: attached.noraKind,
        testsPass: txResult.q.testsPass,
        conformityProven: txResult.q.conformityProven,
        morrisAcceptance: txResult.q.morrisAcceptance,
        adopted: txResult.q.adopted,
        proofVerified: proofCheck.candidate,
        cursorRedispatch: false,
      });
    }

    const { q, finalMarkdown, noraKind, limits } = await evaluateFromObserved();

    const id = newId("rqual");
    await db.insert(realizationQualifications).values({
      id,
      attemptId,
      handoffId: handoff?.id ?? null,
      projectId,
      pilotId: session.pilotId,
      status: "RECORDED",
      rubricsJson: JSON.stringify(q.rubrics),
      verdict: q.verdict,
      noraAnalysisMarkdown: finalMarkdown,
      noraAnalysisAt: finalMarkdown ? now : null,
      limitsJson: JSON.stringify(limits),
      historyJson: "[]",
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    });
    return NextResponse.json({
      qualificationId: id,
      requalified: false,
      verdict: q.verdict,
      rubrics: q.rubrics,
      limits,
      noraAnalysisMarkdown: finalMarkdown,
      noraAnalysisKind: noraKind,
      testsPass: q.testsPass,
      conformityProven: q.conformityProven,
      morrisAcceptance: q.morrisAcceptance,
      adopted: q.adopted,
      cursorRedispatch: false,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { prepareCursorExecution } from "@/domains/execution/cursor-attempt-service";
import { requireStudioSession } from "@/domains/identity/session";
import { studioErrorResponse } from "@/lib/http-errors";

export async function POST(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ projectId: string }> }) {
  try {
    const session = await requireStudioSession();
    const { projectId } = await ctx.params;
    const body = (await req.json()) as {
      contractId?: string;
      correlationKey?: string;
      /** Server-side key only. Absolute client paths are rejected. */
      workspaceKey?: string;
      /** Legacy — rejected when absolute / escaping. */
      workspaceCwd?: string;
      mcpRequired?: string[];
    };
    if (!body.contractId || !body.correlationKey) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "INVALID_REQUEST" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    const result = await prepareCursorExecution({
      pilotId: session.pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractId: body.contractId,
      correlationKey: body.correlationKey,
      workspaceKey: body.workspaceKey ?? "default",
      workspaceCwd: body.workspaceCwd,
      mcpRequired: body.mcpRequired,
    });
    return NextResponse.json(result);
  } catch (e) {
    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}
```

```typescript
    });
    return NextResponse.json(result);

    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import {
  createTechnicalContract,
  listTechnicalContracts,
} from "@/domains/execution/technical-contract";
import { prepareTechnicalContractFromNora } from "@/domains/execution/nora-contract-prepare";
import type { TechnicalContractBody } from "@/domains/execution/types";
import { requireStudioSession } from "@/domains/identity/session";
import { studioErrorResponse } from "@/lib/http-errors";

export async function GET(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ projectId: string }> }) {
  try {
    const session = await requireStudioSession();
    const { projectId } = await ctx.params;
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    const contractKey = url.searchParams.get("contractKey") ?? undefined;
    const items = await listTechnicalContracts({
      pilotId: session.pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractKey,
    });
    return NextResponse.json({ contracts: items });
  } catch (e) {
    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ projectId: string }> }) {
  try {
    const session = await requireStudioSession();
    const { projectId } = await ctx.params;
    const body = (await req.json()) as {
      contractKey?: string;
      preparationId?: string | null;
      body?: TechnicalContractBody;
      sourceTurnCommandId?: string | null;
      supersedesContractId?: string | null;
      /** When true, prepare via durable investigation (Nora path) — always DRAFT. */
      fromNoraInvestigation?: boolean;
      /** Ignored for READY — syntax-complete create is DRAFT unless markReady+server facts. */
      markReady?: boolean;
    };
    if (!body.contractKey || !body.body) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "INVALID_REQUEST" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    if (body.fromNoraInvestigation) {
      if (!body.preparationId) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "INVALID_REQUEST", message: "preparationId requis pour préparation Nora" },
          { status: 400 },
        );
      }
      const result = await prepareTechnicalContractFromNora({
        pilotId: session.pilotId,
        projectId,
        preparationId: body.preparationId,
        contractKey: body.contractKey,
        body: body.body,
        sourceTurnCommandId: body.sourceTurnCommandId,
      });
      return NextResponse.json(result);
    }

    // Manual/API create: always DRAFT. READY only via server-side /ready route (CF-02).
    const result = await createTechnicalContract({
      pilotId: session.pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractKey: body.contractKey,
      preparationId: body.preparationId,
      body: body.body,
      sourceTurnCommandId: body.sourceTurnCommandId,
      supersedesContractId: body.supersedesContractId,
      markReady: false,
    });
    return NextResponse.json(result);
  } catch (e) {
    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { listActivityEvents } from "@/domains/conversation/activity-projection";
import { requireStudioSession } from "@/domains/identity/session";
import { studioErrorResponse } from "@/lib/http-errors";

/** C1 — polling read of Nora activity for a turn. No mutation. */
export async function GET(
  req: Request,
  ctx: { params: Promise<{ projectId: string; turnCommandId: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const session = await requireStudioSession();
    const { turnCommandId } = await ctx.params;
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    const afterRaw = url.searchParams.get("afterSequence");
    const afterSequence = afterRaw != null ? Number(afterRaw) : undefined;
    const result = await listActivityEvents({
      ownerPilotId: session.pilotId,
      turnCommandId,
      afterSequence: Number.isFinite(afterSequence) ? afterSequence : undefined,
    });
    return NextResponse.json(result);
  } catch (e) {
    const mapped = studioErrorResponse(e);
    return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status });
  }
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

/**
 * ML5 — Contrat technique inspectable (frames 12.02 / 12.03 / 12.14).
 * Visual fidelity to Figma page 12 is verified separately (L0–F2).
 * Reading / expanding instruction never authorizes execution.
 */

export type ContractViewerModel = {
  contractId: string;
  contractKey: string;
  version: number;
  fingerprint: string;
  title: string;
  /** DRAFT | READY | … — D6 only when READY */
  status?: string;
  engagements: {
    willDo: string;
    willNotDo: string;
    expectedResult: string;
    pilotControl: string;
  };
  volets: {
    mission: string;
    perimeter: string;
    capabilitiesAuthority: string;
    stopConditions: string;
    proofsSources: string;
    integrity: string;
  };
  instructionText: string;
  risks: string[];
  exclusions: string[];
};

export function ContractViewer(props: {
  contract: ContractViewerModel;
  instructionExpanded: boolean;
  onToggleInstruction: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  onOpenInExecution: () => void;
  onRequestExecute?: () => void;
  executeDisabled?: boolean;
}) {
  const c = props.contract;
  return (
    <div
      className="fig-contract-viewer"
      data-testid="contract-viewer"
      data-contract-id={c.contractId}
      data-fingerprint={c.fingerprint}
    >
      <header className="fig-travail-viewer-head">
        <div>
          <p className="fig-kicker !mb-0">CONTRAT TECHNIQUE  /  LECTURE SEULE</p>
          <h2 className="fig-inspector-title" data-testid="contract-viewer-title">
            {c.title}
          </h2>
          <p className="fig-travail-viewer-meta" data-testid="contract-viewer-identity">
            {c.contractKey} · v{c.version}
            {c.status ? ` · ${c.status}` : ""} · {c.fingerprint.slice(0, 12)}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="fig-travail-viewer-actions">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn secondary"
            data-testid="contract-viewer-close"
            onClick={props.onClose}
          >
            Fermer
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <section data-testid="contract-engagements" className="fig-contract-section">
        <h3>Engagements</h3>
        <dl>
          <dt>Ce qui sera fait</dt>
          <dd>{c.engagements.willDo}</dd>
          <dt>Ce qui ne sera pas fait</dt>
          <dd>{c.engagements.willNotDo}</dd>
          <dt>Résultat attendu</dt>
          <dd>{c.engagements.expectedResult}</dd>
          <dt>Contrôle du Pilote</dt>
          <dd>{c.engagements.pilotControl}</dd>
        </dl>
      </section>

      <section data-testid="contract-volets" className="fig-contract-section">
        <h3>Volets</h3>
        <ul>
          <li>
            <strong>Mission</strong> — {c.volets.mission}
          </li>
          <li>
            <strong>Périmètre</strong> — {c.volets.perimeter}
          </li>
          <li>
            <strong>Capacités / autorité</strong> — {c.volets.capabilitiesAuthority}
          </li>
          <li>
            <strong>STOP</strong> — {c.volets.stopConditions}
          </li>
          <li>
            <strong>Preuves / sources</strong> — {c.volets.proofsSources}
          </li>
          <li>
            <strong>Intégrité</strong> — {c.volets.integrity}
          </li>
        </ul>
      </section>

      {(c.risks.length > 0 || c.exclusions.length > 0) && (
        <section data-testid="contract-risks" className="fig-contract-section">
          <h3>Risques et exclusions</h3>
          <p>Risques: {c.risks.join("; ") || "—"}</p>
          <p>Exclusions: {c.exclusions.join("; ") || "—"}</p>
        </section>
      )}

      <section data-testid="contract-instruction" className="fig-contract-section">
        <div className="fig-travail-viewer-actions">
          <h3>Instruction technique</h3>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn secondary"
            data-testid="contract-instruction-toggle"
            onClick={props.onToggleInstruction}
          >
            {props.instructionExpanded ? "Replier" : "Lire intégralement"}
          </button>
        </div>
        {props.instructionExpanded ? (
          <pre
            className="fig-contract-instruction-full"
            data-testid="contract-instruction-full"
          >
            {c.instructionText}
          </pre>
        ) : (
          <p data-testid="contract-instruction-preview">
            {c.instructionText.slice(0, 280)}
            {c.instructionText.length > 280 ? "…" : ""}
          </p>
        )}
        <p className="fig-travail-viewer-meta">
          Lire ou déplier l&apos;instruction ne constitue jamais une autorisation.
        </p>
      </section>

      <footer className="fig-contract-footer">
        <button
          type="button"
          className="btn secondary"
          data-testid="contract-open-execution"
          onClick={props.onOpenInExecution}
        >
          Ouvrir dans Exécution
        </button>
        {props.onRequestExecute ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn"
            data-testid="contract-request-execute"
            disabled={props.executeDisabled}
            onClick={props.onRequestExecute}
          >
            Exécuter…
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </footer>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

/**
 * ML5 C10 — HumanDecision D6 confirmation overlay (Oui / Non).
 * Shared by Travail 50/50 and Exécution. Reading ≠ authorizing.
 */

export function D6ConfirmLaunch(props: {
  contractKey: string;
  version: number;
  fingerprint: string;
  title?: string;
  busy?: boolean;
  onYes: () => void;
  onNo: () => void;
  onCancel?: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="d6-confirm-title"
      data-testid="d6-confirm-launch"
      className="fig-d6-confirm"
    >
      <div className="fig-d6-confirm-card">
        <h3 id="d6-confirm-title">Confirmer le lancement</h3>
        <p data-testid="d6-confirm-scope">
          Vous avez inspecté le contrat{" "}
          <strong>
            {props.contractKey} v{props.version}
          </strong>
          {props.title ? ` — ${props.title}` : ""}. Confirmez-vous l&apos;exécution
          Cursor de cette version exacte ?
        </p>
        <p className="fig-travail-viewer-meta" data-testid="d6-confirm-fingerprint">
          Empreinte inspectée : {props.fingerprint.slice(0, 16)}…
        </p>
        <p className="fig-travail-viewer-meta">
          Oui = HumanDecision D6 (mandat). Non = refus explicite, aucun dispatch. Annuler =
          fermer sans acte.
        </p>
        <div className="fig-d6-confirm-actions">
          {props.onCancel ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn secondary"
              data-testid="d6-confirm-cancel"
              disabled={props.busy}
              onClick={props.onCancel}
            >
              Annuler
            </button>
          ) : null}
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn secondary"
            data-testid="d6-confirm-no"
            disabled={props.busy}
            onClick={props.onNo}
          >
            Non
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn"
            data-testid="d6-confirm-yes"
            disabled={props.busy}
            onClick={props.onYes}
          >
            Oui
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
