```typescript
"use client";

/**
 * Nora conversational composition renderer.
 * Product responsibility: adaptive restitution of validated D3 compositions.
 * Presentation contract: conversational-composition-v1 (admission).
 * Wire compatibility: e05-visual-composition-v1 (bounded).
 */

import React, {
  Component,
  type ErrorInfo,
  type ReactNode,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  useState,
} from "react";

// Keep React binding for classic JSX transforms (Vitest SSR / esbuild).
void React;
import { SafeMarkdown } from "@/components/SafeMarkdown";
import { NoraSemanticIcon } from "@/components/figma/NoraSemanticIcon";
import { E2eCompositionThrowProbe } from "@/components/figma/E2eCompositionThrowProbe";
import {
  DirectedRelationBoard,
  EditorialSequence,
  EditorialSynthesis,
} from "@/components/figma/nora-composition";
import {
  admitConversationalComposition,
  buildExhaustiveBlockFallback,
  visibleTextAlternativeComplement,
  type AdmittedBlock,
  type ComparisonVariant,
  type RelationsVariant,
  type SequenceVariant,
} from "@/domains/conversation/conversational-composition";
import type {
  ComparisonBlock,
  RelationsBlock,
  SequenceBlock,
  SynthesisBlock,
  TextBlock,
  VisualBlock,
  VisualComposition,
  VisualProvenance,
} from "@/domains/conversation/visual-composition";
import {
  canonicalReferenceKey,
  compositionAnchorsChoices,
  compositionAnchorsReferences,
  partitionChoicesForAnchors,
  partitionReferencesForAnchors,
  provenanceConsultableKeys,
  resolveProvenanceReference,
} from "@/domains/conversation/visual-composition";
import type { TurnChoice, TurnReference } from "@/domains/conversation/turn-projection";

function Provenance(props: {
  items?: VisualProvenance[];
  canonicalReferences?: TurnReference[];
  onReference?: (ref: TurnReference) => void;
}) {
  if (!props.items?.length) return null;
  const canonical = props.canonicalReferences ?? [];
  return (
    <ul
      className="fig-visual-provenance fig-comp-provenance"
      data-testid="nora-visual-provenance"
    >
      {props.items.map((p, i) => {
        const resolved = resolveProvenanceReference(p, canonical);
        return (
          <li key={`${p.label}-${i}`} data-consultable={resolved ? "1" : "0"}>
            {resolved && props.onReference ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="fig-nora-ref-link"
                data-testid="nora-visual-prov-link"
                data-ref-kind={resolved.kind}
                onClick={() => props.onReference?.(resolved)}
              >
                Consulter · {resolved.label}
                {resolved.available === false ? " (à vérifier)" : ""}
              </button>
            ) : (
              <span>
                {p.label}
                <span className="fig-visual-provenance-note"> — mention descriptive</span>
              </span>
            )}
            {p.note ? <span className="fig-visual-provenance-note"> — {p.note}</span> : null}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}

function Heading(props: {
  title: string;
  role?: TextBlock["role"];
  icon?: TextBlock["icon"];
}) {
  const showIcon = Boolean(props.role || props.icon);
  return (
    <h3 className="fig-visual-title fig-comp-title">
      {showIcon ? <NoraSemanticIcon role={props.role} icon={props.icon} /> : null}
      <span>{props.title}</span>
    </h3>
  );
}

/**
 * C2 — visible complementary substance from textAlternative.
 * Must remain consultable under bodyPolicy=substitute (not sr-only alone).
 * Does not duplicate the full replyDraft; only non-redundant complement.
 */
function SubstanceComplement({ block }: { block: VisualBlock }) {
  if (block.kind === "text" || block.kind === "choices" || block.kind === "references") {
    return null;
  }
  const complement = visibleTextAlternativeComplement(block);
  if (!complement) return null;
  return (
    <aside
      className="fig-comp-substance-complement"
      data-testid="nora-composition-substance-complement"
      data-block-id={block.id}
    >
      <p className="fig-comp-substance-complement-label">Complément</p>
      <p className="fig-comp-substance-complement-text">{complement}</p>
    </aside>
  );
}

type BlockShellProps = {
  children: ReactNode;
  textAlternative: string;
  blockId: string;
};

/** CV-10 — isolate render failure to one block; keep readable textAlternative. */
export class BlockErrorBoundary extends Component<
  BlockShellProps,
  { failed: boolean }
> {
  state = { failed: false };

  static getDerivedStateFromError(_error: Error): { failed: boolean } {
    return { failed: true };
  }

  componentDidCatch(_error: Error, _info: ErrorInfo): void {
    // Presentation-only; never escalate to D3 FAILED.
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.failed) {
      return (
        <section
          className="fig-visual-block fig-comp-block fig-comp-block-fallback"
          data-testid="nora-composition-block-fallback"
          data-block-id={this.props.blockId}
          data-fallback="1"
        >
          <p className="fig-comp-fallback-text">{this.props.textAlternative}</p>
        </section>
      );
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}

function AlternativeDetails({
  alt,
  index,
}: {
  alt: ComparisonBlock["alternatives"][number];
  index?: number;
}) {
  const eyebrow =
    index != null ? `OPTION ${String.fromCharCode(65 + index)}` : "OPTION";
  // C2 — every distinct limit remains visible (never cons[0] alone).
  const cons = (alt.cons ?? []).filter((c, i, arr) => {
    const t = c.trim();
    return t.length > 0 && arr.findIndex((x) => x.trim() === t) === i;
  });
  return (
    <article
      className="fig-visual-alt fig-comp-alt fig-nc-option-card"
      data-alt-id={alt.id}
      data-testid="nora-composition-alt-detail"
    >
      <p className="fig-nc-option-eyebrow">{eyebrow}</p>
      <h4 className="fig-nc-option-title">{alt.title}</h4>
      <p className="fig-nc-option-summary">{alt.summary}</p>
      {alt.pros?.length ? (
        <ul className="fig-visual-pros">
          {alt.pros.map((p) => (
            <li key={p}>{p}</li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : null}
      {cons.length === 1 ? (
        <p className="fig-nc-option-vigilance">{cons[0]}</p>
      ) : cons.length > 1 ? (
        <ul className="fig-visual-cons fig-nc-option-cons" data-testid="nora-composition-alt-cons">
          {cons.map((c) => (
            <li key={c}>{c}</li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : null}
    </article>
  );
}

function ComparisonView({
  block,
  variant,
  canonicalReferences,
  onReference,
}: {
  block: ComparisonBlock;
  variant: ComparisonVariant;
  canonicalReferences?: TurnReference[];
  onReference?: (ref: TurnReference) => void;
}) {
  const hasCriteria = Boolean(block.criteria?.length);
  // CV-T04 / Defect A: matrix never hides summary/pros/cons — show complementary details.
  const showMatrix = variant === "matrix" && hasCriteria;
  const showCards =
    variant === "cards" ||
    variant === "stacked" ||
    (variant === "matrix" && !hasCriteria);
  // Figma 04 — matrix cells already carry Nature + criteria; avoid a second card dump
  // unless alternatives expose pros/cons beyond the matrix row.
  const showMatrixDetails =
    showMatrix &&
    !block.fixtureDemo &&
    block.alternatives.some(
      (a) => (a.pros?.length ?? 0) > 0 || (a.cons?.length ?? 0) > 0,
    );
  const forceText = variant === "text";

  return (
    <section
      className={`fig-visual-block fig-visual-comparison fig-comp-block fig-comp-comparison fig-comp-variant-${variant}`}
      data-testid="nora-visual-comparison"
      data-comp-testid="nora-composition-comparison"
      data-block-kind="comparison"
      data-block-id={block.id}
      data-variant={variant}
      data-substance-complete="1"
      aria-label={block.title}
    >
      {block.lead || block.fixtureDemo ? (
        <header className="fig-nc-editorial-hero">
          {block.fixtureDemo ? (
            <p className="fig-nc-fixture-badge">EXEMPLE · DONNÉES FICTIVES</p>
          ) : null}
          <h3 className="fig-nc-editorial-headline">
            <span className="fig-nc-editorial-headline-primary">{block.title}</span>
          </h3>
          {block.lead ? <p className="fig-nc-editorial-lead">{block.lead}</p> : null}
        </header>
      ) : (
        <Heading title={block.title} role={block.role} icon={block.icon} />
      )}
      {forceText ? (
        <div className="fig-comp-fallback-text" data-testid="nora-composition-comparison-text">
          {buildExhaustiveBlockFallback(block)}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {!forceText && showCards ? (
        <div
          className={
            variant === "stacked"
              ? "fig-visual-comparison-grid fig-comp-comparison-stack"
              : "fig-visual-comparison-grid fig-comp-comparison-cards"
          }
          data-testid={
            variant === "stacked"
              ? "nora-composition-comparison-stacked"
              : "nora-composition-comparison-cards"
          }
          data-option-count={block.alternatives.length}
        >
          {block.alternatives.map((alt, i) => (
            <AlternativeDetails key={alt.id} alt={alt} index={i} />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {!forceText && showMatrix ? (
        <>
          <div className="fig-visual-matrix-wrap fig-comp-matrix-wrap fig-nc-matrix-editorial">
            {/* Figma 04 — options as rows, criteria as columns */}
            <table
              className="fig-visual-matrix fig-comp-matrix fig-nc-matrix-rows"
              data-testid="nora-composition-matrix-five"
              data-option-count={block.alternatives.length}
              aria-label={block.title || "Comparaison"}
            >
              {/* UX-02 — no visible redundant caption; block title + column headers suffice. */}
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th scope="col">Option</th>
                  <th scope="col">Nature</th>
                  {block.criteria!.map((c) => (
                    <th key={c.id} scope="col">
                      {c.label}
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {block.alternatives.map((a, i) => (
                  <tr key={a.id}>
                    <th scope="row">
                      <span className="fig-nc-matrix-opt-label">
                        {String.fromCharCode(65 + i)}. {a.title}
                      </span>
                    </th>
                    <td>{a.summary}</td>
                    {block.criteria!.map((c) => (
                      <td key={c.id}>{c.values[a.id] ?? "—"}</td>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          {showMatrixDetails ? (
            <div
              className="fig-comp-comparison-stack fig-comp-matrix-details"
              data-testid="nora-composition-matrix-details"
            >
              <h4 className="fig-comp-matrix-details-title">Détail des options</h4>
              {block.alternatives.map((alt, i) => (
                <AlternativeDetails key={`detail-${alt.id}`} alt={alt} index={i} />
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </>
      ) : null}
      {block.recommendation ? (
        <div className="fig-visual-recommendation" data-testid="nora-visual-recommendation">
          <NoraSemanticIcon role="recommendation" />
          <div className="fig-visual-recommendation-body">
            <span className="fig-visual-recommendation-label">Recommandation (avis Nora)</span>
            <SafeMarkdown content={block.recommendation} className="fig-visual-inline-md" />
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {block.editorialNote ? (
        <aside className="fig-nc-orientation" data-testid="nora-composition-editorial-note">
          <p className="fig-nc-orientation-label">Choix éditorial</p>
          <p className="fig-nc-orientation-body">{block.editorialNote}</p>
        </aside>
      ) : null}
      {!forceText ? <SubstanceComplement block={block} /> : null}
      <Provenance
        items={block.provenance}
        canonicalReferences={canonicalReferences}
        onReference={onReference}
      />
    </section>
  );
}

function SequenceView({
  block,
  variant,
  canonicalReferences,
  onReference,
}: {
  block: SequenceBlock;
  variant: SequenceVariant;
  canonicalReferences?: TurnReference[];
  onReference?: (ref: TurnReference) => void;
}) {
  const titleById = new Map(block.steps.map((s) => [s.id, s.title] as const));
  const forceText = variant === "text";
  return (
    <section
      className={`fig-visual-block fig-visual-sequence fig-comp-block fig-comp-sequence fig-comp-variant-${variant}`}
      data-testid="nora-visual-sequence"
      data-comp-testid="nora-composition-sequence"
      data-block-kind="sequence"
      data-block-id={block.id}
      data-variant={variant}
      aria-label={block.title}
    >
      {forceText ? (
        <>
          <Heading title={block.title} role={block.role ?? "step"} icon={block.icon} />
          <div className="fig-comp-fallback-text" data-testid="nora-composition-sequence-text">
            {buildExhaustiveBlockFallback(block)}
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <EditorialSequence block={block} variant={variant} />
      )}
      {/* Keep human dependency labels available for a11y / T02 without forcing UI noise */}
      {!forceText && block.steps.some((s) => s.dependsOn?.length) ? (
        <ul className="fig-nc-edges-a11y" data-testid="nora-visual-step-deps-list">
          {block.steps.map((step) =>
            step.dependsOn?.length ? (
              <li key={step.id} data-testid="nora-visual-step-deps">
                {step.title} dépend de :{" "}
                {step.dependsOn.map((id) => titleById.get(id) ?? id).join(", ")}
              </li>
            ) : null,
          )}
        </ul>
      ) : null}
      {!forceText ? <SubstanceComplement block={block} /> : null}
      <Provenance
        items={block.provenance}
        canonicalReferences={canonicalReferences}
        onReference={onReference}
      />
    </section>
  );
}

function relationRole(
  kind: RelationsBlock["nodes"][number]["kind"],
): TextBlock["role"] {
  if (kind === "hypothesis") return "hypothesis";
  if (kind === "observation") return "observation";
  if (kind === "fact" || kind === "finding") return "fact";
  return "information";
}

function RelationsListFallback({
  block,
  titleById,
}: {
  block: RelationsBlock;
  titleById: Map<string, string>;
}) {
  return (
    <>
      <ul className="fig-visual-relations-list fig-comp-relations-list">
        {block.nodes.map((n) => (
          <li key={n.id} data-node-id={n.id}>
            <NoraSemanticIcon role={relationRole(n.kind)} />
            <span className="fig-comp-relations-label">{n.label}</span>
            {n.detail ? <span className="fig-comp-relations-detail"> — {n.detail}</span> : null}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {block.edges.length ? (
        <ul
          className="fig-visual-relations-edges fig-comp-relations-edges"
          data-testid="nora-composition-relations-edges"
        >
          {block.edges.map((e, i) => (
            <li key={`${e.from}-${e.to}-${i}`}>
              {titleById.get(e.from) ?? e.from} → {titleById.get(e.to) ?? e.to}
              {e.relation ? ` [${e.relation}]` : ""}
              {e.label ? ` (${e.label})` : ""}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * Directed relations — new subsystem (`DirectedRelationBoard`).
 * Artisan measured-SVG / NoraCompositionGraphs are retired from the production path.
 * ELK paints when installed; otherwise structured reading (gate pending).
 */
function RelationsDirectedView({
  block,
  titleById,
}: {
  block: RelationsBlock;
  titleById: Map<string, string>;
}) {
  return <DirectedRelationBoard block={block} titleById={titleById} />;
}

function RelationsView({
  block,
  variant,
  canonicalReferences,
  onReference,
}: {
  block: RelationsBlock;
  variant: RelationsVariant;
  canonicalReferences?: TurnReference[];
  onReference?: (ref: TurnReference) => void;
}) {
  const forceText = variant === "text";
  const useDirected = variant === "directed";
  const titleById = new Map(block.nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n.label] as const));

  return (
    <section
      className={`fig-visual-block fig-visual-relations fig-comp-block fig-comp-relations fig-comp-variant-${variant}`}
      data-testid="nora-visual-relations"
      data-comp-testid="nora-composition-relations"
      data-block-kind="relations"
      data-block-id={block.id}
      data-variant={variant}
      data-fallback={useDirected ? "0" : "1"}
      data-layout={useDirected ? "directed" : "structured-list"}
      data-layout-hint={block.layoutHint ?? ""}
      aria-label={block.title}
    >
      <Heading title={block.title} role={block.role} icon={block.icon} />
      {forceText ? (
        <div className="fig-comp-fallback-text" data-testid="nora-composition-relations-text">
          {buildExhaustiveBlockFallback(block)}
        </div>
      ) : useDirected ? (
        <RelationsDirectedView block={block} titleById={titleById} />
      ) : (
        <RelationsListFallback block={block} titleById={titleById} />
      )}
      {!forceText ? <SubstanceComplement block={block} /> : null}
      <Provenance
        items={block.provenance}
        canonicalReferences={canonicalReferences}
        onReference={onReference}
      />
    </section>
  );
}

function SynthesisView({
  block,
  canonicalReferences,
  onReference,
}: {
  block: SynthesisBlock;
  canonicalReferences?: TurnReference[];
  onReference?: (ref: TurnReference) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <section
      className="fig-visual-block fig-visual-synthesis fig-comp-block fig-comp-synthesis fig-comp-synthesis-editorial"
      data-testid="nora-visual-synthesis"
      data-comp-testid="nora-composition-synthesis"
      data-block-kind="synthesis"
      data-block-id={block.id}
      aria-label={block.title}
      data-renderer="editorial-v3"
    >
      {/* EditorialSynthesis owns the Figma 01 headline — no legacy Heading duplicate. */}
      <EditorialSynthesis block={block} />
      <SubstanceComplement block={block} />
      <Provenance
        items={block.provenance}
        canonicalReferences={canonicalReferences}
        onReference={onReference}
      />
    </section>
  );
}

function TextView({ block }: { block: TextBlock }) {
  const showIcon = Boolean(block.role || block.icon);
  return (
    <div
      className={`fig-visual-block fig-visual-text fig-comp-block fig-comp-text${
        block.role ? ` fig-visual-text-${block.role}` : ""
      }${showIcon ? " fig-visual-text-with-icon" : ""}`}
      data-testid="nora-visual-text"
      data-comp-testid="nora-composition-text"
      data-block-kind="text"
      data-role={block.role ?? ""}
    >
      {/* UX-01 — icon and body share one row; never stack the glyph alone above the title. */}
      {showIcon ? (
        <span className="fig-visual-text-icon" aria-hidden={false}>
          <NoraSemanticIcon role={block.role} icon={block.icon} />
        </span>
      ) : null}
      <div className="fig-visual-text-body">
        <SafeMarkdown content={block.markdown} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ChoicesCluster(props: {
  choices: TurnChoice[];
  actionable?: boolean;
  busy?: boolean;
  choiceFrozen?: boolean;
  messageId?: string;
  residual?: boolean;
  onChoice?: (choice: TurnChoice, messageId: string) => void;
  anchorId?: string;
}) {
  if (!props.choices.length) return null;
  return (
    <div
      className="fig-nora-choices fig-visual-choices-anchor fig-comp-choices"
      data-testid="nora-choices"
      data-block-kind="choices"
      data-residual={props.residual ? "1" : "0"}
      data-actionable={props.actionable ? "1" : "0"}
      data-message-id={props.messageId}
      data-anchor-id={props.anchorId ?? ""}
    >
      {props.choices.map((c) => (
        <button
          key={c.id}
          type="button"
          className="fig-nora-choice"
          data-testid="nora-choice"
          data-choice-id={c.id}
          disabled={!props.actionable || props.busy || props.choiceFrozen}
          onClick={() => props.messageId && props.onChoice?.(c, props.messageId)}
        >
          {c.label}
        </button>
      ))}
      {!props.actionable ? (
        <p className="fig-nora-choices-expired" data-testid="nora-choices-expired">
          Propositions expirées — consultation seule.
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function RefsCluster(props: {
  references: TurnReference[];
  residual?: boolean;
  anchorId?: string;
  onReference?: (ref: TurnReference) => void;
}) {
  if (!props.references.length) return null;
  return (
    <ul
      className="fig-nora-refs fig-visual-refs-anchor fig-comp-refs"
      data-testid="nora-refs"
      data-block-kind="references"
      data-residual={props.residual ? "1" : "0"}
      data-anchor-id={props.anchorId ?? ""}
    >
      {props.references.map((r, i) => (
        <li key={`${r.kind}-${r.resourceId ?? r.path ?? r.href ?? i}`}>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="fig-nora-ref-link"
            data-testid="nora-ref-link"
            data-ref-kind={r.kind}
            onClick={() => props.onReference?.(r)}
          >
            Consulter · {r.label}
            {r.available === false ? " (à vérifier)" : ""}
          </button>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

/** Defect C — never truncate; exhaustive structured fallback. */
function textAltFor(block: VisualBlock): string {
  return buildExhaustiveBlockFallback(block);
}

function AdmittedBlockView({
  admitted,
  canonicalReferences,
  onReference,
}: {
  admitted: AdmittedBlock;
  canonicalReferences?: TurnReference[];
  onReference?: (ref: TurnReference) => void;
}) {
  const { block, variant } = admitted;
  if (block.kind === "comparison") {
    return (
      <ComparisonView
        block={block}
        variant={variant as ComparisonVariant}
        canonicalReferences={canonicalReferences}
        onReference={onReference}
      />
    );
  }
  if (block.kind === "sequence") {
    return (
      <SequenceView
        block={block}
        variant={variant as SequenceVariant}
        canonicalReferences={canonicalReferences}
        onReference={onReference}
      />
    );
  }
  if (block.kind === "relations") {
    return (
      <RelationsView
        block={block}
        variant={variant as RelationsVariant}
        canonicalReferences={canonicalReferences}
        onReference={onReference}
      />
    );
  }
  if (block.kind === "synthesis") {
    return (
      <SynthesisView
        block={block}
        canonicalReferences={canonicalReferences}
        onReference={onReference}
      />
    );
  }
  if (block.kind === "text") {
    return <TextView block={block} />;
  }
  return null;
}

export type NoraCompositionProps = {
  composition: VisualComposition;
  /** Canonical replyDraft / message body for width-local re-admission consistency. */
  canonicalText?: string | null;
  choices?: TurnChoice[];
  references?: TurnReference[];
  actionable?: boolean;
  busy?: boolean;
  choiceFrozen?: boolean;
  messageId?: string;
  onChoice?: (choice: TurnChoice, messageId: string) => void;
  onReference?: (ref: TurnReference) => void;
};

export function NoraComposition(props: NoraCompositionProps) {
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const [widthPx, setWidthPx] = useState<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = rootRef.current;
    if (!el || typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") {
      setWidthPx(el?.clientWidth ?? null);
      return;
    }
    const ro = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
      const w = entries[0]?.contentRect.width;
      if (typeof w === "number" && Number.isFinite(w)) {
        setWidthPx(Math.round(w));
      }
    });
    ro.observe(el);
    setWidthPx(Math.round(el.clientWidth));
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const admission = admitConversationalComposition(props.composition, {
    containerWidthPx: widthPx,
    canonicalText: props.canonicalText,
  });
  const choices = props.choices ?? [];
  const references = props.references ?? [];
  const choiceParts = partitionChoicesForAnchors(props.composition.blocks, choices);
  const refParts = partitionReferencesForAnchors(props.composition.blocks, references);
  const alreadyConsultable = provenanceConsultableKeys(
    props.composition.blocks,
    references,
  );
  const dedupeRefs = (list: TurnReference[]) =>
    list.filter((r) => !alreadyConsultable.has(canonicalReferenceKey(r)));

  return (
    <div
      ref={rootRef}
      className="fig-visual-composition fig-comp-composition"
      data-testid="nora-visual-composition"
      data-comp-testid="nora-composition"
      data-schema={props.composition.schemaVersion}
      data-contract={admission.contract}
      data-owns-body={admission.ownsBody ? "1" : "0"}
      data-body-policy={admission.bodyPolicy}
      data-container-width={widthPx ?? ""}
    >
      {admission.admitted.map((admitted) => {
        if (admitted.block.kind === "choices") {
          return (
            <ChoicesCluster
              key={admitted.block.id}
              choices={choiceParts.byAnchorId.get(admitted.block.id) ?? []}
              actionable={props.actionable}
              busy={props.busy}
              choiceFrozen={props.choiceFrozen}
              messageId={props.messageId}
              onChoice={props.onChoice}
              anchorId={admitted.block.id}
            />
          );
        }
        if (admitted.block.kind === "references") {
          return (
            <RefsCluster
              key={admitted.block.id}
              references={dedupeRefs(refParts.byAnchorId.get(admitted.block.id) ?? [])}
              onReference={props.onReference}
              anchorId={admitted.block.id}
            />
          );
        }
        return (
          <BlockErrorBoundary
            key={admitted.block.id}
            blockId={admitted.block.id}
            textAlternative={textAltFor(admitted.block)}
          >
            {/* C2-08 — DEV/E2E probe only; armed via window.__SFIA_E2E_COMPOSITION_THROW_BLOCK_ID__ */}
            <E2eCompositionThrowProbe blockId={admitted.block.id} />
            <AdmittedBlockView
              admitted={admitted}
              canonicalReferences={references}
              onReference={props.onReference}
            />
          </BlockErrorBoundary>
        );
      })}
      {compositionAnchorsChoices(props.composition) ? (
        <ChoicesCluster
          choices={choiceParts.residual}
          actionable={props.actionable}
          busy={props.busy}
          choiceFrozen={props.choiceFrozen}
          messageId={props.messageId}
          onChoice={props.onChoice}
          residual
          anchorId="residual-choices"
        />
      ) : null}
      {compositionAnchorsReferences(props.composition) ? (
        <RefsCluster
          references={dedupeRefs(refParts.residual)}
          onReference={props.onReference}
          residual
          anchorId="residual-references"
        />
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { SafeMarkdown } from "@/components/SafeMarkdown";
import { NoraComposition } from "@/components/figma/NoraComposition";
import { useNoraThreadScroll } from "@/hooks/useNoraThreadScroll";
import type {
  MessageProjectionView,
  TurnChoice,
  TurnReference,
} from "@/domains/conversation/turn-projection";
import { admitConversationalComposition } from "@/domains/conversation/conversational-composition";
import {
  compositionAnchorsChoices,
  compositionAnchorsReferences,
} from "@/domains/conversation/visual-composition";

export type NoraMsg = {
  id: string;
  role: string;
  content: string;
  status: string;
};

export function NoraConversation(props: {
  messages: NoraMsg[];
  draft: string;
  busy: boolean;
  unresolvedPending?: boolean;
  activity?: "idle" | "preparing" | "error";
  status?: string;
  onDraft: (v: string) => void;
  onSend: () => void;
  onReconcile?: () => void;
  aside?: React.ReactNode;
  /** When set, participates in project-travail-stage CSS grid via display:contents. */
  embeddedInStage?: boolean;
  projections?: MessageProjectionView[];
  onChoice?: (choice: TurnChoice, messageId: string) => void;
  /** Consultation links — independent of choice lifetime (§6.10). */
  onReference?: (ref: TurnReference) => void;
  choiceFrozen?: boolean;
  forceStickToken?: number;
  layoutMode?: "normal" | "split" | "enlarged";
  /** J-C13 — scroll/highlight exact message without sending. */
  focusMessageId?: string | null;
  onFocusMessageHandled?: () => void;
  focusStatus?: string | null;
  /** Ensemble 07 — verrou qualification initiale (UI + accessibilité). */
  composerLocked?: boolean;
  composerLockReason?: string;
  /** E07 05.17 — bandeau qualification + lien Trajectoire. */
  qualificationBanner?: boolean;
  onOpenTrajectoire?: () => void;
  /** C01/C05/C07 — mid-turn functional activity (polled), distinct from response streaming. */
  liveActivityEvents?: Array<{
    sequence: number;
    nature: string;
    status: string;
    summary: string;
    phase: string;
    sourceRef?: string | null;
  }>;
  liveActivityHeadline?: string;
}) {
  const n = props.messages.length;
  const frame = n === 0 ? "161:216" : n <= 2 ? "161:288" : "94:214";
  const variantLabel =
    n === 0 ? "Première conversation" : n <= 2 ? "Reprise contextualisée" : "Fil long";
  const embedded = Boolean(props.embeddedInStage);
  const composerLocked = Boolean(props.composerLocked);
  const sendDisabled = props.busy || !props.draft.trim() || composerLocked;
  const lastMessageId = n > 0 ? props.messages[n - 1]!.id : null;
  const { threadRef, onScroll, scrollToBottom, newBelow } = useNoraThreadScroll({
    messageCount: n,
    lastMessageId,
    activityPreparing: props.activity === "preparing",
    forceStickToken: props.forceStickToken ?? 0,
    focusMessageId: props.focusMessageId,
  });

  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement | null>(null);
  const [imeComposing, setImeComposing] = useState(false);
  const isMobile =
    typeof window !== "undefined" &&
    window.matchMedia &&
    window.matchMedia("(max-width: 700px)").matches;

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = textareaRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    el.style.height = "auto";
    const max = Math.min(window.innerHeight * 0.36, 280);
    const next = Math.min(Math.max(el.scrollHeight, 24), max);
    el.style.height = `${next}px`;
    el.style.overflowY = el.scrollHeight > max ? "auto" : "hidden";
  }, [props.draft]);

  // Include message id order so Journal→Travail highlight rebinds after a same-length
  // setMessages remount (length-only deps lost data-journal-focus on replaced nodes).
  const messageIdsKey = props.messages.map((m) => m.id).join("\0");
  useEffect(() => {
    const targetId = props.focusMessageId?.trim();
    if (!targetId) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    let highlightTimer: number | undefined;
    let attempts = 0;
    const tryFocus = () => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      const root = threadRef.current;
      const node = root?.querySelector(
        `[data-message-id="${CSS.escape(targetId)}"]`,
      ) as HTMLElement | null;
      if (!node) {
        attempts += 1;
        // Wait for async insert / paint — do not clear focus on first miss (avoids landing on last message).
        if (attempts < 40) {
          window.setTimeout(tryFocus, 50);
          return;
        }
        props.onFocusMessageHandled?.();
        return;
      }
      node.scrollIntoView({ block: "center", behavior: "smooth" });
      node.setAttribute("data-journal-focus", "1");
      node.classList.add("is-journal-focus");
      // Keep focus marker long enough for Journal→Travail deep-link asserts / paint races.
      highlightTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
        node.classList.remove("is-journal-focus");
        node.removeAttribute("data-journal-focus");
        props.onFocusMessageHandled?.();
      }, 5200);
    };
    tryFocus();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      if (highlightTimer) window.clearTimeout(highlightTimer);
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [props.focusMessageId, messageIdsKey]);

  const projectionByMessage = new Map(
    (props.projections ?? []).map((p) => [p.messageId ?? "", p]),
  );

  return (
    <div
      className={
        embedded
          ? "fig-travail-workspace-embed"
          : "fig-workspace fig-nora-responsive fig-travail-workspace"
      }
      data-figma-frame={frame}
      data-figma-mobile-frames="282:468,282:492"
      data-testid="nora-workspace"
      data-travail-embed={embedded ? "1" : "0"}
      data-travail-layout={props.layoutMode ?? "normal"}
    >
      <section
        className="fig-conversation-panel"
        data-testid="nora-conversation-panel"
        data-nora-main="1"
        id="nora-main"
        hidden={props.layoutMode === "enlarged"}
      >
        <div className="fig-conversation-head">
          <p className="fig-kicker !mb-0">Conversation du projet</p>
          <span className="fig-tag fig-tag-muted">{variantLabel}</span>
          {props.unresolvedPending ? (
            <span className="fig-tag fig-tag-warn">Interruption / reprise</span>
          ) : null}
          {props.focusStatus ? (
            <span className="fig-tag fig-tag-warn" data-testid="nora-focus-status">
              {props.focusStatus}
            </span>
          ) : null}
          {newBelow ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="fig-tag fig-tag-ok"
              data-testid="nora-new-below"
              onClick={() => scrollToBottom("smooth")}
            >
              Nouveaux messages ↓
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        <div
          className="fig-nora-thread"
          data-testid="nora-thread"
          ref={threadRef}
          onScroll={onScroll}
        >
          {n === 0 ? (
            <div className="fig-msg fig-msg-nora text-sm" data-testid="nora-first-empty">
              <div className="fig-msg-meta">
                <span className="fig-msg-avatar" aria-hidden>
                  N
                </span>
                <span className="fig-msg-role">Nora</span>
              </div>
              <p className="fig-msg-body">
                Première conversation — écrivez pour démarrer le fil du projet. Aucun message fictif
                n&apos;est prérempli.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {props.messages.map((m) => {
            const isNora = m.role === "assistant";
            const proj = isNora ? projectionByMessage.get(m.id) : undefined;
            return (
              <article
                key={m.id}
                className={`fig-msg ${isNora ? "fig-msg-nora" : "fig-msg-pilot"}`}
                data-message-id={m.id}
                data-testid={isNora ? "nora-msg-assistant" : "nora-msg-pilot"}
              >
                <div className="fig-msg-meta">
                  {isNora ? (
                    <span className="fig-msg-avatar" aria-hidden>
                      N
                    </span>
                  ) : null}
                  <span className={`fig-msg-role ${isNora ? "" : "fig-msg-role-pilot"}`}>
                    {isNora ? "Nora" : "Pilote"}
                  </span>
                  <span className="sr-only">{m.status}</span>
                </div>
                {isNora ? (
                  <div className="fig-msg-body">
                    {(() => {
                      const admission = proj?.visualComposition
                        ? admitConversationalComposition(proj.visualComposition, {
                            canonicalText: m.content,
                          })
                        : null;
                      const policy = admission?.bodyPolicy ?? "markdown_only";
                      const compositionEl =
                        proj?.visualComposition && policy !== "markdown_only" ? (
                          <NoraComposition
                            composition={proj.visualComposition}
                            canonicalText={m.content}
                            choices={proj.choices}
                            references={proj.references}
                            actionable={proj.actionable}
                            busy={props.busy}
                            choiceFrozen={props.choiceFrozen}
                            messageId={m.id}
                            onChoice={props.onChoice}
                            onReference={props.onReference}
                          />
                        ) : null;
                      if (policy === "substitute" && compositionEl) {
                        return compositionEl;
                      }
                      if (policy === "complement" && compositionEl) {
                        return (
                          <>
                            <SafeMarkdown content={m.content} />
                            <div
                              className="fig-comp-complement"
                              data-testid="nora-composition-complement"
                            >
                              {compositionEl}
                            </div>
                          </>
                        );
                      }
                      return <SafeMarkdown content={m.content} />;
                    })()}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="fig-msg-body whitespace-pre-wrap">{m.content}</div>
                )}
                {proj?.activity && proj.activity.kind !== "wait" ? (
                  <details className="fig-nora-activity-history" data-testid="nora-activity-history">
                    <summary>Activité de cette réponse</summary>
                    <p>
                      {proj.activity.label}
                      {proj.activity.detail ? ` — ${proj.activity.detail}` : ""}
                    </p>
                  </details>
                ) : null}
                {proj &&
                proj.choices.length > 0 &&
                !compositionAnchorsChoices(proj.visualComposition) ? (
                  <div
                    className="fig-nora-choices"
                    data-testid="nora-choices"
                    data-actionable={proj.actionable ? "1" : "0"}
                    data-message-id={m.id}
                  >
                    {proj.choices.map((c) => (
                      <button
                        key={c.id}
                        type="button"
                        className="fig-nora-choice"
                        data-testid="nora-choice"
                        data-choice-id={c.id}
                        disabled={!proj.actionable || props.busy || props.choiceFrozen}
                        onClick={() => props.onChoice?.(c, m.id)}
                      >
                        {c.label}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                    {!proj.actionable ? (
                      <p className="fig-nora-choices-expired" data-testid="nora-choices-expired">
                        Propositions expirées — consultation seule.
                      </p>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                ) : null}
                {proj?.references?.length &&
                !compositionAnchorsReferences(proj.visualComposition) ? (
                  <ul className="fig-nora-refs" data-testid="nora-refs">
                    {proj.references.map((r, i) => (
                      <li key={`${r.kind}-${r.resourceId ?? r.path ?? i}`}>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="fig-nora-ref-link"
                          data-testid="nora-ref-link"
                          data-ref-kind={r.kind}
                          onClick={() => props.onReference?.(r)}
                        >
                          Consulter · {r.label}
                          {r.available === false ? " (à vérifier)" : ""}
                        </button>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                ) : null}
              </article>
            );
          })}
          {props.qualificationBanner ? (
            <div
              className="fig-panel space-y-3 my-3"
              role="status"
              aria-live="polite"
              data-testid="qualification-activity-banner"
              style={{ borderColor: "#7477ed55" }}
            >
              <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-[#7477ed] font-semibold">
                Nora prépare sa réponse
              </p>
              <div className="space-y-2 text-sm text-[#a3b0c7]">
                <p>✓ Sources et intention du projet consultées</p>
                <p>○ Préparation de la première orientation de trajectoire…</p>
              </div>
              {props.onOpenTrajectoire ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#7477ed] hover:underline"
                  data-testid="qualification-voir-trajectoire"
                  onClick={props.onOpenTrajectoire}
                >
                  Voir la trajectoire ↗
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {props.activity === "preparing" && !props.qualificationBanner ? (
            <div
              className="fig-nora-activity"
              role="status"
              aria-live="polite"
              data-testid="nora-activity-preparing"
            >
              <span className="fig-nora-activity-pulse" aria-hidden />
              <span>Nora prépare une réponse…</span>
              <span className="fig-nora-activity-note">
                Attente réelle — aucune étape inventée.
              </span>
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {(props.activity === "preparing" || (props.liveActivityEvents?.length ?? 0) > 0) &&
          (props.liveActivityHeadline || (props.liveActivityEvents?.length ?? 0) > 0) ? (
            <div
              className="fig-nora-live-activity"
              role="status"
              aria-live="polite"
              data-testid="nora-live-activity"
            >
              <p className="fig-nora-live-activity-headline" data-testid="nora-live-activity-headline">
                {props.liveActivityHeadline ||
                  props.liveActivityEvents?.[props.liveActivityEvents.length - 1]?.summary ||
                  "Activité en cours"}
              </p>
              {(props.liveActivityEvents?.length ?? 0) > 0 ? (
                <details data-testid="nora-live-activity-detail">
                  <summary>
                    Détail ({props.liveActivityEvents!.length} événement
                    {props.liveActivityEvents!.length > 1 ? "s" : ""})
                  </summary>
                  <ul>
                    {props.liveActivityEvents!.map((ev) => (
                      <li key={ev.sequence} data-nature={ev.nature} data-phase={ev.phase}>
                        <span className="fig-nora-live-activity-nature">{ev.nature}</span>
                        {" · "}
                        {ev.summary}
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </details>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {props.activity === "error" ? (
            <div className="fig-alert" role="alert" data-testid="nora-activity-error">
              La dernière réponse n&apos;a pas pu être consolidée entièrement. Le texte saisi est
              conservé. Aucune mutation n&apos;est relancée automatiquement — reformulez, ou
              réconciliez seulement si une intention d&apos;effet reste ouverte.
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </section>

      {/*
        Pending banner lives outside the Figma-sized composer card so
        max-height never clips reconcile controls under the shell lock.
      */}
      <div
        className="fig-travail-composer-stack"
        data-testid="nora-composer-stack"
        data-pending={props.unresolvedPending ? "1" : "0"}
        hidden={props.layoutMode === "enlarged"}
      >
        {props.unresolvedPending && props.onReconcile ? (
          <div className="fig-travail-pending" data-testid="thread-pending-banner">
            <p className="fig-travail-pending-copy">
              Tentative non résolue — vérifier l&apos;état serveur avant un nouveau tour. Une
              génération cognitive déjà terminée sans effet métier peut être levée ; un effet
              métier incertain reste protégé.
            </p>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn secondary"
              disabled={props.busy}
              data-testid="thread-reconcile-pending"
              onClick={props.onReconcile}
            >
              Vérifier et reprendre
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        <div
          className="fig-composer fig-travail-composer relative"
          data-testid="nora-composer"
          data-composer-locked={composerLocked ? "1" : "0"}
          data-composer-expanded={props.draft.includes("\n") || props.draft.length > 80 ? "1" : "0"}
        >
          {composerLocked ? (
            <div
              className="fig-travail-composer-lock absolute inset-0 z-10 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-4"
              style={{ background: "rgba(12, 16, 28, 0.72)" }}
              data-testid="composer-lock-overlay"
            >
              <svg
                className="shrink-0 text-[#7477ed]"
                width="24"
                height="24"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="1.75"
                aria-hidden
              >
                <rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="10" rx="2" />
                <path d="M8 11V8a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v3" />
              </svg>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-xs text-[#a3b0c7]">
                <p className="font-semibold text-[#f3f5ff]" data-testid="composer-lock-title">
                  Compositeur temporairement indisponible
                </p>
                <p data-testid="composer-lock-reason">
                  {props.composerLockReason ||
                    "Nora prépare la trajectoire — saisie et envoi désactivés jusqu'au résultat terminal."}
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="shrink-0 rounded border border-[#7477ed55] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[#7477ed]"
                title={
                  props.composerLockReason ||
                  "Compositeur temporairement indisponible pendant la qualification de trajectoire."
                }
                aria-label={
                  props.composerLockReason ||
                  "Compositeur temporairement indisponible pendant la qualification de trajectoire."
                }
                data-testid="composer-lock-info"
              >
                i
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : null}
          <div className="fig-travail-composer-row">
            <span className="fig-travail-composer-plus" aria-hidden>
              +
            </span>
            <textarea
              ref={textareaRef}
              className="fig-travail-composer-input"
              value={props.draft}
              onChange={(e) => props.onDraft(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Écrire à Nora dans ce projet…"
              aria-label="Message à Nora"
              data-testid="thread-draft"
              rows={1}
              readOnly={composerLocked}
              disabled={composerLocked}
              aria-disabled={composerLocked}
              onCompositionStart={() => setImeComposing(true)}
              onCompositionEnd={() => setImeComposing(false)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (composerLocked) {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  return;
                }
                if (imeComposing || e.nativeEvent.isComposing) return;
                // Mobile: Enter = newline; send via button only.
                if (isMobile) return;
                if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey && !props.busy) {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  if (props.draft.trim()) props.onSend();
                }
              }}
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              className="fig-travail-composer-send"
              disabled={sendDisabled}
              onClick={props.onSend}
              data-testid="thread-send"
              aria-label="Envoyer"
            >
              <span aria-hidden>↑</span>
            </button>
          </div>
          {props.status ? (
            <p className="sr-only" data-testid="thread-nora-status" role="status">
              {props.status}
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>

      {props.aside ? (
        <aside className="fig-travail-aside" data-testid="nora-aside">
          {props.aside}
        </aside>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import React from "react";
import type { VisualIconId, VisualSemanticRole } from "@/domains/conversation/visual-composition";
import { resolveVisualIcon } from "@/domains/conversation/visual-composition";

// Keep React binding for classic JSX transforms (Vitest SSR / esbuild).
void React;

const LABELS: Record<VisualIconId, string> = {
  info: "Information",
  observe: "Observation",
  fact: "Fait",
  hypothesis: "Hypothèse",
  risk: "Risque",
  recommend: "Recommandation",
  decision: "Décision",
  link: "Dépendance",
  step: "Étape",
  source: "Source",
};

function Glyph({ id }: { id: VisualIconId }) {
  const common = {
    viewBox: "0 0 24 24",
    width: 16,
    height: 16,
    fill: "none",
    stroke: "currentColor",
    strokeWidth: 1.75,
    strokeLinecap: "round" as const,
    strokeLinejoin: "round" as const,
    "aria-hidden": true,
  };
  switch (id) {
    case "info":
      return (
        <svg {...common}>
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" />
          <path d="M12 10v6M12 7h.01" />
        </svg>
      );
    case "observe":
      return (
        <svg {...common}>
          <path d="M2 12s4-6 10-6 10 6 10 6-4 6-10 6S2 12 2 12Z" />
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2.5" />
        </svg>
      );
    case "fact":
      return (
        <svg {...common}>
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" />
          <path d="m8 12 2.5 2.5L16 9" />
        </svg>
      );
    case "hypothesis":
      return (
        <svg {...common}>
          <path d="M9 18h6M10 22h4M8 2h8v2a6 6 0 0 1-2.5 4.9L12 11l-1.5 2.1A6 6 0 0 1 8 4V2Z" />
        </svg>
      );
    case "risk":
      return (
        <svg {...common}>
          <path d="m12 3 9 16H3L12 3Z" />
          <path d="M12 10v4M12 17h.01" />
        </svg>
      );
    case "recommend":
      return (
        <svg {...common}>
          <path d="M12 3v12M8 11l4 4 4-4" />
          <path d="M5 21h14" />
        </svg>
      );
    case "decision":
      return (
        <svg {...common}>
          <rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="2" />
          <path d="m8 12 2.5 2.5L16 9" />
        </svg>
      );
    case "link":
      return (
        <svg {...common}>
          <path d="M9 8H7a4 4 0 0 0 0 8h2M15 8h2a4 4 0 0 1 0 8h-2M8 12h8" />
        </svg>
      );
    case "step":
      return (
        <svg {...common}>
          <circle cx="6" cy="6" r="2.5" />
          <circle cx="18" cy="18" r="2.5" />
          <path d="M8 7.5 16 16.5" />
        </svg>
      );
    case "source":
      return (
        <svg {...common}>
          <path d="M8 4h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v14l-4-2-4 2V6a2 2 0 0 0-2-2H6" />
          <path d="M6 8h2M6 12h2" />
        </svg>
      );
    default:
      return (
        <svg {...common}>
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" />
        </svg>
      );
  }
}

export function NoraSemanticIcon(props: {
  icon?: VisualIconId | null;
  role?: VisualSemanticRole | null;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const id = resolveVisualIcon({ icon: props.icon, role: props.role });
  return (
    <span
      className={`fig-visual-icon fig-visual-icon-${id}${props.className ? ` ${props.className}` : ""}`}
      data-testid="nora-visual-icon"
      data-icon={id}
      title={LABELS[id]}
    >
      <Glyph id={id} />
      <span className="sr-only">{LABELS[id]}</span>
    </span>
  );
}
```

- git: `clean` / index-blob `0ee8d4c1c06543c0ad22005857405ec28c7ef3b5`

```typescript
"use client";

/**
 * Directed relations — ELKjs production layout (Morris GO).
 * Measure real node boxes → ELK orthogonal → paint. Fallback: structured reading.
 */

import React, { useEffect, useId, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { GraphNodeCard } from "@/components/figma/nora-composition/GraphNodeCard";
import {
  computeElkDirectedLayout,
  type DirectedLayoutResult,
  type NodeSizeMap,
} from "@/domains/conversation/directed-layout";
import type { RelationsBlock } from "@/domains/conversation/visual-composition";

void React;

function edgeLabel(e: RelationsBlock["edges"][number]): string {
  if (e.relation === "condition_true") return e.label ? `Si oui — ${e.label}` : "Si oui";
  if (e.relation === "condition_false") return e.label ? `Si non — ${e.label}` : "Si non";
  if (e.relation === "sync") return e.label ? `Synchronisation — ${e.label}` : "Synchronisation";
  if (e.relation === "depends_on") return e.label ? `Dépendance — ${e.label}` : "Dépendance";
  return e.label || "puis";
}

function branchFor(
  nodeId: string,
  edges: RelationsBlock["edges"],
): "root" | "yes" | "no" | "then" | "gate" | undefined {
  const incoming = edges.filter((e) => e.to === nodeId);
  if (!incoming.length) return "root";
  if (incoming.some((e) => e.relation === "sync")) return "gate";
  if (incoming.some((e) => e.relation === "condition_true")) return "yes";
  if (incoming.some((e) => e.relation === "condition_false")) return "no";
  return "then";
}

export function DirectedRelationBoard({
  block,
  titleById,
}: {
  block: RelationsBlock;
  titleById: Map<string, string>;
}) {
  const hint = block.layoutHint ?? "dependencies";
  const reactId = useId();
  const markerId = `fig-nc-elk-arrow-${reactId.replace(/:/g, "")}`;
  const measureRootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [layout, setLayout] = useState<DirectedLayoutResult | null>(null);
  const [measureKey, setMeasureKey] = useState(0);
  const lastWidthRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const testId =
    hint === "decisionTree"
      ? "nora-composition-decision-tree"
      : hint === "parallelProcess"
        ? "nora-composition-parallel"
        : "nora-composition-dependencies";

  const syncTargets = new Set(
    block.edges.filter((e) => e.relation === "sync").map((e) => e.to),
  );
  // Prefer explicit sync gate; else highest multi-lane fan-in (UX-05 flow-only convergence).
  const gateId =
    [...syncTargets][0] ??
    (() => {
      if (hint !== "parallelProcess") return undefined;
      const laneOf = new Map<string, string>();
      for (const n of block.nodes) {
        const lane = n.laneId?.trim();
        if (lane) laneOf.set(n.id, lane);
      }
      let best: string | undefined;
      let bestCount = 1;
      for (const n of block.nodes) {
        const lanesHit = new Set<string>();
        for (const e of block.edges) {
          if (e.to !== n.id) continue;
          const lane = laneOf.get(e.from);
          if (lane) lanesHit.add(lane);
        }
        if (lanesHit.size > bestCount) {
          bestCount = lanesHit.size;
          best = n.id;
        }
      }
      return best;
    })();

  const lanes =
    hint === "parallelProcess"
      ? (() => {
          const m = new Map<string, typeof block.nodes>();
          for (const n of block.nodes) {
            const lane = n.laneId?.trim();
            if (!lane) continue;
            const list = m.get(lane) ?? [];
            list.push(n);
            m.set(lane, list);
          }
          return m;
        })()
      : null;

  // Remeasure on container width changes (debounced via rAF, no RO loop).
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = measureRootRef.current?.parentElement;
    if (!el || typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") return;
    let raf = 0;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
      const w = entries[0]?.contentRect.width ?? 0;
      if (lastWidthRef.current != null && Math.abs(lastWidthRef.current - w) < 8) return;
      lastWidthRef.current = w;
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => setMeasureKey((k) => k + 1));
    });
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      ro.disconnect();
    };
  }, []);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const root = measureRootRef.current;
    if (!root) return;
    const sizes: NodeSizeMap = {};
    for (const n of block.nodes) {
      const el = root.querySelector(`[data-measure-id="${CSS.escape(n.id)}"]`);
      if (el instanceof HTMLElement) {
        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        sizes[n.id] = { width: r.width || 220, height: r.height || 72 };
      }
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    void (async () => {
      const result = await computeElkDirectedLayout(block, sizes);
      if (!cancelled) setLayout(result);
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [block, measureKey]);

  const engineAttr =
    layout?.status === "ready"
      ? "elkjs"
      : layout?.status === "unavailable"
        ? layout.reason === "LAYOUT_FAILED"
          ? "elk-failed"
          : "elk-unavailable"
        : "loading";

  const canvasW =
    layout?.status === "ready"
      ? Math.max(...layout.nodes.map((n) => n.x + n.width), 0) + 16
      : 0;
  const canvasH =
    layout?.status === "ready"
      ? Math.max(...layout.nodes.map((n) => n.y + n.height), 0) + 16
      : 0;

  return (
    <div
      className={`fig-nc-relations fig-nc-relations-${hint}`}
      data-testid={testId}
      data-layout-hint={hint}
      data-layout-engine={engineAttr}
      data-legacy-artisan="0"
      data-connectors={layout?.status === "ready" && layout.edges.length ? "1" : "0"}
      data-gate={gateId ?? ""}
      data-node-count={block.nodes.length}
      data-edge-count={block.edges.length}
    >
      {/* Hidden measure pass — real typography/box sizes for ELK */}
      <div
        ref={measureRootRef}
        className="fig-nc-measure-layer"
        aria-hidden
        data-testid="nora-composition-measure-layer"
        data-measure-width={hint === "parallelProcess" ? "190" : "280"}
        style={{ width: hint === "parallelProcess" ? 190 : 280 }}
      >
        {block.nodes.map((n) => (
          <div key={n.id} data-measure-id={n.id} className="fig-nc-measure-node">
            <GraphNodeCard
              node={n}
              branch={branchFor(n.id, block.edges)}
              emphasize={n.id === gateId}
            />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {layout?.status === "ready" ? (
        <div
          className="fig-nc-elk-canvas-wrap"
          data-testid="nora-composition-elk-wrap"
        >
        <div
          className="fig-nc-elk-canvas"
          data-testid="nora-composition-elk-canvas"
          style={{ width: canvasW, height: canvasH, position: "relative" }}
        >
          <svg
            className="fig-nc-elk-svg"
            width={canvasW}
            height={canvasH}
            viewBox={`0 0 ${canvasW} ${canvasH}`}
            data-testid={
              hint === "decisionTree"
                ? "nora-composition-tree-connectors"
                : hint === "parallelProcess"
                  ? "nora-composition-parallel-connectors"
                  : "nora-composition-deps-connectors"
            }
            aria-hidden
          >
            <defs>
              <marker
                id={markerId}
                markerWidth="8"
                markerHeight="8"
                refX="6"
                refY="3"
                orient="auto"
              >
                <path d="M0,0 L6,3 L0,6 Z" className="fig-comp-deps-arrowhead" />
              </marker>
            </defs>
            {layout.edges.map((e) => {
              if (e.points.length < 2) return null;
              const d = e.points
                .map((p, i) => `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"} ${p[0]} ${p[1]}`)
                .join(" ");
              return (
                <path
                  key={e.id}
                  d={d}
                  className="fig-comp-deps-connector"
                  markerEnd={`url(#${markerId})`}
                  data-edge-key={e.id}
                  data-routing="orthogonal"
                />
              );
            })}
          </svg>
          {layout.nodes.map((box) => {
            const node = block.nodes.find((n) => n.id === box.id);
            if (!node) return null;
            return (
              <div
                key={box.id}
                className="fig-nc-elk-node"
                style={{
                  position: "absolute",
                  left: box.x,
                  top: box.y,
                  width: box.width,
                }}
                data-node-id={box.id}
                data-laid-x={Math.round(box.x)}
                data-laid-y={Math.round(box.y)}
                data-lane={node.laneId ?? ""}
              >
                <GraphNodeCard
                  node={node}
                  branch={branchFor(node.id, block.edges)}
                  emphasize={node.id === gateId}
                />
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="fig-nc-relations-reading" data-testid="nora-composition-relations-reading">
          {lanes ? (
            <div className="fig-nc-parallel-lanes" data-testid="nora-composition-parallel-lanes">
              {[...lanes.entries()].map(([lane, nodes]) => {
                const isGate = gateId != null && nodes.some((n) => n.id === gateId);
                return (
                  <section
                    key={lane}
                    className={`fig-nc-parallel-lane${isGate ? " fig-nc-parallel-lane-gate" : ""}`}
                    data-lane={lane}
                    data-lane-role={isGate ? "gate" : "flow"}
                    data-testid={isGate ? "nora-composition-parallel-gate" : undefined}
                  >
                    <h4 className="fig-comp-parallel-lane-title">
                      {lane}
                      {isGate ? " · convergence" : ""}
                    </h4>
                    <div className="fig-nc-parallel-tasks">
                      {nodes.map((n) => (
                        <GraphNodeCard
                          key={n.id}
                          node={n}
                          branch={isGate ? "gate" : branchFor(n.id, block.edges)}
                        />
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </section>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="fig-nc-node-flow">
              {block.nodes.map((n) => (
                <GraphNodeCard key={n.id} node={n} branch={branchFor(n.id, block.edges)} />
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Accessible relation list — always present; visually subdued when ELK paints */}
      <ul
        className={`fig-comp-deps-edges${layout?.status === "ready" ? " fig-nc-edges-a11y" : ""}`}
        data-testid={
          hint === "decisionTree"
            ? "nora-composition-tree-edges"
            : hint === "parallelProcess"
              ? "nora-composition-parallel-edges"
              : "nora-composition-relations-edges"
        }
        data-directed="1"
        aria-label="Relations dirigées"
      >
        {block.edges.map((e, i) => (
          <li key={`${e.from}-${e.to}-${i}`} data-relation={e.relation ?? "flow"}>
            <span className="fig-comp-deps-from">{titleById.get(e.from) ?? e.from}</span>
            <span className="fig-comp-tree-condition">{edgeLabel(e)}</span>
            <span className="fig-comp-deps-to">{titleById.get(e.to) ?? e.to}</span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>

      {hint === "decisionTree" ? (
        <p className="fig-comp-authority-note">
          Les branches conditionnelles sont des propositions de lecture — aucune HumanDecision
          n&apos;est créée.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <p className="fig-comp-authority-note">
          La convergence graphique n&apos;enregistre aucune décision humaine ni validation.
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

/**
 * Figma 02 / 06 — editorial sequence: horizontal numbered cards + optional
 * fixture timeline, or vertical editorial steps 01–06.
 */

import React from "react";
import { SafeMarkdown } from "@/components/SafeMarkdown";
import { stripLeadingOrdinal } from "@/components/figma/nora-composition/editorial-title";
import type { SequenceBlock } from "@/domains/conversation/visual-composition";
import type { SequenceVariant } from "@/domains/conversation/conversational-composition";

void React;

export function EditorialSequence({
  block,
  variant,
}: {
  block: SequenceBlock;
  variant: SequenceVariant;
}) {
  const horizontal = variant === "horizontal";
  // Timeline renders whenever temporal data is present — fixtureDemo only qualifies
  // the badge/footnote, never the authorization to paint an admitted timeline.
  const showTimeline = Boolean(block.timeline?.weeks && block.timeline.tracks?.length);

  return (
    <div
      className={`fig-nc-sequence fig-nc-sequence-${variant}`}
      data-testid="nora-composition-editorial-sequence"
      data-variant={variant}
      data-fixture-demo={block.fixtureDemo ? "1" : "0"}
      data-timeline={showTimeline ? "1" : "0"}
      data-step-count={block.steps.length}
    >
      {block.fixtureDemo ? (
        <p className="fig-nc-fixture-badge">EXEMPLE · SÉQUENCE FICTIVE</p>
      ) : null}

      <header className="fig-nc-editorial-hero">
        <h3 className="fig-nc-editorial-headline">
          <span className="fig-nc-editorial-headline-primary">{block.title}</span>
          {block.headlineAccent ? (
            <span className="fig-nc-editorial-headline-accent">{block.headlineAccent}</span>
          ) : null}
        </h3>
        {block.lead ? <p className="fig-nc-editorial-lead">{block.lead}</p> : null}
      </header>

      {horizontal ? (
        <section className="fig-nc-editorial-section" data-testid="nora-composition-steps-horizontal">
          {/* UX-03 — section title only; step medallion is the sole ordinal. */}
          <div className="fig-nc-section-head fig-nc-section-head-plain">
            <h4 className="fig-nc-section-title">
              {block.steps.length === 4
                ? "Quatre étapes à maîtriser"
                : `${block.steps.length} étapes à maîtriser`}
            </h4>
          </div>
          <ol className="fig-nc-h-steps">
            {block.steps.map((step, idx) => (
              <li key={step.id} className="fig-nc-h-step" data-step-id={step.id}>
                {idx > 0 ? <div className="fig-nc-h-step-link" aria-hidden /> : null}
                <article className="fig-nc-h-step-card">
                  <div className="fig-nc-h-step-medallion" aria-hidden>
                    {idx + 1}
                  </div>
                  <h5>{stripLeadingOrdinal(step.title)}</h5>
                  {step.detail ? (
                    <SafeMarkdown content={step.detail} className="fig-visual-inline-md" />
                  ) : null}
                </article>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>
        </section>
      ) : (
        <section
          className="fig-nc-editorial-section fig-nc-v-steps-section"
          data-testid="nora-composition-steps-vertical"
        >
          <div className="fig-nc-section-head fig-nc-section-head-plain">
            <h4 className="fig-nc-section-title">
              {block.steps.length === 6
                ? "Parcours en six temps"
                : `Parcours en ${block.steps.length} temps`}
            </h4>
          </div>
          <ol className="fig-nc-v-steps">
            {block.steps.map((step, idx) => (
              <li key={step.id} className="fig-nc-v-step" data-step-id={step.id}>
                <span className="fig-nc-v-step-num" aria-hidden>
                  {String(idx + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
                </span>
                <div className="fig-nc-v-step-body">
                  <h5>{stripLeadingOrdinal(step.title)}</h5>
                  {step.detail ? (
                    <SafeMarkdown content={step.detail} className="fig-visual-inline-md" />
                  ) : null}
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>
        </section>
      )}

      {showTimeline && block.timeline ? (
        <section
          className="fig-nc-editorial-section"
          data-testid="nora-composition-timeline"
          aria-label={
            block.fixtureDemo ? "Chronologie de démonstration" : "Chronologie"
          }
        >
          <div className="fig-nc-section-head fig-nc-section-head-plain">
            <h4 className="fig-nc-section-title">
              Une lecture possible des {block.timeline.weeks} semaines
            </h4>
          </div>
          {block.timeline.caption ? (
            <p className="fig-nc-timeline-caption">{block.timeline.caption}</p>
          ) : null}
          <div
            className="fig-nc-timeline"
            style={{ ["--tl-weeks" as string]: String(block.timeline.weeks) }}
          >
            <div className="fig-nc-timeline-head" aria-hidden>
              <span className="fig-nc-timeline-label-col" />
              <div className="fig-nc-timeline-weeks">
                {Array.from({ length: block.timeline.weeks }, (_, i) => (
                  <span key={i} className="fig-nc-timeline-week">
                    S{i + 1}
                  </span>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            {block.timeline.tracks.map((track) => {
              const start = Math.max(1, Math.min(track.startWeek, block.timeline!.weeks));
              const end = Math.max(start, Math.min(track.endWeek, block.timeline!.weeks));
              const span = end - start + 1;
              return (
                <div key={track.id} className="fig-nc-timeline-row" data-track-id={track.id}>
                  <span className="fig-nc-timeline-label-col">{track.label}</span>
                  <div className="fig-nc-timeline-track">
                    <div
                      className={`fig-nc-timeline-bar fig-nc-timeline-${track.tone ?? "blue"}`}
                      style={{
                        gridColumn: `${start} / span ${span}`,
                      }}
                      data-start-week={start}
                      data-end-week={end}
                    >
                      {track.barLabel ?? track.label}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
          <p className="fig-nc-timeline-footnote">
            {block.fixtureDemo
              ? "Lecture indicative (FIXTURE / DEMONSTRATION) — aucune date projet n'est affirmée."
              : "Lecture temporelle issue des données admises — ne pas confondre avec un engagement."}
          </p>
        </section>
      ) : null}

      {block.closingNote ? (
        <aside className="fig-nc-orientation" data-testid="nora-composition-sequence-closing">
          <p className="fig-nc-orientation-label">Garde-fou</p>
          <p className="fig-nc-orientation-body">{block.closingNote}</p>
        </aside>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```
