```typescript
"use client";

/**
 * Figma 01 — editorial synthesis composition (dark Studio).
 * Structure: headline + accent, lead, indicators, numbered sections,
 * strategy cards, checklist, conditional orientation.
 */

import React from "react";
import { SafeMarkdown } from "@/components/SafeMarkdown";
import { NoraSemanticIcon } from "@/components/figma/NoraSemanticIcon";
import type {
  SynthesisBlock,
  VisualSemanticRole,
} from "@/domains/conversation/visual-composition";

void React;

/** UX-06 — map residual labels to distinct semantic roles; avoid all-observation eyes. */
function residualRole(it: SynthesisBlock["items"][number]): VisualSemanticRole {
  if (it.role) return it.role;
  const blob = `${it.label ?? ""} ${it.detail ?? ""}`.toLowerCase();
  if (it.tone === "risk" || /anomal|incident|vigilance|risque|alerte/.test(blob)) {
    return "risk";
  }
  if (/acquis|confirm[ée]|confirmé|confirmée/.test(blob)) return "fact";
  if (/validat|contr[oô]le/.test(blob)) return "fact";
  if (/d[ée]cision|arbitrage/.test(blob)) {
    // Pending arbitration must not look approved (decision glyph = checkbox).
    if (/approuv|valid[ée]|retenu|act[ée]e?/.test(blob)) return "decision";
    return "recommendation";
  }
  if (it.tone === "hypothesis" || /hypoth/.test(blob)) return "hypothesis";
  if (it.tone === "priority" || /priorit|recommand/.test(blob)) return "recommendation";
  if (it.tone === "observation") return "observation";
  return "information";
}

function residualShowIcon(role: VisualSemanticRole, it: SynthesisBlock["items"][number]): boolean {
  if (it.icon) return true;
  // Skip decorative default eye/info when no useful signal.
  return role !== "information" && role !== "observation";
}

/**
 * C2 exact-identity only — never substring / includes.
 * A residual item is suppressed only when the same label+detail pair (or the same
 * non-empty detail alone against a checklist/strategy field) matches a surface
 * field character-for-character after trim.
 */
function exactShownElsewhere(it: SynthesisBlock["items"][number], block: SynthesisBlock): boolean {
  const label = (it.label ?? "").trim();
  const detail = (it.detail ?? "").trim();
  if (!label && !detail) return false;

  const strategyHit = (block.strategyCards ?? []).some((c) => {
    const fields = [c.title, c.summary, c.positive, c.counterpart, c.eyebrow]
      .filter((x): x is string => typeof x === "string" && x.trim().length > 0)
      .map((x) => x.trim());
    // Full-field equality only — never bag.includes(detail).
    if (detail && fields.some((f) => f === detail)) {
      // If a label exists, require it to match title or eyebrow exactly as well.
      if (!label) return true;
      return fields.some((f) => f === label);
    }
    if (label && detail) {
      const title = (c.title ?? "").trim();
      const eyebrow = (c.eyebrow ?? "").trim();
      const summary = (c.summary ?? "").trim();
      return (
        (label === title || label === eyebrow) &&
        (detail === summary ||
          detail === (c.positive ?? "").trim() ||
          detail === (c.counterpart ?? "").trim())
      );
    }
    return false;
  });
  if (strategyHit) return true;

  return (block.checklist ?? []).some((row) => {
    const rl = (row.label ?? "").trim();
    const rd = (row.detail ?? "").trim();
    if (label && detail) return rl === label && rd === detail;
    if (detail && !label) return rd === detail;
    if (label && !detail) return rl === label && rd === "";
    return false;
  });
}

export function EditorialSynthesis({ block }: { block: SynthesisBlock }) {
  // C2 — drop residual items only on demonstrated exact-identity duplication with
  // strategy/checklist surfaces. Tone alone never suppresses a distinct nuance.
  const residual = block.items.filter((it) => !exactShownElsewhere(it, block));

  return (
    <div
      className="fig-nc-editorial fig-comp-synth-flow"
      data-testid="nora-composition-editorial-synthesis"
      data-renderer="editorial-v3"
      data-fixture-demo={block.fixtureDemo ? "1" : "0"}
    >
      {block.fixtureDemo ? (
        <p className="fig-nc-fixture-badge" data-testid="nora-composition-fixture-badge">
          EXEMPLE · DONNÉES FICTIVES
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <header className="fig-nc-editorial-hero">
        <h3 className="fig-nc-editorial-headline" data-testid="nora-composition-editorial-headline">
          <span className="fig-nc-editorial-headline-primary">{block.title}</span>
          {block.headlineAccent ? (
            <span className="fig-nc-editorial-headline-accent">{block.headlineAccent}</span>
          ) : null}
        </h3>
        {block.lead ? (
          <p className="fig-nc-editorial-lead" data-testid="nora-composition-editorial-lead">
            {block.lead}
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </header>

      {block.indicators?.length ? (
        <div
          className="fig-nc-indicators"
          data-testid="nora-composition-indicators"
          data-count={block.indicators.length}
        >
          {block.indicators.map((ind, i) => (
            <React.Fragment key={ind.id}>
              {i > 0 ? <div className="fig-nc-indicators-divider" aria-hidden /> : null}
              <div className="fig-nc-indicator" data-indicator-id={ind.id}>
                <p className="fig-nc-indicator-value">{ind.value}</p>
                <p className="fig-nc-indicator-label">{ind.label}</p>
              </div>
            </React.Fragment>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {block.strategyCards?.length ? (
        <section
          className="fig-nc-editorial-section"
          data-testid="nora-composition-strategies"
          aria-label={block.strategiesSectionTitle ?? "Stratégies"}
        >
          <div className="fig-nc-section-head fig-nc-section-head-plain">
            <h4 className="fig-nc-section-title">
              {block.strategiesSectionTitle ?? "Deux stratégies, deux répartitions du risque"}
            </h4>
          </div>
          <div
            className="fig-nc-strategy-grid"
            data-count={block.strategyCards.length}
          >
            {block.strategyCards.map((card) => (
              <article
                key={card.id}
                className={`fig-nc-strategy-card fig-nc-strategy-${card.accent ?? "blue"}`}
                data-testid="nora-composition-strategy-card"
                data-accent={card.accent ?? "blue"}
              >
                <div className="fig-nc-strategy-accent" aria-hidden />
                <div className="fig-nc-strategy-top">
                  <p className="fig-nc-strategy-eyebrow">{card.eyebrow}</p>
                  <span className="fig-nc-strategy-mono" aria-hidden>
                    {(card.eyebrow.match(/[A-Z]$/)?.[0] ?? card.eyebrow.slice(-1)).toUpperCase()}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <h5 className="fig-nc-strategy-title">{card.title}</h5>
                <p className="fig-nc-strategy-summary">{card.summary}</p>
                {card.positive || card.counterpart ? (
                  <div className="fig-nc-strategy-footer">
                    {card.positive ? (
                      <p className="fig-nc-strategy-positive">{card.positive}</p>
                    ) : null}
                    {card.counterpart ? (
                      <p className="fig-nc-strategy-counterpart">{card.counterpart}</p>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                ) : null}
              </article>
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      ) : null}

      {block.checklist?.length ? (
        <section
          className="fig-nc-editorial-section"
          data-testid="nora-composition-checklist"
          aria-label={block.checklistSectionTitle ?? "Points à vérifier"}
        >
          <div className="fig-nc-section-head fig-nc-section-head-plain">
            <h4 className="fig-nc-section-title">
              {block.checklistSectionTitle ?? "Ce qui doit être vérifié avant tout choix"}
            </h4>
          </div>
          <ul className="fig-nc-checklist">
            {block.checklist.map((row) => (
              <li key={row.id} className="fig-nc-checklist-row" data-checklist-id={row.id}>
                <span className="fig-nc-checklist-dot" aria-hidden />
                <strong className="fig-nc-checklist-label">{row.label}</strong>
                <span className="fig-nc-checklist-detail">{row.detail}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </section>
      ) : null}

      {residual.length ? (
        <ul className="fig-visual-synthesis-list fig-nc-residual-items">
          {residual.map((it) => {
            const role = residualRole(it);
            const showIcon = residualShowIcon(role, it);
            return (
              <li
                key={it.id}
                data-tone={it.tone}
                data-role={role}
                data-icon={showIcon ? "1" : "0"}
                className={`fig-visual-synth-item fig-visual-tone-${it.tone ?? "information"} fig-comp-synth-row`}
              >
                {showIcon ? <NoraSemanticIcon role={role} icon={it.icon} /> : null}
                <div className="fig-comp-synth-copy">
                  <strong className="fig-comp-synth-label">{it.label}</strong>
                  {it.detail ? (
                    <SafeMarkdown
                      content={it.detail}
                      className="fig-visual-inline-md fig-comp-synth-detail"
                    />
                  ) : null}
                </div>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      ) : null}

      {block.orientation ? (
        <aside
          className="fig-nc-orientation"
          data-testid="nora-composition-orientation"
        >
          <p className="fig-nc-orientation-label">Orientation conditionnelle</p>
          <p className="fig-nc-orientation-body">{block.orientation}</p>
        </aside>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import React from "react";
import { NoraSemanticIcon } from "@/components/figma/NoraSemanticIcon";
import type { RelationsBlock, VisualSemanticRole } from "@/domains/conversation/visual-composition";

void React;

type Node = RelationsBlock["nodes"][number];

/**
 * UX-04 — graph icons only when they carry a verifiable epistemic/risk signal.
 * Neutral activity / observation nodes stay label-only (no decorative eye).
 */
function semanticIconRole(
  kind: string | undefined,
): VisualSemanticRole | null {
  switch (kind) {
    case "hypothesis":
      return "hypothesis";
    case "unknown":
      return "information";
    case "cause":
      return "dependency";
    case "risk":
      return "risk";
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

/** Typed graph node — Figma 07–09 language; no radial E05. */
export function GraphNodeCard({
  node,
  branch,
  emphasize,
}: {
  node: Node;
  branch?: "root" | "yes" | "no" | "then" | "gate";
  emphasize?: boolean;
}) {
  const iconRole = semanticIconRole(node.kind);
  return (
    <article
      className={`fig-nc-graph-node${emphasize ? " fig-nc-graph-node-emphasis" : ""}${
        branch ? ` fig-nc-graph-node-${branch}` : ""
      }${!iconRole ? " fig-nc-graph-node-plain" : ""}`}
      data-testid="nora-graph-node"
      data-node-id={node.id}
      data-node-kind={node.kind ?? ""}
      data-branch={branch ?? ""}
      data-lane={node.laneId ?? ""}
      data-icon={iconRole ? "1" : "0"}
    >
      {iconRole ? <NoraSemanticIcon role={iconRole} /> : null}
      <div className="fig-nc-graph-node-copy">
        <div className="fig-nc-graph-node-label">{node.label}</div>
        {node.detail ? (
          <div className="fig-nc-graph-node-detail">{node.detail}</div>
        ) : null}
        {node.kind === "unknown" || node.kind === "hypothesis" ? (
          <div className="fig-nc-graph-node-status">
            {node.kind === "unknown" ? "Non décidé" : "Hypothèse — pas une HumanDecision"}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * UX-03 — strip decorative leading ordinals duplicated by margin numbers.
 * Preserves titles whose digits are métier content (e.g. mid-string "8 semaines").
 */
export function stripLeadingOrdinal(title: string): string {
  let t = title.trim();
  if (!t) return title;
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i += 1) {
    const next = t.replace(/^\d{1,2}\s*[.)—–\-:/]\s*/, "").trim();
    if (next === t || !next) break;
    t = next;
  }
  return t || title.trim();
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * CP-02 / Cycle 8 A2 — prove DEV listen confinement beyond STUDIO_DEV_BIND env.
 * Env bind is a contract; this probe checks the actual TCP accept behavior.
 */

import net from "node:net";

export function isLoopbackHost(host: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  const h = (host ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  return h === "127.0.0.1" || h === "localhost" || h === "::1" || h === "[::1]";
}

/**
 * Probe whether `port` accepts on loopback and (best-effort) refuses a non-loopback bind check.
 * On macOS, binding to 0.0.0.0 while server listens on 127.0.0.1: connecting via
 * 127.0.0.1 succeeds; we additionally verify STUDIO_DEV_BIND matches.
 */
export async function probeDevListenConfinement(input: {
  port: number;
  declaredBind: string;
  connectHost?: string;
}): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  loopbackAccepts: boolean;
  declaredBindLoopback: boolean;
  reason?: string;
}> {
  const declaredBindLoopback = isLoopbackHost(input.declaredBind);
  if (!declaredBindLoopback) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      loopbackAccepts: false,
      declaredBindLoopback: false,
      reason: "DECLARED_BIND_NOT_LOOPBACK",
    };
  }

  const host = input.connectHost ?? "127.0.0.1";
  const loopbackAccepts = await new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
    const socket = net.connect({ host, port: input.port }, () => {
      socket.end();
      resolve(true);
    });
    socket.on("error", () => resolve(false));
    socket.setTimeout(800, () => {
      socket.destroy();
      resolve(false);
    });
  });

  if (!loopbackAccepts) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      loopbackAccepts: false,
      declaredBindLoopback,
      reason: "LOOPBACK_CONNECT_FAILED",
    };
  }

  return { ok: true, loopbackAccepts: true, declaredBindLoopback };
}

/** Sync gate used by auto-session: env bind + optional proven flag after probe. */
export function isDevListenProvenForAutoSession(
  env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv | Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env,
): boolean {
  const bind = (env.STUDIO_DEV_BIND ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!isLoopbackHost(bind)) return false;
  // After process start, operator/tests may set STUDIO_DEV_LISTEN_PROVEN=1 once probe passed.
  // Without it, auto-session still requires bind but issuance path should re-probe.
  return true;
}
```

```typescript
import { and, eq, isNull, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import { accounts, pilots, users } from "@/db/schema";
import { newId } from "@/lib/ids";

/**
 * Stable GitHub account id → PilotId mapping.
 * Source of truth: verified provider account row (server), never client-supplied PilotId.
 *
 * Hook-order safe: Better Auth may create the user (and an early Pilot) before the
 * GitHub `accounts` row exists. Later calls must backfill `pilots.github_user_id`
 * without changing PilotId or reparenting resources.
 */
export async function ensurePilotForAuthUser(userId: string): Promise<{
  pilotId: string;
  displayName: string;
  githubUserId: string | null;
}> {
  const user = (await db.select().from(users).where(eq(users.id, userId)).limit(1))[0];
  if (!user) {
    throw new Error("AUTH_USER_MISSING");
  }

  const githubAccount = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(accounts)
      .where(and(eq(accounts.userId, userId), eq(accounts.providerId, "github")))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];
  const githubUserId = githubAccount?.accountId ?? null;
  const displayName = user.name?.trim() || user.email || "Pilote";

  if (user.pilotId) {
    const pilot = (await db.select().from(pilots).where(eq(pilots.id, user.pilotId)).limit(1))[0];
    if (pilot) {
      // Late account link: preserve PilotId; fill github_user_id only when still null.
      if (githubUserId && !pilot.githubUserId) {
        const conflict = (
          await db
            .select({ id: pilots.id })
            .from(pilots)
            .where(and(eq(pilots.githubUserId, githubUserId), sql`${pilots.id} <> ${pilot.id}`))
            .limit(1)
        )[0];
        if (conflict) {
          // Do not merge/reparent — surface conflict for Morris/ops.
          throw Object.assign(new Error("PILOT_GITHUB_LINK_CONFLICT"), {
            code: "PILOT_GITHUB_LINK_CONFLICT",
          });
        }
        await db
          .update(pilots)
          .set({ githubUserId })
          .where(and(eq(pilots.id, pilot.id), isNull(pilots.githubUserId)));
        return {
          pilotId: pilot.id,
          displayName: pilot.displayName,
          githubUserId,
        };
      }
      if (
        githubUserId &&
        pilot.githubUserId &&
        pilot.githubUserId !== githubUserId
      ) {
        throw Object.assign(new Error("PILOT_GITHUB_LINK_CONFLICT"), {
          code: "PILOT_GITHUB_LINK_CONFLICT",
        });
      }
      return {
        pilotId: pilot.id,
        displayName: pilot.displayName,
        githubUserId: pilot.githubUserId,
      };
    }
  }

  let pilot =
    githubUserId != null
      ? (
          await db.select().from(pilots).where(eq(pilots.githubUserId, githubUserId)).limit(1)
        )[0]
      : undefined;

  if (!pilot) {
    const pilotId = newId("pilot");
    await db.insert(pilots).values({
      id: pilotId,
      githubUserId,
      displayName,
    });
    pilot = (await db.select().from(pilots).where(eq(pilots.id, pilotId)).limit(1))[0];
  }

  await db.update(users).set({ pilotId: pilot.id, updatedAt: new Date() }).where(eq(users.id, userId));

  return {
    pilotId: pilot.id,
    displayName: pilot.displayName,
    githubUserId: pilot.githubUserId,
  };
}
```

```typescript
import { newId } from "@/lib/ids";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { ensurePilotForAuthUser } from "@/domains/identity/provision-pilot";
import { isDependencyFailure, StudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";

export type AuthMode = "github-oauth" | "dev-test-login" | "unknown";

export type StudioSession = {
  pilotId: string;
  displayName: string;
  sessionId: string;
  authMode: AuthMode;
};

/**
 * Lane-scoped session cookie name to avoid cross-lane collision on the same host
 * (ENV-01 réserve A: 127.0.0.1:3100 vs :3200 share host-only cookies if names collide).
 * Better Auth cookies remain separately configured via BETTER_AUTH_URL per lane.
 */
function studioSessionCookieName(): string {
  const lane = (process.env.STUDIO_LANE ?? "UNKNOWN").trim().toUpperCase() || "UNKNOWN";
  const safe = lane.replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g, "_").slice(0, 24);
  return `sfia_studio_session__${safe}`;
}

const COOKIE = studioSessionCookieName();

/**
 * Single Studio session resolver.
 * Authority order:
 * 1. Better Auth session cookie (GitHub OAuth) → Pilot via users.pilotId / provision
 * 2. DEV-only lane-scoped `sfia_studio_session__*` cookie (explicit test adapter, not OAuth proof)
 */
export async function resolveStudioSession(): Promise<StudioSession | null> {
  const fromBetterAuth = await resolveBetterAuthStudioSession();
  if (fromBetterAuth) return fromBetterAuth;
  return resolveDevAdapterSession();
}

async function resolveBetterAuthStudioSession(): Promise<StudioSession | null> {
  try {
    const h = await headers();
    const result = await auth.api.getSession({ headers: h });
    if (!result?.session?.id || !result.user?.id) return null;

    const sessionRow = (
      await db
        .select({
          id: sessions.id,
          revokedAt: sessions.revokedAt,
          expiresAt: sessions.expiresAt,
          authMode: sessions.authMode,
        })
        .from(sessions)
        .where(eq(sessions.id, result.session.id))
        .limit(1)
    )[0];

    if (!sessionRow) return null;
    if (sessionRow.revokedAt) return null;
    if (sessionRow.expiresAt <= new Date()) return null;

    const linked = await ensurePilotForAuthUser(result.user.id);
    const authMode = (sessionRow.authMode as AuthMode) || "github-oauth";
    return {
      pilotId: linked.pilotId,
      displayName: linked.displayName,
      sessionId: sessionRow.id,
      authMode: authMode === "dev-test-login" ? "dev-test-login" : "github-oauth",
    };
  } catch (e) {
    // Dependency/DB failures must not be silently converted into "no session".
    // Callers map DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE → 503; true auth miss stays null → 401.
    if (isDependencyFailure(e)) {
      throw new StudioError("DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE", "Dépendance session indisponible", {
        httpStatus: 503,
        exposeMessage: false,
        cause: e,
      });
    }
    // Better Auth misconfig / missing secret must not crash every API — fall through to DEV adapter.
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Consume-time gate for DEV test sessions.
 * A cookie issued earlier must not remain valid once the lane leaves DEV or the adapter is disabled.
 */
export function isDevAdapterConsumeAllowed(): boolean {
  if (process.env.STUDIO_DEV_TEST_LOGIN !== "1") return false;
  const lane = (process.env.STUDIO_LANE ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
  // DEV construction + RECETTE Morris essai only — never STABLE/PROD.
  return lane === "DEV" || lane === "RECETTE";
}

/**
 * Consume path for a DEV adapter token (shared by cookie resolver and tests).
 * Fail-closed when lane/adapter flags leave DEV — even if the row is unexpired.
 */
export async function resolveDevAdapterSessionByToken(
  token: string,
): Promise<StudioSession | null> {
  if (!isDevAdapterConsumeAllowed()) return null;
  if (!token) return null;

  const rows = await db
    .select({
      sessionId: sessions.id,
      revokedAt: sessions.revokedAt,
      expiresAt: sessions.expiresAt,
      authMode: sessions.authMode,
      pilotId: pilots.id,
      displayName: pilots.displayName,
    })
    .from(sessions)
    .innerJoin(users, eq(sessions.userId, users.id))
    .innerJoin(pilots, eq(users.pilotId, pilots.id))
    .where(and(eq(sessions.token, token), isNull(sessions.revokedAt), gt(sessions.expiresAt, new Date())))
    .limit(1);

  const row = rows[0];
  if (!row?.pilotId) return null;

  // DEV adapter cookie must never be treated as GitHub OAuth.
  if (row.authMode !== "dev-test-login") return null;

  return {
    pilotId: row.pilotId,
    displayName: row.displayName,
    sessionId: row.sessionId,
    authMode: "dev-test-login",
  };
}

async function resolveDevAdapterSession(): Promise<StudioSession | null> {
  const jar = await cookies();
  const token = jar.get(COOKIE)?.value;
  if (!token) return null;
  return resolveDevAdapterSessionByToken(token);
}

export async function requireStudioSession(): Promise<StudioSession> {
  const s = await resolveStudioSession();
  if (!s) {
    const err = new Error("SESSION_INVALID");
    (err as Error & { code: string }).code = "SESSION_INVALID";
    throw err;
  }
  return s;
}

export async function revokeSession(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
  await db
    .update(sessions)
    .set({ revokedAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date() })
    .where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId));
}

export type DevLoginGateInput = {
  host?: string | null;
  /** Reject when any of these proxy headers are present — Host alone is forgeable. */
  forwardedHost?: string | null;
  forwardedFor?: string | null;
  realIp?: string | null;
};

/**
 * Exact loopback authority check — no prefix/suffix tricks (e.g. localhost.attacker.example).
 * Allows: localhost[:port], 127.0.0.1[:port], [::1][:port], ::1.
 * Rejects: commas/multi-value, userinfo, empty, non-loopback, invalid ports.
 */
export function isApprovedLoopbackAuthority(value: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (value == null) return false;
  const raw = value.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!raw) return false;
  // Ambiguous multi-value header — never trust a partial first element.
  if (raw.includes(",")) return false;
  if (raw.includes("@")) return false;
  if (/\s/.test(raw)) return false;

  if (raw === "::1") return true;

  const v4 = /^(127\.0\.0\.1)(?::(\d{1,5}))?$/.exec(raw);
  if (v4) return isValidPort(v4[2]);

  const local = /^(localhost)(?::(\d{1,5}))?$/.exec(raw);
  if (local) return isValidPort(local[2]);

  const v6 = /^\[::1\](?::(\d{1,5}))?$/.exec(raw);
  if (v6) return isValidPort(v6[1]);

  return false;
}

function isValidPort(port: string | undefined): boolean {
  if (port === undefined) return true;
  const n = Number(port);
  return Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 1 && n <= 65535;
}

/**
 * X-Forwarded-For / client IP: exactly one loopback address, no ports, no chain.
 */
export function isApprovedLoopbackClientIp(value: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (value == null || value.trim() === "") return false;
  const raw = value.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (raw.includes(",") || raw.includes("@") || /\s/.test(raw)) return false;
  return raw === "127.0.0.1" || raw === "::1" || raw === "[::1]";
}

function assertDevTestLoginAllowed(gate: DevLoginGateInput) {
  if (process.env.STUDIO_DEV_TEST_LOGIN !== "1") {
    throw new Error("DEV_TEST_LOGIN_DISABLED");
  }
  // Fail-closed: explicit lane DEV or RECETTE only (absent ≠ DEV; STABLE/PROD forbidden).
  const lane = (process.env.STUDIO_LANE ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (lane !== "DEV" && lane !== "RECETTE") {
    throw new Error("DEV_TEST_LOGIN_LANE_FORBIDDEN");
  }
  // Host alone is forgeable. Next DEV may set x-forwarded-* to loopback — allow only if
  // every present forwarding signal is itself an exact loopback authority.
  if (!isApprovedLoopbackAuthority(gate.host)) {
    throw new Error("DEV_TEST_LOGIN_HOST_FORBIDDEN");
  }
  if (gate.forwardedHost != null && gate.forwardedHost !== "" && !isApprovedLoopbackAuthority(gate.forwardedHost)) {
    throw new Error("DEV_TEST_LOGIN_PROXY_FORBIDDEN");
  }
  if (gate.forwardedFor != null && gate.forwardedFor !== "" && !isApprovedLoopbackClientIp(gate.forwardedFor)) {
    throw new Error("DEV_TEST_LOGIN_PROXY_FORBIDDEN");
  }
  if (gate.realIp != null && gate.realIp !== "" && !isApprovedLoopbackClientIp(gate.realIp)) {
    throw new Error("DEV_TEST_LOGIN_PROXY_FORBIDDEN");
  }
}

/**
 * CP-02 — server listen confinement for auto-session.
 * Headers alone are forgeable; bind address must be explicitly loopback.
 * Expected: next started with `-H 127.0.0.1` and `STUDIO_DEV_BIND=127.0.0.1`.
 */
export function isDevListenConfined(
  env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv | Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env,
): boolean {
  const bind = (env.STUDIO_DEV_BIND ?? env.HOSTNAME ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!bind) return false;
  // Exact bind host only — no ports here (ports are in STUDIO_PORT).
  return (
    bind === "127.0.0.1" ||
    bind === "localhost" ||
    bind === "::1" ||
    bind === "[::1]"
  );
}

/**
 * DÉC-ML5-DEV — auto-session gate (stricter than manual DEV test login).
 * DEV lane only — never RECETTE/STABLE. Explicit flag + loopback Host + bind.
 */
export function isDevAutoSessionAllowed(gate: DevLoginGateInput): boolean {
  if (process.env.STUDIO_DEV_AUTO_SESSION !== "1") return false;
  if (process.env.STUDIO_DEV_TEST_LOGIN !== "1") return false;
  const lane = (process.env.STUDIO_LANE ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (lane !== "DEV") return false;
  if (!isDevListenConfined()) return false;
  try {
    assertDevTestLoginAllowed({
      ...gate,
      // assertDevTestLoginAllowed already checks DEV|RECETTE; we force DEV above.
    });
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function assertDevAutoSessionAllowed(gate: DevLoginGateInput) {
  if (process.env.STUDIO_DEV_AUTO_SESSION !== "1") {
    throw new Error("DEV_AUTO_SESSION_DISABLED");
  }
  if (process.env.STUDIO_DEV_TEST_LOGIN !== "1") {
    throw new Error("DEV_TEST_LOGIN_DISABLED");
  }
  const lane = (process.env.STUDIO_LANE ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (lane !== "DEV") {
    throw new Error("DEV_AUTO_SESSION_LANE_FORBIDDEN");
  }
  if (!isDevListenConfined()) {
    throw new Error("DEV_AUTO_SESSION_BIND_NOT_LOOPBACK");
  }
  assertDevTestLoginAllowed(gate);
}

/**
 * DÉC-ML5-DEV — automatic Pilot A test session for BROWSER/F2 on DEV local.
 * Never chooses an arbitrary real pilot. Same deterministic identity as manual Pilote A.
 */
export async function createDevAutoSession(
  gate: DevLoginGateInput | string | null = null,
): Promise<{ token: string; pilotId: string; sessionId: string; which: "a" }> {
  const normalized: DevLoginGateInput =
    typeof gate === "string" || gate == null ? { host: gate } : gate;
  assertDevAutoSessionAllowed(normalized);
  const created = await createDevTestSession("a", normalized);
  return { ...created, which: "a" };
}

/** DEV-ONLY test login — Fake/Real: NOT GitHub OAuth proof. Loopback + DEV lane only. */
export async function createDevTestSession(
  which: "a" | "b",
  gate: DevLoginGateInput | string | null = null,
): Promise<{ token: string; pilotId: string; sessionId: string }> {
  const normalized: DevLoginGateInput =
    typeof gate === "string" || gate == null ? { host: gate } : gate;
  assertDevTestLoginAllowed(normalized);

  const label = which === "a" ? "Pilot A (DEV)" : "Pilot B (DEV)";
  const email = which === "a" ? "dev+pilot-a@studio.local" : "dev+pilot-b@studio.local";
  const githubMarker = which === "a" ? "dev-github-a" : "dev-github-b";

  let pilot = (
    await db.select().from(pilots).where(eq(pilots.githubUserId, githubMarker)).limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!pilot) {
    const pilotId = newId("pilot");
    await db.insert(pilots).values({
      id: pilotId,
      githubUserId: githubMarker,
      displayName: label,
    });
    pilot = (await db.select().from(pilots).where(eq(pilots.id, pilotId)).limit(1))[0];
  }

  let user = (await db.select().from(users).where(eq(users.email, email)).limit(1))[0];
  if (!user) {
    const userId = newId("user");
    await db.insert(users).values({
      id: userId,
      name: label,
      email,
      emailVerified: true,
      pilotId: pilot.id,
    });
    user = (await db.select().from(users).where(eq(users.id, userId)).limit(1))[0];
  } else if (!user.pilotId) {
    await db.update(users).set({ pilotId: pilot.id }).where(eq(users.id, user.id));
  }

  const token = newId("sess");
  const sessionId = newId("sid");
  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 7);
  await db.insert(sessions).values({
    id: sessionId,
    token,
    userId: user.id,
    expiresAt,
    authMode: "dev-test-login",
  });

  return { token, pilotId: pilot.id, sessionId };
}

export { COOKIE as STUDIO_SESSION_COOKIE };
```

```typescript
import { drizzle } from "drizzle-orm/postgres-js";
import postgres from "postgres";
import * as schema from "./schema";
import { assertApprovedVitestMutativeDatabaseUrl } from "@/lib/e2e-pg-gate";

const url = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
if (!url) {
  throw new Error("DATABASE_URL missing — refuse to start without explicit lane DSN");
}

// Vitest sets VITEST=true. Refuse operator/RECETTE/ambiguous targets before first socket.
if (process.env.VITEST === "true") {
  assertApprovedVitestMutativeDatabaseUrl(url);
}

const globalForDb = globalThis as unknown as { __sfiaSql?: ReturnType<typeof postgres> };

export const sql =
  globalForDb.__sfiaSql ??
  postgres(url, {
    max: 10,
    idle_timeout: 20,
    connect_timeout: 10,
  });

if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") {
  globalForDb.__sfiaSql = sql;
}

export const db = drizzle(sql, { schema });
export type Db = typeof db;
```

```sql
-- ML2 D4: knowledge subjects / acquis / open points + document revision provenance & concurrency.
-- Additive only. No destructive ALTER. Compatible with ML1 001+002 data.

-- Document revision provenance and base-revision concurrency control
ALTER TABLE document_revisions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS base_revision_id text REFERENCES document_revisions(id),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS correlation_key text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS provenance_json text NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS scope text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'document';

  ON document_revisions(document_id, correlation_key)
  WHERE correlation_key IS NOT NULL;

-- D4 knowledge subjects (one tree per preparation/project ownership)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_subjects (
  id text PRIMARY KEY,
  preparation_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES preparations(id),
  project_id text REFERENCES projects(id),
  owner_pilot_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES pilots(id),
  parent_subject_id text REFERENCES knowledge_subjects(id),
  title text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', -- ACTIVE | ARCHIVED | MERGED | SPLIT
  originated_from_subject_id text REFERENCES knowledge_subjects(id),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_subjects_project_idx ON knowledge_subjects(project_id);

  id text PRIMARY KEY,

  project_id text REFERENCES projects(id),
  owner_pilot_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES pilots(id),

);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_acquis_prep_idx ON knowledge_acquis(preparation_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_acquis_subject_idx ON knowledge_acquis(subject_id);

);

);
```

## FILE `projects/sfia-studio-next/web/src/db/migrations/005_ml2_conversation_turn_command.sql`

- lines: 51
- git: `clean` / index-blob `959535a89bec9d660414bd768cd01b6301413f3d`

```sql
-- ML2 D3 — durable conversation turn command (idempotent full-turn).
-- Additive / rejouable. Does NOT open a transaction across provider calls.
-- Never apply to RECETTE/STABLE without Morris gate.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversation_turn_commands (
  id text PRIMARY KEY,
  conversation_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES conversations(id),
  owner_pilot_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES pilots(id),
  client_turn_key text NOT NULL,
  request_fingerprint text NOT NULL,
  operation_id text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL,
  -- ACCEPTED | RUNNING | COMPLETE | FAILED | CONFLICT | UNKNOWN
  ordinal_user integer,
  ordinal_assistant integer,
  user_message_id text,
  assistant_message_id text,
  generation_id text,
  result_json text,
  error_category text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS conversation_turn_commands_conv_key_uidx
  ON conversation_turn_commands (conversation_id, client_turn_key);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS conversation_turn_commands_operation_uidx
  ON conversation_turn_commands (operation_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS conversation_turn_commands_conv_status_idx
  ON conversation_turn_commands (conversation_id, status);

-- Ordinal uniqueness after audit: refuse if duplicates exist.
DO $$
DECLARE
  dup_count integer;
BEGIN
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO dup_count FROM (
    SELECT conversation_id, ordinal, COUNT(*) AS c
    FROM messages
    GROUP BY conversation_id, ordinal
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
  ) d;
  IF dup_count > 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'STOP — messages ordinal duplicates exist (% groups); resolve before unique index', dup_count;
  END IF;
END $$;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS messages_conversation_ordinal_uidx
  ON messages (conversation_id, ordinal);
```

```sql
-- ML3 D5/D6 — pilotage, cycles, method, human decisions, restrictions, business commands.

  ON method_applications(project_id, scope) WHERE is_current = true;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS governance_restrictions (

  lift_decision_id text REFERENCES human_decisions(id),

  lifted_at timestamptz
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS governance_restrictions_project_idx
  ON governance_restrictions(project_id, status);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS business_commands (
  id text PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
  actor_pilot_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES pilots(id),
  client_command_key text NOT NULL,
  fingerprint text NOT NULL,
  source_kind text NOT NULL,
  source_ref text NOT NULL,
  source_action_key text NOT NULL,
  operation text NOT NULL,
  expected_revision integer NOT NULL,
  state_revision integer,
  status text NOT NULL,
  result_json text NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  decision_id text REFERENCES human_decisions(id),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS business_commands_client_key_uidx
  ON business_commands(project_id, actor_pilot_id, client_command_key);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS business_commands_human_intent_uidx
  ON business_commands(project_id, source_kind, source_ref, source_action_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS business_commands_project_idx ON business_commands(project_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS business_command_effects (
  id text PRIMARY KEY,
  command_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES business_commands(id),
  project_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
  effect_kind text NOT NULL,
  target_ref text NOT NULL,
  outcome text NOT NULL,
  ordinal integer NOT NULL,
  detail_json text NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS business_command_effects_command_ordinal_uidx
  ON business_command_effects(command_id, ordinal);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS business_command_effects_command_idx
  ON business_command_effects(command_id);

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'human_decisions_lifts_restriction_fkey') THEN
    ALTER TABLE human_decisions
      ADD CONSTRAINT human_decisions_lifts_restriction_fkey
      FOREIGN KEY (lifts_restriction_id) REFERENCES governance_restrictions(id);
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'human_decisions_state_chk') THEN
    ALTER TABLE human_decisions
      ADD CONSTRAINT human_decisions_state_chk
      CHECK (state IN ('APPLICABLE', 'REVISED', 'REVOKED', 'SUPERSEDED'));
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'trajectory_revisions_status_chk') THEN
    ALTER TABLE trajectory_revisions
      ADD CONSTRAINT trajectory_revisions_status_chk
      CHECK (status IN ('PROPOSED', 'RETAINED', 'SUPERSEDED'));
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'project_cycles_status_chk') THEN
    ALTER TABLE project_cycles
      ADD CONSTRAINT project_cycles_status_chk
      CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CLOSED'));
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'governance_restrictions_status_chk') THEN
    ALTER TABLE governance_restrictions
      ADD CONSTRAINT governance_restrictions_status_chk
      CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'LIFTED'));
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'business_commands_status_chk') THEN
    ALTER TABLE business_commands
      ADD CONSTRAINT business_commands_status_chk
      CHECK (status IN ('APPLIED', 'REJECTED'));
  END IF;
END $$;
```

```sql
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_decision_explanation_revisions_dec_rev_uidx
  ON knowledge_decision_explanation_revisions(decision_id, revision_number);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_decision_explanation_revisions_dec_op_uidx
  ON knowledge_decision_explanation_revisions(decision_id, operation_id)
  WHERE operation_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_decision_explanation_revisions_dec_idx
  ON knowledge_decision_explanation_revisions(decision_id);

-- C. Open-point factual event history (current row stays on knowledge_open_points)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_open_point_events (
  id text PRIMARY KEY,
  open_point_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_open_points(id),
  preparation_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES preparations(id),
  project_id text REFERENCES projects(id),
  owner_pilot_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES pilots(id),
  event_type text NOT NULL, -- OPENED | RESOLVED | REOPENED
  reason text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  actor_kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', -- pilot | nora | system
  provenance_json text NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  operation_id text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_open_point_events_point_idx
  ON knowledge_open_point_events(open_point_id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_open_point_events_op_uidx
  ON knowledge_open_point_events(open_point_id, operation_id)
  WHERE operation_id IS NOT NULL;

COMMENT ON TABLE knowledge_subject_summary_revisions IS
  'D4 immutable subject synthesis revisions (Journal §16A); current = max revision_number';
COMMENT ON TABLE knowledge_decision_explanation_revisions IS
  'D4 immutable decision explanations; never authorizes HumanDecision (D6)';
COMMENT ON TABLE knowledge_open_point_events IS
  'D4 factual open-point lifecycle events; does not lift D6 restrictions';
```

```sql
-- ML5 — additive persistence for technical contracts, Cursor attempts linkage, handoffs, activity.
-- Does not alter Git publication/merge semantics. Re-runnable (IF NOT EXISTS).

-- Canonical technical contract versions (D7) — distinct from Nora replyDraft.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS technical_contracts (
  id text PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
  pilot_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES pilots(id),
  preparation_id text REFERENCES preparations(id),
  contract_key text NOT NULL,
  version integer NOT NULL,
  fingerprint text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL,
  title text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  engagements_json text NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  volets_json text NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  instruction_text text NOT NULL,
  risks_json text NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  exclusions_json text NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  acceptance_json text NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  executor_json text NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  stop_conditions_json text NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  git_scope_json text,
  source_turn_command_id text,
  supersedes_contract_id text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (project_id, contract_key, version)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS technical_contracts_project_idx
  ON technical_contracts (project_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS technical_contracts_fingerprint_idx
  ON technical_contracts (fingerprint);

-- Per-attempt realization handoff (D7 ingestion → D8). One immutable row per attempt.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS realization_handoffs (
  id text PRIMARY KEY,
  attempt_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES effect_attempts(id),
  project_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
  pilot_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES pilots(id),
  contract_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES technical_contracts(id),
  contract_version integer NOT NULL,
  contract_fingerprint text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL,
  report_markdown text,
  manifest_json text NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  integrity_hash text,
  source_kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CURSOR',
  limits_json text NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (attempt_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS realization_handoffs_project_idx
  ON realization_handoffs (project_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS realization_handoffs_contract_idx
  ON realization_handoffs (contract_id);

-- D8 qualification snapshot per attempt (nine rubrics) — never merges with D6.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS realization_qualifications (
  id text PRIMARY KEY,
  attempt_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES effect_attempts(id),
  handoff_id text REFERENCES realization_handoffs(id),
  project_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
  pilot_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES pilots(id),
  status text NOT NULL,
  rubrics_json text NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  verdict text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INDETERMINATE',
  nora_analysis_markdown text,
  nora_analysis_at timestamptz,
  limits_json text NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (attempt_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS realization_qualifications_project_idx
  ON realization_qualifications (project_id);

-- C1 activity events correlated to a conversation turn (functional, not authority).
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS nora_activity_events (
  id text PRIMARY KEY,
  conversation_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES conversations(id),
  turn_command_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES conversation_turn_commands(id),
  owner_pilot_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES pilots(id),
  generation_id text,
  sequence integer NOT NULL,
  phase text NOT NULL,
  nature text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL,
  summary text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  detail_json text NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  source_ref text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (turn_command_id, sequence)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS nora_activity_events_turn_idx
  ON nora_activity_events (turn_command_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS nora_activity_events_conv_idx
  ON nora_activity_events (conversation_id);
```

## FILE `projects/sfia-studio-next/web/src/db/schema.ts`

```typescript
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import {
  pgTable,
  text,
  timestamp,
  integer,
  uniqueIndex,
  index,
  boolean,
  jsonb,
} from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";

/** D1 — Studio pilot identity (internal stable id). */
export const pilots = pgTable(
  "pilots",
  {
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    githubUserId: text("github_user_id"),
    displayName: text("display_name").notNull(),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [uniqueIndex("pilots_github_user_id_uidx").on(t.githubUserId)],
);

/** Better Auth core tables (minimal subset used with drizzle adapter). */
export const users = pgTable("users", {
  id: text("id").primaryKey(),
  name: text("name").notNull(),
  email: text("email").notNull().unique(),
  emailVerified: boolean("email_verified").notNull().default(false),
  image: text("image"),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  pilotId: text("pilot_id").references(() => pilots.id),
});

export const sessions = pgTable(
  "sessions",
  {
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    expiresAt: timestamp("expires_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull(),
    token: text("token").notNull().unique(),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
    updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
    ipAddress: text("ip_address"),
    userAgent: text("user_agent"),
    userId: text("user_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => users.id),
    revokedAt: timestamp("revoked_at", { withTimezone: true }),
    authMode: text("auth_mode").notNull().default("unknown"),
  },
  (t) => [index("sessions_user_id_idx").on(t.userId)],
);

export const accounts = pgTable("accounts", {
  id: text("id").primaryKey(),
  accountId: text("account_id").notNull(),
  providerId: text("provider_id").notNull(),
  userId: text("user_id")
    .notNull()
    .references(() => users.id),
  accessToken: text("access_token"),
  refreshToken: text("refresh_token"),
  idToken: text("id_token"),
  accessTokenExpiresAt: timestamp("access_token_expires_at", { withTimezone: true }),
  refreshTokenExpiresAt: timestamp("refresh_token_expires_at", { withTimezone: true }),
  scope: text("scope"),
  password: text("password"),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
});

export const verifications = pgTable("verifications", {
  id: text("id").primaryKey(),
  identifier: text("identifier").notNull(),
  value: text("value").notNull(),
  expiresAt: timestamp("expires_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull(),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
});

/** D2 — durable preparation without project. */
export const preparations = pgTable(
  "preparations",
  {
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    ownerPilotId: text("owner_pilot_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => pilots.id),
    status: text("status").notNull().default("OPEN"), // OPEN | ATTACHED
    creationRevision: integer("creation_revision").notNull().default(1),
    previewName: text("preview_name").notNull().default(""),
    previewSummary: text("preview_summary").notNull().default(""),
    /** D2 PreparationProjection v1 JSON snapshot — additive; null = legacy/partial. */
    projectionJson: jsonb("projection_json").$type<Record<string, unknown> | null>(),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
    updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [index("preparations_owner_idx").on(t.ownerPilotId)],
);

export const projects = pgTable(
  "projects",
  {
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    ownerPilotId: text("owner_pilot_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => pilots.id),
    name: text("name").notNull(),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [index("projects_owner_idx").on(t.ownerPilotId)],
);

export const preparationProjectLinks = pgTable(
  "preparation_project_links",
  {
    preparationId: text("preparation_id")
      .primaryKey()
      .references(() => preparations.id),
    projectId: text("project_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => projects.id),
    attachedAt: timestamp("attached_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
    /** P0-04 — true only for creates after Ensemble 07 qualification capability. Legacy = false. */
    initialQualificationExpected: boolean("initial_qualification_expected").notNull().default(false),
  },
);

export const createProjectCommands = pgTable(
  "create_project_commands",
  {
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    pilotId: text("pilot_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => pilots.id),
    idempotencyKey: text("idempotency_key").notNull(),
    fingerprint: text("fingerprint").notNull(),
    preparationId: text("preparation_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => preparations.id),
    projectId: text("project_id").references(() => projects.id),
    result: text("result").notNull(), // CREATED | ALREADY_CREATED | CONFLICT | ...
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [
    uniqueIndex("create_project_commands_pilot_key_uidx").on(t.pilotId, t.idempotencyKey),
  ],
);

/** D3 — conversation / messages. */
export const conversations = pgTable(
  "conversations",
  {
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    preparationId: text("preparation_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => preparations.id),
    projectId: text("project_id").references(() => projects.id),
    ownerPilotId: text("owner_pilot_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => pilots.id),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [index("conversations_prep_idx").on(t.preparationId)],
);

export const messages = pgTable(
  "messages",
  {
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    conversationId: text("conversation_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => conversations.id),
    role: text("role").notNull(), // user | assistant | system
    content: text("content").notNull(),
    status: text("status").notNull(), // COMPLETE | FAILED | INTERRUPTED | UNKNOWN | PENDING
    generationId: text("generation_id"),
    ordinal: integer("ordinal").notNull(),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [
    index("messages_conversation_idx").on(t.conversationId),
    uniqueIndex("messages_conversation_ordinal_uidx").on(t.conversationId, t.ordinal),
  ],
);

/**
 * D3 — durable turn command for full-turn idempotence.
 * Uniqueness: (conversation_id, client_turn_key). Short lock only around reservation.
 */
export const conversationTurnCommands = pgTable(
  "conversation_turn_commands",
  {
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    conversationId: text("conversation_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => conversations.id),
    ownerPilotId: text("owner_pilot_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => pilots.id),
    clientTurnKey: text("client_turn_key").notNull(),
    requestFingerprint: text("request_fingerprint").notNull(),
    operationId: text("operation_id").notNull(),
    status: text("status").notNull(),
    ordinalUser: integer("ordinal_user"),
    ordinalAssistant: integer("ordinal_assistant"),
    userMessageId: text("user_message_id"),
    assistantMessageId: text("assistant_message_id"),
    generationId: text("generation_id"),
    resultJson: text("result_json"),
    errorCategory: text("error_category"),
    /** Ownership fence — invalidated on reconcile; required for terminal CAS / D4 gates. */
    ownerToken: text("owner_token"),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
    updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [
    uniqueIndex("conversation_turn_commands_conv_key_uidx").on(t.conversationId, t.clientTurnKey),
    uniqueIndex("conversation_turn_commands_operation_uidx").on(t.operationId),
    index("conversation_turn_commands_conv_status_idx").on(t.conversationId, t.status),
  ],
);

/** D4 — documents / revisions. */
export const documents = pgTable(
  "documents",
  {
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    preparationId: text("preparation_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => preparations.id),
    projectId: text("project_id").references(() => projects.id),
    ownerPilotId: text("owner_pilot_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => pilots.id),
    title: text("title").notNull(),
    creationCorrelationKey: text("creation_correlation_key"),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [index("documents_prep_idx").on(t.preparationId)],
);

export const documentRevisions = pgTable(
  "document_revisions",
  {
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    documentId: text("document_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => documents.id),
    revisionNumber: integer("revision_number").notNull(),
    contentMarkdown: text("content_markdown").notNull(),
    status: text("status").notNull(), // SAVING | AVAILABLE | FAILED | UNKNOWN
    baseRevisionId: text("base_revision_id"),
    correlationKey: text("correlation_key"),
    provenanceJson: text("provenance_json").notNull().default("{}"),
    scope: text("scope").notNull().default("document"),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [
    uniqueIndex("document_revisions_doc_rev_uidx").on(t.documentId, t.revisionNumber),
  ],
);

/** D4 — knowledge subjects / acquis / open points (ML2). */
export const knowledgeSubjects = pgTable(
  "knowledge_subjects",
  {
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    preparationId: text("preparation_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => preparations.id),
    projectId: text("project_id").references(() => projects.id),
    ownerPilotId: text("owner_pilot_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => pilots.id),
    parentSubjectId: text("parent_subject_id"),
    title: text("title").notNull(),
    status: text("status").notNull().default("ACTIVE"),
    originatedFromSubjectId: text("originated_from_subject_id"),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
    updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [index("knowledge_subjects_prep_idx").on(t.preparationId)],
);

export const knowledgeAcquis = pgTable(
  "knowledge_acquis",
  {
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    preparationId: text("preparation_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => preparations.id),
    projectId: text("project_id").references(() => projects.id),

      .notNull()
      .references(() => pilots.id),
    subjectId: text("subject_id").references(() => knowledgeSubjects.id),
    kind: text("kind").notNull().default("FACT"),

    supersedesAcquisId: text("supersedes_acquis_id"),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
    updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [index("knowledge_acquis_prep_idx").on(t.preparationId)],
);

export const knowledgeOpenPoints = pgTable(

  {
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    preparationId: text("preparation_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => preparations.id),

  },

export const knowledgeSubjectEvents = pgTable(
  "knowledge_subject_events",
  {

      .notNull()

/** D4 — immutable subject synthesis revisions (Journal §16A). */
export const knowledgeSubjectSummaryRevisions = pgTable(

/** D9 — GitHub App / integration authorization (pilot-scoped; not a D6 mandate). */
export const integrationAuthorizations = pgTable(
  "integration_authorizations",
  {
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    pilotId: text("pilot_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => pilots.id),
    provider: text("provider").notNull().default("github"),
    status: text("status").notNull(), // CONNECTED | PENDING_APPROVAL | ACCESS_REMOVED | REVOKED | DISCONNECTED | EXPIRED | REQUIRES_REAUTH
    installationId: text("installation_id"),
    accountLogin: text("account_login"),
    /** Stable GitHub user id (not mutable login). */
    githubUserId: text("github_user_id"),
    /** AES-GCM ciphertext of user access token — never plaintext. */
    tokenCiphertext: text("token_ciphertext"),
    tokenNonce: text("token_nonce"),
    tokenKeyVersion: text("token_key_version"),
    refreshCiphertext: text("refresh_ciphertext"),
    refreshNonce: text("refresh_nonce"),
    tokenExpiresAt: timestamp("token_expires_at", { withTimezone: true }),
    /** Short-lived lease for a single in-flight refresh of this authorization generation. */
    refreshLeaseToken: text("refresh_lease_token"),
    refreshLeaseExpiresAt: timestamp("refresh_lease_expires_at", { withTimezone: true }),
    scopesJson: text("scopes_json").notNull().default("[]"),
    lastValidatedAt: timestamp("last_validated_at", { withTimezone: true }),
    metadataJson: text("metadata_json").notNull().default("{}"),
    connectedAt: timestamp("connected_at", { withTimezone: true }),
    revokedAt: timestamp("revoked_at", { withTimezone: true }),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
    updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [
    index("integration_authorizations_pilot_idx").on(t.pilotId),
    index("integration_authorizations_pilot_status_idx").on(t.pilotId, t.status),
    index("integration_authorizations_github_user_idx").on(t.githubUserId),
    // C2: at most one CONNECTED per Pilot × provider (cross-process).
    uniqueIndex("integration_authorizations_one_connected_uidx")
      .on(t.pilotId, t.provider)
      .where(sql`status = 'CONNECTED'`),
  ],
);

    flow: text("flow"),
    consumedAt: timestamp("consumed_at", { withTimezone: true }),
    expiresAt: timestamp("expires_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull(),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),

    uniqueIndex("realization_handoffs_attempt_uidx").on(t.attemptId),
    index("realization_handoffs_project_idx").on(t.projectId),
    index("realization_handoffs_contract_idx").on(t.contractId),

/** D8 — nine-rubric qualification snapshot per attempt. */
export const realizationQualifications = pgTable(
  "realization_qualifications",
  {
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    attemptId: text("attempt_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => effectAttempts.id),
    handoffId: text("handoff_id").references(() => realizationHandoffs.id),
    projectId: text("project_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => projects.id),
    pilotId: text("pilot_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => pilots.id),
    status: text("status").notNull(),
    rubricsJson: text("rubrics_json").notNull().default("{}"),
    verdict: text("verdict").notNull().default("INDETERMINATE"),
    noraAnalysisMarkdown: text("nora_analysis_markdown"),
    noraAnalysisAt: timestamp("nora_analysis_at", { withTimezone: true }),
    limitsJson: text("limits_json").notNull().default("[]"),
    /** G15 — append-only prior qualification snapshots (JSON array). */
    historyJson: text("history_json").notNull().default("[]"),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
    updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [
    uniqueIndex("realization_qualifications_attempt_uidx").on(t.attemptId),
    index("realization_qualifications_project_idx").on(t.projectId),
  ],
);

/** C1 — functional Nora activity events correlated to a turn (not authority). */
export const noraActivityEvents = pgTable(
  "nora_activity_events",
  {
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    conversationId: text("conversation_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => conversations.id),
    turnCommandId: text("turn_command_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => conversationTurnCommands.id),
    ownerPilotId: text("owner_pilot_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => pilots.id),
    generationId: text("generation_id"),
    sequence: integer("sequence").notNull(),
    phase: text("phase").notNull(),
    nature: text("nature").notNull(),
    status: text("status").notNull(),
    summary: text("summary").notNull().default(""),
    detailJson: text("detail_json").notNull().default("{}"),
    sourceRef: text("source_ref"),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [
    uniqueIndex("nora_activity_events_turn_seq_uidx").on(t.turnCommandId, t.sequence),
    index("nora_activity_events_turn_idx").on(t.turnCommandId),
    index("nora_activity_events_conv_idx").on(t.conversationId),
  ],
);

export const schemaRevision = "019_ml5_qualification_history";
```

```typescript
/**

import { createHash } from "crypto";
import { config } from "dotenv";
config({ path: ".env.local" });

import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, existsSync } from "fs";
import { join } from "path";
import { chromium, type Page } from "@playwright/test";

const BASE = process.env.SFIA_C10_BASE_URL ?? "http://127.0.0.1:3100";
const OUT = join(process.cwd(), "../../../.tmp-sfia-review/browser/c10");
const IDS_PATH = join(OUT, "scenario-ids.json");

type ScenarioIds = {
  scenarioId: string;
  pilotId: string;
  projectId: string;
  projectName: string;
  preparationId: string;
  contractId: string;
  contractKey: string;
  contractVersion: number;
  fingerprint: string;
  attemptIdYes: string | null;
  attemptIdRefuse: string | null;
  handoffId?: string | null;
  qualificationId?: string | null;
};

type Step = {
  step: string;
  action: string;
  transition?: string;
  api?: { route: string; status: number; useful?: unknown };
  browser?: { url: string; state: string };
  capture?: { file: string; sha256: string; bytes: number };
  geom?: unknown;
  data: "SCRIPTED" | "OBSERVED" | "DECLARED";
  criteria: string[];
  verdict: "PASS" | "FAIL" | "PARTIAL" | "NOT PROVEN";
  reserve?: string;
};

function sha256(buf: Buffer) {
  return createHash("sha256").update(buf).digest("hex");
}

async function shot(page: Page, name: string) {
  const path = join(OUT, name);
  await page.screenshot({ path, fullPage: false });
  const buf = readFileSync(path);
  return { file: name, sha256: sha256(buf), bytes: buf.length, path };
}

async function measureOverflow(page: Page) {
  // String form avoids tsx/esbuild __name injection into the browser context.
  return page.evaluate(`(() => {
    const viewer = document.querySelector('[data-testid="contract-viewer"]');
    const instr = document.querySelector('[data-testid="contract-instruction-full"]');
    const dialog = document.querySelector('[data-testid="d6-confirm-launch"]');
    const dialogCard = document.querySelector(".fig-d6-confirm-card");
    const box = (el) =>
      el
        ? {
            x: Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().x),
            y: Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().y),
            w: Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().width),
            h: Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().height),
            scrollW: el.scrollWidth,
            clientW: el.clientWidth,
            overflowX: el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth + 2,
          }
        : null;
    return {
      viewport: { w: window.innerWidth, h: window.innerHeight },
      viewer: box(viewer),
      instruction: box(instr),
      dialog: box(dialog),
      dialogCard: box(dialogCard),
      dialogVisible: Boolean(
        dialog &&
          getComputedStyle(dialog).display !== "none" &&
          dialog.getBoundingClientRect().height > 40,
      ),
    };
  })()`);
}

async function autoSession(page: Page) {

  const j = (await res.json()) as { ok?: boolean; pilotId?: string };
  if (!res.ok() || !j.ok) throw new Error(`auto-session failed: ${res.status()}`);
  return j.pilotId!;
}

}

main().catch((e) => {
```

```typescript
async function resolvePilotA(): Promise<string> {
  const byGh = (
    await db.select().from(pilots).where(eq(pilots.githubUserId, "dev-github-a")).limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (byGh) return byGh.id;
  const byName = (
    await db.select().from(pilots).where(eq(pilots.displayName, "Pilot A (DEV)")).limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (byName) return byName.id;
  throw new Error("Pilot A (DEV) introuvable — lancer auto-session d'abord");
}

async function main() {
  if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) throw new Error("DATABASE_URL required");
  process.env.SFIA_CURSOR_EFFECT_MODE = "SCRIPTED";

  const pilotId = await resolvePilotA();
  const label = `ML5-C10-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}-${newId("nm").slice(-6)}`;
  const prep = await openOrCreatePreparation(pilotId);
  await updatePreview(pilotId, prep.id, label, "Parcours mono-tentative C10 SCRIPTED");
  const refreshed = (await db.select().from(preparations).where(eq(preparations.id, prep.id)))[0]!;
  const created = await createProjectCommand({
    pilotId,
    preparationId: prep.id,
    expectedCreationRevision: refreshed.creationRevision,
    projectName: label,
    previewSummary: "C10 mono-attempt E2E SCRIPTED",
    idempotencyKey: newId("idem"),
  });
  if (
    (created.status !== "CREATED" && created.status !== "ALREADY_CREATED") ||
    !("projectId" in created) ||
    !created.projectId
  ) {
    throw new Error(`project create fail: ${JSON.stringify(created)}`);
  }
  const projectId = created.projectId;

  const contract = await createTechnicalContract({
    pilotId,
    projectId,
    preparationId: prep.id,
    contractKey: `c10-mono-${newId("ck").slice(-8)}`,
    body: sampleBody(),
    markReady: true,
    sourcesSufficient: true,
    unknownRestrictions: [],
  });

  mkdirSync(OUT_DIR, { recursive: true });
  const manifest = {
    scenarioId: "ml5-c10-mono-20261123",
    at: new Date().toISOString(),
    creationMechanism: "DOMAIN_SEED_SCRIPTED",
    honesty:
      "Contrat créé par seed domaine (markReady serveur) — ≠ création cognitive Nora LIVE.",
    pilotId,
    projectId,
    projectName: label,
    preparationId: prep.id,
    contractId: contract.contractId,
    contractKey: contract.contractKey,
    contractVersion: contract.version,
    fingerprint: contract.fingerprint,
    instructionBytes: LONG_INSTRUCTION.length,
    attemptIdYes: null as string | null,
    attemptIdRefuse: null as string | null,
    frontier: "SCRIPTED",
  };
  writeFileSync(join(OUT_DIR, "scenario-ids.json"), JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2));
  console.log(JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2));
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error(e);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

```typescript
const BASE = process.env.SFIA_C11_BASE_URL ?? "http://127.0.0.1:3100";

  step: string;

  verdict: "PASS" | "FAIL" | "PARTIAL" | "N/A";
  criteria?: string[];
  useful?: unknown;
  reserve?: string;
};

function sha256(buf: Buffer | string) {
  return createHash("sha256").update(buf).digest("hex");
}

async function shot(page: Page, name: string) {
  const path = join(OUT, name);
  await page.screenshot({ path, fullPage: false });
  const buf = readFileSync(path);
  return { file: name, sha256: sha256(buf), bytes: buf.length };
}

  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/dev/auto-session`, { data: {} });

  if (!res.ok() || !j.ok) throw new Error(`auto-session failed: ${res.status()}`);
  return j.pilotId!;

    step: "E-nora-final-analysis",
    action: "attachNoraCognitive on qualification",
    data: noraCognitive ? "LIVE" : "OBSERVED",
    verdict: noraCognitive ? "PASS" : "PARTIAL",
    criteria: ["CA-08"],
    useful: { kind: qualJ.noraAnalysisKind },
    reserve: noraCognitive
      ? undefined
      : "Analyse jointe non classée NORA_COGNITIVE — vérifier provider / fallback déterministe",
  });

  await page.goto(`${BASE}/projects/${ids.projectId}?surface=results`, {
    waitUntil: "networkidle",
  });
  evidence.shotResults = await shot(page, "c11-02-results.png");

  // ——— F conditionals ———
  steps.push({
    step: "F-web-live",
    action: "B09 WEB LIVE",
    data: "DECLARED",
    verdict: "N/A",
    criteria: ["B09"],
    reserve: "Non requis pour mission C11 primaire — B09 remains NOT_IMPL until LIVE provider wired",
  });
  steps.push({
    step: "F-git-real",
    action: "GitHub REAL mutatif",
    data: "DECLARED",
    verdict: "N/A",
    criteria: ["CA-06"],
    reserve: "Pas de dépôt de test nommé / mandat mutation — skip push",
  });
  steps.push({
    step: "F-mcp",
    action: "MCP conditional",
    data: "DECLARED",
    verdict: "N/A",
    reserve: "Mission C11 sans MCP requis",
  });

  // Double-dispatch negative — idempotent replay of COMPLETED is OK (no second send).
  {
    const again = await request.post(
      `${BASE}/api/projects/${ids.projectId}/realization/attempts/${attemptId}/dispatch`,
      { data: {} },
    );
    const againJ = (await again.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
      idempotent?: boolean;
      status?: string;
      limits?: string[];
    };
    const noBlind =
      againJ.idempotent === true ||
      (againJ.limits ?? []).some((l) => /NO_BLIND_REDISPATCH|IDEMPOTENT/i.test(l)) ||
      again.status() >= 400;
    steps.push({
      step: "R-no-double-dispatch",
      action: "Second dispatch same attempt",
      data: "OBSERVED",
      verdict: noBlind ? "PASS" : "FAIL",
      useful: { http: again.status(), body: againJ },
      reserve: noBlind
        ? undefined
        : "Second dispatch without idempotent/NO_BLIND marker",
    });
  }

  const updatedIds = {
    ...ids,
    contractId: contract.id,
    contractKey: contract.contractKey,
    contractVersion: contract.version,
    fingerprint: contract.fingerprint,
    attemptIdYes: attemptId,
    attemptIdRefuse: evidence.attemptRefuse,
    agentId: live.agentId,
    runId: live.runId,
    handoffId: (handoffJ as { handoff?: { id?: string } }).handoff?.id ?? null,
    qualificationVerdict: qualJ.verdict ?? null,
    noraAnalysisKind: qualJ.noraAnalysisKind ?? null,
    witnessVerified: fileOk,
  };
  writeFileSync(join(OUT, "scenario-ids.json"), JSON.stringify(updatedIds, null, 2));
  writeFileSync(
    join(OUT, "journey-steps.json"),
    JSON.stringify({ steps, evidence, updatedIds }, null, 2),
  );

  await browser.close();

  const failed = steps.filter((s) => s.verdict === "FAIL");
  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(
      {
        summary: {
          pass: steps.filter((s) => s.verdict === "PASS").length,
          partial: steps.filter((s) => s.verdict === "PARTIAL").length,
          fail: failed.length,
          na: steps.filter((s) => s.verdict === "N/A").length,
        },
        updatedIds,
        failed,
      },
      null,
      2,
    ),
  );
  if (failed.length) process.exit(1);
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error(e);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

```typescript
const body: TechnicalContractBody = {

  engagements: {
    willDo: "touch",
    willNotDo: "nothing external",
    expectedResult: "AMBIGUOUS after DROP_ACK",
    pilotControl: "D6",
  },
  volets: {
    mission: "T-04",
    perimeter: "SCRIPTED fault",
    capabilitiesAuthority: "SCRIPTED",
    stopConditions: "n/a",
    proofsSources: "n/a",
    integrity: "fp",
  },
  instructionText: "create ACKDROP.txt with OK",
  risks: [],
  exclusions: [],
  acceptance: { criteria: ["no double send"], expectedProofs: [] },
  executor: { kind: "CURSOR_SDK_LOCAL", capabilities: [], permissionsNeeded: [] },

  reversibilityLimits: [],

};

async function main() {
  mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
  process.env.SFIA_CURSOR_EFFECT_MODE = "SCRIPTED";
  process.env.SFIA_CURSOR_SCRIPTED_PHASED = "0";
  process.env.SFIA_CURSOR_FAULT_AFTER_SEND = "DROP_ACK";
  process.env.SFIA_CURSOR_WORKSPACE_ROOT =
    process.env.SFIA_CURSOR_WORKSPACE_ROOT || "/tmp/sfia-c12-cursor-live-ws";

  const pilot = (
    await db.select().from(pilots).where(eq(pilots.githubUserId, "dev-github-a")).limit(1)
  )[0];
  if (!pilot) throw new Error("no pilot");
  const prepForContract = await openOrCreatePreparation(pilot.id);
  const projectName = `C12-ACKDROP-${newId("nm").slice(-6)}`;
  await updatePreview(pilot.id, prepForContract.id, projectName, "incident");
  const refreshed2 = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(preparations)
      .where(eq(preparations.id, prepForContract.id))
  )[0]!;
  const proj = await createProjectCommand({
    pilotId: pilot.id,
    preparationId: prepForContract.id,
    expectedCreationRevision: refreshed2.creationRevision,
    projectName,
    previewSummary: "ack drop",
    idempotencyKey: newId("idem"),
  });
  if (
    (proj.status !== "CREATED" && proj.status !== "ALREADY_CREATED") ||
    !("projectId" in proj) ||
    !proj.projectId
  ) {
    throw new Error(`no project: ${JSON.stringify(proj)}`);
  }

  const contract = await createTechnicalContract({
    pilotId: pilot.id,
    projectId: proj.projectId,
    preparationId: prepForContract.id,
    contractKey: `ackdrop-${newId("ck").slice(-6)}`,
    body,
    markReady: true,
    sourcesSufficient: true,
    unknownRestrictions: [],
  });

  const prepared = await prepareCursorExecution({
    pilotId: pilot.id,
    projectId: proj.projectId,
    contractId: contract.contractId,
    correlationKey: `ackdrop-${Date.now()}`,
    workspaceKey: "default",
  });

  await authorizeCursorExecution({
    pilotId: pilot.id,
    projectId: proj.projectId,
    attemptId: prepared.attemptId,
    statement: "Oui ACKDROP",
    inspectedFingerprint: contract.fingerprint,
    confirmed: true,
  });

  let dispatchErr: string | null = null;
  try {
    await dispatchCursorExecution({
      pilotId: pilot.id,
      projectId: proj.projectId,
      attemptId: prepared.attemptId,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    dispatchErr = String((e as Error)?.message ?? e);
  }

  const attempt = (
    await db
      .select()
      .from(effectAttempts)
      .where(eq(effectAttempts.id, prepared.attemptId))
      .limit(1)
  )[0];

  const prior = priorSendMayHaveOccurred(attempt?.resultJson);
  let secondOk = false;
  let secondErr: string | null = null;
  try {
    await dispatchCursorExecution({
      pilotId: pilot.id,
      projectId: proj.projectId,
      attemptId: prepared.attemptId,
    });
    secondOk = true;
  } catch (e) {
    secondErr = String((e as Error)?.message ?? e);
  }

  const result = {
    attemptId: prepared.attemptId,
    status: attempt?.status,
    dispatchErr,
    priorSendMayHaveOccurred: prior,
    secondDispatchSucceeded: secondOk,
    secondErr,
    oracle:
      attempt?.status === "AMBIGUOUS" && prior && !secondOk ? "PASS" : "FAIL",
  };
  writeFileSync(join(OUT, "ack-drop-incident.json"), JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  delete process.env.SFIA_CURSOR_FAULT_AFTER_SEND;
  if (result.oracle !== "PASS") process.exit(1);
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error(e);
  delete process.env.SFIA_CURSOR_FAULT_AFTER_SEND;
  process.exit(1);
});
```
