      summary: "c3",
    });
    await page.goto(`/projects/${projectId}?surface=travail`);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("project-load-state")).toHaveAttribute(
      "data-project-load-state",
      "ready",
      { timeout: 20000 },
    );
    const secret = `SECRET_SAME_TAB_${Date.now()}`;
    await page.getByTestId("thread-draft").fill(secret);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("thread-draft")).toHaveValue(secret);

    // Explicit identity switch in the SAME tab (sessionStorage persists across nav).
    await page.goto("/login");
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Pilote B (DEV)" }).click();
    await page.waitForURL("**/portfolio");
    await page.goto(`/projects/${projectId}?surface=travail`);
    await expect
      .poll(async () => {
        const state = await page
          .getByTestId("project-load-state")
          .getAttribute("data-project-load-state")
          .catch(() => null);
        const unavailable = await page.getByTestId("project-unavailable").count();
        return state === "ready" || unavailable > 0;
      }, { timeout: 25000 })
      .toBe(true);
    const draft = page.getByTestId("thread-draft");
    if (await draft.count()) {
      await expect(draft).not.toHaveValue(secret);
    }
    // Draft keys must be gone from sessionStorage after login purge.
    const leftover = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const keys: string[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < sessionStorage.length; i += 1) {
        const k = sessionStorage.key(i);
        if (k && k.startsWith("sfia.travail.draft:v1:")) keys.push(k);
      }
      return keys.length;
    });
    expect(leftover).toBe(0);
  });

  test("P2-B draft isolation across pilots", async ({ page, browser }) => {
    test.setTimeout(120_000);
    await page.goto("/login");
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Pilote A (DEV)" }).click();
    await page.waitForURL("**/portfolio");
    const { projectId } = await bootstrapProjectFromPortfolio(page, {
      seed: "E05 draft isolation A",
      name: `E05 Draft A ${Date.now()}`,
      summary: "isolation",
    });
    await page.goto(`/projects/${projectId}?surface=travail`);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("project-load-state")).toHaveAttribute(
      "data-project-load-state",

    const secret = `SECRET_PILOT_A_${Date.now()}`;
    await page.getByTestId("thread-draft").fill(secret);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("thread-draft")).toHaveValue(secret);

    // Separate browser context ⇒ distinct cookies + sessionStorage (P2-B).
    const ctxB = await browser.newContext();
    const pageB = await ctxB.newPage();
    try {
      await pageB.goto("/login");
      await pageB.getByRole("button", { name: "Pilote B (DEV)" }).click();
      await pageB.waitForURL("**/portfolio");
      await pageB.goto(`/projects/${projectId}?surface=travail`);
      // Owner isolation: 404 unavailable OR ready without A's draft.
      await expect
        .poll(async () => {
          const state = await pageB
            .getByTestId("project-load-state")
            .getAttribute("data-project-load-state")
            .catch(() => null);
          const unavailable = await pageB.getByTestId("project-unavailable").count();
          return state === "ready" || unavailable > 0;
        }, { timeout: 25000 })
        .toBe(true);
      const draftB = pageB.getByTestId("thread-draft");
      if (await draftB.count()) {
        await expect(draftB).not.toHaveValue(secret);
      }
    } finally {
      await ctxB.close();
    }
  });
});

/**
 * E08 POST-UAT — Playwright Nora publication discriminant (DEV :3101 / sfia_next_e2e).
 * SCRIPTED provider only — WRITE OFF full refuse is proven in PG (REAL gate).
 * Does NOT mutate RECETTE :3200. Does NOT prove GitHub REAL WRITE.
 */
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import {
  constituteAndCreateProject,
  openNewPreparation,
  sendPrepMessage,
  uniqueProjectName,
} from "./helpers/g4-chat-first";

async function connectGithubAndAttach(page: Page, projectId: string) {
  await page.goto("/settings/integrations");
  await expect(page.getByTestId("integrations-panel")).toBeVisible();
  if (await page.getByTestId("disconnect-github").isVisible().catch(() => false)) {
    await page.getByTestId("disconnect-github").click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId("integrations-disconnect-confirm")).toBeVisible();
    await page.getByTestId("disconnect-github-confirm").click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId("connect-github")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 15_000 });
  }
  await page.getByTestId("connect-github").click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("integrations-status-banner")).toContainText(
    /GitHub (est )?connecté/i,
    {
      timeout: 20_000,
    },
  );

  await page.goto(`/projects/${projectId}?surface=git`);
  await expect(page.getByTestId("git-empty").or(page.getByTestId("git-repo-card"))).toBeVisible({
    timeout: 20_000,
  });
  if (await page.getByTestId("git-empty").isVisible().catch(() => false)) {
    const choices = page.getByTestId("git-empty-repo-choices");
    await expect(choices).toBeVisible({ timeout: 15_000 });
    await choices.locator("button").first().click();
  }
  await expect(page.getByTestId("git-repo-card")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 20_000 });
}

async function sendTravail(page: Page, text: string) {
  const draft = page.getByTestId("thread-draft").first();
  const send = page.getByTestId("thread-send").first();
  const thread = page.getByTestId("nora-thread");
  await expect(draft).toBeEditable({ timeout: 20_000 });
  await expect(draft).toHaveValue("", { timeout: 60_000 });
  await draft.fill(text);
  await expect(send).toBeEnabled({ timeout: 10_000 });
  await send.click();
  // Match Pilote bubble only — never the draft textarea content.
  await expect(
    thread
      .getByTestId("nora-msg-pilot")
      .filter({ hasText: text.slice(0, Math.min(40, text.length)) })
      .last(),
  ).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 });
  await expect(draft).toHaveValue("", { timeout: 120_000 });
}

async function lastAssistantText(page: Page): Promise<string> {
  const msgs = page.getByTestId("nora-msg-assistant");
  await expect(msgs.last()).toBeVisible({ timeout: 60_000 });
  return (await msgs.last().innerText()).trim();
}

    expect(clarifyText).not.toMatch(/a été publié/i);

      /précision|introuvable|non déterminé|Aucune publication|pas été (lancée|tentée)|pas abouti/i,
    );
  });

  test("SCRIPTED create+publish → Nora COMPLETED + publications", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/login");
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Pilote A (DEV)" }).click();
    await page.waitForURL("**/portfolio");

    await openNewPreparation(page);
    await sendPrepMessage(page, "Préparation E08 create publish");

    const projectId = await constituteAndCreateProject(page, {
      name: uniqueProjectName("E08 CreatePub"),
      summary: "create+publish SCRIPTED",
    });
    expect(projectId).toBeTruthy();

    await page.goto(`/projects/${projectId}?surface=travail`);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("project-load-state")).toHaveAttribute(

      "ready",
      { timeout: 20_000 },
    );

    await sendTravail(page, "E08_PUBLISH_CREATE_SCRIPTED");
    const text = await lastAssistantText(page);
    expect(text).toMatch(/a été publié/i);
    expect(text).toMatch(/Aucune fusion/i);
    expect(text).not.toMatch(/Je publie/i);
    expect(text).not.toMatch(/reste à confirmer/i);

    await page.goto(`/projects/${projectId}?surface=git`);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("git-repo-card")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 20_000 });
    await page.getByTestId("git-tab-publications").click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId("git-publications")).toBeVisible();
    const pubsBody = await page.getByTestId("git-publications").innerText();
    expect(pubsBody.length).toBeGreaterThan(10);

    await page.reload();
    await expect(page.getByTestId("git-tab-publications").or(page.getByTestId("git-publications"))).toBeVisible({
      timeout: 20_000,
    });
    if (await page.getByTestId("git-tab-publications").isVisible().catch(() => false)) {
      await page.getByTestId("git-tab-publications").click();
    }
    const pubsAfter = await page.getByTestId("git-publications").innerText();
    expect(pubsAfter.length).toBeGreaterThan(10);
  });
});

import { test, expect } from "@playwright/test";
import path from "node:path";
import fs from "node:fs";
import {
  openNewPreparation,
  constituteAndCreateProject,
} from "./helpers/g4-chat-first";

/**
 * Ensemble 06 — CampusFlow LIVE Nora 20-turn qualification (GO Morris DEV).
 * Real product path: UI → POST /api/preparations/:id/messages → generateNoraReply → OpenAI.
 * Never seeds Journal via journal-e2e-seed. Never calls OpenAI outside Nora.
 */

const EVIDENCE = path.resolve(
  __dirname,
  "../../../.tmp-sfia-review/journal-live-campusflow-20261119",
);

const USD_IN_PER_M = 2.0;
const USD_OUT_PER_M = 10.0;
const CEILING_USD = 10.0;
const RESERVE_USD = 0.6;
const FALLBACK_USD = 0.35;

const TURNS: { id: string; prompt: string }[] = [

  },
];

type TurnRow = {
  id: string;
  startedAt: string;
  durationMs: number;
  statusText: string;
  modeLive: boolean;
  fixtureLeak: boolean;
  simLeak: boolean;
  userMessageId: string | null;
  assistantMessageId: string | null;
  excerpt: string;
  estimatedUsd: number;
  cumulativeUsd: number;
};

type JournalSnapshot = {
  at: string;
  label: "T0" | "T10" | "T20";
  subjectCount: number;
  subjectTitles: string[];
  acquisCount: number;
  openPointCount: number;
  decisionCount: number;
  searchEmpty: boolean;
  raw?: unknown;
};

function estimateUsd(inputTokens?: number, outputTokens?: number): number {
  if (inputTokens == null || outputTokens == null) return FALLBACK_USD;
  return (inputTokens / 1e6) * USD_IN_PER_M + (outputTokens / 1e6) * USD_OUT_PER_M;
}

async function captureJournal(
  page: import("@playwright/test").Page,
  projectId: string,
  label: JournalSnapshot["label"],
): Promise<JournalSnapshot> {
  await page.getByTestId("studio-rail").getByTestId("nav-journal").click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("project-journal")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 20000 });
  const api = await page.request.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}/journal`);
  const body = api.ok() ? await api.json() : { error: await api.text(), status: api.status() };
  const subjects = Array.isArray(body?.knowledge?.subjects)
    ? body.knowledge.subjects
    : Array.isArray(body?.subjects)
      ? body.subjects
      : [];
  const acquis = Array.isArray(body?.knowledge?.acquis)
    ? body.knowledge.acquis
    : Array.isArray(body?.acquis)
      ? body.acquis
      : [];
  const openPoints = Array.isArray(body?.knowledge?.openPoints)
    ? body.knowledge.openPoints
    : Array.isArray(body?.openPoints)
      ? body.openPoints
      : [];
  const decisions = Array.isArray(body?.decisions) ? body.decisions : [];
  const titles = subjects.map((s: { title?: string }) => String(s.title ?? "")).filter(Boolean);
  const shot = path.join(EVIDENCE, `journal-${label.toLowerCase()}.png`);
  await page.screenshot({ path: shot, fullPage: false });
  const snap: JournalSnapshot = {
    at: new Date().toISOString(),
    label,
    subjectCount: subjects.length,
    subjectTitles: titles,
    acquisCount: acquis.filter((a: { status?: string }) => a.status === "CURRENT").length,
    openPointCount: openPoints.filter((o: { status?: string }) => o.status === "OPEN").length,
    decisionCount: decisions.length,
    searchEmpty: subjects.length === 0 && acquis.length === 0,
    raw: {
      status: body?.status,
      preparationIds: body?.knowledge?.preparationIds ?? body?.preparationIds,
      contradictionCount: Array.isArray(body?.contradictions) ? body.contradictions.length : 0,
      restrictionCount: Array.isArray(body?.restrictions) ? body.restrictions.length : 0,
    },
  };
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(EVIDENCE, `journal-${label.toLowerCase()}.json`), JSON.stringify(snap, null, 2));
  return snap;
}

test.describe("Journal V4 — CampusFlow LIVE Nora 20-turn", () => {
  test("LIVE 20 échanges + Journal T0/T10/T20", async ({ page }) => {
    test.skip(
      process.env.STUDIO_ALLOW_LIVE_BOUNDED !== "1" || !process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY,
      "requires STUDIO_ALLOW_LIVE_BOUNDED=1 and OPENAI_API_KEY",
    );
    test.setTimeout(1_200_000);
    fs.mkdirSync(EVIDENCE, { recursive: true });

    const ledger: {
      projectName: string;
      projectId: string | null;
      preparationId: string | null;
      ceilingUsd: number;
      model: string;
      turns: TurnRow[];
      journal: JournalSnapshot[];
      stoppedEarly?: string;
      providerProof: string[];
    } = {
      projectName: "",
      projectId: null,
      preparationId: null,
      ceilingUsd: CEILING_USD,
      model: "openai-agents-sdk-live (configured DEV)",
      turns: [],
      journal: [],
      providerProof: [],
    };

    await page.goto("/login");
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Pilote A (DEV)" }).click();
    await page.waitForURL("**/portfolio");

    const preparationId = await openNewPreparation(page);
    const projectName = `CampusFlow — Test LIVE Journal ${Date.now()}`;
    ledger.projectName = projectName;
    ledger.preparationId = preparationId;
    const projectId = await constituteAndCreateProject(page, {
      name: projectName,
      summary: "Projet fictif réservation salles — LIVE Journal qualification",
      alreadyUnique: true,
    });
    ledger.projectId = projectId;
    expect(projectId).toBeTruthy();

    await page.goto(`/projects/${projectId}?surface=travail`);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("project-load-state")).toHaveAttribute(
      "data-project-load-state",
      "ready",
      { timeout: 20000 },
    );

    ledger.journal.push(await captureJournal(page, projectId!, "T0"));
    // Prefer explicit project URL for surface restore (rail Link can race after Journal).
    await page.goto(`/projects/${projectId}?surface=travail`);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("project-load-state")).toHaveAttribute(
      "data-project-load-state",
      "ready",
      { timeout: 30000 },
    );
    await expect(page.getByTestId("nora-workspace")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30000 });
    await expect(page.getByTestId("thread-draft")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30000 });

    const draft = page.getByTestId("thread-draft");
    const send = page.getByTestId("thread-send");
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 900 });

    let cumulative = 0;
    let stopReason: string | undefined;

    for (let i = 0; i < TURNS.length; i++) {
      const turn = TURNS[i]!;
      if (cumulative + RESERVE_USD > CEILING_USD) {
        stopReason = `BUDGET_RESERVE_STOP before ${turn.id}: cumulative=${cumulative.toFixed(2)}`;
        break;
      }

      // Ensure composer is idle before each turn.
      if ((await page.getByTestId("nora-workspace").count()) === 0) {
        await page.goto(`/projects/${projectId}?surface=travail`);
        await expect(page.getByTestId("nora-workspace")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30000 });
      }

      const t0 = Date.now();
      fs.writeFileSync(
        path.join(EVIDENCE, "live-progress.json"),
        JSON.stringify({ next: turn.id, at: new Date().toISOString(), cumulative }, null, 2),
      );
      await draft.fill(turn.prompt);
      await expect(send).toBeEnabled({ timeout: 10000 });
      await send.click();

      const status = page.getByTestId("thread-nora-status");
      await expect(status).toContainText(/COMPLETE|UNKNOWN|FAILED|INTERRUPTED|Nora|openai/i, {
        timeout: 180_000,
      });
      await expect(draft).toHaveValue("", { timeout: 180_000 });

      const statusText = ((await status.textContent()) ?? "").trim();
      const modeLive = /openai-agents-sdk-live/i.test(statusText);
      const fixtureLeak = /deterministic-fixture/i.test(statusText);
      const simLeak = /provider-simulated/i.test(statusText);
      if (modeLive) ledger.providerProof.push(`${turn.id}:${statusText.slice(0, 160)}`);

      const assistant = page.getByTestId("nora-msg-assistant").last();
      await expect(assistant).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30000 });
      const fullText = (await assistant.innerText()).slice(0, 6000);
      const assistantMessageId =
        (await assistant.getAttribute("data-message-id")) ??
        (await assistant.locator("[data-message-id]").first().getAttribute("data-message-id").catch(() => null));
      const userBubble = page.locator("[data-testid=nora-msg-user], [data-role=user]").last();
      const userMessageId =
        (await userBubble.getAttribute("data-message-id").catch(() => null)) ?? null;

      const cost = estimateUsd();
      cumulative += cost;
      const row: TurnRow = {
        id: turn.id,
        startedAt: new Date(t0).toISOString(),
        durationMs: Date.now() - t0,
        statusText,
        modeLive,
        fixtureLeak,
        simLeak,
        userMessageId,
        assistantMessageId,
        excerpt: fullText.slice(0, 1200).replace(/\s+/g, " "),
        estimatedUsd: cost,
        cumulativeUsd: cumulative,
      };
      ledger.turns.push(row);
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(EVIDENCE, "live-ledger.json"), JSON.stringify(ledger, null, 2));
      fs.writeFileSync(
        path.join(EVIDENCE, `turn-${turn.id.toLowerCase()}.md`),
        `# ${turn.id}\n\n## Pilote\n\n${turn.prompt}\n\n## Nora\n\n${fullText}\n\n## Meta\n\n- status: ${statusText}\n- live: ${modeLive}\n- durationMs: ${row.durationMs}\n`,
      );

      if (fixtureLeak || simLeak) {
        stopReason = `${turn.id}: FIXTURE_OR_SIM_LEAK status=${statusText}`;
        break;
      }
      if (cumulative > CEILING_USD) {
        stopReason = `BUDGET_EXCEEDED after ${turn.id}`;
        break;
      }

      if (turn.id === "E10") {
        ledger.journal.push(await captureJournal(page, projectId!, "T10"));
        // Continuity: reload project via normal parcours
        await page.goto(`/projects/${projectId}?surface=travail`);
        await expect(page.getByTestId("project-load-state")).toHaveAttribute(
          "data-project-load-state",
          "ready",
          { timeout: 20000 },
        );
        await expect(page.getByTestId("nora-msg-assistant").last()).toBeVisible({ timeout: 20000 });
      }
    }

    if (stopReason) ledger.stoppedEarly = stopReason;
    ledger.journal.push(await captureJournal(page, projectId!, "T20"));

    // Optional D6 via Pilotage if UI available — never insert HumanDecision in DB.
    await page.goto(`/projects/${projectId}?surface=pilotage`);
    await page.waitForTimeout(800);
    const pilotageVisible = (await page.getByTestId("pilotage-panel").count().catch(() => 0)) > 0;
    fs.writeFileSync(
      path.join(EVIDENCE, "d6-attempt.json"),
      JSON.stringify(
        {
          pilotagePanelVisible: pilotageVisible,
          note: pilotageVisible
            ? "Panel visible — acte D6 non forcé si confirmation UI ambiguë; E17 reste proposition non officialisée sauf acte Pilote explicite."
            : "Pilotage panel not found — D6 confirmation NOT APPLICABLE in this run.",
        },
        null,
        2,
      ),
    );

    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(EVIDENCE, "live-ledger.json"), JSON.stringify(ledger, null, 2));

    const liveTurns = ledger.turns.filter((t) => t.modeLive && !t.fixtureLeak);
    expect(liveTurns.length, `expected LIVE turns, got ${JSON.stringify(ledger.turns.map((t) => ({ id: t.id, modeLive: t.modeLive, status: t.statusText })))}`).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(ledger.turns.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    // Do not require 20/20 if provider/budget stopped — honesty over cosmetics.
  });
});

    await sendPrepMessage(page, SAS_MATURATION_T2);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("prep-field-intention")).toContainText(/chefs de projet/i, {
      timeout: 30000,
    });
    await expect(page.getByTestId("prep-proposal")).toContainText(/automatique|manuelle|réunion/i);

    // Incomplete QUALIFIED (clarifications omitted) — open question must remain (R2-C)
    await sendPrepMessage(page, SAS_MATURATION_INCOMPLETE_QUAL);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("prep-field-intention")).toContainText(/chefs de projet/i, {
      timeout: 30000,
    });
    await expect(page.getByTestId("prep-proposal")).toContainText(
      /récupération automatique depuis les outils existants est-elle indispensable/i,
    );

    // Ordinary turn without rename — durable intention unchanged (R1-B)
    await sendPrepMessage(page, SAS_MATURATION_ORDINARY);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("prep-field-intention")).toContainText(/chefs de projet/i, {
      timeout: 30000,
    });
    await expect(page.getByTestId("prep-field-intention")).not.toContainText(/Recommander/i);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("prep-proposal")).toContainText(
      /récupération automatique depuis les outils existants est-elle indispensable/i,
    );

    // T3 — V1 manual resolves that question; open list empty / not the old arbitration
    await sendPrepMessage(page, SAS_MATURATION_T3);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("prep-proposal-ready")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30000 });
    await expect(page.getByTestId("prep-field-name")).toContainText("Assistant de pilotage");
    await expect(page.getByTestId("prep-proposal-state")).toHaveText(/Base suffisante/i);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("prep-proposal")).not.toContainText(
      /récupération automatique depuis les outils existants est-elle indispensable/i,
    );

    // T4/T5 — rename only: name changes, durable intention preserved
    const unique = `Cockpit projets MT-${Date.now()}`;
    await sendPrepMessage(page, sasMaturationT4Rename(unique));
    await expect(page.getByTestId("prep-field-name")).toContainText(unique, {
      timeout: 30000,
    });
    await expect(page.getByTestId("prep-field-name")).not.toHaveText("Assistant de pilotage");
    await expect(page.getByTestId("prep-field-intention")).not.toContainText(/Retenir/i);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("prep-field-intention")).toContainText(/chefs de projet/i);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("prep-create-project")).toBeEnabled();
    await expect(page.getByTestId("prep-constitute")).toHaveCount(0);

    // T6 — explicit create
    await clickCreateProjectAndEnter(page, { createTimeoutMs: 30000, navTimeoutMs: 30000 });
    const projectId = page.url().split("/projects/")[1]?.split(/[?#]/)[0];
    expect(projectId).toBeTruthy();

    // T7 — same thread after reload
    await page.reload();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp(`/projects/${projectId}`));
    await expect(page.getByTestId("travail-intro")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 15000 });
    await expect(page.getByTestId("project-surface-title")).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByTestId("studio-rail")).toBeVisible();
  });
});

/**
 * C13 — real D8 reader path (loadAttempt + readConfinedWorkspaceFile) against DEV PG.
 * Proves: allowed read, traversal/absolute/symlink deny, wrong pilot/project deny, budget.
 */
import { beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { config } from "dotenv";
config({ path: ".env.local" });

import {
  mkdirSync,
  writeFileSync,
  symlinkSync,
  rmSync,
  existsSync,
} from "fs";
import { join } from "path";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import { effectAttempts, pilots, preparations } from "@/db/schema";
import {
  readAttemptWorkspaceFile,
  listRealizationEvidence,
} from "@/domains/proofs/d8-evidence-read";
import { createToolSourceJournal } from "@/domains/conversation/tool-source-journal";
import { createProjectCommand } from "@/domains/preparation/create-project";
import { openOrCreatePreparation, updatePreview } from "@/domains/preparation/service";
import { newId } from "@/lib/ids";

const WS = "/tmp/sfia-c13-d8-pg-ws";
const OUTSIDE = "/tmp/sfia-c13-d8-pg-outside.txt";

describe("PostgreSQL ML5 C13 D8 evidence confinement (real reader)", () => {
  let pilotId = "";
  let otherPilotId = "";
  let projectId = "";
  let otherProjectId = "";
  let attemptId = "";

  beforeAll(async () => {
    if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) throw new Error("DATABASE_URL required");
    rmSync(WS, { recursive: true, force: true });
    mkdirSync(WS, { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(join(WS, "ok.txt"), "C13-PG-ALLOWED\n");
    writeFileSync(OUTSIDE, "SECRET_PG_OUTSIDE\n");
    symlinkSync(OUTSIDE, join(WS, "escape.txt"));

    pilotId = newId("pilot");
    otherPilotId = newId("pilot");
    await db.insert(pilots).values([
      { id: pilotId, displayName: "c13-d8-a", githubUserId: `gh-${pilotId}` },
      { id: otherPilotId, displayName: "c13-d8-b", githubUserId: `gh-${otherPilotId}` },
    ]);

    const labelA = `c13-d8-${newId("nm").slice(-6)}`;
    const prep = await openOrCreatePreparation(pilotId);
    await updatePreview(pilotId, prep.id, labelA, "s");
    const refreshed = (await db.select().from(preparations).where(eq(preparations.id, prep.id)))[0]!;
    const created = await createProjectCommand({
      pilotId,
      preparationId: prep.id,
      expectedCreationRevision: refreshed.creationRevision,
      projectName: labelA,
      previewSummary: "s",
      idempotencyKey: newId("idem"),
    });
    if (!("projectId" in created) || !created.projectId) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(created));
    projectId = created.projectId;

    const labelB = `c13-d8b-${newId("nm").slice(-6)}`;
    const prep2 = await openOrCreatePreparation(otherPilotId);
    await updatePreview(otherPilotId, prep2.id, labelB, "s");
    const refreshed2 = (
      await db.select().from(preparations).where(eq(preparations.id, prep2.id))
    )[0]!;
    const created2 = await createProjectCommand({
      pilotId: otherPilotId,
      preparationId: prep2.id,
      expectedCreationRevision: refreshed2.creationRevision,
      projectName: labelB,
      previewSummary: "s",
      idempotencyKey: newId("idem"),
    });
    if (!("projectId" in created2) || !created2.projectId) {
      throw new Error(JSON.stringify(created2));
    }
    otherProjectId = created2.projectId;

    attemptId = newId("efx");
    const plan = {
      kind: "CURSOR_EXECUTION",
      contractId: "ctc_c13",
      contractVersion: 1,
      contractFingerprint: "fp_c13",
      instructionFingerprint: "ifp_c13",
      workspaceCwd: WS,
      workspaceKey: "default",
      effectProviderMode: "SCRIPTED",
    };
    await db.insert(effectAttempts).values({
      id: attemptId,
      projectId,
      pilotId,
      kind: "CURSOR_EXECUTION",
      status: "COMPLETED",
      fingerprint: "fp_c13",
      planJson: JSON.stringify(plan),
      resultJson: JSON.stringify({ terminalStatus: "finished" }),
      correlationKey: `c13-d8-${attemptId}`,
      createdAt: new Date(),
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    });
  }, 60_000);

  it("allowed file under workspace — CONSULTED + journal", async () => {
    const journal = createToolSourceJournal();
    const r = await readAttemptWorkspaceFile(
      {
        pilotId,
        projectId,
        attemptId,
        budget: { remainingCalls: 5, remainingChars: 50_000 },
        sourceJournal: journal,
      },
      "ok.txt",
    );
    expect(r.coverage).toBe("CONSULTED");
    expect(r.content).toContain("C13-PG-ALLOWED");
    expect(journal.entries.some((e) => e.coverage === "CONSULTED")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("relative traversal — DENIED", async () => {
    const r = await readAttemptWorkspaceFile(
      {
        pilotId,
        projectId,
        attemptId,
        budget: { remainingCalls: 5, remainingChars: 50_000 },
      },
      "../sfia-c13-d8-pg-outside.txt",
    );
    expect(r.coverage).toBe("DENIED");
    expect(JSON.stringify(r)).not.toContain("SECRET_PG");
  });

  it("absolute path — DENIED", async () => {
    const r = await readAttemptWorkspaceFile(
      {
        pilotId,
        projectId,
        attemptId,
        budget: { remainingCalls: 5, remainingChars: 50_000 },
      },
      OUTSIDE,
    );
    expect(r.coverage).toBe("DENIED");
    expect(r.reason).toMatch(/ABSOLUTE|UNSAFE/);
    expect(JSON.stringify(r)).not.toContain("SECRET_PG");
  });

  it("symlink escape — DENIED without content leak", async () => {
    expect(existsSync(join(WS, "escape.txt"))).toBe(true);
    const r = await readAttemptWorkspaceFile(
      {
        pilotId,
        projectId,
        attemptId,
        budget: { remainingCalls: 5, remainingChars: 50_000 },
      },
      "escape.txt",
    );
    expect(r.coverage).toBe("DENIED");
    expect(r.reason).toMatch(/SYMLINK/);
    expect(JSON.stringify(r)).not.toContain("SECRET_PG");
  });

  it("wrong pilot — DENIED", async () => {
    const r = await readAttemptWorkspaceFile(
      {
        pilotId: otherPilotId,
        projectId,
        attemptId,
        budget: { remainingCalls: 5, remainingChars: 50_000 },
      },
      "ok.txt",
    );
    expect(r.coverage).toBe("DENIED");
    expect(r.reason).toBe("ATTEMPT_NOT_IN_SCOPE");
    expect(r.content).toBeNull();
  });

  it("wrong project — DENIED", async () => {
    const r = await readAttemptWorkspaceFile(
      {
        pilotId,
        projectId: otherProjectId,
        attemptId,
        budget: { remainingCalls: 5, remainingChars: 50_000 },
      },
      "ok.txt",
    );
    expect(r.coverage).toBe("DENIED");
    expect(r.reason).toBe("ATTEMPT_NOT_IN_SCOPE");
  });

  it("budget exhausted — DENIED", async () => {
    const r = await readAttemptWorkspaceFile(
      {
        pilotId,
        projectId,
        attemptId,
        budget: { remainingCalls: 0, remainingChars: 50_000 },
      },
      "ok.txt",
    );
    expect(r.coverage).toBe("DENIED");
    expect(r.reason).toBe("D8_TOOL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED");
  });

  it("list metadata only — DISCOVERED in journal, not CONSULTED content", async () => {
    const journal = createToolSourceJournal();
    const r = await listRealizationEvidence({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      attemptId,
      budget: { remainingCalls: 3, remainingChars: 50_000 },
      sourceJournal: journal,
    });
    expect(r.coverage).toBe("OPENED");
    expect(journal.entries[0]?.coverage).toBe("DISCOVERED");
    expect(journal.entries[0]?.notes).toMatch(/metadata only/i);
  });
});

/**
 * ML5 P0-01 — PostgreSQL concurrent Cursor dispatch + fencing + workspace payload mismatch.
 * Requires DATABASE_URL (DEV/e2e). SCRIPTED adapter only — no LIVE SDK.
 */
import { afterEach, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { config } from "dotenv";
config({ path: ".env.local" });

import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync } from "fs";
import { tmpdir } from "os";
import { join } from "path";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import { effectAttempts, pilots, preparations, schemaRevision } from "@/db/schema";
import {
  authorizeCursorExecution,
  dispatchCursorExecution,
  prepareCursorExecution,
  reconcileCursorExecution,
} from "@/domains/execution/cursor-attempt-service";
import { claimCursorAttempt, persistCursorOwnedResult } from "@/domains/execution/cursor-claim";
import { createTechnicalContract } from "@/domains/execution/technical-contract";
import type { TechnicalContractBody } from "@/domains/execution/types";
import { __resetScriptedCursorRunsForTests } from "@/domains/execution/cursor-sdk-adapter";
import { createProjectCommand } from "@/domains/preparation/create-project";
import { openOrCreatePreparation, updatePreview } from "@/domains/preparation/service";
import { newId } from "@/lib/ids";
import { StudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";
import { readClaim, writeClaimInto, mintClaim } from "@/domains/execution/claim-lease";

function sampleBody(): TechnicalContractBody {
  return {
    title: "PG concurrent",
    engagements: {
      willDo: "noop",
      willNotDo: "git",
      expectedResult: "scripted finish",
      pilotControl: "D6",
    },
    volets: {
      mission: "test",
      perimeter: "sandbox",
      capabilitiesAuthority: "scripted",
      stopConditions: "STOP",
      proofsSources: "handoff",
      integrity: "fp",
    },
    instructionText: "scripted only",
    risks: [],
    exclusions: [],
    acceptance: { criteria: [], expectedProofs: [] },
    executor: {
      kind: "CURSOR_SDK_LOCAL",
      capabilities: [],
      permissionsNeeded: [],
    },
    stopConditions: ["STOP"],
    reversibilityLimits: ["no rollback"],
    gitScope: null,
  };
}

async function seed(label = `ml5-${newId("nm").slice(-8)}`) {
  const pilotId = newId("pilot");
  await db.insert(pilots).values({ id: pilotId, displayName: label, githubUserId: `gh-${pilotId}` });
  const prep = await openOrCreatePreparation(pilotId);
  await updatePreview(pilotId, prep.id, label, "s");
  const refreshed = (await db.select().from(preparations).where(eq(preparations.id, prep.id)))[0]!;
  const created = await createProjectCommand({
    pilotId,
    preparationId: prep.id,
    expectedCreationRevision: refreshed.creationRevision,
    projectName: label,
    previewSummary: "s",
    idempotencyKey: newId("idem"),
  });
  if (
    (created.status !== "CREATED" && created.status !== "ALREADY_CREATED") ||
    !("projectId" in created) ||
    !created.projectId
  ) {
    throw new Error(`seed fail: ${JSON.stringify(created)}`);
  }
  return { pilotId, projectId: created.projectId, preparationId: prep.id };
}

describe("PostgreSQL ML5 Cursor dispatch concurrency (SCRIPTED)", () => {
  let workspaceRoot = "";

  beforeAll(() => {
    if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) throw new Error("DATABASE_URL required");
    process.env.SFIA_CURSOR_EFFECT_MODE = "SCRIPTED";
    workspaceRoot = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "sfia-ml5-ws-"));
    process.env.SFIA_CURSOR_WORKSPACE_ROOT = workspaceRoot;
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    __resetScriptedCursorRunsForTests();
  });

  it("schema revision includes 019", () => {
    expect(schemaRevision).toBe("019_ml5_qualification_history");
  });

  it("persists reversibilityLimits round-trip and DRAFT≠READY without markReady", async () => {
    const { pilotId, projectId } = await seed();
    const draft = await createTechnicalContract({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractKey: "c-draft",
      body: sampleBody(),
      markReady: false,
    });
    expect(draft.status).toBe("DRAFT");
    const ready = await createTechnicalContract({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractKey: "c-ready",
      body: sampleBody(),
      markReady: true,
    });
    expect(ready.status).toBe("READY");
    const { getTechnicalContract } = await import("@/domains/execution/technical-contract");
    const got = await getTechnicalContract({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractId: ready.contractId,
    });
    expect(got.body.reversibilityLimits).toEqual(["no rollback"]);
    expect(got.fingerprint).toBe(ready.fingerprint);
  });

  it("concurrent dispatch: at most one send wins claim", async () => {
    const { pilotId, projectId } = await seed();
    const c = await createTechnicalContract({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractKey: "c-race",
      body: sampleBody(),
      markReady: true,
    });
    const prep = await prepareCursorExecution({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractId: c.contractId,
      correlationKey: newId("corr"),
      workspaceKey: "default",
    });
    await authorizeCursorExecution({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      attemptId: prep.attemptId,
      statement: "mandate",
      inspectedFingerprint: c.fingerprint,
      confirmed: true,
    });

    const results = await Promise.allSettled([
      dispatchCursorExecution({ pilotId, projectId, attemptId: prep.attemptId }),
      dispatchCursorExecution({ pilotId, projectId, attemptId: prep.attemptId }),
    ]);
    const fulfilled = results.filter((r) => r.status === "fulfilled");
    const rejected = results.filter((r) => r.status === "rejected");
    // At most one non-idempotent send. A second call may REJECT (claim lost) or
    // fulfill as idempotent if SCRIPTED already reached COMPLETED.
    const primary = fulfilled.filter(
      (r) => r.status === "fulfilled" && r.value.idempotent !== true,
    );
    const idempotent = fulfilled.filter(
      (r) => r.status === "fulfilled" && r.value.idempotent === true,
    );
    expect(primary.length).toBe(1);
    expect(primary.length + rejected.length + idempotent.length).toBe(2);
    const row = (
      await db.select().from(effectAttempts).where(eq(effectAttempts.id, prep.attemptId)).limit(1)
    )[0]!;
    expect(["COMPLETED", "DISPATCHED"]).toContain(row.status);
  });

  it("same correlationKey with different workspaceKey → CONFLICT", async () => {
    const { pilotId, projectId } = await seed();
    const c = await createTechnicalContract({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractKey: "c-corr",
      body: sampleBody(),
      markReady: true,
    });
    const corr = newId("corr");
    await prepareCursorExecution({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractId: c.contractId,
      correlationKey: corr,
      workspaceKey: "default",
    });
    await expect(
      prepareCursorExecution({
        pilotId,
        projectId,
        contractId: c.contractId,
        correlationKey: corr,
        workspaceKey: "other",
      }),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(StudioError);
  });

  it("rejects absolute client workspaceCwd", async () => {
    const { pilotId, projectId } = await seed();
    const c = await createTechnicalContract({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractKey: "c-cwd",
      body: sampleBody(),
      markReady: true,
    });
    await expect(
      prepareCursorExecution({
        pilotId,
        projectId,
        contractId: c.contractId,
        correlationKey: newId("corr"),
        workspaceCwd: "/tmp/evil",
      }),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(StudioError);
  });

  it("stale claimToken cannot overwrite after fencing", async () => {
    const { pilotId, projectId } = await seed();
    const c = await createTechnicalContract({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractKey: "c-fence",
      body: sampleBody(),
      markReady: true,
    });
    const prep = await prepareCursorExecution({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractId: c.contractId,
      correlationKey: newId("corr"),
      workspaceKey: "default",
    });
    await authorizeCursorExecution({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      attemptId: prep.attemptId,
      statement: "mandate",
      inspectedFingerprint: c.fingerprint,
      confirmed: true,
    });
    const claimed = await claimCursorAttempt(prep.attemptId, "AUTHORIZED", {
      stampSendIntent: false,
    });
    expect(claimed).toBeTruthy();
    const staleToken = claimed!.claim.claimToken;

    // Simulate lease renewal / new owner by minting a new claim into resultJson while DISPATCHED.
    const row = (
      await db.select().from(effectAttempts).where(eq(effectAttempts.id, prep.attemptId)).limit(1)
    )[0]!;
    const freshClaim = mintClaim(readClaim(row.resultJson));
    await db
      .update(effectAttempts)
      .set({
        resultJson: writeClaimInto(row.resultJson || "{}", freshClaim),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(effectAttempts.id, prep.attemptId));

    await expect(
      persistCursorOwnedResult({
        attemptId: prep.attemptId,
        claimToken: staleToken,
        resultJson: JSON.stringify({ terminalStatus: "finished", forged: true }),
        status: "COMPLETED",
        release: true,
      }),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(StudioError);
  });

  it("reconcile does not redispatch", async () => {
    const { pilotId, projectId } = await seed();
    const c = await createTechnicalContract({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractKey: "c-rec",
      body: sampleBody(),
      markReady: true,
    });
    const prep = await prepareCursorExecution({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractId: c.contractId,
      correlationKey: newId("corr"),
      workspaceKey: "default",
    });
    await authorizeCursorExecution({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      attemptId: prep.attemptId,
      statement: "mandate",
      inspectedFingerprint: c.fingerprint,
      confirmed: true,
    });
    await dispatchCursorExecution({ pilotId, projectId, attemptId: prep.attemptId });
    const before = (
      await db.select().from(effectAttempts).where(eq(effectAttempts.id, prep.attemptId)).limit(1)
    )[0]!;
    await reconcileCursorExecution({ pilotId, projectId, attemptId: prep.attemptId });
    const after = (
      await db.select().from(effectAttempts).where(eq(effectAttempts.id, prep.attemptId)).limit(1)
    )[0]!;
    expect(after.status).toBe(before.status);
  });

  it("CF-03/T-04: first send → ACK lost → claim expired → no AMBIGUOUS redispatch", async () => {
    const { pilotId, projectId } = await seed();
    const c = await createTechnicalContract({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractKey: "c-ack-lost",
      body: sampleBody(),
      markReady: true,
    });
    const prep = await prepareCursorExecution({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractId: c.contractId,
      correlationKey: newId("corr"),
      workspaceKey: "default",
    });
    await authorizeCursorExecution({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      attemptId: prep.attemptId,
      statement: "mandate",
      inspectedFingerprint: c.fingerprint,
      confirmed: true,
    });

    // Simulate: claim+sendIntent, SDK "called", ACK lost, lease expired, AMBIGUOUS.
    const claimed = await claimCursorAttempt(prep.attemptId, "AUTHORIZED", {
      stampSendIntent: true,
    });
    expect(claimed).toBeTruthy();
    expect(claimed!.sendRequestedAt).toBeTruthy();
    const row = (
      await db.select().from(effectAttempts).where(eq(effectAttempts.id, prep.attemptId)).limit(1)
    )[0]!;
    const live = JSON.parse(row.resultJson || "{}") as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(live.sendRequestedAt).toBeTruthy();
    const expiredClaim = {
      ...(live.claim as object),
      leaseExpiresAt: new Date(Date.now() - 60_000).toISOString(),
      releasedAt: null,
    };
    const ambiguousJson = JSON.stringify({
      ...live,
      claim: expiredClaim,
      agentId: "agent-sim-1",
      runId: "run-sim-1",
      // ackReceivedAt intentionally absent — ACK lost
    });
    await db
      .update(effectAttempts)
      .set({ status: "AMBIGUOUS", resultJson: ambiguousJson, updatedAt: new Date() })
      .where(eq(effectAttempts.id, prep.attemptId));

    // Reclaim must refuse — prior send may have produced an effect.
    const reclaim = await claimCursorAttempt(prep.attemptId, "AMBIGUOUS");
    expect(reclaim).toBeNull();

    await expect(
      dispatchCursorExecution({ pilotId, projectId, attemptId: prep.attemptId }),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(StudioError);

    const after = (
      await db.select().from(effectAttempts).where(eq(effectAttempts.id, prep.attemptId)).limit(1)
    )[0]!;
    expect(after.status).toBe("AMBIGUOUS");
    const afterLive = JSON.parse(after.resultJson || "{}") as {
      sendRequestedAt?: string;
      agentId?: string;
    };
    expect(afterLive.sendRequestedAt).toBeTruthy();
    expect(afterLive.agentId).toBe("agent-sim-1");
  });

  it("P0: claim stamps sendRequestedAt before SDK — crash window covered", async () => {
    const { pilotId, projectId } = await seed();
    const c = await createTechnicalContract({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractKey: "c-pre-send",
      body: sampleBody(),
      markReady: true,
    });
    const prep = await prepareCursorExecution({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      contractId: c.contractId,
      correlationKey: newId("corr"),
      workspaceKey: "default",
    });
    await authorizeCursorExecution({
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      attemptId: prep.attemptId,
      statement: "mandate",
      inspectedFingerprint: c.fingerprint,
      confirmed: true,
    });
    const claimed = await claimCursorAttempt(prep.attemptId, "AUTHORIZED", {
      stampSendIntent: true,
    });
    expect(claimed?.sendRequestedAt).toBeTruthy();
    const row = (
      await db.select().from(effectAttempts).where(eq(effectAttempts.id, prep.attemptId)).limit(1)
    )[0]!;
    expect(row.status).toBe("DISPATCHED");
    expect(JSON.parse(row.resultJson || "{}").sendRequestedAt).toBeTruthy();
    // Simulate crash before SDK: force AMBIGUOUS with expired claim, keep sendRequestedAt.
    const live = JSON.parse(row.resultJson || "{}") as Record<string, unknown>;
    await db
      .update(effectAttempts)
      .set({
        status: "AMBIGUOUS",
        resultJson: JSON.stringify({
          ...live,
          claim: {
            ...(live.claim as object),
            leaseExpiresAt: new Date(Date.now() - 60_000).toISOString(),
            releasedAt: null,
          },
        }),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(effectAttempts.id, prep.attemptId));
    expect(await claimCursorAttempt(prep.attemptId, "AMBIGUOUS")).toBeNull();
  });
});

/**
 * G15 — concurrent requalify under SELECT FOR UPDATE (PostgreSQL DEV).
 */
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import {
  effectAttempts,
  pilots,
  projects,
  realizationQualifications,
} from "@/db/schema";
import { newId } from "@/lib/ids";

const hasDb = Boolean(process.env.DATABASE_URL);

describe.skipIf(!hasDb)("ML5 G15 concurrent requalify (PostgreSQL)", () => {
  const pilotId = newId("pilot");
  const projectId = newId("proj");
  const attemptId = newId("efx");
  const qualId = newId("rqual");

  beforeAll(async () => {
    await db.insert(pilots).values({
      id: pilotId,
      githubUserId: `dev-g15-${pilotId.slice(-6)}`,
      displayName: "G15 Pilot",
    });
    await db.insert(projects).values({
      id: projectId,
      ownerPilotId: pilotId,
      name: "G15 Project",
    });
    await db.insert(effectAttempts).values({
      id: attemptId,
      pilotId,
      projectId,
      kind: "CURSOR_EXECUTION",
      status: "COMPLETED",
      correlationKey: `g15-${attemptId}`,
      fingerprint: "fp-g15",
      planJson: "{}",
      resultJson: "{}",
      createdAt: new Date(),
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    });
    await db.insert(realizationQualifications).values({
      id: qualId,
      attemptId,
      handoffId: null,
      projectId,
      pilotId,
      status: "RECORDED",
      rubricsJson: JSON.stringify({}),
      verdict: "INDETERMINATE",
      limitsJson: "[]",
      historyJson: "[]",
      createdAt: new Date(),
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    });
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await db.delete(realizationQualifications).where(eq(realizationQualifications.id, qualId));
    await db.delete(effectAttempts).where(eq(effectAttempts.id, attemptId));
    await db.delete(projects).where(eq(projects.id, projectId));
    await db.delete(pilots).where(eq(pilots.id, pilotId));
  });

  it("two concurrent requalifies preserve both history entries via FOR UPDATE", async () => {
    const runOnce = async (tag: string) =>
      db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(
          sql`select id from realization_qualifications where id = ${qualId} for update`,
        );
        const locked = (
          await tx
            .select()
            .from(realizationQualifications)
            .where(eq(realizationQualifications.id, qualId))
            .limit(1)
        )[0]!;
        let history: unknown[] = [];
        try {
          history = JSON.parse(locked.historyJson || "[]") as unknown[];
        } catch {
          history = [];
        }
        if (!Array.isArray(history)) history = [];
        history.push({
          at: locked.updatedAt.toISOString(),
          verdict: locked.verdict,
          tag,
          supersededAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          newProofRef: `proof-${tag}`,
        });
        const now = new Date();
        await tx
          .update(realizationQualifications)
          .set({
            status: "REQUALIFIED",
            verdict: tag,
            historyJson: JSON.stringify(history),
            updatedAt: now,
          })
          .where(eq(realizationQualifications.id, qualId));
        return history.length;
      });

    const [a, b] = await Promise.all([runOnce("A"), runOnce("B")]);
    expect(Math.max(a, b)).toBe(2);

    const final = (
      await db
        .select()
        .from(realizationQualifications)
        .where(eq(realizationQualifications.id, qualId))
        .limit(1)
    )[0]!;
    const history = JSON.parse(final.historyJson || "[]") as unknown[];
    expect(history).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(final.status).toBe("REQUALIFIED");
  });
});

/**
 * E08 POST-UAT clôture — PG service chains (sfia_next_e2e only).
 * C5: WRITE OFF full chain, zero mutation.
 * C6: SCRIPTED publish end-to-end D3→D9 + Nora restitution.
 * DETERMINISTIC PROVEN ≠ REAL WRITE PROVEN.
 */
import { beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { config } from "dotenv";
config({ path: ".env.local" });

import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db/client";
import {
  documentRevisions,
  effectAttempts,
  humanDecisions,
  observedGitFacts,
  pilots,
  preparations,
} from "@/db/schema";
import { newId } from "@/lib/ids";
import { openOrCreatePreparation, updatePreview } from "@/domains/preparation/service";
import { createProjectCommand } from "@/domains/preparation/create-project";
import {
  completeGitHubAuthorization,
  startGitHubAuthorization,
} from "@/domains/integrations/authorization-service";
import { attachRepositoryToProject } from "@/domains/integrations/project-link-service";
import {
  getScriptedGitHubProvider,
  getScriptedMutationCounts,
  resetScriptedMutationCounts,
  resetScriptedStore,
} from "@/domains/integrations/scripted-github-provider";
import { listProjectPublications } from "@/domains/integrations/publication-projection-service";
import { reconcileAttempt } from "@/domains/execution/effect-service";
import { postUserMessageAndNora, listMessages } from "@/domains/conversation/service";
import { getDocumentRevision, listDocuments } from "@/domains/document/service";
import {
  resolvePublicationDocumentTarget,
} from "@/domains/conversation/publication-document-target";
import {
  effectEnvelope,
  registerCreateDocumentTitled,
  registerTypedScenario,
} from "../helpers/semantic-fixture-envelopes";

/** Publish-existing only (no same-turn D4 CREATE) — preserves explicit revision targeting. */
function publishExistingEnvelope(opts: {
  title: string;
  publicationPath: string;
  revisionHint?: string;
}) {
  const documentHint = opts.revisionHint
    ? `${opts.title} ${opts.revisionHint}`
    : opts.title;
  return effectEnvelope(
    `Publication existante ${opts.title}`,
    `Je prépare la publication de « ${opts.title} ».`,
    [
      {
        capabilityId: "d7.prepare_publication",
        mode: "REQUEST_EFFECT",
        summary: "Préparer publication",
        parameters: {
          documentHint,
          publicationPath: opts.publicationPath,
        },
      },
    ],
  );
}

async function noraTurn(
  pilotId: string,
  preparationId: string,
  text: string,
  opts?: Parameters<typeof postUserMessageAndNora>[3],
) {
  return postUserMessageAndNora(pilotId, preparationId, text, opts);
}

async function seedPilot(label: string) {
  const id = newId("pilot");
  await db.insert(pilots).values({ id, displayName: label, githubUserId: `gh-${id}` });
  return id;
}

async function seedProjectWithGit(label: string) {
  resetScriptedStore();
  const pilotId = await seedPilot(label);
  const prep = await openOrCreatePreparation(pilotId);
  await updatePreview(pilotId, prep.id, label, "s");
  const refreshed = (await db.select().from(preparations).where(eq(preparations.id, prep.id)))[0];
  const created = await createProjectCommand({
    pilotId,
    preparationId: prep.id,
    expectedCreationRevision: refreshed!.creationRevision,
    projectName: label,
    previewSummary: "s",
    idempotencyKey: newId("idem"),
  });
  if (created.status !== "CREATED" || !created.projectId) {
    throw new Error(`seed failed: ${created.status}`);
  }
  const sessionId = newId("sid");
  const { state } = await startGitHubAuthorization(pilotId, "/settings/integrations", sessionId);
  const status = await completeGitHubAuthorization({
    pilotId,
    state,
    studioSessionId: sessionId,
  });
  const repoId = status.repositories[0]!.id;
  await attachRepositoryToProject(pilotId, created.projectId, repoId);
  getScriptedGitHubProvider();
  return { pilotId, projectId: created.projectId, preparationId: prep.id, repositoryId: repoId };
}

async function countGitPublicationAttempts(projectId: string) {
  return db
    .select()
    .from(effectAttempts)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(effectAttempts.projectId, projectId),
        eq(effectAttempts.kind, "GIT_PUBLICATION"),
      ),
    );
}

describe("E08 clôture — WRITE OFF + SCRIPTED PG chains", () => {
  beforeAll(() => {
    if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) throw new Error("DATABASE_URL required");
    expect(process.env.DATABASE_URL).toMatch(/\/sfia_next_e2e(?:\?|$)/);
    delete process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;
    process.env.STUDIO_LANE = "DEV";
    process.env.STUDIO_E2E = "1";
    process.env.STUDIO_GITHUB_PROVIDER = "scripted";
    delete process.env.STUDIO_GITHUB_ALLOW_MUTATIONS;
  });

  it("C5 WRITE OFF: full service chain — zero D7 prepare, zero Git mutation, Nora refuses", async () => {
    const prevProvider = process.env.STUDIO_GITHUB_PROVIDER;
    const prevMut = process.env.STUDIO_GITHUB_ALLOW_MUTATIONS;

    const { pilotId, projectId, preparationId } = await seedProjectWithGit("cloture-writeoff");

    const askA = "Crée un document intitulé Clôture Alpha WriteOff.";
    registerCreateDocumentTitled(askA, { title: "Clôture Alpha WriteOff" });
    const createA = await noraTurn(pilotId, preparationId, askA, {
      clientTurnKey: newId("ctk"),
    });
    expect(createA.documentSave?.status).toBe("AVAILABLE");

    const askB = "Crée un document intitulé Clôture Bravo WriteOff.";
    registerCreateDocumentTitled(askB, { title: "Clôture Bravo WriteOff" });
    const createB = await noraTurn(pilotId, preparationId, askB, {
      clientTurnKey: newId("ctk"),
    });
    expect(createB.documentSave?.status).toBe("AVAILABLE");
    expect(createB.documentSave!.documentId).not.toBe(createA.documentSave!.documentId);

    const beforeAttempts = await countGitPublicationAttempts(projectId);
    const beforeMut = getScriptedMutationCounts(pilotId);
    resetScriptedMutationCounts(pilotId);

    // Simulate REAL WRITE OFF (gate refuses before D7).
    process.env.STUDIO_GITHUB_PROVIDER = "real";
    delete process.env.STUDIO_GITHUB_ALLOW_MUTATIONS;

    const publishAsk =
      "Publie le document Clôture Bravo WriteOff dans mon dépôt GitHub chemin docs/studio-next/cloture-bravo.md";
    registerTypedScenario(
      publishAsk,
      publishExistingEnvelope({
        title: "Clôture Bravo WriteOff",
        publicationPath: "docs/studio-next/cloture-bravo.md",
      }),
    );
    const chat = await noraTurn(pilotId, preparationId, publishAsk, {
      clientTurnKey: newId("ctk"),
      documentFocus: {
        documentId: createA.documentSave!.documentId!,
        sourceRevisionId: createA.documentSave!.revisionId!,
        sourceRevisionNumber: createA.documentSave!.revisionNumber ?? 1,
        observedHeadRevisionId: createA.documentSave!.revisionId!,
      },
    });

    process.env.STUDIO_GITHUB_PROVIDER = prevProvider ?? "scripted";
    if (prevMut === undefined) delete process.env.STUDIO_GITHUB_ALLOW_MUTATIONS;
    else process.env.STUDIO_GITHUB_ALLOW_MUTATIONS = prevMut;

    const afterAttempts = await countGitPublicationAttempts(projectId);
    expect(afterAttempts.length).toBe(beforeAttempts.length);

    const d7 = chat.missionProjection?.steps.find((s) => s.id === "d7_prepare");
    expect(d7?.status).toBe("FAILED");
    expect(d7?.reason).toMatch(/WRITE_DISABLED/);
    expect(d7?.attemptId).toBeFalsy();
    expect(chat.missionProjection?.status).toBe("PARTIAL_FAILED_STEP");
    expect(chat.humanDecisionCreated).toBe(false);

    const mut = getScriptedMutationCounts(pilotId);
    expect(mut.createBranch).toBe(0);
    expect(mut.putFileContents).toBe(0);
    expect(mut.createPR).toBe(0);
    expect(mut.mergePR).toBe(0);
    // beforeMut captured only for diagnostics — store was reset
    void beforeMut;

    const thread = await listMessages(pilotId, preparationId);
    const lastAssistant = [...thread].reverse().find((m) => m.role === "assistant");
    expect(lastAssistant?.content ?? "").toMatch(/n'a pas été effectuée/i);
    expect(lastAssistant?.content ?? "").toMatch(/ne sont pas disponibles|écritures GitHub/i);
    expect(lastAssistant?.content ?? "").not.toMatch(/a été publié/i);
    expect(lastAssistant?.content ?? "").not.toMatch(/Je publie/i);

    // Re-read: no additional attempt
    const reread = await countGitPublicationAttempts(projectId);
    expect(reread.length).toBe(beforeAttempts.length);
  });

  it("C5b objectRef/documentHint conflict — no prepare, no mutation", async () => {
    const { pilotId, projectId, preparationId } = await seedProjectWithGit("cloture-conflict");
    const askA = "Crée un document intitulé Conflit Doc Alpha.";
    registerCreateDocumentTitled(askA, { title: "Conflit Doc Alpha" });
    const createA = await noraTurn(pilotId, preparationId, askA, {
      clientTurnKey: newId("ctk"),
    });
    const askB = "Crée un document intitulé Conflit Doc Bravo.";
    registerCreateDocumentTitled(askB, { title: "Conflit Doc Bravo" });
    const createB = await noraTurn(pilotId, preparationId, askB, {
      clientTurnKey: newId("ctk"),
    });
    expect(createA.documentSave?.status).toBe("AVAILABLE");
    expect(createB.documentSave?.status).toBe("AVAILABLE");

    const docs = await listDocuments(pilotId, preparationId);
    const resolved = resolvePublicationDocumentTarget({
      sameTurnEffect: null,
      docs,
      documentHint: "Conflit Doc Bravo",
      objectRef: createA.documentSave!.documentId!,
      focus: null,
    });
    expect(resolved.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!resolved.ok) expect(resolved.reason).toBe("AMBIGUOUS");

    const before = await countGitPublicationAttempts(projectId);
    const publishAsk =
      "Publie Conflit Doc Bravo dans mon dépôt GitHub chemin docs/studio-next/conflit.md";
    registerTypedScenario(
      publishAsk,
      effectEnvelope("Publication conflit refs", "Précision nécessaire.", [
        {
          capabilityId: "d7.prepare_publication",
          mode: "REQUEST_EFFECT",
          summary: "Préparer publication",
          parameters: {
            documentHint: "Conflit Doc Bravo",
            objectRef: createA.documentSave!.documentId!,
            publicationPath: "docs/studio-next/conflit.md",
          },
        },
      ]),
    );
    const chat = await noraTurn(pilotId, preparationId, publishAsk, {
      clientTurnKey: newId("ctk"),
    });
    const after = await countGitPublicationAttempts(projectId);
    expect(after.length).toBe(before.length);
    expect(chat.missionProjection?.status).toBe("AWAITING_CLARIFICATION");
    expect(chat.missionProjection?.steps.find((s) => s.id === "d7_prepare")?.attemptId).toBeFalsy();
    expect(chat.humanDecisionCreated).toBe(false);
    const lastAssistant = [...(await listMessages(pilotId, preparationId))]
      .reverse()
      .find((m) => m.role === "assistant");
    expect(lastAssistant?.content ?? "").toMatch(/précision|plusieurs documents|Aucune publication/i);
    expect(lastAssistant?.content ?? "").not.toMatch(/a été publié/i);
    void createB;
  });

  it("C6 SCRIPTED: explicit revision over focus — D6/D7/D8 + Nora COMPLETED", async () => {
    process.env.STUDIO_GITHUB_PROVIDER = "scripted";
    delete process.env.STUDIO_GITHUB_ALLOW_MUTATIONS;

    const { pilotId, projectId, preparationId } = await seedProjectWithGit("cloture-scripted");
    const title = "Clôture Scripted MultiRev";
    const createAsk = `Crée un document intitulé ${title}.`;
    registerCreateDocumentTitled(createAsk, { title });
    const create = await noraTurn(pilotId, preparationId, createAsk, {
      clientTurnKey: newId("ctk"),
    });
    expect(create.documentSave?.status).toBe("AVAILABLE");
    const docId = create.documentSave!.documentId!;
    const rev1 = create.documentSave!.revisionId!;

    const rev2 = newId("drev");
    const rev3 = newId("drev");
    await db.insert(documentRevisions).values([
      {
        id: rev2,
        documentId: docId,
        revisionNumber: 2,
        contentMarkdown: "# clôture v2 exact content",
        status: "AVAILABLE",
        baseRevisionId: rev1,
        provenanceJson: "{}",
        scope: "document",
      },
      {
        id: rev3,
        documentId: docId,
        revisionNumber: 3,
        contentMarkdown: "# clôture v3 head — must not publish",
        status: "AVAILABLE",
        baseRevisionId: rev2,
        provenanceJson: "{}",
        scope: "document",
      },
    ]);

    resetScriptedMutationCounts(pilotId);
    const beforeAttempts = await countGitPublicationAttempts(projectId);

    const publishAsk = `Publie le document ${title} révision 2 dans mon dépôt GitHub chemin docs/studio-next/cloture-v2.md`;
    registerTypedScenario(
      publishAsk,
      publishExistingEnvelope({
        title,
        publicationPath: "docs/studio-next/cloture-v2.md",
        revisionHint: "v2",
      }),
    );

    const chat = await noraTurn(pilotId, preparationId, publishAsk, {
      clientTurnKey: newId("ctk"),
      documentFocus: {
        documentId: docId,
        sourceRevisionId: rev3,
        sourceRevisionNumber: 3,
        observedHeadRevisionId: rev3,
      },
    });

    expect(chat.missionProjection?.status).toBe("COMPLETED");
    expect(chat.humanDecisionCreated).toBe(true);
    const prepStep = chat.missionProjection?.steps.find((s) => s.id === "d7_prepare");
    expect(prepStep?.decisionId).toBeTruthy();
    expect(prepStep?.attemptId).toBeTruthy();
    expect(prepStep?.revisionId).toBe(rev2);

    let attempt = (
      await db.select().from(effectAttempts).where(eq(effectAttempts.id, prepStep!.attemptId!))
    )[0];
    expect(attempt?.kind).toBe("GIT_PUBLICATION");
    expect(attempt?.decisionId).toBe(prepStep?.decisionId);

    // Reserve B — DISPATCHED alone is not success; reconcile to terminal COMPLETED.
    if (attempt?.status === "DISPATCHED" || attempt?.status === "AMBIGUOUS") {
      const rec = await reconcileAttempt(pilotId, projectId, attempt.id);
      expect(rec.status).toBe("COMPLETED");
      attempt = (
        await db.select().from(effectAttempts).where(eq(effectAttempts.id, attempt.id))
      )[0];
    }
    expect(attempt?.status).toBe("COMPLETED");

    const plan = JSON.parse(attempt!.planJson || "{}") as {
      repositoryFullName?: string;
      publicationBranch?: string;
      targetPath?: string;
      documentId?: string;
      revisionId?: string;
      proposedContent?: string;
    };
    expect(plan.documentId).toBe(docId);
    expect(plan.revisionId).toBe(rev2);
    expect(plan.targetPath).toBe("docs/studio-next/cloture-v2.md");
    expect(plan.repositoryFullName).toBeTruthy();
    expect(plan.publicationBranch).toBeTruthy();

    // Reserve A — D4 rev2 content vs SCRIPTED published file (no silent normalize).
    const d4 = await getDocumentRevision(pilotId, preparationId, docId, rev2);
    expect(d4.status).toBe("AVAILABLE");
    if (d4.status !== "AVAILABLE" || !("revision" in d4) || !d4.revision) {
      throw new Error("D4 rev2 unavailable");
    }
    const sourceContent = d4.revision.contentMarkdown;
    expect(sourceContent).toBe("# clôture v2 exact content");
    expect(sourceContent).not.toContain("must not publish");
    if (plan.proposedContent != null) {
      expect(plan.proposedContent).toBe(sourceContent);
    }

    const provider = getScriptedGitHubProvider();
    const published = await provider.getFileContent(
      pilotId,
      plan.repositoryFullName!,
      plan.targetPath!,
      plan.publicationBranch!,
    );
    expect(published.encoding).toBe("utf-8");
    expect(published.content).toBe(sourceContent);
    expect(Buffer.from(published.content, "utf8").equals(Buffer.from(sourceContent, "utf8"))).toBe(
      true,
    );
    expect(published.content).not.toContain("must not publish");
    expect(published.content).not.toBe("# clôture v3 head — must not publish");

    // D8 facts + project publications projection
    const facts = await db
      .select()
      .from(observedGitFacts)
      .where(eq(observedGitFacts.attemptId, attempt!.id));
    expect(facts.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(facts.some((f) => f.factKind === "COMMIT" || f.factKind === "PR_OPENED" || f.factKind === "BRANCH")).toBe(
      true,
    );
    expect(facts.some((f) => f.factKind === "MERGE" || f.factKind === "PR_MERGED")).toBe(false);

    const pubs = await listProjectPublications(pilotId, projectId);
    const matching = pubs.publications.filter(
      (p) => p.documentId === docId && p.revisionId === rev2,
    );
    expect(matching.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(pubs.publications.some((p) => p.revisionId === rev3)).toBe(false);
    expect(matching[0]!.targetPath).toBe(plan.targetPath);
    expect(matching[0]!.repositoryFullName).toBe(plan.repositoryFullName);
    expect(matching[0]!.effectStatus).toBe("COMPLETED");
    expect(matching[0]!.mergeObserved).toBe(false);

    const hd = (
      await db
        .select()
        .from(humanDecisions)
        .where(
          and(eq(humanDecisions.projectId, projectId), eq(humanDecisions.id, attempt!.decisionId!)),
        )
    )[0];
    expect(hd?.kind).toBe("GIT_PUBLICATION_MANDATE");
    expect(hd?.state).toBe("APPLICABLE");

    const afterAttempts = await countGitPublicationAttempts(projectId);
    expect(afterAttempts.length).toBe(beforeAttempts.length + 1);

    const mut = getScriptedMutationCounts(pilotId);
    expect(mut.createBranch + mut.putFileContents).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(mut.mergePR).toBe(0);

    // Nora restitution only after terminal proof
    const thread = await listMessages(pilotId, preparationId);
    const lastAssistant = [...thread].reverse().find((m) => m.role === "assistant");
    expect(lastAssistant?.content ?? "").toMatch(/a été publié/i);
    expect(lastAssistant?.content ?? "").toMatch(/révision 2/i);
    expect(lastAssistant?.content ?? "").toMatch(/Aucune fusion/i);
    expect(lastAssistant?.content ?? "").not.toMatch(/reste à confirmer/i);
    expect(lastAssistant?.content ?? "").not.toMatch(/encore en vérification/i);

    // Idempotent re-submit same clientTurnKey must not double-mutate
    const replayKey = newId("ctk");
    const first = await noraTurn(pilotId, preparationId, publishAsk, {
      clientTurnKey: replayKey,
      documentFocus: {
        documentId: docId,
        sourceRevisionId: rev3,
        sourceRevisionNumber: 3,
        observedHeadRevisionId: rev3,
      },
    });
    const mutAfterFirst = getScriptedMutationCounts(pilotId);
    const second = await noraTurn(pilotId, preparationId, publishAsk, {
      clientTurnKey: replayKey,
      documentFocus: {
        documentId: docId,
        sourceRevisionId: rev3,
        sourceRevisionNumber: 3,
        observedHeadRevisionId: rev3,
      },
    });
    expect(second.userMessageId).toBe(first.userMessageId);
    const mutAfterReplay = getScriptedMutationCounts(pilotId);
    expect(mutAfterReplay.createBranch).toBe(mutAfterFirst.createBranch);
    expect(mutAfterReplay.putFileContents).toBe(mutAfterFirst.putFileContents);

    // Refresh listMessages — single coherent outcome, no extra attempt from read
    const attemptsAfterRead = await countGitPublicationAttempts(projectId);
    await listMessages(pilotId, preparationId);
    const attemptsAfterReread = await countGitPublicationAttempts(projectId);
    expect(attemptsAfterReread.length).toBe(attemptsAfterRead.length);

    const assistants = (await listMessages(pilotId, preparationId)).filter(
      (m) => m.role === "assistant",
    );
    const successMsgs = assistants.filter((m) => /a été publié/i.test(m.content ?? ""));
    expect(successMsgs.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    for (const m of successMsgs) {
      expect(m.content).not.toMatch(/n'a pas été effectuée/i);
    }
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  extractNegatedPrNumbers,
  extractPositivelyRequestedPrNumbers,
  extractRepositoryFullNameHints,
  extractRequestedPrNumbers,
  userStatementHasOpenMergeCondition,
  userStatementHasUnresolvedSamePrMergeContradiction,
  userStatementIsNonAuthorizingMergeTalk,
  userStatementRefusesMerge,
  userStatementRequestsPositiveMerge,
} from "@/domains/conversation/conversation-merge-authority";

describe("P0-M01 merge negation / positive intent", () => {
  it("treats explicit refusals as refuse — not positive", () => {
    const negatives = [
      "Ne merge pas cette PR.",
      "Ne fusionne pas la PR #42.",
      "Je ne veux pas que tu merges cette PR.",
      "Ne fais surtout pas le merge.",
      "Publie ce document, mais ne merge pas la PR.",
    ];
    for (const s of negatives) {
      expect(userStatementRefusesMerge(s), s).toBe(true);
      expect(userStatementRequestsPositiveMerge(s), s).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  it("blocks how-to / hypothetical / deferred talk", () => {
    const talk = [
      "Explique-moi comment merger cette PR.",
      "Si je te demandais de merger la PR #42...",
      "Merge-la uniquement quand je te le demanderai.",
    ];
    for (const s of talk) {
      expect(userStatementIsNonAuthorizingMergeTalk(s), s).toBe(true);
      expect(userStatementRequestsPositiveMerge(s), s).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  it("accepts explicit positive merge imperatives", () => {
    const positives = [
      "Merge la PR #42.",
      "Fusionne la PR documentaire #42 du dépôt X.",
      "Peux-tu merger la PR #7 ?",
    ];
    for (const s of positives) {
      expect(userStatementRefusesMerge(s), s).toBe(false);
      expect(userStatementRequestsPositiveMerge(s), s).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it("does not treat bare publish+merge word soup without imperative as positive", () => {
    expect(userStatementRequestsPositiveMerge("La publication a un merge en attente")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("mixed refuse #42 then merge #43 keeps a positive signal", () => {
    const s = "Ne merge pas la PR #42, merge la PR #43.";
    expect(userStatementRefusesMerge(s)).toBe(false);
    expect(userStatementRequestsPositiveMerge(s)).toBe(true);
    expect(extractNegatedPrNumbers(s)).toEqual([42]);
    expect(extractPositivelyRequestedPrNumbers(s)).toEqual([43]);
    expect(userStatementHasUnresolvedSamePrMergeContradiction(s)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("same-PR contradiction blocks positive extraction and flags contradiction", () => {
    const s = "Ne merge pas la PR #42, merge la PR #42.";
    expect(userStatementHasUnresolvedSamePrMergeContradiction(s)).toBe(true);
    expect(extractPositivelyRequestedPrNumbers(s)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("extracts repository owner/name hints without inventing paths", () => {
    expect(
      extractRepositoryFullNameHints("Merge la PR #42 du dépôt mcleland147/sfia-workspace."),
    ).toEqual(["mcleland147/sfia-workspace"]);
    expect(extractRepositoryFullNameHints("Merge docs/foo.md")).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("E08-S01 open merge conditions", () => {
  it("flags open conditions that must not authorize immediate merge", () => {
    const open = [
      "Merge la PR #42 uniquement après validation.",
      "Merge la PR #42 si tous les tests sont verts.",
      "Ne merge pas tant que la revue n'est pas terminée.",
      "Merge après mon prochain GO.",
      "Intègre cette PR seulement quand je confirmerai.",
    ];
    for (const s of open) {
      expect(userStatementHasOpenMergeCondition(s), s).toBe(true);
      expect(userStatementRequestsPositiveMerge(s), s).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  it("allows immediate positive merge without open condition", () => {
    expect(userStatementHasOpenMergeCondition("Merge la PR #42.")).toBe(false);
    expect(userStatementHasOpenMergeCondition("Fusionne la PR documentaire #7.")).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("E08-S02 non-authorizing paraphrases", () => {
  it("blocks questions and deferred talk without requiring verb list for qual path", () => {
    for (const s of [
      "Quelles PR peut-on intégrer ?",
      "La PR #42 est-elle prête à être fusionnée ?",
      "On pourrait intégrer la PR demain.",
      "Cette PR pourra être mergée plus tard.",
    ]) {
      expect(userStatementIsNonAuthorizingMergeTalk(s), s).toBe(true);
    }
  });
});

describe("P0-M02 PR identity extraction", () => {
  it("extracts explicit PR numbers", () => {
    expect(extractRequestedPrNumbers("Merge la PR #42.")).toEqual([42]);
    expect(extractRequestedPrNumbers("Fusionne pull request 7")).toEqual([7]);
  });

  it("never silently picks a different PR from text alone", () => {
    expect(extractPositivelyRequestedPrNumbers("Merge la PR #42")).toEqual([42]);
    expect(extractPositivelyRequestedPrNumbers("Merge la PR #42 et la PR #43").sort()).toEqual([
      42, 43,
    ]);
  });
});

function plan(overrides: Partial<PublicationPlan> = {}): PublicationPlan {

    contentMarkdown: "# Hi",
    inspection: {
      kind: "CREATE",
      basePath: "docs/studio-next/accept01.md",
      baseSha: null,
      baseContent: null,
      proposedContent: "# Hi",
      unifiedDiff: "",

    },

describe("conversation-publication-authority guards", () => {

      ),

  it("plan drift on path is refused", () => {

      plan: plan(),

  });

    const amb = assertPublicationMandateCoversPlan({

      qualifiedPath: "docs/a.md",
      qualifiedBranch: null,
      plan: plan({ targetPath: "docs/a.md" }),

    expect(amb.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!amb.ok) expect(amb.reasonCode).toBe("AMBIGUOUS_PATH");
  });
});

  });

  it("covers plan when publicationBranch matches the mandated name", () => {

      qualifiedPath: "docs/recette-studio-next/publication-documentaire.md",
      qualifiedBranch: "sfia/pub-r12-recette-20261122",

        targetBranch: "main",
        publicationBranch: "sfia/pub-r12-recette-20261122",
      }),
