/**
 * MERGE-01..12 — deterministic documentary merge contract (no GitHub REAL mutation).
 * Complements PG integration suites; focuses on fingerprint/mode/SHA/eligibility gates.
 */
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { mergeEffectFingerprint } from "@/domains/execution/fingerprint";
import type { MergePlan } from "@/domains/execution/types";
import { qualifyPlanEffectProviderMode } from "@/domains/execution/publication-steps";
import { mergePullRequestRemote } from "@/domains/integrations/github-app-auth";
import {
  getScriptedGitHubProvider,
  resetScriptedStore,
} from "@/domains/integrations/scripted-github-provider";
import { isStudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";
import {
  userStatementRequestsMergeOnly,
} from "@/domains/conversation/conversation-publication-mandate-guards";
import {
  userStatementHasOpenMergeCondition,
  userStatementRefusesMerge,
  userStatementRequestsPositiveMerge,
} from "@/domains/conversation/conversation-merge-authority";

const HEAD = "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa";
const BASE = "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb";
const MERGE = "cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc";

function sampleMergePlan(over: Partial<MergePlan> = {}): MergePlan {
  return {
    repositoryId: "r1",
    repositoryFullName: "acme/docs",
    authorizationId: "a1",
    installationId: "i1",
    actorLogin: "pilot",
    publicationAttemptId: "efx_pub",
    publicationRefId: "dpr1",
    documentId: "doc1",
    revisionId: "rev1",
    targetPath: "docs/a.md",
    prNumber: 21,
    expectedHeadSha: HEAD,
    expectedBaseSha: BASE,
    expectedHeadRef: "studio/pub-21",
    expectedBaseRef: "main",
    publicationBranch: "studio/pub-21",
    effectProviderMode: "SCRIPTED",
    ...over,
  };
}

function jsonResponse(status: number, body: unknown) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

describe("MERGE documentary contract (unit)", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    resetScriptedStore();
  });

  it("MERGE-01 fingerprint binds publication provenance + PR", () => {
    const fp = mergeEffectFingerprint(sampleMergePlan());
    expect(fp).toHaveLength(64);
    expect(mergeEffectFingerprint(sampleMergePlan({ publicationAttemptId: "other" }))).not.toBe(fp);
    expect(mergeEffectFingerprint(sampleMergePlan({ prNumber: 99 }))).not.toBe(fp);
  });

  it("MERGE-02 mandate fingerprint includes frozen provider mode when set", () => {
    const without = sampleMergePlan();
    delete without.effectProviderMode;
    const withMode = sampleMergePlan({ effectProviderMode: "SCRIPTED" });
    expect(mergeEffectFingerprint(without)).not.toBe(mergeEffectFingerprint(withMode));
    expect(qualifyPlanEffectProviderMode(without)).toBe("UNKNOWN");
    expect(qualifyPlanEffectProviderMode(withMode)).toBe("SCRIPTED");
  });

  it("MERGE-03/11 publish≠merge lexical guards", () => {
    expect(userStatementRequestsMergeOnly("Fusionne la PR #21")).toBe(true);
    expect(userStatementRequestsPositiveMerge("Fusionne la PR documentaire #21")).toBe(true);
    expect(userStatementRequestsMergeOnly("Publie ce document sur GitHub")).toBe(false);
    expect(userStatementRefusesMerge("Ne fusionne pas")).toBe(true);
    expect(userStatementHasOpenMergeCondition("Fusionne uniquement après validation")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("MERGE-05 HEAD drift refuses before PUT", async () => {
    const fetchImpl = async () =>
      jsonResponse(200, {
        number: 21,
        title: "doc",
        state: "open",
        html_url: "https://github.com/o/r/pull/21",
        merged: false,
        mergeable: true,
        mergeable_state: "clean",
        head: { sha: MERGE, ref: "studio/pub-21" },
        base: { sha: BASE, ref: "main" },
      });
    await expect(
      mergePullRequestRemote({
        token: "t",
        fullName: "o/r",
        prNumber: 21,
        expectedHeadSha: HEAD,
        fetchImpl: fetchImpl as unknown as typeof fetch,
      }),
    ).rejects.toSatisfy((e: unknown) => isStudioError(e) && e.code === "CONFLICT");
  });

  it("MERGE-06 BASE drift refuses before PUT", async () => {
    const fetchImpl = async () =>
      jsonResponse(200, {
        number: 21,
        title: "doc",
        state: "open",
        html_url: "https://github.com/o/r/pull/21",
        merged: false,
        mergeable: true,
        mergeable_state: "clean",
        head: { sha: HEAD, ref: "studio/pub-21" },
        base: { sha: MERGE, ref: "main" },
      });
    await expect(
      mergePullRequestRemote({
        token: "t",
        fullName: "o/r",
        prNumber: 21,
        expectedHeadSha: HEAD,
        expectedBaseSha: BASE,
        fetchImpl: fetchImpl as unknown as typeof fetch,
      }),
    ).rejects.toSatisfy((e: unknown) => isStudioError(e) && e.code === "CONFLICT");
  });

  it("MERGE-07 permissions/rules refuse when not clean", async () => {
    const fetchImpl = async () =>
      jsonResponse(200, {
        number: 21,
        title: "doc",
        state: "open",
        html_url: "https://github.com/o/r/pull/21",
        merged: false,
        mergeable: true,
        mergeable_state: "blocked",
        head: { sha: HEAD, ref: "studio/pub-21" },
        base: { sha: BASE, ref: "main" },
      });
    await expect(
      mergePullRequestRemote({
        token: "t",
        fullName: "o/r",
        prNumber: 21,
        expectedHeadSha: HEAD,
        fetchImpl: fetchImpl as unknown as typeof fetch,
      }),
    ).rejects.toSatisfy((e: unknown) => isStudioError(e) && e.code === "ACCESS_DENIED");
  });

  it("MERGE-08 scripted success returns distinct merge commit SHA", async () => {
    const provider = getScriptedGitHubProvider();
    const pilotId = "pilot-merge-08";
    const fullName = "acme/docs";
    const mainSha = await provider.getRefSha(pilotId, fullName, "main");
    await provider.createBranch(pilotId, fullName, "studio/pub-21", mainSha);
    await provider.putFileContents({
      pilotId,
      fullName,
      path: "docs/a.md",
      branch: "studio/pub-21",
      message: "doc",
      content: "# a\n",
    });
    const pr = await provider.createPullRequest({
      pilotId,
      fullName,
      title: "doc",
      head: "studio/pub-21",
      base: "main",
      publicationMarker: "mk-21",
    });
    const merged = await provider.mergePullRequest({
      pilotId,
      fullName,
      prNumber: pr.number,
      expectedHeadSha: pr.headSha,
      expectedBaseSha: pr.baseSha,
    });
    expect(merged.merged).toBe(true);
    expect(merged.sha).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/);
    expect(merged.sha).not.toBe(pr.headSha);
    const after = await provider.getPullRequest(pilotId, fullName, pr.number);
    expect(after.state).toBe("merged");
    expect(after.mergeCommitSha).toBe(merged.sha);
  });

  it("MERGE-09/10 already-merged returns merge_commit_sha without second PUT", async () => {
    let puts = 0;
    const fetchImpl = async (_input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => {
      const method = (init?.method ?? "GET").toUpperCase();
      if (method === "PUT") {
        puts += 1;
        return jsonResponse(500, { message: "no second merge" });
      }
      return jsonResponse(200, {
        number: 21,
        title: "doc",
        state: "closed",
        html_url: "https://github.com/o/r/pull/21",
        merged: true,
        merge_commit_sha: MERGE,
        head: { sha: HEAD, ref: "studio/pub-21" },
        base: { sha: BASE, ref: "main" },
      });
    };
    const first = await mergePullRequestRemote({
      token: "t",
      fullName: "o/r",
      prNumber: 21,
      expectedHeadSha: HEAD,
      fetchImpl: fetchImpl as unknown as typeof fetch,
    });
    const second = await mergePullRequestRemote({
      token: "t",
      fullName: "o/r",
      prNumber: 21,
      expectedHeadSha: HEAD,
      fetchImpl: fetchImpl as unknown as typeof fetch,
    });
    expect(first.sha).toBe(MERGE);
    expect(second.sha).toBe(MERGE);
    expect(puts).toBe(0);
  });

  it("MERGE-12 fingerprint stability without inventing REAL mode", () => {
    const historical = sampleMergePlan();
    delete historical.effectProviderMode;
    expect(qualifyPlanEffectProviderMode(historical)).toBe("UNKNOWN");
    expect(qualifyPlanEffectProviderMode(sampleMergePlan({ effectProviderMode: "REAL" }))).toBe(
      "REAL",
    );
  });

  it("C3: merge into release advances release only — main unchanged", async () => {
    const provider = getScriptedGitHubProvider();
    const pilotId = "pilot-c3-release";
    const fullName = "acme/docs";
    const mainBefore = await provider.getRefSha(pilotId, fullName, "main");
    await provider.createBranch(pilotId, fullName, "release", mainBefore);
    await provider.createBranch(pilotId, fullName, "studio/pub-rel", mainBefore);
    await provider.putFileContents({
      pilotId,
      fullName,
      path: "docs/rel.md",
      branch: "studio/pub-rel",
      message: "doc",
      content: "# rel\n",
    });
    const pr = await provider.createPullRequest({
      pilotId,
      fullName,
      title: "doc-rel",
      head: "studio/pub-rel",
      base: "release",
      publicationMarker: "mk-rel",
    });
    const releaseBefore = await provider.getRefSha(pilotId, fullName, "release");
    const merged = await provider.mergePullRequest({
      pilotId,
      fullName,
      prNumber: pr.number,
      expectedHeadSha: pr.headSha,
      expectedBaseSha: pr.baseSha,
    });
    const mainAfter = await provider.getRefSha(pilotId, fullName, "main");
    const releaseAfter = await provider.getRefSha(pilotId, fullName, "release");
    expect(mainAfter).toBe(mainBefore);
    expect(releaseAfter).toBe(merged.sha);
    expect(releaseAfter).not.toBe(releaseBefore);
  });

  it("C3: merge into main advances main only", async () => {
    const provider = getScriptedGitHubProvider();
    const pilotId = "pilot-c3-main";
    const fullName = "acme/docs";
    const mainBefore = await provider.getRefSha(pilotId, fullName, "main");
    await provider.createBranch(pilotId, fullName, "release", mainBefore);
    await provider.createBranch(pilotId, fullName, "studio/pub-main", mainBefore);
    await provider.putFileContents({
      pilotId,
      fullName,
      path: "docs/main.md",
      branch: "studio/pub-main",
      message: "doc",
      content: "# main\n",
    });
    const pr = await provider.createPullRequest({
      pilotId,
      fullName,
      title: "doc-main",
      head: "studio/pub-main",
      base: "main",
      publicationMarker: "mk-main",
    });
    const releaseBefore = await provider.getRefSha(pilotId, fullName, "release");
    const merged = await provider.mergePullRequest({
      pilotId,
      fullName,
      prNumber: pr.number,
      expectedHeadSha: pr.headSha,
      expectedBaseSha: pr.baseSha,
    });
    const mainAfter = await provider.getRefSha(pilotId, fullName, "main");
    const releaseAfter = await provider.getRefSha(pilotId, fullName, "release");
    expect(mainAfter).toBe(merged.sha);
    expect(mainAfter).not.toBe(mainBefore);
    expect(releaseAfter).toBe(releaseBefore);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { evaluateCurrentAuthority, methodUsageRestricted } from "@/domains/decisions/authority";

describe("ml3 authority restrictions", () => {
  const cycleBlock = {
    id: "r-cycle",
    targetKind: "CYCLE_MUTATION",
    targetRef: "*",
    status: "ACTIVE",
  };

  it("blocks cycle mutations and still allows a lift", () => {
    expect(evaluateCurrentAuthority({ operation: "OPEN_CYCLE", restrictions: [cycleBlock] }).allowed).toBe(
      false,
    );
    expect(
      evaluateCurrentAuthority({ operation: "TRANSITION_CYCLE", restrictions: [cycleBlock] }).allowed,
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      evaluateCurrentAuthority({ operation: "LIFT_RESTRICTION", restrictions: [cycleBlock] }).allowed,
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(
      evaluateCurrentAuthority({
        operation: "OPEN_CYCLE",
        restrictions: [{ ...cycleBlock, status: "LIFTED" }],
      }).allowed,
    ).toBe(true);
  });

  it("blocks only the named cycle and lets another cycle through", () => {
    const uxOnly = {
      id: "r-ux",
      targetKind: "CYCLE_MUTATION",
      targetRef: "UX_UI",
      status: "ACTIVE",
    };
    expect(
      evaluateCurrentAuthority({
        operation: "OPEN_CYCLE",
        restrictions: [uxOnly],
        cycleType: "UX_UI",
      }).allowed,
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      evaluateCurrentAuthority({
        operation: "OPEN_CYCLE",
        restrictions: [uxOnly],
        cycleType: "CADRAGE",
      }).allowed,
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(
      evaluateCurrentAuthority({
        operation: "CLOSE_CYCLE",
        restrictions: [{ ...uxOnly, targetRef: "cyc-a" }],
        cycleId: "cyc-a",
      }).allowed,
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      evaluateCurrentAuthority({
        operation: "CLOSE_CYCLE",
        restrictions: [{ ...uxOnly, targetRef: "cyc-a" }],
        cycleId: "cyc-b",
      }).allowed,
    ).toBe(true);
  });

  it("treats a global cycle or pilotage target as blocking every candidate", () => {
    for (const targetRef of ["*", ""]) {
      const globalCycle = {
        id: "r-global",
        targetKind: "CYCLE_MUTATION",
        targetRef,
        status: "ACTIVE",
      };
      expect(
        evaluateCurrentAuthority({
          operation: "OPEN_CYCLE",
          restrictions: [globalCycle],
          cycleType: "CADRAGE",
        }).allowed,
      ).toBe(false);
      expect(
        evaluateCurrentAuthority({
          operation: "OPEN_CYCLE",
          restrictions: [globalCycle],
          cycleType: "UX_UI",
        }).allowed,
      ).toBe(false);
    }
    const globalEffect = {
      id: "r-effect",
      targetKind: "PILOTAGE_EFFECT",
      targetRef: "*",
      status: "ACTIVE",
    };
    expect(
      evaluateCurrentAuthority({
        operation: "CHOOSE_METHOD",
        restrictions: [globalEffect],
        methodRef: "Scrum",
      }).allowed,
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      evaluateCurrentAuthority({
        operation: "OPEN_CYCLE",
        restrictions: [globalEffect],
        cycleType: "CADRAGE",
      }).allowed,
    ).toBe(false);
    const namedEffect = { ...globalEffect, targetRef: "Scrum" };
    expect(
      evaluateCurrentAuthority({
        operation: "CHOOSE_METHOD",
        restrictions: [namedEffect],
        methodRef: "Scrum",
        effectTargetRef: "Scrum",
      }).allowed,
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      evaluateCurrentAuthority({
        operation: "CHOOSE_METHOD",
        restrictions: [namedEffect],
        methodRef: "Kanban",
        effectTargetRef: "Kanban",
      }).allowed,
    ).toBe(true);
  });

  it("marks method use as restricted without treating that as erasure or a cycle block", () => {
    const methodUse = {
      id: "r-method",
      targetKind: "METHOD_USE",
      targetRef: "Scrum",
      status: "ACTIVE",
    };
    expect(methodUsageRestricted([methodUse], "Scrum")).toBe(true);
    expect(methodUsageRestricted([methodUse], "Kanban")).toBe(false);
    const verdict = evaluateCurrentAuthority({
      operation: "OPEN_CYCLE",
      restrictions: [methodUse],
      methodRef: "Scrum",
    });
    expect(verdict.allowed).toBe(true);
    expect(verdict.usageRestricted).toBe(true);
  });

  it("CR-01: TRANSITION_CYCLE is blocked when source A or target B is restricted", () => {
    const blockB = {
      id: "r-b",
      targetKind: "CYCLE_MUTATION",
      targetRef: "UX_UI",
      status: "ACTIVE",
    };
    expect(
      evaluateCurrentAuthority({
        operation: "TRANSITION_CYCLE",
        restrictions: [blockB],
        cycleId: "cyc-a",
        cycleType: "CADRAGE",
        toCycleType: "UX_UI",
      }).allowed,
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      evaluateCurrentAuthority({
        operation: "TRANSITION_CYCLE",
        restrictions: [blockB],
        cycleId: "cyc-a",
        cycleType: "CADRAGE",
        toCycleType: "DELIVERY",
      }).allowed,
    ).toBe(true);

    const blockA = {
      id: "r-a",
      targetKind: "CYCLE_MUTATION",
      targetRef: "CADRAGE",
      status: "ACTIVE",
    };
    expect(
      evaluateCurrentAuthority({
        operation: "TRANSITION_CYCLE",
        restrictions: [blockA],
        cycleId: "cyc-a",
        cycleType: "CADRAGE",
        toCycleType: "UX_UI",
      }).allowed,
    ).toBe(false);

    const blockAId = {
      id: "r-aid",
      targetKind: "CYCLE_MUTATION",
      targetRef: "cyc-a",
      status: "ACTIVE",
    };
    expect(
      evaluateCurrentAuthority({
        operation: "TRANSITION_CYCLE",
        restrictions: [blockAId],
        cycleId: "cyc-a",
        cycleType: "CADRAGE",
        toCycleType: "UX_UI",
      }).allowed,
    ).toBe(false);

    const unrelated = {
      id: "r-other",
      targetKind: "CYCLE_MUTATION",
      targetRef: "SECURITE",
      status: "ACTIVE",
    };
    expect(
      evaluateCurrentAuthority({
        operation: "TRANSITION_CYCLE",
        restrictions: [unrelated],
        cycleId: "cyc-a",
        cycleType: "CADRAGE",
        toCycleType: "UX_UI",
      }).allowed,
    ).toBe(true);

    const global = {
      id: "r-g",
      targetKind: "CYCLE_MUTATION",
      targetRef: "*",
      status: "ACTIVE",
    };
    expect(
      evaluateCurrentAuthority({
        operation: "TRANSITION_CYCLE",
        restrictions: [global],
        cycleId: "cyc-a",
        cycleType: "CADRAGE",
        toCycleType: "UX_UI",
      }).allowed,
    ).toBe(false);
  });
});

/**
 * ML5 C10 — confirmed must be explicit boolean; absent ≠ silent refuse.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

describe("ML5 C10 D6 confirmed contract", () => {
  it("treats only true as Oui and only false as Non", () => {
    const decide = (confirmed: unknown) => {
      if (typeof confirmed !== "boolean") return "REJECT_NO_ACT";
      return confirmed ? "AUTHORIZE" : "REFUSE";
    };
    expect(decide(true)).toBe("AUTHORIZE");
    expect(decide(false)).toBe("REFUSE");
    expect(decide(undefined)).toBe("REJECT_NO_ACT");
    expect(decide(null)).toBe("REJECT_NO_ACT");
    expect(decide("true")).toBe("REJECT_NO_ACT");
    expect(decide(1)).toBe("REJECT_NO_ACT");
  });
});
```

import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

describe("ML5 C12 T-04 DROP_ACK fault injection (SCRIPTED)", () => {

  });

  it("throws DROP_ACK after scripted send intent materialized in memory", async () => {

          workspaceCwd: "/tmp",
          idempotencyKey: "efx_c12_ack",

    ).rejects.toThrow(/DROP_ACK/);

        }),
      ),
    ).toBe(true);

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync, rmSync } from "fs";
import { join } from "path";

/**
 * Path confinement unit tests — DB-backed readers covered in PG/integration when available.
 * Here we validate relative-path safety helpers indirectly via readAttemptWorkspaceFile
 * with a fake plan is heavy; test normalize rules via exported behavior when DB absent.
 */

describe("ML5 C12 D8 evidence path safety", () => {
  it("rejects path traversal patterns in relativePath pre-check", async () => {
    const { readAttemptWorkspaceFile } = await import(
      "@/domains/proofs/d8-evidence-read"
    );
    const scope = {
      pilotId: "pilot_x",
      projectId: "proj_x",
      attemptId: "efx_nonexistent_c12",
      budget: { remainingCalls: 5, remainingChars: 50_000 },
    };
    // Without DB row → DENIED ATTEMPT_NOT_IN_SCOPE (never opens filesystem).
    const r = await readAttemptWorkspaceFile(scope, "../etc/passwd");
    expect(r.coverage).toBe("DENIED");
    expect(r.reason).toMatch(/ATTEMPT_NOT_IN_SCOPE|UNSAFE/);
  });

  it("workspace fixture file is readable when present on disk (local harness)", () => {
    const root = "/tmp/sfia-c12-unit-ws";
    rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
    mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(join(root, "hello.txt"), "C12-OK\n");
    expect(require("fs").readFileSync(join(root, "hello.txt"), "utf8").trim()).toBe(
      "C12-OK",
    );
  });
});

/**
 * C13 — real physical confinement tests against readConfinedWorkspaceFile
 * (the same path used by readAttemptWorkspaceFile after attempt/scope checks).
 */
import { describe, expect, it, beforeEach, afterEach } from "vitest";
import {
  mkdirSync,
  writeFileSync,
  rmSync,
  symlinkSync,
  existsSync,
} from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import {
  D8_MAX_FILE_BYTES,
  readConfinedWorkspaceFile,
} from "@/domains/proofs/d8-path-confine";

const ROOT = "/tmp/sfia-c13-d8-confine-ws";
const OUTSIDE = "/tmp/sfia-c13-d8-outside-secret.txt";

describe("ML5 C13 D8 path confinement (realpath/lstat/O_NOFOLLOW)", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    rmSync(ROOT, { recursive: true, force: true });
    mkdirSync(ROOT, { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(OUTSIDE, "SECRET_OUTSIDE_WORKSPACE\n");
    writeFileSync(join(ROOT, "allowed.txt"), "C13-ALLOWED-OK\n");
    mkdirSync(join(ROOT, "sub"), { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(join(ROOT, "sub", "nested.txt"), "nested-ok\n");
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    rmSync(ROOT, { recursive: true, force: true });
    try {
      rmSync(OUTSIDE, { force: true });
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  });

  it("1 — allowed text file under workspace succeeds", () => {
    const r = readConfinedWorkspaceFile(ROOT, "allowed.txt");
    expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
    if (r.ok) {
      expect(r.bytes.toString("utf8")).toContain("C13-ALLOWED-OK");
      expect(r.byteLength).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }
  });

  it("2 — relative traversal is refused", () => {
    const r = readConfinedWorkspaceFile(ROOT, "../sfia-c13-d8-outside-secret.txt");
    expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!r.ok) expect(r.reason).toBe("UNSAFE_RELATIVE_PATH");
  });

  it("3 — absolute-looking path after strip still refused by lexical rules", () => {
    // Caller strips absolute; confinement still refuses .. and empty
    const r = readConfinedWorkspaceFile(ROOT, "");
    expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!r.ok) expect(r.reason).toBe("UNSAFE_RELATIVE_PATH");
  });

  it("4 — symlink to file outside workspace is refused", () => {
    symlinkSync(OUTSIDE, join(ROOT, "escape-link.txt"));
    const r = readConfinedWorkspaceFile(ROOT, "escape-link.txt");
    expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!r.ok) {
      expect(["SYMLINK_ESCAPE", "SYMLINK_COMPONENT"]).toContain(r.reason);
    }
    // Content must not leak even on deny
    expect(JSON.stringify(r)).not.toContain("SECRET_OUTSIDE");
  });

  it("5 — intermediate directory symlink escape is refused", () => {
    const evilDir = "/tmp/sfia-c13-d8-evil-dir";
    rmSync(evilDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
    mkdirSync(evilDir, { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(join(evilDir, "leaked.txt"), "LEAKED_VIA_DIR_SYMLINK\n");
    symlinkSync(evilDir, join(ROOT, "evil-sub"));
    const r = readConfinedWorkspaceFile(ROOT, "evil-sub/leaked.txt");
    expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!r.ok) {
      expect(["SYMLINK_ESCAPE", "SYMLINK_COMPONENT"]).toContain(r.reason);
    }
    expect(JSON.stringify(r)).not.toContain("LEAKED_VIA_DIR");
    rmSync(evilDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  });

  it("6 — oversized file is refused before full load", () => {
    const big = join(ROOT, "huge.bin");
    // Write slightly over max without holding full string in test assert content
    const chunk = Buffer.alloc(64_000, 0x41);
    const fdParts: Buffer[] = [];
    let total = 0;
    while (total <= D8_MAX_FILE_BYTES) {
      fdParts.push(chunk);
      total += chunk.length;
    }
    writeFileSync(big, Buffer.concat(fdParts));
    const r = readConfinedWorkspaceFile(ROOT, "huge.bin");
    expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!r.ok) expect(r.reason).toBe("FILE_TOO_LARGE");
  });

  it("7 — binary null byte files still open at confine layer (caller refuses)", () => {
    writeFileSync(join(ROOT, "bin.dat"), Buffer.from([0x00, 0x01, 0x02, 0xff]));
    const r = readConfinedWorkspaceFile(ROOT, "bin.dat");
    expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
    if (r.ok) expect(r.bytes.includes(0)).toBe(true);
  });

  it("8 — nested allowed path works", () => {
    const r = readConfinedWorkspaceFile(ROOT, "sub/nested.txt");
    expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
    if (r.ok) expect(r.bytes.toString("utf8")).toContain("nested-ok");
  });

  it("9 — missing file → FILE_ABSENT", () => {
    const r = readConfinedWorkspaceFile(ROOT, "no-such.txt");
    expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!r.ok) expect(r.reason).toBe("FILE_ABSENT");
  });

  it("10 — invalid / missing root → ROOT_UNRESOLVABLE", () => {
    const r = readConfinedWorkspaceFile("/tmp/sfia-c13-no-such-root-xyz", "a.txt");
    expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!r.ok) expect(r.reason).toBe("ROOT_UNRESOLVABLE");
  });

  it("11 — null byte in path refused", () => {
    const r = readConfinedWorkspaceFile(ROOT, "allowe\0d.txt");
    expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!r.ok) expect(r.reason).toBe("UNSAFE_RELATIVE_PATH");
  });

  it("fixture still present after denials", () => {
    expect(existsSync(join(ROOT, "allowed.txt"))).toBe(true);
  });
});

/**
 * C13 — D8 per-tool provenance journal (not mere toolCallsObserved).
 * Exercises journal wiring via confine layer + recordToolSource semantics.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  createToolSourceJournal,
  recordToolSource,
} from "@/domains/conversation/tool-source-journal";
import { classifyManifestHonesty } from "@/domains/execution/handoff-integrity";

describe("ML5 C13 D8 tool journal + handoff honesty", () => {
  it("records distinct piece refs with coverage — not just call counts", () => {
    const journal = createToolSourceJournal();
    recordToolSource(journal, {
      kind: "DOCUMENT",
      ref: "d8:list_realization_evidence:efx_1",
      coverage: "DISCOVERED",
      notes: "metadata only",
    });
    recordToolSource(journal, {
      kind: "DOCUMENT",
      ref: "d8:read_attempt_workspace_file:RESULT.txt",
      coverage: "CONSULTED",
      versionOrSha: "abc",
    });
    recordToolSource(journal, {
      kind: "DOCUMENT",
      ref: "d8:read_attempt_workspace_file:secret.env",
      coverage: "DENIED",
      notes: "secret refused",
    });
    recordToolSource(journal, {
      kind: "DOCUMENT",
      ref: "d8:read_evidence_capture_meta:ecap_1",
      coverage: "DISCOVERED",
      notes: "metadata opened — binary content not consulted",
    });
    expect(journal.entries).toHaveLength(4);
    const consulted = journal.entries.filter((e) => e.coverage === "CONSULTED");
    const denied = journal.entries.filter((e) => e.coverage === "DENIED");
    const discovered = journal.entries.filter((e) => e.coverage === "DISCOVERED");
    expect(consulted).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(denied).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(discovered).toHaveLength(2);
    // Listing ≠ content consultation
    expect(
      journal.entries.find((e) => e.ref.includes("list_realization"))?.coverage,
    ).toBe("DISCOVERED");
  });

  it("upgrades coverage for same ref without duplicating", () => {
    const journal = createToolSourceJournal();
    recordToolSource(journal, {
      kind: "DOCUMENT",
      ref: "d8:read_realization_handoff_report:rhf_1",
      coverage: "PARTIAL",
    });
    recordToolSource(journal, {
      kind: "DOCUMENT",
      ref: "d8:read_realization_handoff_report:rhf_1",
      coverage: "CONSULTED",
    });
    expect(journal.entries).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(journal.entries[0]!.coverage).toBe("CONSULTED");
  });

  it("RESULT file alone does not verify announced unit tests", () => {
    const h = classifyManifestHonesty({
      filesCreated: ["RESULT_C12.txt", "src/add.ts"],
      filesObserved: ["RESULT_C12.txt", "src/add.ts"],
      testsExecuted: ["node --test src/add.test.mjs"],
      testsCaptured: [],
    });
    expect(h.canClaimVerifiedTests).toBe(false);
    expect(h.notes).toContain("TESTS_ANNOUNCED_WITHOUT_CAPTURE");
  });

  it("captured test output allows verified claim", () => {
    const h = classifyManifestHonesty({
      filesObserved: ["src/add.ts"],
      testsExecuted: ["node --test"],
      testsCaptured: ["stdout:C12_TEST_OK exit=0"],
    });
    expect(h.canClaimVerifiedTests).toBe(true);
  });
});

/**
 * C13 — durable supervisor registry: single observer per attempt, stop/fencing.
 * Does not call Cursor SDK (no LIVE provider in unit).
 */
import { describe, expect, it, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from "vitest";

describe("ML5 C13 cursor live supervisor registry", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.resetModules();
    const g = globalThis as unknown as {
      __sfiaCursorLiveSupervisors?: Map<string, unknown>;
      __sfiaCursorLiveSupervisorResumeOnce?: boolean;
    };
    g.__sfiaCursorLiveSupervisors = undefined;
    g.__sfiaCursorLiveSupervisorResumeOnce = undefined;
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.resetModules();
  });

  it("starts once per attemptId — second ensure is alreadyActive", async () => {
    vi.doMock("@/domains/execution/cursor-attempt-service", () => ({
      reconcileCursorExecution: vi.fn(async () => ({
        status: "DISPATCHED",
        live: { terminalStatus: null, runId: "run_x" },
      })),
    }));
    const mod = await import("@/domains/execution/cursor-live-supervisor");
    const a = mod.ensureCursorLiveSupervisor({
      pilotId: "p1",
      projectId: "proj1",
      attemptId: "efx_sup_1",
    });
    const b = mod.ensureCursorLiveSupervisor({
      pilotId: "p1",
      projectId: "proj1",
      attemptId: "efx_sup_1",
    });
    expect(a.started).toBe(true);
    expect(b.alreadyActive).toBe(true);
    expect(mod.listActiveCursorLiveSupervisors()).toHaveLength(1);
    mod.stopCursorLiveSupervisor("efx_sup_1", "TEST");
    expect(mod.getCursorLiveSupervisor("efx_sup_1")?.stopped).toBe(true);
    expect(mod.listActiveCursorLiveSupervisors()).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it("two attemptIds do not contaminate", async () => {
    vi.doMock("@/domains/execution/cursor-attempt-service", () => ({
      reconcileCursorExecution: vi.fn(async () => ({
        status: "DISPATCHED",
        live: { terminalStatus: null },
      })),
    }));
    const mod = await import("@/domains/execution/cursor-live-supervisor");
    mod.ensureCursorLiveSupervisor({
      pilotId: "p1",
      projectId: "proj1",
      attemptId: "efx_a",
    });
    mod.ensureCursorLiveSupervisor({
      pilotId: "p2",
      projectId: "proj2",
      attemptId: "efx_b",
    });
    expect(mod.listActiveCursorLiveSupervisors()).toHaveLength(2);
    mod.stopCursorLiveSupervisor("efx_a");
    expect(mod.listActiveCursorLiveSupervisors().map((h) => h.attemptId)).toEqual([
      "efx_b",
    ]);
    mod.stopCursorLiveSupervisor("efx_b");
  });
});

/**
 * C14 — no lexical cognitive routing; semantic prepare helpers; length ≠ profile.
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { qualifyCognitiveProfile } from "@/domains/conversation/cognitive-policy";
import { createEmptyInvestigation } from "@/domains/conversation/investigation-state";
import {
  detectsCorrectiveDraftIntent,
  detectsTechnicalContractIntent,
  semanticWantsCorrectiveDraft,
  semanticWantsCursorContractPrepare,
} from "@/domains/conversation/nora-contract-bridge";
import {
  SEMANTIC_QUALIFICATION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  type NoraTurnQualification,
} from "@/domains/conversation/semantic-qualification";
import {
  assertOutboundHasNoPrivateLeak,
  executePublicWebSearch,
  __resetPublicWebOutboundLogForTests,
  __getPublicWebOutboundLogForTests,
} from "@/domains/conversation/public-web-search-frontier";

function qual(partial: Partial<NoraTurnQualification>): NoraTurnQualification {
  return {
    schemaVersion: SEMANTIC_QUALIFICATION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    status: "QUALIFIED",
    goal: partial.goal ?? "g",
    projectIntention: "",
    desiredOutcome: "",
    initialScope: "",
    proposedProjectName: "",
    intents: partial.intents ?? [],
    clarifications: [],
    continueChoices: [],
    resourceReferences: [],
    replyDraft: "ok",
    preparationAssessment: "EXPLORING",
    preparationAssessmentExplanation: "",
    ...partial,
  };
}

describe("ML5 C14 semantic routing (no lexical decision)", () => {
  it("legacy lexical detectors always fail-closed (false)", () => {
    expect(
      detectsTechnicalContractIntent("Prépare un contrat technique pour Cursor"),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(detectsCorrectiveDraftIntent("Corrige le brouillon dans le mandat")).toBe(
      false,
    );
  });

  it("semantic prepare from qualification intents", () => {
    const q = qual({
      intents: [
        {
          id: "p1",
          capabilityId: "d7.prepare_cursor_contract",
          mode: "PREPARE",
          parameters: {},
          constraints: [],
          dependsOn: [],
          sourceEvidence: [],
        },
      ],
    });
    expect(semanticWantsCursorContractPrepare(q)).toBe(true);
    expect(semanticWantsCorrectiveDraft(q)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("negation / discussion about Cursor without prepare intent → no prepare", () => {
    const q = qual({
      goal: "Je ne veux surtout pas lancer Cursor ; explique seulement",
      intents: [
        {
          id: "i1",
          capabilityId: "d3.converse",
          mode: "EXPLAIN",
          parameters: {},
          constraints: [],
          dependsOn: [],
          sourceEvidence: [],
        },
      ],
    });
    expect(semanticWantsCursorContractPrepare(q)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("correctiveDraft parameter is semantic, not keyword", () => {
    const q = qual({
      intents: [
        {
          id: "c1",
          capabilityId: "d7.prepare_cursor_contract",
          mode: "PREPARE",
          parameters: { correctiveDraft: "true" },
          constraints: [],
          dependsOn: [],
          sourceEvidence: [],
        },
      ],
    });
    expect(semanticWantsCorrectiveDraft(q)).toBe(true);
  });

  it("length does not select investigation profile", () => {
    const short = qualifyCognitiveProfile("ok?");
    const long = qualifyCognitiveProfile("x".repeat(2000));
    expect(short.profile).toBe("analyse");
    expect(long.profile).toBe("analyse");
    expect(short.reasonCodes).toContain("BUDGET_DEFAULT_ANALYSE_NO_LENGTH_ROUTING");
    expect(createEmptyInvestigation("hi").profileHint).toBe("analyse");
    expect(createEmptyInvestigation("x".repeat(500)).profileHint).toBe("analyse");
  });

  it("WEB frontier outbound never includes private markers", async () => {
    __resetPublicWebOutboundLogForTests();
    const markers = [
      "pilot_secret_marker_c14",
      "INTERNAL_DOC_C14_PRIVATE",
      "sk-proj-fake-not-a-real-key",
    ];
    const r = await executePublicWebSearch({
      rawQuery: "public TypeScript handbook overview",
      privateContextMarkers: markers,
      env: {
        SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED: "1",
        SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_LIVE: "0",
      },
    });
    expect(r.mode).toBe("SCRIPTED");
    expect(r.status).toBe("AVAILABLE");
    const log = __getPublicWebOutboundLogForTests();
    expect(log.length).toBe(1);
    const leak = assertOutboundHasNoPrivateLeak(log[0]!.outboundFields, markers);
    expect(leak.ok).toBe(true);
    expect(JSON.stringify(log[0]!.outboundFields)).not.toMatch(/pilot_secret|INTERNAL_DOC|sk-proj/);
  });

  it("WEB frontier blocks when private marker appears in query payload", async () => {
    const r = await executePublicWebSearch({
      rawQuery: "tell me about pilot_secret_marker_c14",
      privateContextMarkers: ["pilot_secret_marker_c14"],
      env: {
        SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED: "1",
        SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_LIVE: "0",
      },
    });
    expect(r.status).toBe("DENIED");
    expect(r.limits.some((l) => l.includes("PRIVATE_LEAK") || l.includes("leak:"))).toBe(
      true,
    );
  });
});

/**
 * ML5 C9 — D6 refuse is an authenticated act; SCRIPTED phased emits RUNNING then finished.
 */
import { describe, expect, it, afterEach } from "vitest";
import {
  __resetScriptedCursorRunsForTests,
  advanceScriptedRunToFinished,
  dispatchCursorRun,
  isScriptedPhasedMode,
} from "@/domains/execution/cursor-sdk-adapter";

describe("ML5 C9 SCRIPTED phased + D6 refuse helpers", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    __resetScriptedCursorRunsForTests();
    delete process.env.SFIA_CURSOR_SCRIPTED_PHASED;
  });

  it("isScriptedPhasedMode reads env", () => {
    expect(isScriptedPhasedMode({})).toBe(false);
    expect(isScriptedPhasedMode({ SFIA_CURSOR_SCRIPTED_PHASED: "1" })).toBe(true);
  });

  it("SCRIPTED phased returns RUNNING observation without terminal", async () => {
    process.env.SFIA_CURSOR_SCRIPTED_PHASED = "1";
    const d = await dispatchCursorRun({
      attemptId: "efx_test_phased",
      instructionText: "noop",
      instructionFingerprint: "fp",
      workspaceCwd: "/tmp",
      idempotencyKey: "efx_test_phased",
      waitForTerminal: true, // env PHASED still forces running first
    });
    expect(d.terminalStatus).toBeNull();
    expect(d.lastActivitySummary).toBe("SCRIPTED_OBSERVATION_RUNNING");
    expect(d.limits).toContain("SCRIPTED_PHASED");
    const fin = advanceScriptedRunToFinished("efx_test_phased");
    expect(fin?.lastActivitySummary).toBe("SCRIPTED_OBSERVATION_FINISHED");
    expect(fin?.resultText).toContain("efx_test_phased");
  });

  it("SCRIPTED non-phased still finishes immediately", async () => {
    const d = await dispatchCursorRun({
      attemptId: "efx_test_immediate",
      instructionText: "noop",
      instructionFingerprint: "fp",
      workspaceCwd: "/tmp",
      idempotencyKey: "efx_test_immediate",
      waitForTerminal: true,
    });
    expect(d.terminalStatus).toBe("finished");
    expect(d.lastActivitySummary).toBe("SCRIPTED_FINISHED");
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  assertContractBodyComplete,
  evaluateContractReadiness,
} from "@/domains/execution/technical-contract";
import type { TechnicalContractBody } from "@/domains/execution/types";
import {
  buildNoraFinalAnalysisBrief,
  classifyAttachedNoraPayload,
  qualifyCursorRealization,
} from "@/domains/proofs/cursor-qualify";

function sampleBody(): TechnicalContractBody {
  return {
    title: "Mission test",
    engagements: {
      willDo: "Modifier README",
      willNotDo: "Pas de merge",
      expectedResult: "README mis à jour",
      pilotControl: "HumanDecision Exécuter",
    },
    volets: {
      mission: "doc",
      perimeter: "README.md",
      capabilitiesAuthority: "Cursor SDK local",
      stopConditions: "STOP demandé",
      proofsSources: "diff + handoff",
      integrity: "fingerprint",
    },
    instructionText: "éditer README",
    risks: ["faible"],
    exclusions: ["PR"],
    acceptance: { criteria: ["diff"], expectedProofs: ["handoff"] },
    executor: {
      kind: "CURSOR_SDK_LOCAL",
      capabilities: ["edit"],
      permissionsNeeded: ["workspace"],
    },
    stopConditions: ["STOP"],
    reversibilityLimits: ["pas de rollback auto"],
    gitScope: null,
  };
}

describe("ML5 P1 — contract readiness + Nora brief distinction", () => {
  it("document complete ≠ READY when unknown restrictions", () => {
    const body = sampleBody();
    assertContractBodyComplete(body);
    const r = evaluateContractReadiness({
      body,
      unknownRestrictions: ["scope.git.unknown"],
    });
    expect(r.documentComplete).toBe(true);
    expect(r.ready).toBe(false);
    expect(r.blockedReasons.some((b) => b.includes("UNKNOWN_RESTRICTIONS"))).toBe(true);
  });

  it("ready only when document complete and no unknowns", () => {
    const r = evaluateContractReadiness({ body: sampleBody(), sourcesSufficient: true });
    expect(r.ready).toBe(true);
  });

  it("attached payload is technical brief, not Nora cognitive", () => {
    const q = qualifyCursorRealization({
      contractFingerprint: "abc",
      handoffStatus: null,
      reportMarkdown: null,
      manifest: null,
    });
    const brief = buildNoraFinalAnalysisBrief(q);
    expect(classifyAttachedNoraPayload(brief)).toBe("TECHNICAL_BRIEF");
    expect(brief).toMatch(/pas un avis Nora/);
  });
});
```

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  __resetScriptedCursorRunsForTests,
  dispatchCursorRun,
  resolveCursorAdapterMode,
  stopCursorRun,
} from "@/domains/execution/cursor-sdk-adapter";
import { handoffIntegrityHash } from "@/domains/execution/handoff-integrity";

describe("ML5 E — Cursor SDK adapter invariants (SCRIPTED)", () => {
  it("defaults to SCRIPTED", () => {
    expect(resolveCursorAdapterMode({} as unknown as NodeJS.ProcessEnv)).toBe("SCRIPTED");
    expect(
      resolveCursorAdapterMode(
        { SFIA_CURSOR_EFFECT_MODE: "LIVE" } as unknown as NodeJS.ProcessEnv,
      ),
    ).toBe("LIVE");
  });

  it("idempotent replay does not create a second scripted run identity", async () => {
    __resetScriptedCursorRunsForTests();
    const input = {
      attemptId: "efx_test_1",
      instructionText: "do thing",
      instructionFingerprint: "fp1",
      workspaceCwd: "/tmp",
      idempotencyKey: "efx_test_1",
    };
    const a = await dispatchCursorRun(input, "SCRIPTED");
    const b = await dispatchCursorRun(input, "SCRIPTED");
    expect(a.agentId).toBe(b.agentId);
    expect(a.runId).toBe(b.runId);
    expect(b.limits).toContain("IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY");
  });

  it("STOP requested documents cancel ≠ rollback", async () => {
    __resetScriptedCursorRunsForTests();
    const stop = await stopCursorRun({
      attemptId: "efx_x",
      agentId: null,
      runId: null,
      workspaceCwd: "/tmp",
      mode: "SCRIPTED",
    });
    expect(stop.limits).toContain("CANCEL_IS_NOT_ROLLBACK");
    expect(stop.stopRequestedAt).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it("handoff integrity changes when report changes", () => {
    const a = handoffIntegrityHash({
      attemptId: "a1",
      contractFingerprint: "c1",
      reportMarkdown: "one",
      manifest: { filesCreated: ["x"] },
    });
    const b = handoffIntegrityHash({
      attemptId: "a1",
      contractFingerprint: "c1",
      reportMarkdown: "two",
      manifest: { filesCreated: ["x"] },
    });
    expect(a).not.toBe(b);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

  });
});

import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  buildCursorGitMandateFromScope,
  buildCursorGitObservation,
  createLocalBareGitHarness,
  observeWorkspaceGitFacts,
  preflightCursorGitOptionA,
  qualifyCursorGitPublication,
  verifyRemoteBranchSha,
  type LocalGitHarness,
} from "@/domains/execution/cursor-git-option-a";

describe("ML5 Git Cursor option A (DÉC-ML5-GIT / CP-01)", () => {
  let harness: LocalGitHarness | null = null;
  afterEach(() => {
    harness?.cleanup();
    harness = null;
  });

  it("refuses missing mandate and protected default branches", () => {
    expect(buildCursorGitMandateFromScope(null)).toBeNull();
    expect(
      buildCursorGitMandateFromScope({
        required: true,
        repositoryFullName: "org/repo",
        baseRef: "main",
        workBranch: "main",
        baseSha: null,
      }),
    ).toBeNull();
  });

  it("preflight denies unauthorized repo", () => {
    harness = createLocalBareGitHarness();
    const mandate = buildCursorGitMandateFromScope({
      required: true,
      repositoryFullName: "org/repo",
      baseRef: "main",
      workBranch: "cursor/ml5-work",
      baseSha: harness.headSha(harness.workPath),
    })!;
    const obs = observeWorkspaceGitFacts(harness.workPath, "main", "cursor/ml5-work");
    const denied = preflightCursorGitOptionA({
      mandate,
      workspacePath: harness.workPath,
      authorizedRepos: ["other/repo"],
      observations: obs,
    });
    expect(denied.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!denied.ok) expect(denied.reason).toBe("REPO_NOT_AUTHORIZED");
  });

  it("CP-01: independent observation — missing workspace fails", () => {
    const mandate = buildCursorGitMandateFromScope({
      required: true,
      repositoryFullName: "org/repo",
      baseRef: "main",
      workBranch: "cursor/ml5-work",
      baseSha: "aaa",
    })!;
    const obs = observeWorkspaceGitFacts("/tmp/sfia-missing-ws-" + Date.now(), "main", "cursor/ml5-work");
    expect(obs.workspaceExists).toBe(false);
    const pre = preflightCursorGitOptionA({
      mandate,
      workspacePath: obs.workspacePath,
      authorizedRepos: ["org/repo"],
      observations: obs,
    });
    expect(pre.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!pre.ok) expect(pre.reason).toBe("WORKSPACE_MISSING");
  });

  it("CP-01: base SHA divergence uses observed remote, not contract echo", () => {
    harness = createLocalBareGitHarness();
    const real = harness.headSha(harness.workPath);
    const mandate = buildCursorGitMandateFromScope({
      required: true,
      repositoryFullName: harness.remoteName,
      baseRef: "main",
      workBranch: "cursor/ml5-work",
      baseSha: "deadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeef",
    })!;
    const obs = observeWorkspaceGitFacts(harness.workPath, "main", "cursor/ml5-work");
    expect(obs.observedRemoteBaseSha).toBe(real);
    const pre = preflightCursorGitOptionA({
      mandate,
      workspacePath: harness.workPath,
      authorizedRepos: [harness.remoteName],
      observations: obs,
    });
    expect(pre.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!pre.ok) expect(pre.reason).toBe("BASE_SHA_DIVERGED");
  });

  it("push declared ≠ remote verified until independent re-read + local match", () => {
    expect(
      qualifyCursorGitPublication({
        localHeadSha: "abc",
        remoteHeadShaVerified: null,
        pushDeclaredByCursor: true,
      }),
    ).toBe("PUSHED_UNVERIFIED");
    expect(
      qualifyCursorGitPublication({
        localHeadSha: null,
        remoteHeadShaVerified: "abc",
        pushDeclaredByCursor: true,
      }),
    ).toBe("PUSHED_UNVERIFIED");
    expect(
      qualifyCursorGitPublication({
        localHeadSha: "abc",
        remoteHeadShaVerified: "abc",
        pushDeclaredByCursor: true,
      }),
    ).toBe("REMOTE_VERIFIED");
  });

  it("local bare harness: commit+push then remote HEAD matches", () => {
    harness = createLocalBareGitHarness();
    const branch = "cursor/ml5-work";
    harness.pushWorkBranch(branch);
    const local = harness.headSha(harness.workPath);
    const remote = harness.remoteHead(branch);
    expect(local).toBe(remote);
    const verified = verifyRemoteBranchSha(harness.workPath, branch);
    expect(verified).toBe(remote);
    const obs = buildCursorGitObservation({
      workBranch: branch,
      baseShaDeclared: null,
      localHeadSha: local,
      remoteHeadShaVerified: verified,
      pushDeclaredByCursor: true,
    });
    expect(obs.publicationStatus).toBe("REMOTE_VERIFIED");
  });

  it("preflight passes when observations match mandate", () => {
    harness = createLocalBareGitHarness();
    const base = harness.headSha(harness.workPath);
    const mandate = buildCursorGitMandateFromScope({
      required: true,
      repositoryFullName: harness.remoteName,
      baseRef: "main",
      workBranch: "cursor/ml5-work",
      baseSha: base,
    })!;
    const observations = observeWorkspaceGitFacts(
      harness.workPath,
      "main",
      "cursor/ml5-work",
    );
    expect(observations.originUrl).toBeTruthy();
    expect(observations.observedRemoteBaseSha).toBe(base);
    const pre = preflightCursorGitOptionA({
      mandate,
      workspacePath: harness.workPath,
      authorizedRepos: [harness.remoteName],
      observations,
    });
    expect(pre.ok).toBe(true);
    if (pre.ok) {
      expect(pre.observedBaseSha).toBe(base);
      expect(pre.remoteUrl).toBeTruthy();
    }
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  buildNoraFinalAnalysisBrief,
  qualifyCursorRealization,
} from "@/domains/proofs/cursor-qualify";

describe("ML5 G — D8 cursor qualification", () => {
  it("exposes nine rubrics and never claims PASS/ADOPTED", () => {
    const q = qualifyCursorRealization({
      contractFingerprint: "abc",
      handoffStatus: "RECEIVED",
      reportMarkdown: "# Rapport\n\nTravail scripted.",
      manifest: {
        filesCreated: ["a.ts"],
        testsDeclared: ["t1"],
        testsExecuted: ["t1"],
        testsCaptured: [],
        gaps: ["preuve test manquante"],
      },
      terminalStatus: "finished",
    });
    expect(q.rubrics).toHaveLength(9);
    expect(q.testsPass).toBe(false);
    expect(q.conformityProven).toBe(false);
    expect(q.morrisAcceptance).toBe(false);
    expect(q.adopted).toBe(false);
    expect(q.verdict).toBe("PARTIAL");
    expect(q.limits.some((l) => /Tests déclarés/.test(l))).toBe(true);
  });

  it("marks missing report as indeterminate", () => {
    const q = qualifyCursorRealization({
      contractFingerprint: "abc",
      handoffStatus: null,
      reportMarkdown: null,
      manifest: null,
    });
    expect(q.verdict).toBe("INDETERMINATE");
    const brief = buildNoraFinalAnalysisBrief(q);
    expect(brief).toMatch(/BRIEF TECHNIQUE DÉTERMINISTE/);
    expect(brief).toMatch(/pas une HumanDecision/);
  });

  it("refuses lexical criterion-as-proof and flags git tip mismatch", () => {
    const q = qualifyCursorRealization({
      contractFingerprint: "abc",
      acceptanceCriteria: ["critere-alpha-unique"],
      expectedProofs: ["capture"],
      handoffStatus: "RECEIVED",
      reportMarkdown: "# Rapport contenant critere-alpha-unique en texte",
      manifest: {
        filesCreated: ["a.ts"],
        testsDeclared: [],
        testsCaptured: [],
        git: { tipSha: "aaa" },
        sourcesConsulted: [],
      },
      gitFacts: [{ path: "a.ts", sha: "bbb" }],
      gitFactsVerified: false,
    });
    expect(q.verdict).toBe("PARTIAL");
    expect(q.limits.some((l) => /présence textuelle ≠ satisfaction/.test(l))).toBe(true);
    expect(q.limits.some((l) => /D9/.test(l))).toBe(true);
    expect(q.limits.some((l) => /tipSha/.test(l))).toBe(true);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  isApprovedLoopbackAuthority,
  isDevAutoSessionAllowed,
  isDevListenConfined,
} from "@/domains/identity/session";

describe("ML5 DEV auto-session gate (DÉC-ML5-DEV / CP-02)", () => {
  it("isApprovedLoopbackAuthority rejects forged hosts", () => {
    expect(isApprovedLoopbackAuthority("127.0.0.1:3100")).toBe(true);
    expect(isApprovedLoopbackAuthority("localhost.attacker.example")).toBe(false);
    expect(isApprovedLoopbackAuthority("evil.com")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("CP-02: listen confinement requires STUDIO_DEV_BIND loopback", () => {
    const prev = process.env.STUDIO_DEV_BIND;
    try {
      process.env.STUDIO_DEV_BIND = "127.0.0.1";
      expect(isDevListenConfined()).toBe(true);
      process.env.STUDIO_DEV_BIND = "0.0.0.0";
      expect(isDevListenConfined()).toBe(false);
      delete process.env.STUDIO_DEV_BIND;
      expect(isDevListenConfined()).toBe(false);
    } finally {
      process.env.STUDIO_DEV_BIND = prev;
    }
  });

  it("auto-session requires DEV lane + flags + bind (probe without DB)", () => {
    const gate = { host: "127.0.0.1:3100" };
    const prev = {
      auto: process.env.STUDIO_DEV_AUTO_SESSION,
      login: process.env.STUDIO_DEV_TEST_LOGIN,
      lane: process.env.STUDIO_LANE,
      bind: process.env.STUDIO_DEV_BIND,
    };
    try {
      process.env.STUDIO_DEV_AUTO_SESSION = "1";
      process.env.STUDIO_DEV_TEST_LOGIN = "1";
      process.env.STUDIO_LANE = "DEV";
      process.env.STUDIO_DEV_BIND = "127.0.0.1";
      expect(isDevAutoSessionAllowed(gate)).toBe(true);

      process.env.STUDIO_DEV_BIND = "0.0.0.0";
      expect(isDevAutoSessionAllowed(gate)).toBe(false);

      process.env.STUDIO_DEV_BIND = "127.0.0.1";
      process.env.STUDIO_LANE = "RECETTE";
      expect(isDevAutoSessionAllowed(gate)).toBe(false);

      process.env.STUDIO_LANE = "STABLE";
      expect(isDevAutoSessionAllowed(gate)).toBe(false);

      process.env.STUDIO_LANE = "DEV";
      process.env.STUDIO_DEV_AUTO_SESSION = "0";
      expect(isDevAutoSessionAllowed(gate)).toBe(false);

      // Forged Host still denied even with bind ok
      process.env.STUDIO_DEV_AUTO_SESSION = "1";
      expect(isDevAutoSessionAllowed({ host: "evil.example.com" })).toBe(false);
      expect(
        isDevAutoSessionAllowed({
          host: "127.0.0.1:3100",
          forwardedFor: "8.8.8.8",
        }),
      ).toBe(false);
    } finally {
      process.env.STUDIO_DEV_AUTO_SESSION = prev.auto;
      process.env.STUDIO_DEV_TEST_LOGIN = prev.login;
      process.env.STUDIO_LANE = prev.lane;
      process.env.STUDIO_DEV_BIND = prev.bind;
    }
  });
});
```

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  createEmptyInvestigation,
  evaluateContractReadiness,
  qualifySearchMiss,
  resumeInvestigation,
  type InvestigationState,
} from "@/domains/conversation/investigation-state";

describe("ML5 A — investigation-state", () => {
  it("blocks contract ready when determinant questions remain open", () => {
    const state: InvestigationState = {
      ...createEmptyInvestigation("Préparer un contrat Cursor"),
      profileHint: "investigation",
      questions: [
        {
          id: "q1",
          text: "Quelle branche de travail ?",
          status: "OPEN",
          importance: "DETERMINANT",
        },
      ],
    };
    const next = evaluateContractReadiness(state);
    expect(next.contractReady).toBe(false);
    expect(next.sufficiency).toBe("INSUFFICIENT");
    expect(next.contractReadyBlockedReason).toMatch(/q1/);
  });

  it("blocks when late unknown restriction is recorded", () => {
    const state: InvestigationState = {
      ...createEmptyInvestigation("mission"),
      questions: [],
      sufficiency: "BLOCKED_BY_UNKNOWN_RESTRICTION",
    };
    const next = evaluateContractReadiness(state);
    expect(next.contractReady).toBe(false);
    expect(next.sufficiency).toBe("BLOCKED_BY_UNKNOWN_RESTRICTION");
  });

  it("allows ready only when determinants answered and no contradictions", () => {
    const state: InvestigationState = {
      ...createEmptyInvestigation("mission"),
      questions: [
        {
          id: "q1",
          text: "Cible ?",
          status: "ANSWERED",
          importance: "DETERMINANT",
          answerSummary: "sandbox only",
        },
      ],
      sources: [
        {
          kind: "GIT",
          ref: "repo@abc",
          coverage: "VERIFIED",
        },
      ],
      contradictions: [],
      sufficiency: "UNKNOWN",
    };
    const next = evaluateContractReadiness(state);
    expect(next.contractReady).toBe(true);
    expect(next.sufficiency).toBe("SUFFICIENT");
  });

  it("does not treat lexical miss as demonstrated absence", () => {
    expect(qualifySearchMiss("LEXICAL_MISS")).toBe("UNKNOWN");
    expect(qualifySearchMiss("DEMONSTRATED_ABSENCE")).toBe("VERIFIED");
  });

  it("resume does not invent sources", () => {
    const resumed = resumeInvestigation(
      {
        intentSummary: "reprendre",
        sources: [{ kind: "D4", ref: "", coverage: "CONSULTED" }],
      } as Partial<InvestigationState>,
      "reprendre",
    );
    expect(resumed.sources).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  detectsTechnicalContractIntent,
  draftBodyFromInvestigation,
  semanticWantsCorrectiveDraft,
  semanticWantsCursorContractPrepare,
} from "@/domains/conversation/nora-contract-bridge";

} from "@/domains/conversation/investigation-state";

} from "@/domains/proofs/cursor-qualify";
import { BILAN_TAB_LABELS } from "@/components/figma/RealizationBilan";

describe("ML5 CA-01 Nora contract bridge helpers", () => {
  it("C14: lexical detectors are inert (fail-closed)", () => {
    expect(
      detectsTechnicalContractIntent("Prépare un contrat technique pour Cursor"),
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it("C14: semantic prepare / corrective from qualification", () => {
    const base: NoraTurnQualification = {
      schemaVersion: SEMANTIC_QUALIFICATION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      status: "QUALIFIED",
      goal: "préparer mandat",
      projectIntention: "",
      desiredOutcome: "module",
      initialScope: "",
      proposedProjectName: "",
      intents: [
        {
          id: "p1",
          capabilityId: "d7.prepare_cursor_contract",
          mode: "PREPARE",
          parameters: { correctiveDraft: "true" },
          constraints: [],
          dependsOn: [],
          sourceEvidence: [],
        },
      ],
      clarifications: [],
      continueChoices: [],
      resourceReferences: [],
      replyDraft: "ok",
      preparationAssessment: "PROPOSAL",
      preparationAssessmentExplanation: "",
    };
    expect(semanticWantsCursorContractPrepare(base)).toBe(true);
    expect(semanticWantsCorrectiveDraft(base)).toBe(true);
  });

  it("refuses prepare semantics without consulted source", () => {
    const inv = evaluateContractReadiness(createEmptyInvestigation("mission cursor"));
    expect(inv.contractReady).toBe(true); // empty questions → ready structurally
    expect(inv.sources.some((s) => s.coverage === "CONSULTED")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("drafts a contract body from investigation with sources + business criteria", () => {
    const base = createEmptyInvestigation("réalisation cursor du module X");
    const inv = evaluateContractReadiness({
      ...base,
      desiredOutcome: "module X livré avec calcul correct",
      remainingWork: ["cas limite TVA 0%", "arrondi centimes"],
      sources: [
        { kind: "GIT", ref: "repo/README.md", coverage: "CONSULTED" },
        { kind: "D4", ref: "doc:spec", coverage: "VERIFIED" },
      ],
      exclusions: ["push GitHub"],
    });
    const body = draftBodyFromInvestigation(inv, {
      instructionFromNora: "Détail technique long de Nora pour le mandat.",
    });
    expect(body.instructionText).toMatch(/Sources consultées/);
    expect(body.instructionText).toMatch(/Détail technique long/);
    expect(body.acceptance.criteria).toContain("cas limite TVA 0%");
    expect(body.exclusions).toContain("push GitHub");
    expect(body.executor.kind).toBe("CURSOR_SDK_LOCAL");
  });
});

describe("ML5 CA-08 synthesis vs Nora cognitive classification", () => {

    const q = qualifyCursorRealization({

      handoffStatus: "RECEIVED",
      reportMarkdown: "# Rapport\nhandoff RECEIVED ok",
      manifest: { filesCreated: ["a.ts"], gaps: ["preuve tardive"] },

      ),
    ).toBe("NORA_COGNITIVE");
  });
});

describe("C8 B1 proof-ref exact", () => {
  it("rejects substring matches and empty new_proof fallback", () => {
    const partial = verifyNewProofRef({
      newProofRef: "a",
      attemptId: "efx_1",
      handoffId: "rh_abc",
      handoffIntegrityHash: null,
      manifestRefs: ["src/a.ts"],
      mode: "new_proof",
    });
    expect(partial.ok).toBe(false);

    const exact = verifyNewProofRef({
      newProofRef: "src/a.ts",
      attemptId: "efx_1",
      handoffId: "rh_abc",
      handoffIntegrityHash: null,
      manifestRefs: ["src/a.ts"],
      mode: "new_proof",
    });
    expect(exact.ok).toBe(true);
  });

  it("rejects echoing prior handoff as new_proof", () => {
    const r = verifyNewProofRef({
      newProofRef: "rh_abc",
      attemptId: "efx_1",
      handoffId: "rh_abc",
      handoffIntegrityHash: null,
      manifestRefs: [],
      mode: "new_proof",
      priorHandoffId: "rh_abc",
    });
    expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!r.ok) expect(r.reason).toMatch(/NOT_NEW/);
  });

  it("collects manifest refs", () => {
    expect(
      collectManifestRefs({
        filesCreated: ["a.ts"],
        captures: ["cap1"],
      }),
    ).toEqual(["a.ts", "cap1"]);
  });
});

      }),

    expect(formatCitationForDisplay(c)).toMatch(/découvert/);

describe("C8 A3 MCP fail-closed", () => {
  it("UNKNOWN blocks dispatch; SCRIPTED_SIMULATED needs opt-in", () => {
    const unknown = checkRequiredMcpCapabilities(["figma"], {});
    expect(unknown[0]?.status).toBe("UNKNOWN");
    expect(assertMcpReadyForDispatch(unknown).ok).toBe(false);

    const inventoryOnly = checkRequiredMcpCapabilities(["figma"], {
      SFIA_CURSOR_MCP_AVAILABLE: "figma",
    });
    expect(inventoryOnly[0]?.status).toBe("UNKNOWN");
    expect(assertMcpReadyForDispatch(inventoryOnly).ok).toBe(false);

    const scripted = checkRequiredMcpCapabilities(["figma"], {}, { scriptedSimulation: true });
    expect(scripted[0]?.status).toBe("SCRIPTED_SIMULATED");
    expect(assertMcpReadyForDispatch(scripted).ok).toBe(false);
    expect(assertMcpReadyForDispatch(scripted, { allowScriptedSimulation: true }).ok).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("G07 evidence captures hardened", () => {
  it("stores PNG with magic check and lists by attempt", () => {
    const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "sfia-ecap-"));
    const prev = process.env.SFIA_EVIDENCE_ROOT;
    process.env.SFIA_EVIDENCE_ROOT = root;
    try {
      // Minimal PNG signature + padding
      const buf = Buffer.from([
        0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a, 0, 0, 0, 0,
      ]);
      expect(detectImageMime(buf)).toBe("image/png");
      const meta = storeEvidenceCapture({
        attemptId: "efx_test",
        projectId: "proj_x",
        pilotId: "pilot_x",
        bytes: buf,
        label: "runtime-execution",
        viewport: { w: 1280, h: 800 },
      });
      expect(meta.contentSha256).toBe(sha256Buffer(buf));
      expect(listEvidenceCapturesForAttempt("efx_test")).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(() =>
        storeEvidenceCapture({
          attemptId: "efx_test",
          projectId: "proj_x",
          pilotId: "pilot_x",
          bytes: Buffer.from("not-an-image"),
          label: "bad",
        }),
      ).toThrow(/NOT_PNG/);
    } finally {
      process.env.SFIA_EVIDENCE_ROOT = prev;
      rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
    }
  });
});

    expect(r.reason).toBe("DECLARED_BIND_NOT_LOOPBACK");
  });
});

import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  __getPublicWebOutboundLogForTests,
  __resetPublicWebOutboundLogForTests,
  __parseLiveWebItemsForTests,
  assertOutboundHasNoPrivateLeak,
  assertPublicHttpsUrl,
  canUsePublicWebFrontier,
  confrontWebSources,
  executePublicWebOpenPage,
  executePublicWebSearch,
} from "@/domains/conversation/public-web-search-frontier";
import type { CognitivePolicy } from "@/domains/conversation/cognitive-policy";

const basePolicy = {
  profile: "analyse",
  profileType: "OPERATIONAL",
} as unknown as CognitivePolicy;

function env(partial: Record<string, string>): NodeJS.ProcessEnv {
  // Default LIVE off in unit tests unless the case opts in — avoid shell pollution.
  return { ...process.env, SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_LIVE: "0", ...partial };
}

afterEach(() => {
  __resetPublicWebOutboundLogForTests();
});

describe("ML5 B1 public web frontier", () => {
  it("is off by default", () => {
    expect(canUsePublicWebFrontier(basePolicy, env({ SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED: "0" }))).toBe(
      false,
    );
  });

  it("blocks secretish queries and records no useful outbound", async () => {
    const r = await executePublicWebSearch({
      rawQuery: "api_key=sk-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456",
      env: env({ SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED: "1" }),
    });
    expect(r.status).toBe("DENIED");
    expect(__getPublicWebOutboundLogForTests()).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it("SCRIPTED search records only sanitized public query", async () => {
    const secret = "super-private-doc-xyz";
    const r = await executePublicWebSearch({
      rawQuery: "RFC 9110 HTTP semantics",
      privateContextMarkers: [secret, "/Users/morris/secret"],
      env: env({ SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED: "1" }),
    });
    expect(r.status).toBe("AVAILABLE");
    expect(r.mode).toBe("SCRIPTED");
    const log = __getPublicWebOutboundLogForTests();
    expect(log).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(log[0]!.outboundFields.q).toMatch(/RFC 9110/);
    const leak = assertOutboundHasNoPrivateLeak(log[0]!.outboundFields, [
      secret,
      "/Users/morris/secret",
    ]);
    expect(leak.ok).toBe(true);
  });

  it("refuses private path leakage in query", async () => {
    const r = await executePublicWebSearch({
      rawQuery: "see /Users/morris/Projects/private/notes.md for details",
      env: env({ SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED: "1" }),
    });
    if (r.status === "AVAILABLE") {
      const log = __getPublicWebOutboundLogForTests();
      expect(JSON.stringify(log)).not.toMatch(/\/Users\/morris/);
    } else {
      expect(r.limits.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }
  });

  it(
    "SCRIPTED open_page marks PAGE_OPENED; LIVE open is no longer Morris-gate-denied",
    async () => {
      const opened = await executePublicWebOpenPage({
        url: "https://example.invalid/doc",
        env: env({ SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED: "1" }),
      });
      expect(opened.coverage).toBe("PAGE_OPENED");
      // LIVE open attempts a real fetch (fail-closed on DNS/timeout) — not MORRIS_GATE stub.
      process.env.SFIA_WEB_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = "2000";
      const liveOpen = await executePublicWebOpenPage({
        url: "https://example.invalid/doc",
        env: env({ SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED: "1", SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_LIVE: "1" }),
      });
      expect(liveOpen.limits.some((l) => /MORRIS_GATE/.test(l))).toBe(false);
      expect(["ERROR", "DENIED", "AVAILABLE"]).toContain(liveOpen.status);
    },
    12_000,
  );

  it("assertPublicHttpsUrl rejects private and credentialed destinations", () => {
    expect(assertPublicHttpsUrl("http://example.com").ok).toBe(false);
    expect(assertPublicHttpsUrl("https://127.0.0.1/x").ok).toBe(false);
    expect(assertPublicHttpsUrl("https://10.0.0.5/x").ok).toBe(false);
    expect(assertPublicHttpsUrl("https://192.168.1.1/x").ok).toBe(false);
    expect(assertPublicHttpsUrl("https://user:pass@example.com/x").ok).toBe(false);
    expect(assertPublicHttpsUrl("https://example.invalid/doc").ok).toBe(true);
  });

  it("open_page denies private IP even over https", async () => {
    const r = await executePublicWebOpenPage({
      url: "https://10.1.2.3/secret",
      env: env({ SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED: "1" }),
    });
    expect(r.status).toBe("DENIED");
    expect(r.limits).toContain("URL_PRIVATE_IP");
    expect(__getPublicWebOutboundLogForTests()).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it("parses LIVE single-object, array, and hosted navigation shapes", () => {
    const one = __parseLiveWebItemsForTests(
      '{"url":"https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Array/map","title":"map","snippet":"creates a new array"}',
    );
    expect(one).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(one[0]!.url).toContain("developer.mozilla.org");
    const many = __parseLiveWebItemsForTests(
      '[{"url":"https://example.invalid/a","title":"A","snippet":"a"},{"url":"https://example.invalid/b","title":"B","snippet":"b"}]',
    );
    expect(many).toHaveLength(2);
    const nav = __parseLiveWebItemsForTests(
      '{"navigation":[["MDN map","developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Array/map"]],"needs_search":true}',
    );
    expect(nav).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(nav[0]!.url).toMatch(/^https:\/\/developer\.mozilla\.org\//);
  });

  it("confrontWebSources flags opposing year claims", () => {
    const c = confrontWebSources([
      { url: "https://a.example/x", title: "Spec 2019", snippet: "deprecated in practice" },
      { url: "https://b.example/y", title: "Guide 2024", snippet: "recommended current approach" },
    ]);
    expect(c.contradictions.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it("never treats ISOLATION_PROVEN env as attaching hosted tool", async () => {
    const { canAttachWebSearchTool, buildPublicWebSearchTool } = await import(
      "@/domains/conversation/web-search-tools"
    );
    expect(
      buildPublicWebSearchTool(
        env({
          SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED: "1",
          SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_ISOLATION_PROVEN: "0",
        }),

      canAttachWebSearchTool(
        basePolicy,
        env({
          SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED: "1",
          SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_ISOLATION_PROVEN: "0",
        }),
      ),
    ).toBe(false);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

/**
 * G15 — requalification history append is pure logic exercised here;
 * route POST uses the same snapshot shape without Cursor redispatch.
 */
function appendQualificationHistory(
  historyJson: string,
  snapshot: {
    at: string;
    verdict: string;
    authorPilotId: string;
    requalifyReason: string;
  },
): unknown[] {
  let history: unknown[] = [];
  try {
    history = JSON.parse(historyJson || "[]") as unknown[];
  } catch {
    history = [];
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(history)) history = [];
  history.push(snapshot);
  return history;
}

describe("ML5 G15 qualification requalify history", () => {
  it("preserves prior verdict when appending", () => {
    const next = appendQualificationHistory("[]", {
      at: "2026-11-23T10:00:00.000Z",
      verdict: "INDETERMINATE",
      authorPilotId: "pilot_a",
      requalifyReason: "Handoff late pièces reçues",
    });
    expect(next).toHaveLength(1);
    expect((next[0] as { verdict: string }).verdict).toBe("INDETERMINATE");
    const again = appendQualificationHistory(JSON.stringify(next), {
      at: "2026-11-23T11:00:00.000Z",
      verdict: "NON_CONFORME",
      authorPilotId: "pilot_a",
      requalifyReason: "Tests non capturés",
    });
    expect(again).toHaveLength(2);
    expect((again[0] as { verdict: string }).verdict).toBe("INDETERMINATE");
    expect((again[1] as { verdict: string }).verdict).toBe("NON_CONFORME");
  });

  it("never implies cursorRedispatch", () => {
    const responseShape = { requalified: true, cursorRedispatch: false as const };
    expect(responseShape.cursorRedispatch).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  instructionFingerprint,
  isMaterialContractChange,
  technicalContractFingerprint,
} from "@/domains/execution/technical-contract-fingerprint";
import type { TechnicalContractBody } from "@/domains/execution/types";

function sampleBody(instruction: string): TechnicalContractBody {
  return {
    title: "Mission test",
    engagements: {
      willDo: "Modifier README",
      willNotDo: "Pas de merge",
      expectedResult: "README mis à jour",
      pilotControl: "HumanDecision Exécuter",
    },
    volets: {
      mission: "doc",
      perimeter: "README.md",
      capabilitiesAuthority: "Cursor SDK local",
      stopConditions: "STOP demandé",
      proofsSources: "diff + handoff",
      integrity: "fingerprint",
    },
    instructionText: instruction,
    risks: ["faible"],
    exclusions: ["PR"],
    acceptance: { criteria: ["diff"], expectedProofs: ["handoff"] },
    executor: {
      kind: "CURSOR_SDK_LOCAL",
      capabilities: ["edit"],
      permissionsNeeded: ["workspace"],
    },
    stopConditions: ["STOP"],
    reversibilityLimits: ["pas de rollback auto"],
    gitScope: null,
  };
}

describe("ML5 D — technical contract fingerprint", () => {
  it("keeps full instruction in fingerprint (no replyDraft truncation)", () => {
    const long = "X".repeat(50_000);
    const fp = technicalContractFingerprint(sampleBody(long));
    expect(fp).toHaveLength(64);
    expect(instructionFingerprint(long)).toHaveLength(64);
    expect(instructionFingerprint(long)).not.toBe(instructionFingerprint(long.slice(0, 1000)));
  });

  it("detects material instruction change", () => {
    const a = technicalContractFingerprint(sampleBody("v1 exact"));
    const b = technicalContractFingerprint(sampleBody("v2 exact"));
    expect(isMaterialContractChange(a, b)).toBe(true);
    expect(isMaterialContractChange(a, a)).toBe(false);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  buildPublicWebSearchTool,
  canAttachWebSearchTool,
  isWebSearchIsolationProven,
  preparePublicWebQuery,
  WEB_SEARCH_BOUNDARY_NOTE,
} from "@/domains/conversation/web-search-tools";
import type { CognitivePolicy } from "@/domains/conversation/cognitive-policy";

const analysePolicy = {
  profile: "analyse",
  profileType: "STANDARD",
} as unknown as CognitivePolicy;

describe("ML5 P0-03 — B1 web search boundary", () => {
  it("keeps tool detached when isolation is not proven", () => {
    const env = {
      SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED: "1",
    } as unknown as NodeJS.ProcessEnv;
    expect(isWebSearchIsolationProven(env)).toBe(false);
    expect(canAttachWebSearchTool(analysePolicy, env)).toBe(false);
    expect(buildPublicWebSearchTool(env)).toBeNull();
    expect(WEB_SEARCH_BOUNDARY_NOTE).toMatch(/DISABLED/);
  });

  it("still requires both env flags when isolation claimed", () => {
    const env = {
      SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED: "1",
      SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_ISOLATION_PROVEN: "1",
    } as unknown as NodeJS.ProcessEnv;
    expect(canAttachWebSearchTool(analysePolicy, env)).toBe(true);
  });

  it("sanitizer blocks or redacts secrets in public query formulation", () => {
    const r = preparePublicWebQuery(
      "search for sk-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789 and project /Users/morris/secret/path",
    );
    if (r.ok) {
      expect(r.query).not.toMatch(/sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}/);
      expect(r.redactions.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    } else {
      expect(r.reason.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }
  });

  it("refuses tool for simple profile even if isolation proven", () => {
    const env = {
      SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED: "1",
      SFIA_WEB_SEARCH_ISOLATION_PROVEN: "1",
    } as unknown as NodeJS.ProcessEnv;
    const simple = { profile: "simple", profileType: "STANDARD" } as unknown as CognitivePolicy;
    expect(canAttachWebSearchTool(simple, env)).toBe(false);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  coverageFromObservation,
  sanitizePublicWebQuery,
} from "@/domains/conversation/web-search-sanitize";

describe("ML5 B — web query sanitization", () => {
  it("allows a public documentation query", () => {
    const r = sanitizePublicWebQuery("Cursor TypeScript SDK local agent documentation");
    expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
    expect(r.query).toMatch(/Cursor/);
  });

  it("blocks secretish keywords", () => {
    const r = sanitizePublicWebQuery("find my api_key for production");
    expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
    expect(r.blockedReason).toBe("SECRETISH_CONTENT");
  });

  it("redacts tokens and paths", () => {
    const r = sanitizePublicWebQuery(
      "docs for sk-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012345 at /Users/morris/workspace/demo",
    );
    expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
    expect(r.query).not.toMatch(/sk-/);
    expect(r.query).not.toMatch(/\/Users\//);
    expect(r.redactions.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

  it("distinguishes citation from page opened", () => {
    expect(coverageFromObservation({ hasCitation: true })).toBe("CITED");
    expect(coverageFromObservation({ action: "open_page" })).toBe("PAGE_OPENED");
    expect(coverageFromObservation({ action: "search" })).toBe("URL_DISCOVERED");
    expect(coverageFromObservation({ searchEngaged: true })).toBe("SEARCH_ENGAGED");
  });
});

import { mkdtempSync, realpathSync, rmSync, symlinkSync, writeFileSync } from "fs";
import { tmpdir } from "os";
import { join } from "path";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { resolveCursorWorkspace } from "@/domains/execution/workspace-resolver";
import { StudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";

describe("ML5 P0-02 — workspace confinement", () => {
  it("resolves under approved root with hashed pilot/project segments", () => {
    const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "sfia-ws-"));
    const r = resolveCursorWorkspace({
      pilotId: "pilot_a",
      projectId: "proj_b",
      workspaceKey: "default",
      env: { SFIA_CURSOR_WORKSPACE_ROOT: root } as unknown as NodeJS.ProcessEnv,
    });
    expect(r.workspaceCwd.startsWith(realpathSync(root))).toBe(true);
    expect(r.workspaceKey).toBe("default");
  });

  it("rejects absolute client cwd", () => {
    const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "sfia-ws-"));
    expect(() =>
      resolveCursorWorkspace({
        pilotId: "p",
        projectId: "j",
        clientDeclaredCwd: "/etc/passwd",
        env: { SFIA_CURSOR_WORKSPACE_ROOT: root } as unknown as NodeJS.ProcessEnv,
      }),
    ).toThrow(StudioError);
  });

  it("rejects traversal workspaceKey", () => {
    const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "sfia-ws-"));
    expect(() =>
      resolveCursorWorkspace({
        pilotId: "p",
        projectId: "j",
        workspaceKey: "../escape",
        env: { SFIA_CURSOR_WORKSPACE_ROOT: root } as unknown as NodeJS.ProcessEnv,
      }),
    ).toThrow(StudioError);
  });

  it("rejects symlink escaping the root", () => {
    const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "sfia-ws-"));
    const outside = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "sfia-out-"));
    writeFileSync(join(outside, "secret.txt"), "x");
    // Build the expected sandbox path then replace leaf with symlink out.
    const first = resolveCursorWorkspace({
      pilotId: "p1",
      projectId: "j1",
      workspaceKey: "linkme",
      env: { SFIA_CURSOR_WORKSPACE_ROOT: root } as unknown as NodeJS.ProcessEnv,
    });
    rmSync(first.workspaceCwd, { recursive: true, force: true });
    symlinkSync(outside, first.workspaceCwd);
    expect(() =>
      resolveCursorWorkspace({
        pilotId: "p1",
        projectId: "j1",
        workspaceKey: "linkme",
        ensureDir: false,
        env: { SFIA_CURSOR_WORKSPACE_ROOT: root } as unknown as NodeJS.ProcessEnv,
      }),
    ).toThrow(StudioError);
  });

  it("requires SFIA_CURSOR_WORKSPACE_ROOT", () => {
    expect(() =>
      resolveCursorWorkspace({
        pilotId: "p",
        projectId: "j",
        env: {} as unknown as NodeJS.ProcessEnv,
      }),
    ).toThrow(/SFIA_CURSOR_WORKSPACE_ROOT/);
  });
});
```
