```typescript
import { describe, expect, it, vi, afterEach } from "vitest";
import {
  categorizeProviderError,
  extractProviderErrorDiagnostics,
  generateNoraReply,
} from "@/domains/conversation/nora-adapter";
import { buildCognitivePolicy } from "@/domains/conversation/cognitive-policy";
import { redactDeep } from "@/lib/observability";

describe("FIX-SDK / SDK-RETRY — no automatic second run()", () => {
  const prevLane = process.env.STUDIO_LANE;
  const prevE2e = process.env.STUDIO_E2E;
  const prevForce = process.env.STUDIO_FORCE_NORA_FIXTURE;
  const prevKey = process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;
  const prevCog = process.env.SFIA_COG_PROFILE_TYPE;

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.resetModules();
    vi.doUnmock("@openai/agents");
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
    if (prevLane === undefined) delete process.env.STUDIO_LANE;
    else process.env.STUDIO_LANE = prevLane;
    if (prevE2e === undefined) delete process.env.STUDIO_E2E;
    else process.env.STUDIO_E2E = prevE2e;
    if (prevForce === undefined) delete process.env.STUDIO_FORCE_NORA_FIXTURE;
    else process.env.STUDIO_FORCE_NORA_FIXTURE = prevForce;
    if (prevKey === undefined) delete process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;
    else process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY = prevKey;
    if (prevCog === undefined) delete process.env.SFIA_COG_PROFILE_TYPE;
    else process.env.SFIA_COG_PROFILE_TYPE = prevCog;
  });

  it("categorizes errors without exposing raw provider text as category", () => {
    const c = categorizeProviderError(new Error("sk-abcdef1234567890 rate limit 429 from api.openai.com"));
    expect(c.category).toMatch(/PROVIDER_/);
    expect(c.category).not.toContain("sk-");
  });

  it("R05 OBS: extracts allowlisted diagnostics without raw message or secrets", () => {
    const inner = new Error("sk-abcdef1234567890 leaked prompt body");
    inner.name = "APIError";
    (inner as Error & { status: number; code: string }).status = 429;
    (inner as Error & { code: string }).code = "rate_limit_exceeded";
    const outer = new Error("wrapper");
    outer.name = "h";
    (outer as Error & { cause: Error }).cause = inner;
    const d = extractProviderErrorDiagnostics(outer, {
      phase: "stream_drain",
      streamingDelivered: true,
      toolCallsObserved: 2,
    });
    expect(d.error_name).toBe("APIError");
    expect(d.error_name_stable).toBe("APIError");
    expect(d.error_code).toBe("rate_limit_exceeded");
    expect(d.http_status).toBe(429);
    expect(d.streaming_delivered).toBe(true);
    expect(d.tool_calls_observed).toBe(2);
    expect(d.cause_depth).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(d.msg_fingerprint).toMatch(/^[a-f0-9]{16}$/);
    const serialized = JSON.stringify(d);
    expect(serialized).not.toContain("sk-abcdef");
    expect(serialized).not.toContain("leaked prompt");
    expect(serialized).not.toContain("wrapper");
  });

  it("UAT-03 OBS: Invalid output type (space) → SCHEMA_OR_OUTPUT + zod path", () => {
    const err = new Error(
      'Invalid output type: final assistant output failed schema validation at "visualComposition.blocks.1.steps.0.detail" (Too big: expected string to have <=400 characters).',
    );
    err.name = "h"; // production minify of ModelBehaviorError
    const c = categorizeProviderError(err);
    expect(c.category).toBe("PROVIDER_SCHEMA_OR_OUTPUT");
    const d = extractProviderErrorDiagnostics(err, {
      phase: "stream_drain",
      streamingDelivered: true,
      toolCallsObserved: 0,
    });
    expect(d.error_kind).toBe("structured_output_schema_validation");
    expect(d.error_name_stable).toBe("ModelBehaviorError");
    expect(d.zod_issue_path).toBe("visualComposition.blocks.1.steps.0.detail");
    expect(d.validation_rule_hint).toBe("max_length");
    expect(JSON.stringify(d)).not.toContain("Too big");
  });

  it("UAT-03 OBS: timed out → INTERRUPTED; Model did not produce → not false SCHEMA", () => {
    expect(categorizeProviderError(new Error("Model call timed out after 120000ms.")).category).toBe(
      "PROVIDER_INTERRUPTED",
    );
    expect(
      categorizeProviderError(new Error("Model did not produce a final response!")).category,
    ).toBe("PROVIDER_ERROR");
  });

  it("R05 OBS: redaction drops sensitive simulated strings in deep structures", () => {
    const scrubbed = redactDeep({
      authorization: "Bearer secret",
      meta: { error_name: "APIError", note: "SYNTH_SECRET_PROBE_DO_NOT_LOG_X" },
    });
    expect(JSON.stringify(scrubbed)).not.toContain("Bearer secret");
    expect(JSON.stringify(scrubbed)).toContain("[REDACTED");
  });

  async function runOnceScenario(message: string) {
    process.env.STUDIO_LANE = "DEV";
    delete process.env.STUDIO_E2E;
    delete process.env.STUDIO_FORCE_NORA_FIXTURE;
    process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY = "sk-test-not-real-but-present";
    process.env.SFIA_COG_PROFILE_TYPE = "TEST_BOUNDARY";

    const runMock = vi.fn(async () => {
      throw new Error(message);
    });

    vi.doMock("@openai/agents", () => ({
      Agent: class {
        // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-useless-constructor
        constructor(_opts: unknown) {}
      },
      run: runMock,
      setTracingDisabled: vi.fn(),
      tool: vi.fn(),
    }));

    const { generateNoraReply: gen } = await import("@/domains/conversation/nora-adapter");
    const policy = buildCognitivePolicy("Compare option A et B", "TEST_BOUNDARY");
    const result = await gen({
      userText: "Compare option A et B",
      contextSnippets: [],
      policyOverride: policy,
    });
    return { runMock, result };
  }

  it("SDK-RETRY-01: invalid model settings after run() → single invocation, non-COMPLETE", async () => {
    const { runMock, result } = await runOnceScenario("invalid model settings rejected by API");
    expect(runMock).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(result.status).not.toBe("COMPLETE");
    expect(result.attempts.length).toBe(1);
    expect(result.attempts[0].providerContacted).toBe("UNCERTAIN");
    expect(JSON.stringify(result)).not.toContain("invalid model settings rejected");
  });

  it("SDK-RETRY-01: ECONNRESET / 429 / 503 each invoke run() once only", async () => {
    for (const msg of ["ECONNRESET mid stream", "HTTP 429 rate limited", "503 upstream unavailable"]) {
      vi.resetModules();
      vi.doUnmock("@openai/agents");
      const { runMock, result } = await runOnceScenario(msg);
      expect(runMock).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(result.status).not.toBe("COMPLETE");
    }
  });

  it("SDK-RETRY-02: error before Runner import path still fails closed without COMPLETE LIVE", async () => {
    process.env.STUDIO_LANE = "DEV";
    process.env.STUDIO_E2E = "1";
    process.env.SFIA_COG_PROFILE_TYPE = "TEST_BOUNDARY";
    delete process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;
    const result = await generateNoraReply({
      userText: "Merci",
      contextSnippets: [],
    });
    expect(result.mode).toBe("deterministic-fixture");
    expect(result.status).toBe("COMPLETE");
    expect(result.modelApplied).toBe("deterministic-fixture");
  });

  it("does not claim CKI DELIVERED when generate fails before a fixture or provider body", async () => {
    process.env.STUDIO_LANE = "RECETTE";
    process.env.STUDIO_E2E = "1";
    delete process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;
    const blocked = await generateNoraReply({
      userText: "Merci",
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it, afterEach } from "vitest";
import {
  generateNoraReply,
  mustUseNoraFixture,
  noraFixtureFlagsOutsideDev,
} from "@/domains/conversation/nora-adapter";

describe("Nora E2E / lane fixture boundaries", () => {
  const prev = {
    e2e: process.env.STUDIO_E2E,
    key: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY,
    force: process.env.STUDIO_FORCE_NORA_FIXTURE,
    lane: process.env.STUDIO_LANE,
  };

  afterEach(() => {
    const map: Record<string, string | undefined> = {
      STUDIO_E2E: prev.e2e,
      OPENAI_API_KEY: prev.key,
      STUDIO_FORCE_NORA_FIXTURE: prev.force,
      STUDIO_LANE: prev.lane,
    };
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(map)) {
      if (v === undefined) delete process.env[k];
      else process.env[k] = v;
    }
  });

  it("DEV + STUDIO_E2E=1 → fixture COMPLETE even if key present (no LIVE path)", async () => {
    process.env.STUDIO_E2E = "1";
    process.env.STUDIO_LANE = "DEV";
    process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY = "sk-test-must-not-be-used";
    expect(mustUseNoraFixture()).toBe(true);
    expect(noraFixtureFlagsOutsideDev()).toBe(false);
    const result = await generateNoraReply({
      userText: "ping e2e isolation",
      contextSnippets: [],
    });
    expect(result.mode).toBe("deterministic-fixture");
    expect(result.status).toBe("COMPLETE");
    expect(result.content.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(result.qualification?.status).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it("DEV without E2E/force + no key → fixture COMPLETE (local DEV convenience)", async () => {
    delete process.env.STUDIO_E2E;
    delete process.env.STUDIO_FORCE_NORA_FIXTURE;
    process.env.STUDIO_LANE = "DEV";
    delete process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;
    expect(mustUseNoraFixture()).toBe(false);
    // Without E2E flag, fixtureSemanticQualify is blocked — force E2E for deterministic path.
    process.env.STUDIO_E2E = "1";
    const result = await generateNoraReply({ userText: "dev no key", contextSnippets: [] });
    expect(result.status).toBe("COMPLETE");
    expect(result.mode).toBe("deterministic-fixture");
  });

  it("RECETTE + STUDIO_E2E=1 → FAILED (no FAKE COMPLETE, no LIVE)", async () => {
    process.env.STUDIO_E2E = "1";
    process.env.STUDIO_LANE = "RECETTE";
    process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY = "sk-test-must-not-be-used";
    expect(mustUseNoraFixture()).toBe(false);
    expect(noraFixtureFlagsOutsideDev()).toBe(true);
    const result = await generateNoraReply({ userText: "blocked", contextSnippets: [] });
    expect(result.status).toBe("FAILED");
    expect(result.content).toMatch(/NORA_FIXTURE_LANE_FORBIDDEN/);
    expect(result.content).not.toMatch(/fixture FAKE, not LIVE/);
  });

  it("STABLE + STUDIO_E2E=1 → FAILED", async () => {
    process.env.STUDIO_E2E = "1";
    process.env.STUDIO_LANE = "STABLE";
    delete process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;
    const result = await generateNoraReply({ userText: "blocked", contextSnippets: [] });
    expect(result.status).toBe("FAILED");
    expect(result.content).toMatch(/NORA_FIXTURE_LANE_FORBIDDEN/);
  });

  it("absent lane + STUDIO_E2E=1 → FAILED", async () => {
    process.env.STUDIO_E2E = "1";
    delete process.env.STUDIO_LANE;
    const result = await generateNoraReply({ userText: "blocked", contextSnippets: [] });
    expect(result.status).toBe("FAILED");
    expect(noraFixtureFlagsOutsideDev()).toBe(true);
  });

  it("RECETTE without key and without E2E flags → FAILED (no silent FAKE)", async () => {
    delete process.env.STUDIO_E2E;
    delete process.env.STUDIO_FORCE_NORA_FIXTURE;
    process.env.STUDIO_LANE = "RECETTE";
    process.env.SFIA_COG_PROFILE_TYPE = "TEST_BOUNDARY";
    delete process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;
    const result = await generateNoraReply({ userText: "no fake", contextSnippets: [] });
    expect(result.status).toBe("FAILED");
    expect(result.content).toMatch(/NORA_LIVE_KEY_REQUIRED/);
    expect(result.content).not.toMatch(/fixture FAKE, not LIVE/);
  });

  it("RECETTE with absent cog profile type → FAILED fail-closed (no silent OPERATIONAL)", async () => {
    delete process.env.STUDIO_E2E;
    delete process.env.STUDIO_FORCE_NORA_FIXTURE;
    delete process.env.SFIA_COG_PROFILE_TYPE;
    process.env.STUDIO_LANE = "RECETTE";
    const result = await generateNoraReply({ userText: "no silent op", contextSnippets: [] });
    expect(result.status).toBe("FAILED");
    expect(result.content).toMatch(/SFIA_COG_PROFILE_TYPE|fail-closed|COG_POLICY/i);
    expect(result.content).not.toMatch(/fixture FAKE, not LIVE/);
  });

  it("STUDIO_FORCE_NORA_FIXTURE outside DEV → FAILED", async () => {
    delete process.env.STUDIO_E2E;
    process.env.STUDIO_FORCE_NORA_FIXTURE = "1";
    process.env.STUDIO_LANE = "RECETTE";
    const result = await generateNoraReply({ userText: "force blocked", contextSnippets: [] });
    expect(result.status).toBe("FAILED");
    expect(mustUseNoraFixture()).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import path from "node:path";
import { z } from "zod";
import { NoraTurnQualificationSchema } from "@/domains/conversation/semantic-qualification";
import {
  parseVisualComposition,
  VISUAL_COMPOSITION_SCHEMA,
  VisualCompositionAgentOutputSchema,
} from "@/domains/conversation/visual-composition";
import { categorizeProviderError } from "@/domains/conversation/nora-adapter";

type JsonSchema = Record<string, unknown>;

async function convert(schema: z.ZodType) {
  const toolsPath = path.resolve(
    process.cwd(),
    "node_modules/@openai/agents-core/dist/utils/tools.mjs",
  );
  const { convertAgentOutputTypeToSerializable } = await import(
    pathToFileURL(toolsPath).href
  );
  return convertAgentOutputTypeToSerializable(schema) as {
    type: string;
    name?: string;
    strict?: boolean;
    schema: JsonSchema;
  };
}

async function loadStrictHelpers() {
  const strictPath = path.resolve(
    process.cwd(),
    "node_modules/@openai/agents-core/dist/utils/strictToolSchema.mjs",
  );
  return import(pathToFileURL(strictPath).href) as Promise<{
    prepareOpenAIStrictToolSchema: (schema: JsonSchema) => { schema: JsonSchema };
  }>;
}

function asObject(node: unknown): JsonSchema | undefined {
  return node && typeof node === "object" && !Array.isArray(node)
    ? (node as JsonSchema)
    : undefined;
}

/** Collect property schemas that are effectively empty `{}` (the PROVIDER_ERROR root cause). */
function findEmptyPropertySchemas(
  node: unknown,
  path = "$",
  out: string[] = [],
): string[] {
  const obj = asObject(node);
  if (!obj) return out;
  const props = asObject(obj.properties);
  if (props) {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(props)) {
      const child = asObject(value);
      if (child) {
        const meaningful = Object.keys(child).filter(
          (k) => k !== "description" && k !== "title",
        );
        if (meaningful.length === 0) {
          out.push(`${path}.properties.${key}`);
        }
        findEmptyPropertySchemas(child, `${path}.properties.${key}`, out);
      }
    }
  }
  for (const key of ["items", "additionalProperties"] as const) {
    if (key in obj) {
      findEmptyPropertySchemas(obj[key], `${path}.${key}`, out);
    }
  }
  for (const key of ["anyOf", "oneOf", "allOf"] as const) {
    const arr = obj[key];
    if (Array.isArray(arr)) {
      arr.forEach((item, i) =>
        findEmptyPropertySchemas(item, `${path}.${key}[${i}]`, out),
      );
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function findOpenRecordObjects(
  node: unknown,
  path = "$",
  out: Array<{ path: string; additionalProperties: unknown }> = [],
): Array<{ path: string; additionalProperties: unknown }> {
  const obj = asObject(node);
  if (!obj) return out;
  if (
    obj.type === "object" &&
    obj.additionalProperties !== undefined &&
    obj.additionalProperties !== false
  ) {
    out.push({ path, additionalProperties: obj.additionalProperties });
  }
  const props = asObject(obj.properties);
  if (props) {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(props)) {
      findOpenRecordObjects(value, `${path}.properties.${key}`, out);
    }
  }
  for (const key of ["items", "additionalProperties"] as const) {
    if (key in obj) findOpenRecordObjects(obj[key], `${path}.${key}`, out);
  }
  for (const key of ["anyOf", "oneOf", "allOf"] as const) {
    const arr = obj[key];
    if (Array.isArray(arr)) {
      arr.forEach((item, i) =>
        findOpenRecordObjects(item, `${path}.${key}[${i}]`, out),
      );
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function collectObjectRequiredGaps(
  node: unknown,
  path = "$",
  out: Array<{ path: string; missingFromRequired: string[] }> = [],
): Array<{ path: string; missingFromRequired: string[] }> {
  const obj = asObject(node);
  if (!obj) return out;
  const props = asObject(obj.properties);
  if (props) {
    const required = Array.isArray(obj.required)
      ? (obj.required as string[])
      : [];
    const missing = Object.keys(props).filter((k) => !required.includes(k));
    if (missing.length > 0) {
      out.push({ path, missingFromRequired: missing });
    }
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(props)) {
      collectObjectRequiredGaps(value, `${path}.properties.${key}`, out);
    }
  }
  if ("items" in obj) collectObjectRequiredGaps(obj.items, `${path}.items`, out);
  for (const key of ["anyOf", "oneOf", "allOf"] as const) {
    const arr = obj[key];
    if (Array.isArray(arr)) {
      arr.forEach((item, i) =>
        collectObjectRequiredGaps(item, `${path}.${key}[${i}]`, out),
      );
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function visualBlockKinds(schema: JsonSchema): string[] {
  const visual = asObject(asObject(schema.properties)?.visualComposition);
  const blocks = asObject(visual?.properties)?.blocks;
  const items = asObject(asObject(blocks)?.items);
  const anyOf = items?.anyOf;
  if (!Array.isArray(anyOf)) return [];
  return anyOf.map((variant) => {
    const kind = asObject(asObject(asObject(variant)?.properties)?.kind);
    return String(kind?.const ?? "");
  });
}

describe("Nora LIVE structured output schema (E05 visualComposition)", () => {
  it("rejects z.unknown visualComposition as empty JSON Schema property", async () => {
    const broken = z.object({
      replyDraft: z.string(),
      visualComposition: z.unknown().optional(),
    });
    const serialized = await convert(broken);
    const visual = asObject(serialized.schema.properties)?.visualComposition;
    expect(visual).toBeDefined();
    expect(
      Object.keys(visual ?? {}).filter((k) => k !== "description"),
    ).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("serializes VisualCompositionAgentOutputSchema without empty property schema", async () => {
    const wrapped = z.object({
      replyDraft: z.string(),
      visualComposition: VisualCompositionAgentOutputSchema.optional(),
    });
    const serialized = await convert(wrapped);
    const visual = asObject(serialized.schema.properties)?.visualComposition;
    expect(visual).toBeDefined();
    expect(Object.keys(visual ?? {}).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(JSON.stringify(visual)).not.toBe("{}");
  });

  it("serializes full NoraTurnQualificationSchema without empty visualComposition", async () => {
    const serialized = await convert(NoraTurnQualificationSchema);
    const visual = asObject(serialized.schema.properties)?.visualComposition;
    expect(visual).toBeDefined();
    const keys = Object.keys(visual ?? {}).filter(
      (k) => k !== "description",
    );
    expect(keys.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(JSON.stringify(visual)).not.toBe("{}");
  });

  it("full D3 schema has no empty property schemas anywhere", async () => {
    const serialized = await convert(NoraTurnQualificationSchema);
    expect(findEmptyPropertySchemas(serialized.schema)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("full D3 schema is a root object with additionalProperties false", async () => {
    const serialized = await convert(NoraTurnQualificationSchema);
    expect(serialized.type).toBe("json_schema");
    expect(serialized.schema.type).toBe("object");
    expect(serialized.schema.additionalProperties).toBe(false);
    expect(Array.isArray(serialized.schema.required)).toBe(true);
  });

  it("serializes all seven visual block variants under anyOf", async () => {
    const serialized = await convert(NoraTurnQualificationSchema);
    expect(visualBlockKinds(serialized.schema).sort()).toEqual([
      "choices",
      "comparison",
      "references",
      "relations",
      "sequence",
      "synthesis",
      "text",
    ]);
  });

  it("criteria[].values serializes as open record (additionalProperties schema)", async () => {
    const serialized = await convert(NoraTurnQualificationSchema);
    const opens = findOpenRecordObjects(serialized.schema);
    const valuesPath =
      "$.properties.visualComposition.properties.blocks.items.anyOf[1].properties.criteria.items.properties.values";
    const hit = opens.find((o) => o.path === valuesPath);
    expect(hit).toBeDefined();
    expect(hit?.additionalProperties).toEqual({ type: "string" });
  });

  it("documents Agents SDK convert path: strict=false for full D3 (optional fields)", async () => {
    const serialized = await convert(NoraTurnQualificationSchema);
    // Production converter falls back when zodTextFormat cannot emit strict SO.
    expect(serialized.strict).toBe(false);
    const gaps = collectObjectRequiredGaps(serialized.schema);
    expect(gaps.some((g) => g.path === "$")).toBe(true);
    expect(
      gaps.find((g) => g.path === "$")?.missingFromRequired,
    ).toEqual(
      expect.arrayContaining([
        "clarifications",
        "continueChoices",
        "visualComposition",
      ]),
    );
  });

  it("openai zodTextFormat rejects full D3 (optional without nullable)", async () => {
    const { zodTextFormat } = await import("openai/helpers/zod");
    expect(() =>
      zodTextFormat(NoraTurnQualificationSchema as never, "output"),
    ).toThrow(/optional\(\).*nullable\(\)/);
  });

  it("Agents SDK prepareOpenAIStrictToolSchema rejects converted D3 schema", async () => {
    const serialized = await convert(NoraTurnQualificationSchema);
    const { prepareOpenAIStrictToolSchema } = await loadStrictHelpers();
    expect(() => prepareOpenAIStrictToolSchema(serialized.schema)).toThrow(
      /strict mode|additionalProperties|anyOf|optional/i,
    );
  });

  it("openai zodTextFormat rejects z.record criteria.values shape", async () => {
    const { zodTextFormat } = await import("openai/helpers/zod");
    const recordShape = z.object({
      values: z.record(z.string(), z.string().max(400)),
    });
    expect(() => zodTextFormat(recordShape as never, "output")).toThrow(
      /additionalProperties: false/,
    );
  });

  it("parseVisualComposition remains fail-closed for invalid composition", () => {
    expect(
      parseVisualComposition({
        schemaVersion: VISUAL_COMPOSITION_SCHEMA,
        blocks: [{ kind: "comparison", id: "c1", title: "t", alternatives: [] }],
      }),
    ).toBeNull();
  });

  it("parseVisualComposition accepts a minimal valid comparison with criteria values record", () => {
    const parsed = parseVisualComposition({
      schemaVersion: VISUAL_COMPOSITION_SCHEMA,
      blocks: [
        {
          kind: "comparison",
          id: "cmp1",
          title: "Options",
          textAlternative: "Deux options.",
          alternatives: [
            { id: "a", title: "A", summary: "Alpha" },
            { id: "b", title: "B", summary: "Beta" },
          ],
          criteria: [
            { id: "c1", label: "Effort", values: { a: "Faible", b: "Élevé" } },
          ],
        },
      ],
    });
    expect(parsed).not.toBeNull();
    expect(parsed?.blocks[0]?.kind).toBe("comparison");
  });

  it("text-only qualification without visualComposition remains valid", () => {
    const parsed = NoraTurnQualificationSchema.safeParse({
      schemaVersion: "ml4c-sem-qual-v1",
      status: "QUALIFIED",
      goal: "goal",
      projectIntention: "intention",
      desiredOutcome: "outcome",
      initialScope: "scope",
      proposedProjectName: "",
      intents: [],
      replyDraft: "Réponse textuelle seule.",
    });
    expect(parsed.success).toBe(true);
    if (parsed.success) {
      expect(parsed.data.visualComposition).toBeUndefined();
    }
  });

  it("categorizes structured-output schema errors distinctly", () => {
    const c = categorizeProviderError(
      new Error("Invalid schema for response_format json_schema: empty object"),
    );
    expect(c.category).toBe("PROVIDER_SCHEMA_OR_OUTPUT");
    expect(c.category).not.toContain("Invalid schema");
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

/**
 * Structural proof: LIVE agent instructions include sas maturation duties
 * in the same qualification turn (no second prompt). Does not prove LIVE cognition.
 */
describe("Nora LIVE instructions — sas maturation (structural)", () => {
  const src = readFileSync(
    join(__dirname, "../../src/domains/conversation/nora-adapter.ts"),
    "utf8",
  );

  it("embeds maturation responsibilities in QUALIFICATION_INSTRUCTIONS", () => {
    expect(src).toContain("MATURATION DU SAS");
    expect(src).toContain("Comprendre l'intention libre");
    expect(src).toContain("projectIntention");
    expect(src).toContain("demande de tour (goal) et intention métier durable");
    expect(src).toContain("desiredOutcome / initialScope");
    expect(src).toContain("Respecter négations et corrections");
    expect(src).toContain("preparationAssessment");
    expect(src).toContain("jamais un GO de création");
    expect(src).toContain("omets preparationAssessment");
    expect(src).toContain("questions encore ouvertes");
    // Single agent / single outputType — no second LLM for aperçu.
    // E05 freeze (Morris 19/11): LIVE uses NoraTurnQualificationLiveOutputSchema (no visualComposition).
    expect(src).toContain("NoraTurnQualificationLiveOutputSchema");
    expect(src).toMatch(
      /outputType:\s*E05_VISUAL_COMPOSITION_FROZEN\s*\?\s*NoraTurnQualificationLiveOutputSchema\s*:\s*NoraTurnQualificationAgentSchema/,

    const maturationBlocks = src.split("MATURATION DU SAS").length - 1;

});
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  PREPARATIONS_PAGE_SIZE,
  decodePreparationsCursor,
  encodePreparationsCursor,
} from "@/domains/identity/portfolio-cursor";
import { preparationDisplayLabel } from "@/domains/identity/portfolio-labels";
import { StudioError } from "@/lib/http-errors";

describe("A1 preparations cursor", () => {
  it("round-trips opaque keyset cursor", () => {
    const createdAt = new Date("2026-11-08T10:00:00.000Z");
    const encoded = encodePreparationsCursor({ createdAt, id: "prep-1" });
    const decoded = decodePreparationsCursor(encoded);
    expect(decoded).toEqual({ createdAt: createdAt.toISOString(), id: "prep-1" });
  });

  it("rejects malformed cursor as INVALID_CURSOR (400)", () => {
    expect(() => decodePreparationsCursor("not-a-cursor")).toThrow(StudioError);
    try {
      decodePreparationsCursor("%%%");
    } catch (e) {
      expect(e).toBeInstanceOf(StudioError);
      expect((e as StudioError).httpStatus).toBe(400);
      expect((e as StudioError).message).toBe("INVALID_CURSOR");
    }
  });

  it("uses page size 25", () => {
    expect(PREPARATIONS_PAGE_SIZE).toBe(25);
  });
});

describe("A1 preparation labels", () => {
  it("stays neutral when preview empty", () => {
    expect(preparationDisplayLabel({ id: "abcdefghij" })).toBe("Préparation abcdefgh");

    expect(
      preparationDisplayLabel({
        id: "x",
        previewName: "  Sas alpha  ",
        previewSummary: "ignored",
      }),
    ).toBe("Sas alpha");
  });
});
```

```markdown
| Champ | Valeur |

Il ne modifie ni SEF, ni Roadmap, ni ADR, ni spécifications R2 propriétaires ; il ne remplace pas une revue exhaustive des flux, invariants, tests et preuves LIVE/REAL.

# 1. Résultat recherché et trajectoire

## 1.1. Capacité intégratrice

La cible utilisateur est une chaîne complète et gouvernée :

**Intention → investigation séquencée par Nora → contrat unique/versionné → inspection 50/50 → autorisation explicite Exécuter → tentative Cursor → suivi observable → rapport et preuve → analyse de Nora → décision éventuelle du Pilote → reprise contextualisée.**

Trois capacités cognitives doivent servir **toutes les activités pertinentes de Nora**, et non exclusivement Cursor ou le chat projet :

1. **Investigation approfondie et séquencée**, avec sélection proportionnée des sources, suivi de dépendances, confrontation, consolidation et traitement explicite des limites.
2. **Recherche et lecture web publiques**, en lecture seule, sourcées et sécurisées ; résultats trouvés ≠ pages réellement consultées.
3. **Activité Nora fonctionnelle observable pendant le travail**, synthétique et honnête, sans exposer une chaîne de pensée privée ni inventer une progression.

ML5 est le lot intégrateur de ces fondations et de la réalisation technique Cursor, sans deuxième moteur de Nora, D7, décisions ou résultats.

## 1.2. Parcours UX déjà retenu comme base D0

- Travail : rail de navigation fixe, fil Nora central, visionneuse de contrat à droite en **50/50 horizontal**.
- Carte conversationnelle : **Voir le contrat / Ouvrir dans Exécution**, pas de bouton d'exécution directe sur la carte.
- Visionneuse : quatre engagements, six volets, instruction technique complète, Exécuter ; **pas de bouton Agrandir**.
- Confirmation unique et courte : **« Êtes-vous sûr de vouloir lancer l'exécution ? »**, réponses **Non / Oui**.
- Après Oui : fiche de la tentative dans **Exécution**, sans inventer une prise en charge Cursor.
- Exécution : historique, contrat inspectable, états réellement observables ; suivi en **zone gauche situation/mandat** et **zone droite rapports/résultats**, sans chat ni compositeur.
- Résultats & preuves : **consultation**, avec analyse favorable/réservée/défavorable/indéterminée de Nora, références et réserves ; **pas de boutons Accepter / Refuser / Reporter**.
- **En discuter avec Nora** : référence au bilan jointe au **prochain message préparé**, modifiable et retirable ; aucun envoi automatique.
- Activité Nora : vue compacte et détails repliables, partout où Nora travaille ; **transparence seulement**, pas de micro-interruption.

Ce sont des orientations de conception et de wireframe v0.4, **pas une preuve de correspondance Figma ni un écran Next implémenté**.
```
